Parameter dan counter
    1 | #==============================================================================
    2 | # Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    3 | # Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    4 | # File Name    : SDAOISL10Gto10G.xdc
    5 | # Target Board : ALINX AXKU062 (AMD Xilinx Kintex UltraScale xcku060-ffva1156-2-i)
    6 | # Description  : Physical Pin, GTH Quad X1Y2 Co-Location, CDC Timing, and 
    7 | #                3 Stage-Dedicated ChipScope ILA Cores (TX, GTH, RX)
    8 | #
    9 | # Revision History:
   10 | #   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Physical constraints and 3 stage-dedicated ILA cores.
   11 | #   - Rev 2.7 (2026-10-30 02:53 KST) : [Audit Fix N15 - Exact Differential Clock Pins]
   12 | #     1. Aligned 200 MHz differential system oscillator pins with ALINX AXKU062 
   13 | #        User Manual Section 2.3 (Page 16): sys_clk_p = Pin AK17, sys_clk_n = Pin AK16
   14 | #        (Bank 45, DIFF_HSTL_I_18) with explicit 5.000 ns period create_clock.
   15 | #     2. Added explicit GTH reference clock N-side pin assignment (fso_refclk_n = Pin T5).
   16 | #==============================================================================
   17 | 
   18 | # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   19 | # 1. BITSTREAM & SPI FLASH CONFIGURATION PROPERTIES
   20 | # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   21 | set_property BITSTREAM.CONFIG.SPI_BUSWIDTH 8 [current_design]
   22 | set_property CONFIG_MODE SPIx8 [current_design]
   23 | set_property BITSTREAM.CONFIG.CONFIGRATE 50 [current_design]
   24 | set_property BITSTREAM.GENERAL.COMPRESS TRUE [current_design]
   25 | set_property BITSTREAM.CONFIG.UNUSEDPIN PULLUP [current_design]
   26 | 
   27 | # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   28 | # 2. SYSTEM DIFFERENTIAL CLOCK (200 MHz Oscillator -> Pin AK17 / AK16, Bank 45)
   29 | # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   30 | set_property PACKAGE_PIN AK17 [get_ports sys_clk_p]
   31 | set_property PACKAGE_PIN AK16 [get_ports sys_clk_n]
   32 | set_property IOSTANDARD DIFF_HSTL_I_18 [get_ports sys_clk_p]
   33 | set_property IOSTANDARD DIFF_HSTL_I_18 [get_ports sys_clk_n]
   34 | create_clock -name clk_sys_200m -period 5.000 [get_ports sys_clk_p]
   35 | 
   36 | # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   37 | # 3. GTH REFERENCE CLOCK & QUAD X1Y2 CO-LOCATION (156.25 MHz -> Pin T6 / T5)
   38 | # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   39 | set_property PACKAGE_PIN T6 [get_ports fso_refclk_p]
   40 | set_property PACKAGE_PIN T5 [get_ports fso_refclk_n]
   41 | create_clock -name clk_fso_refclk_p -period 6.400 [get_ports fso_refclk_p]
   42 | 
   43 | set_property LOC GTHE3_COMMON_X1Y2 [get_cells {u_fso_gth_core/u_gth_fso_64b66b/inst/gen_gtwizard_gthe3_top.gth_fso_64b66b_gtwizard_gthe3_inst/gen_gtwizard_gthe3.gen_common.gen_common_container[3].gen_enabled_common.gthe3_common_wrapper_inst/common_inst/gthe3_common_gen.GTHE3_COMMON_PRIM_INST}]
   44 | set_property LOC GTHE3_CHANNEL_X1Y8 [get_cells {u_fso_gth_core/u_gth_fso_64b66b/inst/gen_gtwizard_gthe3_top.gth_fso_64b66b_gtwizard_gthe3_inst/gen_gtwizard_gthe3.gen_channel_container[3].gen_enabled_channel.gthe3_channel_wrapper_inst/channel_inst/gthe3_channel_gen.gen_gthe3_channel_inst[0].GTHE3_CHANNEL_PRIM_INST}]
   45 | 
   46 | # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   47 | # 4. SFP+ OPTICAL MODULE CONTROL & BOARD COOLING FAN PINS (LVCMOS18)
   48 | # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   49 | set_property PACKAGE_PIN AN11 [get_ports {tx_disable[0]}]
   50 | set_property PACKAGE_PIN AM11 [get_ports {tx_disable[1]}]
   51 | set_property IOSTANDARD LVCMOS18 [get_ports {tx_disable[0]}]
   52 | set_property IOSTANDARD LVCMOS18 [get_ports {tx_disable[1]}]
   53 | 
   54 | set_property PACKAGE_PIN AK11 [get_ports fan]
   55 | set_property IOSTANDARD LVCMOS18 [get_ports fan]
   56 | 
   57 | # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   58 | # 5. ASYNCHRONOUS CLOCK DOMAIN CROSSING (CDC) & GTH CLOCK GROUPS
   59 | # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   60 | set_clock_groups -asynchronous \
   61 |     -group [get_clocks -include_generated_clocks -of_objects [get_pins clk_wiz_0_inst/inst/mmcme3_adv_inst/CLKOUT0]] \
   62 |     -group [get_clocks -include_generated_clocks -of_objects [get_pins clk_wiz_0_inst/inst/mmcme3_adv_inst/CLKOUT1]] \

    1 | # ==============================================================================
    2 | # Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    3 | # Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    4 | # File Name    : setup_all_25_waveforms.tcl
    5 | # Description  : Unified Auto-Grouping Waveform Script for All 25 Testbenches
    6 | #                in the SDA OISL 10G-to-10G Optical Communication Project.
    7 | #                - Keeps standard default Vivado waveform colors.
    8 | #                - Automatically sets Radix (unsigned for counters/indices,
    9 | #                  ascii for string tags, hex for data/header/CRC buses).
   10 | #
   11 | # Revision History:
   12 | #   - Rev 1.0 (2026-10-27) : Initial 25-testbench auto-grouping Tcl dispatcher.
   13 | #   - Rev 2.3 (2026-10-29 01:49 KST) : Synchronized all 25 testbench waveform
   14 | #     groups to include unified frame_id, frame_type_str ("DAT1", "DAT2", 
   15 | #     "IDLE", "MGMT"), in_clk_cnt, in_byte_cnt, out_clk_cnt, out_byte_cnt, 
   16 | #     and scoreboard telemetry counters.
   17 | #
   18 | # Usage        : In Vivado Tcl Console (while any simulation is open), run:
   19 | #                  source setup_all_25_waveforms.tcl
   20 | # ==============================================================================
   21 | 
   22 | # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   23 | # HELPER PROCEDURE: Safely adds a list of signals into a collapsible Wave Group
   24 | #                   with automatic Radix formatting and default Vivado colors.
   25 | # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   26 | proc add_grp_sigs {grp_title top_scope sig_list} {
   27 |     set grp_obj [add_wave_group $grp_title]
   28 |     foreach s $sig_list {
   29 |         set full_path "/${top_scope}/${s}"
   30 |         set obj [get_objects -quiet $full_path]
   31 |         if {[llength $obj] > 0} {
   32 |             set w [add_wave -into $grp_obj $obj]
   33 |             set s_low [string tolower $s]
   34 |             # Auto-select Radix based on signal name convention (colors untouched)
   35 |             if {[string match "*_str*" $s_low] || [string match "*ascii*" $s_low]} {
   36 |                 set_property radix ascii $w
   37 |             } elseif {[string match "time_*" $s_low] || [string match "oisl_*" $s_low] || [string match "measured_*" $s_low]} {
   38 |                 # Real/floating-point metric signals keep default real format
   39 |             } elseif {[string match "*_cnt*" $s_low] || [string match "*_idx*" $s_low] || \
   40 |                       [string match "*_index*" $s_low] || [string match "*_bytes*" $s_low] || \
   41 |                       [string match "*_words*" $s_low] || [string match "*frame_id*" $s_low] || \
   42 |                       [string match "*_size*" $s_low] || [string match "*_disp*" $s_low] || \
   43 |                       [string match "*repaired*" $s_low] || [string match "*_pass_*" $s_low] || \
   44 |                       [string match "*_ok_*" $s_low] || [string match "*_err_*" $s_low] || \
   45 |                       [string match "*tracker*" $s_low] || [string match "*scenario_id*" $s_low] || \
   46 |                       [string match "*_sequence*" $s_low] || [string match "*_tod_*" $s_low] || \
   47 |                       [string match "*_sec*" $s_low] || [string match "*_picosec*" $s_low] || \
   48 |                       [string match "*_acc*" $s_low]} {
   49 |                 set_property radix unsigned $w
   50 |             } else {
   51 |                 catch {set_property radix hex $w}
   52 |             }
   53 |         }
   54 |     }
   55 | }
   56 | 
   57 | # ==============================================================================
   58 | # 1. tb_fso_header_top (4 Frames: DAT1, DAT2, IDLE, MGMT)
   59 | # ==============================================================================
   60 | proc wave_tb_fso_header_top {} {
   61 |     set t "tb_fso_header_top"
   62 |     add_grp_sigs "1_Clocks_and_Frame_ID" $t {clk rst_n frame_id frame_type_str scenario_id trigger_header_gen system_busy}
   63 |     add_grp_sigs "2_Table_2_9_Header_Inputs" $t {txfn_in rxfn_in ack_in ack_valid_in frame_type_in tx_ts_in tod_seconds_in ts_applies_in fcch_opcode_in fcch_pl_in}
   64 |     add_grp_sigs "3_Serialized_16B_Header_and_CRC16_Out" $t {final_header_valid final_header_byte byte_tracker out_clk_cnt out_byte_cnt total_hdr_bytes error_cnt}
   65 | }
   66 | 
   67 | # ==============================================================================
   68 | # 2. tb_fso_payload (2000B Jumbo: DAT1, DAT2 Continuation & ARQ Retx)
   69 | # ==============================================================================
   70 | proc wave_tb_fso_payload {} {
   71 |     set t "tb_fso_payload"
   72 |     add_grp_sigs "1_PC_Packet_Gen_2000B" $t {clk rst_n trigger target_frame_size frame_id frame_type_str gen_tvalid gen_tdata gen_tkeep gen_tlast gen_tready}
   73 |     add_grp_sigs "2_FrontEnd_1900B_Segmenter" $t {seg_tvalid seg_tdata seg_tlast seg_tready seg_valid_bytes in_clk_cnt in_byte_cnt}
   74 |     add_grp_sigs "3_FSO_Payload_1912B_Table_2_18" $t {fifo_data_tvalid fifo_data_tdata fifo_data_tlast fifo_data_tready payload_cycle_cnt out_clk_cnt out_byte_cnt frame1_word_cnt frame2_word_cnt f1_pld_hdr f1_pkt_hdr f1_crc32 f2_pld_hdr f2_word1_data f2_word25_fcs f2_crc32}
   75 |     add_grp_sigs "4_ARQ_DDR4_Sniffer_and_Retx" $t {ddr4_write_req ddr4_read_req ddr4_delete_req ddr4_addr retx_data_tvalid retx_data_tdata retx_data_tlast retx_word_cnt retx_last_word_crc32}
   76 | }
   77 | 
   78 | # ==============================================================================
   79 | # 3. tb_idle_MGMT (25-bit PRBS IDLE & 5000 km MGMT Telemetry)
   80 | # ==============================================================================

  364 | # ==============================================================================
  365 | # MASTER AUTO-DISPATCHER: Detects the active simulation top module and runs
  366 | #                         its corresponding waveform grouping procedure.
  367 | # ==============================================================================
  368 | set all_supported_tbs {
  369 |     tb_SDAOISL10Gto10G_top
  370 |     tb_fso_header_top
  371 |     tb_fso_payload
  372 |     tb_idle_MGMT
  373 |     tb_FEC_RS
  374 |     tb_Scrambler_LPC
  375 |     tb_mux_gearbox
  376 |     tb_x_gth_logic
  377 |     tb_cdc_logic_gth
  378 |     tb_eth_rx_front_end_top
  379 |     tb_mux_eth_32
  380 |     tb_arq_tx_controller
  381 |     tb_cdc3_rx_gth_logic
  382 |     tb_demux_decoder
  383 |     tb_error_inject
  384 |     tb_fso_gth_bridge_hotswap
  385 |     tb_gth64b66b_loopback
  386 |     tb_demux_preamble_128
  387 |     tb_lpc_dec_descrambler
  388 |     tb_FEC_Demux
  389 |     tb_rs_decoder_rx
  390 |     tb_cdc4_logic_gth
  391 |     tb_fso_deframer_payload
  392 |     tb_fso_ethernet_deframer
  393 |     tb_reassembly_and_backend
  394 |     tb_eth_tx_back_end_top
  395 | }
  396 | 
  397 | set detected_tb ""
  398 | foreach cand_tb $all_supported_tbs {
  399 |     if {[llength [get_objects -quiet "/${cand_tb}/*"]] > 0} {
  400 |         set detected_tb $cand_tb
  401 |         break
  402 |     }
  403 | }
  404 | 
  405 | if {$detected_tb eq ""} {
  406 |     catch {set detected_tb [get_property top [current_fileset -simset]]}
  407 | }
  408 | 
  409 | if {$detected_tb ne "" && [info procs "wave_${detected_tb}"] ne ""} {
  410 |     puts "=================================================================="
  411 |     puts " \[AUTO-WAVEFORM\] Detected Active Testbench: $detected_tb"
  412 |     puts " \[AUTO-WAVEFORM\] Clearing ungrouped waves and building groups..."
  413 |     puts "=================================================================="
  414 |     catch {remove_wave [get_waves *]}
  415 |     eval "wave_${detected_tb}"
  416 |     catch {wv.zoom.full}
  417 |     puts " \[AUTO-WAVEFORM\] Waveform Groups for $detected_tb Ready!"
  418 | } else {
  419 |     puts " \[WARN\] Could not auto-detect active testbench. You can manually call:"
  420 |     puts "        wave_<tb_name>  (e.g., wave_tb_SDAOISL10Gto10G_top)"
  421 | }

    1 | `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 | Module Name  : FEC_Demux
    7 | Description  : Receiver Baseband FEC Demultiplexer (2072B -> 32B RS Header + 
    8 |                2040B RS Payload).
    9 |                - Receives 259 contiguous 64-bit descrambled words (2072 Bytes) 
   10 |                  per frame from descrambler.v at 200.0 MHz.
   11 |                - Buffers the first 4 words (32 Bytes) into hdr_shift_buf and 
   12 |                  serializes them 1 Byte per cycle (32 cycles) to rs_decoder #(33).
   13 |                - Routes the remaining 255 words (2040 Bytes) directly to the 
   14 |                  64-bit Payload bus (255 cycles) for rs_decoder_64.
   15 |                                1. RS Header Stream : 32 cycles @ 8-bit  (32 Bytes: 16B Data + 16B Parity)
   16 |                                2. RS Payload Stream: 255 cycles @ 64-bit (2040 Bytes: 1912B Data + 128B Parity)
   17 | 
   18 |                Revision Notes:
   19 |                - Added non-intrusive simulation trackers (hdr_out_byte_cnt 1..32,
   20 |                  pld_out_word_cnt 1..255), clocked pld_sim_q writer on negedge clk, 
   21 |                  and maintained continuous 4-frame unpacking (8160 bytes across 
   22 |                  exact 2493.600 ns frame windows) so demux_frame_id counts 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4.
   23 |                - Rev 2.4 (2026-10-29 12:52 KST) : [Audit Fix - Waveform Telemetry Counter Restoration]
   24 |                  Added internal telemetry counters (out_hdr_byte_cnt [1..32], 
   25 |                  out_pld_word_cnt [1..255], and out_pld_byte_cnt [8..2040]) 
   26 |                  referenced by tb_FEC_Demux.v and setup_all_25_waveforms.tcl.
   27 |                - Rev 2.5 (2026-10-29 15:19 KST) : [Audit Fix R03 - Restored 256-Bit Header Serializer & 255-Word Payload Datapath]
   28 |                  Restored the exact 256-bit 'hdr_shift_buf' serializer and 
   29 |                  'in_word_cnt' (0..258) state machine from the verified baseline 
   30 |                  so all 32 Header bytes serialize MSB-first with 0 mismatches and 
   31 |                  strictly 255 Payload words (2040 Bytes) are emitted per frame 
   32 |                  without admitting invalid tail words when en == 0.
   33 | ===========================================================================
   34 | */
   35 | 
   36 | module FEC_Demux (
   37 |     input  wire        clk,
   38 |     input  wire        rst_n,
   39 |     input  wire        en,          // 259 continuous cycles from descrambler
   40 |     input  wire [63:0] data_in,     // 64-bit descrambled word
   41 | 
   42 |     // Output to RS(32,16) Header Decoder (8-bit, 32 cycles = 32 Bytes)
   43 |     output reg         header_dv,
   44 |     output reg  [7:0]  header,
   45 | 
   46 |     // Output to 8xRS(255,239) Payload Decoder (64-bit, 255 cycles = 2040 Bytes)
   47 |     output reg         payload_dv,
   48 |     output reg  [63:0] payload
   49 | );
   50 | 
   51 |     reg [8:0]   in_word_cnt;
   52 |     reg [255:0] hdr_shift_buf;
   53 |     reg [5:0]   hdr_byte_idx;
   54 |     reg         hdr_serializing;
   55 | 
   56 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   57 |         if (!rst_n) begin
   58 |             in_word_cnt     <= 9'd0;
   59 |             hdr_shift_buf   <= 256'd0;
   60 |             hdr_byte_idx    <= 6'd0;
   61 |             hdr_serializing <= 1'b0;
   62 |             header_dv       <= 1'b0;
   63 |             header          <= 8'd0;
   64 |             payload_dv      <= 1'b0;
   65 |             payload         <= 64'd0;
   66 |         end else begin
   67 |             header_dv  <= 1'b0;
   68 |             header     <= 8'd0;
   69 |             payload_dv <= 1'b0;
   70 |             payload    <= 64'd0;
   71 | 
   72 |             // 1. Route first 4 words (32 Bytes) to Header buffer, remaining 255 words (2040 Bytes) to Payload
   73 |             if (en) begin
   74 |                 if (in_word_cnt < 9'd4) begin
   75 |                     case (in_word_cnt[1:0])
   76 |                         2'd0: hdr_shift_buf[255:192] <= data_in;
   77 |                         2'd1: hdr_shift_buf[191:128] <= data_in;
   78 |                         2'd2: hdr_shift_buf[127:64]  <= data_in;
   79 |                         2'd3: begin
   80 |                             hdr_shift_buf[63:0] <= data_in;
   81 |                             hdr_serializing     <= 1'b1;
   82 |                             hdr_byte_idx        <= 6'd0;
   83 |                         end
   84 |                     endcase
   85 |                     in_word_cnt <= in_word_cnt + 9'd1;
   86 |                 end else begin
   87 |                     payload_dv <= 1'b1;
   88 |                     payload    <= data_in;
   89 |                     if (in_word_cnt == 9'd258)
   90 |                         in_word_cnt <= 9'd0;
   91 |                     else
   92 |                         in_word_cnt <= in_word_cnt + 9'd1;
   93 |                 end
   94 |             end else begin
   95 |                 in_word_cnt <= 9'd0;
   96 |             end
   97 | 
   98 |             // 2. Serialize 32-Byte RS Header at 1 Byte per clock cycle (MSB-first)
   99 |             if (hdr_serializing) begin
  100 |                 header_dv     <= 1'b1;
  101 |                 header        <= hdr_shift_buf[255:248];
  102 |                 hdr_shift_buf <= {hdr_shift_buf[247:0], 8'd0};
  103 | 
  104 |                 if (hdr_byte_idx == 6'd31) begin
  105 |                     hdr_serializing <= 1'b0;
  106 |                     hdr_byte_idx    <= 6'd0;
  107 |                 end else begin
  108 |                     hdr_byte_idx <= hdr_byte_idx + 6'd1;
  109 |                 end
  110 |             end
  111 |         end
  112 |     end
  113 | 
  114 |     // =======================================================
  115 |     // 3. TELEMETRY & WAVEFORM TRACKERS: HEADER (1..32B) & PAYLOAD (1..2040B)
  116 |     // =======================================================
  117 |     reg  [5:0]  hdr_out_byte_cnt; // Counts 1..32 during header_dv
  118 |     reg  [8:0]  pld_out_word_cnt; // Counts 1..255 during payload_dv
  119 |     wire [5:0]  out_hdr_byte_cnt = hdr_out_byte_cnt;
  120 |     wire [8:0]  out_pld_word_cnt = pld_out_word_cnt;
  121 |     wire [11:0] out_pld_byte_cnt = {pld_out_word_cnt, 3'b000};
  122 | 
  123 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  124 |         if (!rst_n) begin
  125 |             hdr_out_byte_cnt <= 6'd0;
  126 |             pld_out_word_cnt <= 9'd0;
  127 |         end else begin
  128 |             if (hdr_serializing)
  129 |                 hdr_out_byte_cnt <= hdr_byte_idx + 6'd1;
  130 |             else
  131 |                 hdr_out_byte_cnt <= 6'd0;
  132 | 
  133 |             if (en && (in_word_cnt >= 9'd4))
  134 |                 pld_out_word_cnt <= (in_word_cnt - 9'd3);
  135 |             else
  136 |                 pld_out_word_cnt <= 9'd0;
  137 |         end
  138 |     end
  139 | 
  140 |     // synthesis translate_off
  141 |     reg [7:0]  pld_sim_q [0:16383];
  142 |     integer    pld_wr_ptr;
  143 |     integer    pld_rd_ptr;
  144 |     reg        pld_unpack_active;
  145 | 
  146 |     reg [7:0]  pld_byte_stream;
  147 |     reg [11:0] pld_byte_cnt;     // Counts strictly 1 to 2040 per frame
  148 |     reg [31:0] demux_frame_id;   // Active Frame ID (1, 2, 3, 4)
  149 |     reg [15:0] pld_total_bytes;  // Counts 1 to 8160 (4 x 2040 Bytes)
  150 | 
  151 |     initial begin
  152 |         pld_wr_ptr        = 0;
  153 |         pld_rd_ptr        = 0;
  154 |         pld_unpack_active = 1'b0;
  155 |         pld_byte_stream   = 8'd0;
  156 |         pld_byte_cnt      = 12'd0;
  157 |         demux_frame_id    = 32'd0;
  158 |         pld_total_bytes   = 16'd0;
  159 |     end
  160 | 
  161 |     // THREAD B: Negedge Queue Writer (2.5 ns before posedge clk)
  162 |     always @(negedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  163 |         if (!rst_n) begin
  164 |             pld_wr_ptr = 0;
  165 |         end else if (payload_dv) begin
  166 |             pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 0] = payload[63:56];
  167 |             pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 1] = payload[55:48];
  168 |             pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 2] = payload[47:40];
  169 |             pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 3] = payload[39:32];
  170 |             pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 4] = payload[31:24];
  171 |             pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 5] = payload[23:16];
  172 |             pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 6] = payload[15:8];
  173 |             pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 7] = payload[7:0];
  174 |             pld_wr_ptr                = pld_wr_ptr + 8;
  175 |         end
  176 |     end
  177 | 
  178 |     // THREAD C: Continuous 4-Frame Unpacker (2040 Bytes per 2493.600 ns frame window)
  179 |     real next_pld_edge_ns;
  180 |     always @(posedge clk) begin
  181 |         if (rst_n && en && (in_word_cnt == 9'd4) && !pld_unpack_active) begin
  182 |             pld_unpack_active = 1'b1;
  183 |             #0.001;
  184 |             next_pld_edge_ns  = $realtime;
  185 |             while (pld_total_bytes < 16'd8160) begin
  186 |                 if (pld_rd_ptr == 0)
  187 |                     pld_byte_stream = payload[63:56];
  188 |                 else
  189 |                     pld_byte_stream = pld_sim_q[pld_rd_ptr];
  190 | 
  191 |                 pld_rd_ptr      = pld_rd_ptr + 1;
  192 |                 pld_total_bytes = pld_total_bytes + 16'd1;
  193 | 
  194 |                 if (demux_frame_id == 32'd0) begin
  195 |                     demux_frame_id = 32'd1;
  196 |                     pld_byte_cnt   = 12'd1;
  197 |                 end else if (pld_byte_cnt == 12'd2040) begin
  198 |                     demux_frame_id = demux_frame_id + 32'd1;
  199 |                     pld_byte_cnt   = 12'd1;
  200 |                 end else begin
  201 |                     pld_byte_cnt   = pld_byte_cnt + 12'd1;
  202 |                 end
  203 | 
  204 |                 next_pld_edge_ns = next_pld_edge_ns + (2493.6 / 2040.0);
  205 |                 #((next_pld_edge_ns - $realtime) > 0.0 ? (next_pld_edge_ns - $realtime) : 0.001);
  206 |             end
  207 |             pld_byte_stream   = 8'd0;
  208 |             pld_byte_cnt      = 12'd0;
  209 |             demux_frame_id    = 32'd0;
  210 |             pld_unpack_active = 1'b0;
  211 |         end
  212 |     end
  213 |     // synthesis translate_on
  214 | 
  215 | endmodule

Dependensi: 
Parameter dan counter
    1 | `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Description  : FEC Multiplexer (Replaces combiner.v).
    5 |                Zero-Gap Continuous Streaming (259 Cycles)
    6 |                without using BRAM or large counter delays.
    7 |                
    8 |                Mechanism:
    9 |                1. Absorbs 32-Bytes of RS Header silently into a Shift Register.
   10 |                2. When Payload arrives, it is delayed by exactly 4 clock cycles.
   11 |                3. During those 4 cycles, the 32-Byte Header is blasted out 
   12 |                   at 64-bits per cycle.
   13 |                4. On cycle 5, the Payload emerges and perfectly splices 
   14 |                   behind the Header. Total Output = 4 + 255 = 259 Cycles.
   15 |  FIX: 
   16 |                Implemented edge-detection routing (rs_load_dv && !pipe).
   17 |                This guarantees that the 32-Byte Header is blasted out in 
   18 |                EXACTLY 4 cycles, seamlessly followed by the 255-Word Payload.
   19 |                Total Output = 259 Continuous Cycles (Zero-Gap).
   20 | ===========================================================================
   21 | */
   22 | 
   23 | module FEC_MUX (
   24 |     input               clk,
   25 |     input               rst_n,
   26 |     
   27 |     // Interface from RS Header
   28 |     input               rs_head_dv,
   29 |     input   [7:0]       rs_head,
   30 |     
   31 |     // Interface from RS Payload
   32 |     input               rs_load_dv,
   33 |     input   [63:0]      rs_load,
   34 |     
   35 |     // Continuous Output to Scrambler
   36 |     output              flag,
   37 |     output  [63:0]      data_out
   38 | );
   39 | 
   40 |     // =======================================================
   41 |     // 1. HEADER ABSORPTION (32-Bytes = 256 bits)
   42 |     // =======================================================
   43 |     reg [255:0] hdr_buf;
   44 |     
   45 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   46 |         if (!rst_n) 
   47 |             hdr_buf <= 256'd0;
   48 |         else if (rs_head_dv) 
   49 |             hdr_buf <= {hdr_buf[247:0], rs_head};
   50 |     end
   51 | 
   52 |     // =======================================================
   53 |     // 2. PAYLOAD 4-CYCLE DELAY PIPELINE
   54 |     // =======================================================
   55 |     reg [63:0] load_pipe [0:3];
   56 |     reg [3:0]  load_dv_pipe;
   57 | 
   58 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   59 |         if (!rst_n) begin
   60 |             load_pipe[0] <= 64'd0; load_pipe[1] <= 64'd0;
   61 |             load_pipe[2] <= 64'd0; load_pipe[3] <= 64'd0;
   62 |             load_dv_pipe <= 4'd0;
   63 |         end else begin
   64 |             // Shift Payload Data
   65 |             load_pipe[0] <= rs_load;
   66 |             load_pipe[1] <= load_pipe[0];
   67 |             load_pipe[2] <= load_pipe[1];
   68 |             load_pipe[3] <= load_pipe[2];
   69 |             
   70 |             // Shift Data Valid Flag
   71 |             load_dv_pipe <= {load_dv_pipe[2:0], rs_load_dv};
   72 |         end
   73 |     end
   74 | 
   75 |     // =======================================================
   76 |     // 3. STRICT COMBINATIONAL ROUTING
   77 |     // =======================================================
   78 |     assign data_out = (rs_load_dv      && !load_dv_pipe[0]) ? hdr_buf[255:192] :
   79 |                       (load_dv_pipe[0] && !load_dv_pipe[1]) ? hdr_buf[191:128] :
   80 |                       (load_dv_pipe[1] && !load_dv_pipe[2]) ? hdr_buf[127:64]  :
   81 |                       (load_dv_pipe[2] && !load_dv_pipe[3]) ? hdr_buf[63:0]    :
   82 |                       (load_dv_pipe[3])                     ? load_pipe[3]     : 64'd0;
   83 | 
   84 |     assign flag = rs_load_dv | load_dv_pipe[0] | load_dv_pipe[1] | load_dv_pipe[2] | load_dv_pipe[3];
   85 | 
   86 | endmodule

    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 | Module Name  : FEC_separator (Previously separator.v)
    7 | Description  : FEC Auto-Aligning Demultiplexer (Exact Inverse of FEC_MUX.v).
    8 |                Receives the 259-cycle continuous 64-bit stream (2072 Bytes) 
    9 |                from descrambler.v and separates it into:
   10 |                1. RS Header Stream : 32 cycles @ 8-bit  (32 Bytes: 16B Data + 16B Parity)
   11 |                2. RS Payload Stream: 255 cycles @ 64-bit (2040 Bytes: 1912B Data + 128B Parity)
   12 | ===========================================================================
   13 | */
   14 | 
   15 | module FEC_separator (
   16 |     input  wire        clk,
   17 |     input  wire        rst_n,
   18 |     input  wire        en,          // From descrambler_dv (259 continuous cycles)
   19 |     input  wire [63:0] data_in,     // From descrambler data_out[63:0]
   20 | 
   21 |     // Output to RS(32,16) Header Decoder (8-bit, 32 cycles)
   22 |     output reg         header_dv,
   23 |     output reg  [7:0]  header,
   24 | 
   25 |     // Output to 8xRS(255,239) Payload Decoder (64-bit, 255 cycles)
   26 |     output reg         payload_dv,
   27 |     output reg  [63:0] payload
   28 | );
   29 | 
   30 |     reg [8:0]   in_word_cnt;
   31 |     reg [255:0] hdr_shift_buf;
   32 |     reg [5:0]   hdr_byte_cnt;
   33 |     reg         hdr_serializing;
   34 | 
   35 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   36 |         if (!rst_n) begin
   37 |             in_word_cnt     <= 9'd0;
   38 |             hdr_shift_buf   <= 256'd0;
   39 |             hdr_byte_cnt    <= 6'd0;
   40 |             hdr_serializing <= 1'b0;
   41 |             header_dv       <= 1'b0;
   42 |             header          <= 8'd0;
   43 |             payload_dv      <= 1'b0;
   44 |             payload         <= 64'd0;
   45 |         end else begin
   46 |             // Default de-assertions
   47 |             header_dv  <= 1'b0;
   48 |             header     <= 8'd0;
   49 |             payload_dv <= 1'b0;
   50 |             payload    <= 64'd0;
   51 | 
   52 |             // ---------------------------------------------------
   53 |             // 1. INCOMING 259-CYCLE 64-BIT STREAM ROUTING
   54 |             // ---------------------------------------------------
   55 |             if (en) begin
   56 |                 if (in_word_cnt < 9'd4) begin
   57 |                     // Cycles 0..3: Capture 4 x 64-bit words (256 bits = 32 Bytes) of RS Header
   58 |                     case (in_word_cnt[1:0])
   59 |                         2'd0: hdr_shift_buf[255:192] <= data_in;
   60 |                         2'd1: hdr_shift_buf[191:128] <= data_in;
   61 |                         2'd2: hdr_shift_buf[127:64]  <= data_in;
   62 |                         2'd3: begin
   63 |                             hdr_shift_buf[63:0] <= data_in;
   64 |                             hdr_serializing     <= 1'b1;
   65 |                             hdr_byte_cnt        <= 6'd0;
   66 |                         end
   67 |                     endcase
   68 |                     in_word_cnt <= in_word_cnt + 9'd1;
   69 |                 end else begin
   70 |                     // Cycles 4..258: Forward 255 x 64-bit words (2040 Bytes) to RS Payload Decoder
   71 |                     payload_dv <= 1'b1;
   72 |                     payload    <= data_in;
   73 |                     if (in_word_cnt == 9'd258)
   74 |                         in_word_cnt <= 9'd0;
   75 |                     else
   76 |                         in_word_cnt <= in_word_cnt + 9'd1;
   77 |                 end
   78 |             end else begin
   79 |                 in_word_cnt <= 9'd0;
   80 |             end
   81 | 
   82 |             // ---------------------------------------------------
   83 |             // 2. SERIALIZE 256-BIT HEADER BUFFER (32 CYCLES @ 8-BIT)
   84 |             // Emits MSB-first (hdr_shift_buf[255:248] .. [7:0])
   85 |             // ---------------------------------------------------
   86 |             if (hdr_serializing) begin
   87 |                 header_dv     <= 1'b1;
   88 |                 header        <= hdr_shift_buf[255:248];
   89 |                 hdr_shift_buf <= {hdr_shift_buf[247:0], 8'd0};
   90 | 
   91 |                 if (hdr_byte_cnt == 6'd31) begin
   92 |                     hdr_serializing <= 1'b0;
   93 |                     hdr_byte_cnt    <= 6'd0;
   94 |                 end else begin
   95 |                     hdr_byte_cnt <= hdr_byte_cnt + 6'd1;
   96 |                 end
   97 |             end
   98 |         end
   99 |     end
  100 | 
  101 | endmodule

    1 | `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 | Module Name  : arq_ddr4_wrapper
    7 | Description  : Circular Frame-Indexed ARQ Retransmission Memory Wrapper.
    8 |                Sniffs and stores outgoing 1912-Byte FSO DATA frames (478 words 
    9 |                x 32-bit, including the 4-Byte FSO CRC-32) indexed by TXFN, and 
   10 |                re-emits them upon retransmission requests from arq_tx_controller.
   11 | 
   12 |                Revision Notes:
   13 |                - Separated 'ram_storage' write from asynchronous reset to 
   14 |                  infer true UltraScale Block RAM (RAMB36E2) instead of FFs.
   15 |                - [Rev 2.0 - 2026-10-27 04:19 KST - Target B3.2 Audit Fix]:
   16 |                  Updated LAST_WORD_IDX from 9'd476 to 9'd477 (478 words = 1912 Bytes)
   17 |                  so the 4-Byte FSO CRC-32 is stored and retransmitted intact.
   18 |                - [Rev 2.5 - 2026-10-29 15:19 KST - Audit Fix R10 & R04]:
   19 |                  1. [Fix R10]: Added BRAM read clock-enable gating ('rd_ce') coupled 
   20 |                     strictly to AXI-Stream output acceptance (m_axis_tvalid && m_axis_tready)
   21 |                     so that arbitrary downstream backpressure stalls (arq_ram_stalls.sv) 
   22 |                     preserve all 478 words, 0 mismatches, and exact m_axis_tlast alignment.
   23 |                  2. [Fix R04]: Provided both 'writing_state' and 'is_writing' alias 
   24 |                     for full testbench backward compatibility.
   25 | ===========================================================================
   26 | */
   27 | 
   28 | module arq_ddr4_wrapper #(
   29 |     parameter MAX_FRAMES    = 16,
   30 |     parameter LAST_WORD_IDX = 9'd477 // 0..477 = 478 words = 1912 Bytes (includes 4B CRC-32)
   31 | )(
   32 |     input  wire        clk,
   33 |     input  wire        rst_n,
   34 | 
   35 |     // Control Signals from arq_tx_controller
   36 |     input  wire        ddr4_write_req,
   37 |     input  wire        ddr4_read_req,
   38 |     input  wire        ddr4_delete_req,
   39 |     input  wire [15:0] ddr4_addr,
   40 | 
   41 |     // Passive Sniffer Input (Connected to CRC-32 Output Stream)
   42 |     input  wire [31:0] s_axis_tdata,
   43 |     input  wire        s_axis_tvalid,
   44 |     input  wire        s_axis_tlast,
   45 |     input  wire        s_axis_tready,
   46 | 
   47 |     // Retransmit AXI-Stream Output to fso_payload_mux (Path 11)
   48 |     output reg  [31:0] m_axis_tdata,
   49 |     output reg         m_axis_tvalid,
   50 |     output reg         m_axis_tlast,
   51 |     input  wire        m_axis_tready
   52 | );
   53 | 
   54 |     // 16 Slots x 512 Words x 32-bit = 8192 Words (32 KB Internal Block RAM)
   55 |     (* ram_style = "block" *) reg [31:0] ram_storage [0:8191];
   56 | 
   57 |     /*
   58 |     ===========================================================================
   59 |     [NOTE FOR HARDWARE DDR4 MIG EXPANSION ON ALINX AXKU062 (BANK 44/45/46)]
   60 |     When scaling window capacity to 13,377..16,320 frames (~25.6 MB TX Buffer):
   61 |       - TX Buffer Physical Base Address : 32'h0000_0000
   62 |       - Direct 2KB Slot Byte Address    : {5'd0, ddr4_addr[15:0], 11'd0}
   63 |     ===========================================================================
   64 |     */
   65 | 
   66 |     reg [3:0] write_slot_ptr;
   67 |     reg [8:0] write_word_ptr;
   68 |     reg       writing_state;
   69 |     wire      is_writing = writing_state;
   70 | 
   71 |     reg [3:0] read_slot_ptr;
   72 |     reg [8:0] read_word_ptr;
   73 |     reg       reading_state;
   74 | 
   75 |     wire        stream_handshake = s_axis_tvalid && s_axis_tready;
   76 |     wire        ram_wr_en        = writing_state && stream_handshake;
   77 |     wire [12:0] wr_ram_addr      = {write_slot_ptr, write_word_ptr};
   78 | 
   79 |     // [Rev 2.5 - Fix R10] Advance BRAM read only on initial read request or accepted output beat
   80 |     wire        start_read_now   = ddr4_read_req && !reading_state;
   81 |     wire        advance_read_now = reading_state && m_axis_tvalid && m_axis_tready && !m_axis_tlast;
   82 |     wire        rd_ce            = start_read_now || advance_read_now;
   83 |     wire [12:0] rd_ram_addr      = start_read_now ? {ddr4_addr[3:0], 9'd0} :
   84 |                                                     {read_slot_ptr, read_word_ptr + 9'd1};
   85 | 
   86 |     // Purely Synchronous Block RAM Write & Stall-Protected Read Port
   87 |     always @(posedge clk) begin
   88 |         if (ram_wr_en) begin
   89 |             ram_storage[wr_ram_addr] <= s_axis_tdata;
   90 |         end
   91 |         if (rd_ce) begin
   92 |             m_axis_tdata <= ram_storage[rd_ram_addr];
   93 |         end
   94 |     end
   95 | 
   96 |     // Write Sniffer FSM
   97 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   98 |         if (!rst_n) begin
   99 |             writing_state  <= 1'b0;
  100 |             write_slot_ptr <= 4'd0;
  101 |             write_word_ptr <= 9'd0;
  102 |         end else begin
  103 |             if (ddr4_write_req) begin
  104 |                 writing_state  <= 1'b1;
  105 |                 write_slot_ptr <= ddr4_addr[3:0];
  106 |                 write_word_ptr <= 9'd0;
  107 |             end else if (ram_wr_en) begin
  108 |                 if (s_axis_tlast || (write_word_ptr == LAST_WORD_IDX)) begin
  109 |                     writing_state  <= 1'b0;
  110 |                     write_word_ptr <= 9'd0;
  111 |                 end else begin
  112 |                     write_word_ptr <= write_word_ptr + 9'd1;
  113 |                 end
  114 |             end
  115 |         end
  116 |     end
  117 | 
  118 |     // Stall-Protected Retransmission Readout FSM (Emits all 478 words = 1912 Bytes)
  119 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  120 |         if (!rst_n) begin
  121 |             reading_state <= 1'b0;
  122 |             read_slot_ptr <= 4'd0;
  123 |             read_word_ptr <= 9'd0;
  124 |             m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  125 |             m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  126 |         end else begin
  127 |             if (start_read_now) begin
  128 |                 // Word 0 is fetched into m_axis_tdata by rd_ce on this posedge
  129 |                 reading_state <= 1'b1;
  130 |                 read_slot_ptr <= ddr4_addr[3:0];
  131 |                 read_word_ptr <= 9'd0;
  132 |                 m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b1;
  133 |                 m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  134 |             end else if (reading_state) begin
  135 |                 if (m_axis_tvalid && m_axis_tready) begin
  136 |                     if (m_axis_tlast) begin
  137 |                         reading_state <= 1'b0;
  138 |                         m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  139 |                         m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  140 |                         read_word_ptr <= 9'd0;
  141 |                     end else begin
  142 |                         read_word_ptr <= read_word_ptr + 9'd1;
  143 |                         m_axis_tlast  <= ((read_word_ptr + 9'd1) == LAST_WORD_IDX);
  144 |                     end
  145 |                 end
  146 |             end
  147 |         end
  148 |     end
  149 | 
  150 | endmodule

    1 | `timescale 1ns / 100ps
    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 | Module Name  : arq_rx_controller
    7 | Description  : Selective Repeat ARQ Receiver Controller (Control Plane).
    8 | 
    9 |                KEY OPERATIONS:
   10 |                1. Peer Feedback Forwarding (To Local arq_tx_controller):
   11 |                   When a valid FSO Header arrives (hdr_crc_ok == 1) with 
   12 |                   rx_ack_valid == 1, forwards (rx_rxfn, rx_ack, rx_ack_valid)
   13 |                   to the local transmitter so ACKed frames are deleted from 
   14 |                   TX DDR4 RAM and NAKed frames are immediately retransmitted.
   15 |                2. Local RX CRC-32 Decision & ACK/NAK Generation:
   16 |                   Upon completion of the 1912-Byte Payload CRC-32 check 
   17 |                   (pld_check_done == 1):
   18 |                   - For DATA frames (rx_frame_type == 2'b01):
   19 |                     Generates ACK (local_fb_ack = 1) if pld_crc_ok == 1, or 
   20 |                     NAK (local_fb_ack = 0) if pld_crc_ok == 0, with 
   21 |                     local_fb_rxfn = rx_txfn.
   22 |                   - For IDLE (2'b00) or MGMT (2'b10) frames:
   23 |                     Asserts non_data_seq_adv so the Selective Repeat Reorder 
   24 |                     Buffer advances its expected sequence pointer past the 
   25 |                     non-data frame number without stalling.
   26 | ===========================================================================
   27 | */
   28 | 
   29 | module arq_rx_controller (
   30 |     input  wire        clk,
   31 |     input  wire        rst_n,
   32 | 
   33 |     // Inputs from deframer_header
   34 |     input  wire        hdr_check_done,
   35 |     input  wire        hdr_crc_ok,
   36 |     input  wire [15:0] rx_txfn,
   37 |     input  wire [15:0] rx_rxfn,
   38 |     input  wire        rx_ack,
   39 |     input  wire        rx_ack_valid,
   40 |     input  wire [1:0]  rx_frame_type,
   41 | 
   42 |     // Inputs from deframer_payload
   43 |     input  wire        pld_check_done,
   44 |     input  wire        pld_crc_ok,
   45 | 
   46 |     // Output 1: Peer ARQ Feedback (Forwarded to Local TX arq_tx_controller)
   47 |     output reg  [15:0] peer_rxfn_out,
   48 |     output reg         peer_ack_out,
   49 |     output reg         peer_ack_valid_out,
   50 | 
   51 |     // Output 2: Local RX ACK/NAK Feedback (To Local TX Header Generator)
   52 |     output reg  [15:0] local_fb_rxfn,
   53 |     output reg         local_fb_ack,
   54 |     output reg         local_fb_ack_valid,
   55 | 
   56 |     // Output 3: Control Commands to Selective Repeat Reorder Buffer
   57 |     output reg         non_data_seq_adv,
   58 |     output reg  [15:0] non_data_txfn,
   59 |     output reg  [15:0] ack_sent_cnt,
   60 |     output reg  [15:0] nak_sent_cnt
   61 | );
   62 | 
   63 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   64 |         if (!rst_n) begin
   65 |             peer_rxfn_out      <= 16'd0;
   66 |             peer_ack_out       <= 1'b0;
   67 |             peer_ack_valid_out <= 1'b0;
   68 |             local_fb_rxfn      <= 16'd0;
   69 |             local_fb_ack       <= 1'b0;
   70 |             local_fb_ack_valid <= 1'b0;
   71 |             non_data_seq_adv   <= 1'b0;
   72 |             non_data_txfn      <= 16'd0;
   73 |             ack_sent_cnt       <= 16'd0;
   74 |             nak_sent_cnt       <= 16'd0;
   75 |         end else begin
   76 |             peer_ack_valid_out <= 1'b0;
   77 |             local_fb_ack_valid <= 1'b0;
   78 |             non_data_seq_adv   <= 1'b0;
   79 | 
   80 |             // 1. Forward incoming peer ACK/NAK from verified Header to local TX Controller
   81 |             if (hdr_check_done && hdr_crc_ok && rx_ack_valid) begin
   82 |                 peer_rxfn_out      <= rx_rxfn;
   83 |                 peer_ack_out       <= rx_ack;
   84 |                 peer_ack_valid_out <= 1'b1;
   85 |             end
   86 | 
   87 |             // 2. Evaluate local Payload CRC-32 result & generate outgoing ACK/NAK
   88 |             if (pld_check_done) begin
   89 |                 if (!hdr_crc_ok) begin
   90 |                     // Header was corrupted: cannot trust rx_txfn
   91 |                     local_fb_ack_valid <= 1'b0;
   92 |                 end else if (rx_frame_type == 2'b01) begin
   93 |                     // DATA Frame: Generate ACK (1) on CRC-32 Pass, or NAK (0) on CRC-32 Fail
   94 |                     local_fb_rxfn      <= rx_txfn;
   95 |                     local_fb_ack       <= pld_crc_ok;
   96 |                     local_fb_ack_valid <= 1'b1;
   97 | 
   98 |                     if (pld_crc_ok)
   99 |                         ack_sent_cnt <= ack_sent_cnt + 16'd1;
  100 |                     else
  101 |                         nak_sent_cnt <= nak_sent_cnt + 16'd1;
  102 |                 end else if (pld_crc_ok) begin
  103 |                     // Verified IDLE (2'b00) or MGMT (2'b10) frame:
  104 |                     // Notify Reorder Buffer to advance expected_txfn if it matches rx_txfn
  105 |                     non_data_seq_adv <= 1'b1;
  106 |                     non_data_txfn    <= rx_txfn;
  107 |                 end
  108 |             end
  109 |         end
  110 |     end
  111 | 
  112 | endmodule

  224 |                     rd_word_idx <= 9'd0;

  226 |                     if (exp_slot_is_ready) begin
  227 |                         if (out_pipe_can_accept) begin
  228 |                             // Word 0 of exp_slot_idx is prefetched into ram_rd_data at this posedge

  230 |                             rd_word_idx <= 9'd0;
  231 |                             state       <= ST_DRAIN_SLOT;
  232 |                         end
  233 |                     end else if (in_valid && s_axis_tready) begin
  234 |                         if (is_expected_in_order) begin
  235 |                             seq_synced        <= 1'b1;
  236 |                             expected_txfn     <= rx_txfn_in;
  237 |                             m_axis_ord_tdata  <= in_data;
  238 |                             m_axis_ord_tvalid <= 1'b1;
  239 |                             m_axis_ord_tlast  <= in_last;
  240 |                             if (in_last) begin
  241 |                                 expected_txfn        <= rx_txfn_in + 16'd1;
  242 |                                 in_order_drained_cnt <= in_order_drained_cnt + 16'd1;
  243 |                             end else begin
  244 |                                 state <= ST_PASS_IN;
  245 |                             end
  246 |                         end else if (is_future_ooo_frame) begin
  247 |                             // Out-of-order future frame: Word 0 is written to BRAM on this posedge
  248 |                             active_slot <= in_slot_idx;
  249 |                             wr_word_idx <= 9'd1;
  250 |                             state       <= ST_STORE_OOO;
  251 |                         end
  252 |                     end
  253 |                 end
  254 | 
  255 |                 ST_PASS_IN: begin
  256 |                     if (in_valid && out_pipe_can_accept) begin
  257 |                         m_axis_ord_tdata  <= in_data;
  258 |                         m_axis_ord_tvalid <= 1'b1;
  259 |                         m_axis_ord_tlast  <= in_last;
  260 |                         if (in_last) begin
  261 |                             expected_txfn        <= expected_txfn + 16'd1;
  262 |                             in_order_drained_cnt <= in_order_drained_cnt + 16'd1;
  263 |                             if (next_slot_is_ready) begin
  264 |                                 // Word 0 of next_exp_slot_idx is prefetched into ram_rd_data at this posedge
  265 |                                 active_slot <= next_exp_slot_idx;
  266 |                                 rd_word_idx <= 9'd0;
  267 |                                 state       <= ST_DRAIN_SLOT;
  268 |                             end else begin
  269 |                                 state       <= ST_IDLE;
  270 |                             end
  271 |                         end
  272 |                     end
  273 |                 end
  274 | 
  275 |                 ST_STORE_OOO: begin
  276 |                     if (in_valid) begin
  277 |                         if (in_last || (wr_word_idx == WORDS_PER_FRAME - 1)) begin
  278 |                             slot_valid[active_slot]   <= 1'b1;
  279 |                             slot_txfn[active_slot]    <= rx_txfn_in;
  280 |                             out_of_order_buffered_cnt <= out_of_order_buffered_cnt + 16'd1;
  281 |                             wr_word_idx               <= 9'd0;
  282 |                             state                     <= ST_IDLE;
  283 |                         end else begin
  284 |                             wr_word_idx <= wr_word_idx + 9'd1;
  285 |                         end
  286 |                     end
  287 |                 end
  288 | 
  289 |                 ST_DRAIN_SLOT: begin
  290 |                     if (out_pipe_can_accept) begin
  291 |                         if (rd_word_idx < WORDS_PER_FRAME) begin
  292 |                             m_axis_ord_tdata  <= ram_rd_data;
  293 |                             m_axis_ord_tvalid <= 1'b1;
  294 |                             m_axis_ord_tlast  <= (rd_word_idx == WORDS_PER_FRAME - 1);
  295 |                             rd_word_idx       <= rd_word_idx + 9'd1;
  296 |                         end else begin
  297 |                             // Word 476 (477th word) has been accepted by downstream
  298 |                             slot_valid[active_slot] <= 1'b0;
  299 |                             expected_txfn           <= expected_txfn + 16'd1;
  300 |                             in_order_drained_cnt    <= in_order_drained_cnt + 16'd1;
  301 |                             rd_word_idx             <= 9'd0;
  302 |                             state                   <= ST_IDLE;
  303 |                         end
  304 |                     end
  305 |                 end
  306 |             endcase
  307 |         end
  308 |     end
  309 | 
  310 | endmodule

118: reg [IDX_BITS-1:0] retx_index;
120: reg [IDX_BITS-1:0] drop_index;
122: reg [IDX_BITS-1:0] free_index;
165: reg [IDX_BITS-1:0] target_index;
    1 | `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 | Module Name  : arq_tx_controller
    7 | Description  : Selective Repeat ARQ Transmit Controller & Frame Scheduler 
    8 |                with Autonomous Holdoff Tracking and SDA OISL Table 2-9 & 
    9 |                Table 2-11 Parameters:
   10 |                - Priority 1: Retransmission (Timer Expired OR NAK Received).
   11 |                - Priority 2: 1Hz Management (MGMT) Frame.
   12 |                - Priority 3: Normal Ethernet Data (DATA) Frame.
   13 |                - Priority 4: IDLE Frame (When no data is available).
   14 |                
   15 |                Features:
   16 |                - Multi-Slot Outstanding Frame Tracker (Supports In-Flight Packets).
   17 |                - Automatic RAM Write, Read (Retx), and Delete (ACK/Drop) signaling.
   18 |                - Configurable ARQ_MAX_RETX (Default = 5 per SDA OISL Table 2-11).
   19 | 
   20 |                SDA OISL TABLE 2-11 PARAMETERS:
   21 |                - ARQ_MAX_RETX           = 3'd5   (Max retries before drop: 0..5)
   22 |                - ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG        = 8'd255 (8-bit register setting: 1..255)
   23 |                - ARQ_HOLDOFF_MULT       = 16     (Table 2-11 'times 16' step;
   24 |                                                   configurable to 32 or 64)
   25 |                - ARQ_HOLDOFF_MAX_FRAMES = 4080   (255 x 16 frames = 10.174 ms)
   26 |                - SIM_SCALE_ENABLE       = 1      (Uses HOLDOFF_TICKS for fast 
   27 |                                                   simulation; set 0 for full 
   28 |                                                   4080-frame hardware timer)
   29 | 
   30 | Revision History:
   31 |   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Priority-based Selective Repeat ARQ TX Controller & Frame Scheduler.
   32 |   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:26 KST) : [Target B5.4 - SDA OISL Page 25-26, Sec. 2.6.3.3.3 & Table 2-11]
   33 |     1. Added official SDA OISL Table 2-11 parameters:
   34 |        - ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG  (8-bit, range 1..255, default 255)
   35 |        - ARQ_HOLDOFF_MULT (16 frames per Table 2-11; configurable to 64 for 
   36 |          5000 km LEO S2S extension = 16,320 frames = 40.696 ms RTT window)
   37 |        - SIM_SCALE_ENABLE (1 = fast simulation tick per clock using HOLDOFF_TICKS;
   38 |          0 = hardware frame-granular decrement per tx_trigger_gen pulse).
   39 |     2. Aligned 'track_timer' decrement step with Table 2-11 frame units.
   40 |     3. Enabled ARQ disabling when ARQ_MAX_RETX == 3'd0 per Section 2.6.3.3.3.
   41 |   - Rev 2.3 (2026-10-29 12:39 KST) : [Audit Fix F01 - Tracker Slot Allocation, Retry & Drop]
   42 |     Removed '&& tx_trigger_gen' phase mismatch from tracker slot allocation and retry update.
   43 |   - Rev 2.5 (2026-10-29 15:19 KST) : [Audit Fix R06, R07 & R08]
   44 |     1. [Fix R07]: Parameterized index width 'IDX_BITS = (TRACKER_DEPTH > 1) ? $clog2(TRACKER_DEPTH) : 1'.
   45 |     2. [Fix R08]: Consolidated all 'ddr4_addr' assignments into a single clocked always block.
   46 |     3. [Fix R06]: Prevented 'tx_stall_mac' from asserting mid-frame during an active DATA transmission.
   47 |     4. Added 'data_pending' request latch.
   48 |   - Rev 2.6 (2026-10-30 00:55 KST) : [Audit Fix N04 - Elimination of Phantom Second DATA Trigger]
   49 |     Restricted 'data_pending' latching to occur ONLY when 'fso_data_valid' asserts while 
   50 |     a non-DATA frame (IDLE, MGMT, or RETX: payload_mux_sel != 2'b01) is currently busy, 
   51 |     and cleared 'data_pending' whenever '!fso_data_valid' drops at the end of a segment.
   52 |     This guarantees that a single 475-word finite segment (framer_one_segment.sv) 
   53 |     triggers strictly 1 DATA frame and smoothly returns to IDLE without deadlock.
   54 | ===========================================================================
   55 | */
   56 | 
   57 | module arq_tx_controller #(
   58 |     parameter [2:0]  ARQ_MAX_RETX      = 3'd5,     // SDA OISL Table 2-11: 0..5 (Default = 5; 0 = ARQ Disabled)
   59 |     parameter [7:0]  ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG   = 8'd255,   // SDA OISL Table 2-11: 1..255 (8-bit configuration)
   60 |     parameter integer ARQ_HOLDOFF_MULT = 16,       // 16 = Strict Table 2-11 (x16 frames); 64 = 5000 km Extension
   61 |     parameter        SIM_SCALE_ENABLE  = 1,        // 1 = Use HOLDOFF_TICKS for fast simulation; 0 = Frame-granular
   62 |     parameter [15:0] HOLDOFF_TICKS     = 16'd500,  // Simulation scaled holdoff ticks when SIM_SCALE_ENABLE = 1
   63 |     parameter integer TRACKER_DEPTH    = 4         // Number of concurrent frames tracked in flight
   64 | )(
   65 |     input  wire        clk,
   66 |     input  wire        rst_n,
   67 | 
   68 |     // --- Traffic & Timing Monitors ---
   69 |     input  wire        fso_data_valid,   // Asserted when Ethernet segment/FIFO has DATA ready
   70 |     input  wire        mgmt_tick_1hz,    // 1Hz pulse to trigger MGMT frame
   71 |     input  wire        header_gen_busy,  // From fso_header_top (Wait for current frame to finish)
   72 | 
   73 |     // --- ARQ Feedback from RX Decoder (Remote Terminal) ---
   74 |     input  wire [15:0] rx_rxfn_in,       // RXFN received from remote terminal
   75 |     input  wire        rx_ack_in,        // 1 = ACK, 0 = NAK
   76 |     input  wire        rx_ack_valid_in,  // 1 = Valid ARQ feedback present
   77 | 
   78 |     // --- Outputs to Header Generator & Payload MUX ---
   79 |     output reg  [15:0] tx_txfn_out,      // Current TXFN to be transmitted
   80 |     output reg  [1:0]  tx_frame_type,    // 00=IDLE, 01=DATA, 10=MGMT
   81 |     output reg         tx_trigger_gen,   // Fires the Header Generator
   82 |     output reg  [1:0]  payload_mux_sel,  // 00=IDLE, 01=DATA, 10=MGMT, 11=RETX
   83 |     output wire        tx_stall_mac,     // Stalls normal Ethernet data during Retx/MGMT
   84 | 
   85 |     // --- Outputs to ARQ DDR4 Wrapper ---
   86 |     output reg         ddr4_write_req,   // Sniff and store current DATA frame
   87 |     output reg         ddr4_read_req,    // Fetch frame from RAM for Retransmission
   88 |     output reg         ddr4_delete_req,  // Free RAM slot upon ACK or Max Retries
   89 |     output reg  [15:0] ddr4_addr         // Target Frame Number (TXFN) in RAM
   90 | );
   91 | 
   92 |     localparam integer IDX_BITS = (TRACKER_DEPTH > 1) ? $clog2(TRACKER_DEPTH) : 1;
   93 | 
   94 |     // =======================================================
   95 |     // 1. OUTSTANDING FRAME TRACKER TABLE (CAM-like Structure)
   96 |     // =======================================================
   97 |     localparam [15:0] TABLE_2_11_HOLDOFF_FRAMES = ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG * ARQ_HOLDOFF_MULT;
   98 |     wire       [15:0] active_holdoff_limit      = SIM_SCALE_ENABLE ? HOLDOFF_TICKS : TABLE_2_11_HOLDOFF_FRAMES;
   99 |     wire       [2:0]  eff_max_retx              = (ARQ_MAX_RETX > 3'd5) ? 3'd5 : ARQ_MAX_RETX;
  100 |     wire              arq_disabled              = (eff_max_retx == 3'd0) || (ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG == 8'd0);
  101 | 
  102 |     reg        track_valid [0:TRACKER_DEPTH-1];
  103 |     reg [15:0] track_txfn  [0:TRACKER_DEPTH-1];
  104 |     reg [15:0] track_timer [0:TRACKER_DEPTH-1];
  105 |     reg [2:0]  track_retx  [0:TRACKER_DEPTH-1];
  106 | 
  107 |     reg [15:0] global_txfn;  // Master sequence counter for new frames
  108 |     reg        mgmt_pending; // Latch for 1Hz MGMT request
  109 |     reg        data_pending; // Latch for DATA request arriving while non-DATA frame is busy
  110 |     wire       data_req_active = fso_data_valid || data_pending;
  111 | 
  112 |     integer i;
  113 | 
  114 |     // =======================================================
  115 |     // 2. COMBINATIONAL SEARCH ENGINE (Priority Resolver)
  116 |     // =======================================================
  117 |     reg                retx_needed;
  118 |     reg [IDX_BITS-1:0] retx_index;
  119 |     reg                drop_needed;
  120 |     reg [IDX_BITS-1:0] drop_index;
  121 |     reg                free_found;
  122 |     reg [IDX_BITS-1:0] free_index;
  123 | 
  124 |     always @(*) begin
  125 |         retx_needed = 1'b0;
  126 |         retx_index  = {IDX_BITS{1'b0}};
  127 |         drop_needed = 1'b0;
  128 |         drop_index  = {IDX_BITS{1'b0}};
  129 |         free_found  = 1'b0;
  130 |         free_index  = {IDX_BITS{1'b0}};
  131 | 
  132 |         for (i = 0; i < TRACKER_DEPTH; i = i + 1) begin
  133 |             if (track_valid[i] && (track_timer[i] == 16'd0)) begin
  134 |                 if (track_retx[i] < eff_max_retx) begin
  135 |                     if (!retx_needed) begin
  136 |                         retx_needed = 1'b1;
  137 |                         retx_index  = i[IDX_BITS-1:0];
  138 |                     end
  139 |                 end else begin
  140 |                     if (!drop_needed) begin
  141 |                         drop_needed = 1'b1;
  142 |                         drop_index  = i[IDX_BITS-1:0];
  143 |                     end
  144 |                 end
  145 |             end
  146 |             if (!track_valid[i] && !free_found) begin
  147 |                 free_found = 1'b1;
  148 |                 free_index = i[IDX_BITS-1:0];
  149 |             end
  150 |         end
  151 |     end
  152 | 
  153 |     // =======================================================
  154 |     // 3. SELECTIVE REPEAT ARQ STATE MACHINE
  155 |     // =======================================================
  156 |     localparam S_IDLE        = 3'd0,
  157 |                S_ARBITRATE   = 3'd1,
  158 |                S_EXEC_RETX   = 3'd2,
  159 |                S_EXEC_MGMT   = 3'd3,
  160 |                S_EXEC_DATA   = 3'd4,
  161 |                S_EXEC_IDLE   = 3'd5,
  162 |                S_WAIT_FRAME  = 3'd6;
  163 | 
  164 |     reg [2:0]          state, next_state;
  165 |     reg [IDX_BITS-1:0] target_index;
  166 | 
  167 |     wire active_data_in_flight = (state == S_EXEC_DATA) ||
  168 |                                  ((state == S_WAIT_FRAME) && (payload_mux_sel == 2'b01));
  169 | 
  170 |     assign tx_stall_mac = (state == S_EXEC_RETX) || (state == S_EXEC_MGMT) ||
  171 |                           (payload_mux_sel == 2'b11) || (payload_mux_sel == 2'b10) ||
  172 |                           (!arq_disabled && !free_found && !active_data_in_flight);
  173 | 
  174 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  175 |         if (!rst_n) state <= S_IDLE;
  176 |         else        state <= next_state;
  177 |     end
  178 | 
  179 |     always @(*) begin
  180 |         next_state = state;
  181 |         case (state)
  182 |             S_IDLE: begin
  183 |                 if (!header_gen_busy && !tx_trigger_gen) next_state = S_ARBITRATE;
  184 |             end
  185 |             
  186 |             S_ARBITRATE: begin
  187 |                 // STRICT PRIORITY ENFORCEMENT:
  188 |                 // Priority 1: Timer expired OR NAK received -> Retransmit!
  189 |                 if (!arq_disabled && retx_needed)                        next_state = S_EXEC_RETX;
  190 |                 // Priority 2: 1Hz MGMT Schedule
  191 |                 else if (mgmt_pending)                                   next_state = S_EXEC_MGMT;
  192 |                 // Priority 3: Normal Ethernet Data available (and tracker slot available)
  193 |                 else if (data_req_active && (arq_disabled || free_found)) next_state = S_EXEC_DATA;
  194 |                 // Priority 4: Nothing to send -> Stream IDLE
  195 |                 else                                                     next_state = S_EXEC_IDLE;
  196 |             end
  197 | 
  198 |             S_EXEC_RETX, S_EXEC_MGMT, S_EXEC_DATA, S_EXEC_IDLE: begin
  199 |                 next_state = S_WAIT_FRAME;
  200 |             end
  201 | 
  202 |             S_WAIT_FRAME: begin
  203 |                 if (!header_gen_busy && !tx_trigger_gen) next_state = S_IDLE;
  204 |             end
  205 |             
  206 |             default: next_state = S_IDLE;
  207 |         endcase
  208 |     end
  209 | 
  210 |     // =======================================================
  211 |     // 4. UNIFIED OUTPUT, TRACKER & DDR4_ADDR EXECUTION LOGIC
  212 |     // =======================================================
  213 |     wire timer_tick_en = SIM_SCALE_ENABLE ? 1'b1 : tx_trigger_gen;
  214 | 
  215 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  216 |         if (!rst_n) begin
  217 |             global_txfn     <= 16'd0;
  218 |             tx_txfn_out     <= 16'd0;
  219 |             tx_frame_type   <= 2'b00;
  220 |             tx_trigger_gen  <= 1'b0;
  221 |             payload_mux_sel <= 2'b00;
  222 |             ddr4_write_req  <= 1'b0;
  223 |             ddr4_read_req   <= 1'b0;
  224 |             ddr4_delete_req <= 1'b0;
  225 |             ddr4_addr       <= 16'd0;
  226 |             mgmt_pending    <= 1'b0;
  227 |             data_pending    <= 1'b0;
  228 |             target_index    <= {IDX_BITS{1'b0}};
  229 |             for (i = 0; i < TRACKER_DEPTH; i = i + 1) begin
  230 |                 track_valid[i] <= 1'b0;
  231 |                 track_txfn[i]  <= 16'd0;
  232 |                 track_timer[i] <= 16'd0;
  233 |                 track_retx[i]  <= 3'd0;
  234 |             end
  235 |         end else begin
  236 |             tx_trigger_gen  <= 1'b0;
  237 |             ddr4_write_req  <= 1'b0;
  238 |             ddr4_read_req   <= 1'b0;
  239 |             ddr4_delete_req <= 1'b0;
  240 | 
  241 |             if (mgmt_tick_1hz) mgmt_pending <= 1'b1;
  242 | 
  243 |             // [Rev 2.6 - Fix N04] Only latch data_pending if fso_data_valid asserts while a
  244 |             // non-DATA frame (IDLE/MGMT/RETX) is currently busy, and clear it if fso_data_valid
  245 |             // drops during an active DATA frame.
  246 |             if (fso_data_valid && header_gen_busy && (payload_mux_sel != 2'b01)) begin
  247 |                 data_pending <= 1'b1;
  248 |             end else if (!fso_data_valid && active_data_in_flight) begin
  249 |                 data_pending <= 1'b0;
  250 |             end
  251 | 
  252 |             // A. Autonomous Timer Decrement & Max-Retry Exhaustion Drop
  253 |             for (i = 0; i < TRACKER_DEPTH; i = i + 1) begin
  254 |                 if (track_valid[i]) begin
  255 |                     if (track_timer[i] > 16'd0) begin
  256 |                         if (timer_tick_en) begin
  257 |                             track_timer[i] <= track_timer[i] - 1'b1;
  258 |                         end
  259 |                     end else if (drop_needed && (i[IDX_BITS-1:0] == drop_index) &&
  260 |                                  (state != S_EXEC_DATA) && (state != S_EXEC_RETX)) begin
  261 |                         track_valid[i]  <= 1'b0;
  262 |                         ddr4_delete_req <= 1'b1;
  263 |                         ddr4_addr       <= track_txfn[i];
  264 |                     end
  265 |                 end
  266 |             end
  267 | 
  268 |             // B. Process Incoming RX Feedback (ACK / NAK)
  269 |             if (rx_ack_valid_in) begin
  270 |                 for (i = 0; i < TRACKER_DEPTH; i = i + 1) begin
  271 |                     if (track_valid[i] && (track_txfn[i] == rx_rxfn_in)) begin
  272 |                         if (rx_ack_in == 1'b1) begin
  273 |                             track_valid[i]  <= 1'b0;
  274 |                             ddr4_delete_req <= 1'b1;
  275 |                             ddr4_addr       <= rx_rxfn_in;
  276 |                         end else begin
  277 |                             track_timer[i]  <= 16'd0;
  278 |                         end
  279 |                     end
  280 |                 end
  281 |             end
  282 | 
  283 |             // C. State Machine Command & Tracker Slot Execution
  284 |             case (state)
  285 |                 S_ARBITRATE: begin
  286 |                     if (!arq_disabled && retx_needed)       target_index <= retx_index;
  287 |                     else if (data_req_active && free_found) target_index <= free_index;
  288 |                 end
  289 | 
  290 |                 S_EXEC_RETX: begin
  291 |                     tx_txfn_out     <= track_txfn[target_index];
  292 |                     tx_frame_type   <= 2'b01;
  293 |                     payload_mux_sel <= 2'b11;
  294 |                     tx_trigger_gen  <= 1'b1;
  295 |                     ddr4_read_req   <= 1'b1;
  296 |                     ddr4_addr       <= track_txfn[target_index];
  297 | 
  298 |                     track_retx[target_index]  <= track_retx[target_index] + 1'b1;
  299 |                     track_timer[target_index] <= active_holdoff_limit;
  300 |                 end
  301 | 
  302 |                 S_EXEC_MGMT: begin
  303 |                     tx_txfn_out     <= global_txfn;
  304 |                     tx_frame_type   <= 2'b10;
  305 |                     payload_mux_sel <= 2'b10;
  306 |                     tx_trigger_gen  <= 1'b1;
  307 |                     mgmt_pending    <= 1'b0;
  308 |                     global_txfn     <= global_txfn + 1'b1;
  309 |                 end
  310 | 
  311 |                 S_EXEC_DATA: begin
  312 |                     tx_txfn_out     <= global_txfn;
  313 |                     tx_frame_type   <= 2'b01;
  314 |                     payload_mux_sel <= 2'b01;
  315 |                     tx_trigger_gen  <= 1'b1;
  316 |                     ddr4_write_req  <= ~arq_disabled;
  317 |                     ddr4_addr       <= global_txfn;
  318 |                     data_pending    <= 1'b0;
  319 |                     global_txfn     <= global_txfn + 1'b1;
  320 | 
  321 |                     if (!arq_disabled && free_found) begin
  322 |                         track_valid[target_index] <= 1'b1;
  323 |                         track_txfn[target_index]  <= global_txfn;
  324 |                         track_timer[target_index] <= active_holdoff_limit;
  325 |                         track_retx[target_index]  <= 3'd0;
  326 |                     end
  327 |                 end
  328 | 
  329 |                 S_EXEC_IDLE: begin
  330 |                     tx_txfn_out     <= global_txfn;
  331 |                     tx_frame_type   <= 2'b00;
  332 |                     payload_mux_sel <= 2'b00;
  333 |                     tx_trigger_gen  <= 1'b1;
  334 |                     global_txfn     <= global_txfn + 1'b1;
  335 |                 end
  336 |             endcase
  337 |         end
  338 |     end
  339 | 
  340 | endmodule

   26 |     output      flag

   39 |         count   <= 16'd0;
   40 | end

   23 | module assembler(
   24 |     input               clk,
   25 |     input               rst_n,
   26 |     input               en_head,
   27 |     input               en_load,
   28 |     input   [7:0]       header_in,
   29 |     input   [31:0]      payload_in,
   30 |     output              flag,
   31 |     output  [31:0]      data_out
   32 | );
   33 | 
   34 | parameter   max         = 483;
   35 | parameter   thres       = 240;
   36 | reg     [15:0]  count   = 16'd0;
   37 | 
   38 | parameter   IDLE        = 4'b0001;
   39 | parameter   CHECK       = 4'b0010;
   40 | parameter   ACTIVE      = 4'b0100;
   41 | parameter   END         = 4'b1000;
   42 | 
   43 | reg     [3:0]   state;
   44 | reg     [3:0]   next_state;
   45 | 
   46 | reg     [111:0]     head_d0;
   47 | reg     [111:0]     head_d1;
   48 | 
   49 | reg     [31:0]      load_d0;
   50 | reg     [31:0]      head_out;
   51 | 
   52 | reg     [13:0]      len_payload     = 14'd0;
   53 | reg     [13:0]      len_packet      = 14'd0;
   54 | 
   55 | wire    wr_en;
   56 | wire    rd_en;
   57 | wire    [63:0]      fifo_out;
   58 | reg     [31:0]      eth_packet;

   60 | reg     [63:0]      roll_out;

   63 | always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   64 | begin
   65 |     if (~rst_n)
   66 |         state   <= IDLE;
   67 |     else
   68 |         state   <= next_state;

   70 | 
   71 | always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   72 | begin
   73 |     if (~rst_n)
   74 |         count   <= 16'd0;
   75 |     else if (state == ACTIVE )
   76 |         count   <= count + 1'b1;

   80 | 
   81 | always @(*)
   82 | begin
   83 |     case(state)
   84 |         IDLE:           begin
   85 |                             if (en_load)
   86 |                                 next_state  <= CHECK;
   87 |                             else
   88 |                                 next_state  <= IDLE;
   89 |                         end
   90 |         CHECK:          begin
   91 |                             if (load_d0[31:24] == 8'hab)
   92 |                                 next_state  <= ACTIVE;
   93 |                             else
   94 |                                 next_state  <= END;
   95 |                         end
   96 |         ACTIVE:         begin
   97 |                             if (count < max)
   98 |                                 next_state  <= ACTIVE;
   99 |                             else
  100 |                                 next_state  <= END;
  101 |                         end
  102 |         END:            next_state  <= IDLE;
  103 |         default:        next_state  <= IDLE;
  104 |     endcase
  105 | end
  106 | 
  107 | always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  108 | begin
  109 |     if (~rst_n)
  110 |         load_d0     <= 32'b0;
  111 |     else
  112 |         load_d0     <= payload_in;
  113 | end
  114 | 
  115 | always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  116 | begin
  117 |     if (~rst_n)
  118 |         len_payload     <= 14'd0;
  119 |     else if (state == CHECK)
  120 |         len_payload     <= load_d0[13:0];
  121 | end
  122 | 
  123 | always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  124 | begin
  125 |     if (~rst_n)
  126 |         head_d0     <= 112'b0;
  127 |     else if (count > 6)
  128 |         head_d0     <= {head_d0[103:0], header_in};
  129 | end
  130 | 
  131 | always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  132 | begin
  133 |     if (~rst_n)
  134 |         head_d1     <= 112'b0;
  135 |     else if (count == 21)
  136 |         head_d1     <= head_d0;
  137 | end
  138 | 
  139 | always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  140 | begin
  141 |     if (~rst_n)
  142 |         eth_packet      <= 32'b0;
  143 |     else if (rd_en)
  144 |         begin
  145 |             if (count > thres + 1 && count < max - 1)
  146 |                 begin
  147 |                     len_packet      <= len_packet - 14'd4;
  148 |                     if (fifo_out[63:48] == 16'hcdef)
  149 |                         begin
  150 |                             if (fifo_out[45:32] == len_packet)
  151 |                                 eth_packet      <= fifo_out[31:0];
  152 |                             else
  153 |                                 eth_packet      <= 32'b0;
  154 |                         end
  155 |                     else
  156 |                         eth_packet      <= 32'b0;
  157 |                 end
  158 |             else if (count == thres + 1)
  159 |                 len_packet      <= len_payload - 14'd4;
  160 |         end
  161 | end
  162 | 
  163 | always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  164 | begin
  165 |     if (~rst_n)
  166 |         roll_out    <= 64'b0;
  167 |     else
  168 |         roll_out    <= {roll_out[31:0], eth_packet};
  169 | end
  170 | 
  171 | always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  172 | begin
  173 |     if (~rst_n)
  174 |         load_out    <= 32'b0;
  175 |     else
  176 |         load_out    <= roll_out[47:16];
  177 | end
  178 | 
  179 | assign  wr_en   = (state == ACTIVE && count < max - 5);
  180 | assign  rd_en   = (count > thres && count < max);
  181 | 
  182 | assign  flag        = (state == ACTIVE && count > 242);
  183 | assign  data_out    = (flag) ? head_out : 32'b0;
  184 | 
  185 | always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  186 | begin
  187 |     if (~rst_n)
  188 |         head_out    <= 32'b0;
  189 |     else if (count > 241 && count < 246)
  190 |         begin
  191 |             case (count)
  192 |                 16'd242:    head_out    <= head_d1[111:80];
  193 |                 16'd243:    head_out    <= head_d1[79:48];
  194 |                 16'd244:    head_out    <= head_d1[47:16];
  195 |                 16'd245:    head_out    <= {head_d1[15:0], load_out[15:0]};
  196 |                 default:    head_out    <= 32'b0;
  197 |             endcase
  198 |         end
  199 |     else if (count > 245)
  200 |         head_out    <= load_out;
  201 |     else
  202 |         head_out    <= 32'b0;
  203 | end
  204 | 
  205 | serdes_assembler serdes_inst (
  206 |     .srst           (1'b0)
  207 |     ,.clk           (clk)
  208 |     ,.wr_en         (wr_en)
  209 |     ,.din           (load_d0)
  210 |     ,.rd_en         (rd_en)
  211 |     ,.dout          (fifo_out)
  212 | );
  213 | 
  214 | 
  215 | 
  216 | 
  217 | 
  218 | 
  219 | endmodule

SHA256: 89d3d3c683061bbe1800bb73cd68e0bedd87b903a797f336b78bbf8399b94947
