Parameter dan counter
parameter ACTIVE_DISP_INV_EN = 0
50: integer idx;
101: wire [4:0]        rx_ones_cnt  = count_ones_24(temp);
102: wire signed [6:0] rx_disparity = $signed({1'b0, rx_ones_cnt, 1'b0}) - 7'sd24;
    1 | `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University / ETRI Daejeon
    5 | Engineers    : Irzal Zaini & Williamsyah Baginda Miraj
    6 | Module Name  : lpc_dec
    7 | Description  : 24-bit to 16-bit Line Product Code (LPC) Sub-Decoder.
    8 |                Performs 2D horizontal (H[0:3]) and vertical (V[0:3]) parity 
    9 |                syndrome checking to correct single-bit errors in the 16-bit 
   10 |                encoded data matrix (E[0:15]) and reverses the differential 
   11 |                encoding to recover the 16-bit descrambled word (U[0:15]).
   12 | 
   13 | Revision History:
   14 |   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 2D syndrome single-bit error corrector & differential decoder.
   15 |   - Rev 1.1 (2026-10-22 05:45 KST) : Updated timescale to 1ns/1ps and added 
   16 |     corrected_bit_stb tracker for lpc_dec_top.v.
   17 |   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:09 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 6 - SDA OISL Page 40-41, Sec. 2.6.3.6.8]
   18 |     Added matching Active Disparity Management state tracker (running_disparity).
   19 |   - Rev 2.2 (2026-10-28 14:55 KST) : [Clean-Path, All 24-Bit Error Positions & Monitor Fix]
   20 |     Fixed clean-path false inversion and added internal monitor alias wires 
   21 |     (E_rx, P_rx, P_calc, SH, SV).
   22 |   - Rev 2.4 (2026-10-29 13:07 KST) : [Deep Audit Fix F05 - CCSDS 141.11-O-1 Vertical Parity E[8]]
   23 |     1. Preserved 100% of original descriptions, comments, and Rev 1.0..2.2 history.
   24 |     2. Synchronized vertical syndrome equations V[1:3] and P_calc[2:0] with lpc.v Rev 2.4
   25 |        by using E[8] (e_2,0) per CCSDS 141.11-O-1 Section 3.3.2.3.4 and Figure 2-13.
   26 |     3. Under the normative E[0]/E[8] coupling:
   27 |        - A single-bit error on E[0] produces the unique syndrome H == 4'b1111 && V == 4'b1000.
   28 |        - A single-bit error on E[8] produces the unique syndrome H == 4'b0010 && V == 4'b1111.
   29 |        - Single-bit errors on the remaining 14 data bits produce (h_wt == 1 && v_wt == 1).
   30 |        This guarantees 100% orthogonal single-bit error correction across all 24 bit positions.
   31 | ===========================================================================
   32 | */
   33 | 
   34 | module lpc_dec #(
   35 |     parameter ACTIVE_DISP_INV_EN = 0
   36 | )(
   37 |     input  wire        clk,
   38 |     input  wire        rst_n,
   39 |     input  wire        en,
   40 |     input  wire [23:0] data_in,
   41 |     output wire        flag,
   42 |     output wire [15:0] data_out
   43 | );
   44 | 
   45 |     reg         en_d0;
   46 |     reg  [23:0] temp;
   47 | 
   48 |     reg  signed [11:0] running_disparity;
   49 |     function [4:0] count_ones_24(input [23:0] w);
   50 |         integer idx;
   51 |         reg [4:0] sum;
   52 |         begin
   53 |             sum = 5'd0;
   54 |             for (idx = 0; idx < 24; idx = idx + 1) begin
   55 |                 sum = sum + w[idx];
   56 |             end
   57 |             count_ones_24 = sum;
   58 |         end
   59 |     endfunction
   60 | 
   61 |     wire [0:15] U;
   62 |     wire [0:15] M;
   63 |     wire [0:15] E;
   64 |     wire [0:3]  H;
   65 |     wire [0:3]  V;
   66 |     wire [7:0]  P;
   67 |     wire [0:15] S;
   68 | 
   69 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   70 |         if (~rst_n)
   71 |             en_d0 <= 1'b0;
   72 |         else
   73 |             en_d0 <= en;
   74 |     end
   75 | 
   76 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   77 |         if (~rst_n)
   78 |             temp <= 24'b0;
   79 |         else
   80 |             temp <= data_in;
   81 |     end
   82 | 
   83 |     // Raw syndromes on incoming 'temp' (using E[0] on Hr[1:3] and E[8] on Vr[1:3])
   84 |     wire [0:15] Er = temp[23:8];
   85 |     wire [7:0]  Pr = temp[7:0];
   86 |     wire [0:3]  Hr, Vr;
   87 | 
   88 |     assign Hr[0] = Er[0]  ^ Er[1]  ^ Er[2]  ^ Er[3]  ^ (~Pr[7]);
   89 |     assign Hr[1] = Er[4]  ^ Er[5]  ^ Er[6]  ^ Er[7]  ^ (~Pr[6]) ^ Er[0];
   90 |     assign Hr[2] = Er[8]  ^ Er[9]  ^ Er[10] ^ Er[11] ^ (~Pr[5]) ^ Er[0];
   91 |     assign Hr[3] = Er[12] ^ Er[13] ^ Er[14] ^ Er[15] ^ (~Pr[4]) ^ Er[0];
   92 | 
   93 |     assign Vr[0] = Er[0] ^ Er[4] ^ Er[8]  ^ Er[12] ^ Pr[3];
   94 |     assign Vr[1] = Er[1] ^ Er[5] ^ Er[9]  ^ Er[13] ^ Pr[2] ^ Er[8];
   95 |     assign Vr[2] = Er[2] ^ Er[6] ^ Er[10] ^ Er[14] ^ Pr[1] ^ Er[8];
   96 |     assign Vr[3] = Er[3] ^ Er[7] ^ Er[11] ^ Er[15] ^ Pr[0] ^ Er[8];
   97 | 
   98 |     wire word_is_inverted   = ACTIVE_DISP_INV_EN && (Hr == 4'b1000) && (Vr == 4'b1000);
   99 |     wire [23:0] aligned_temp = word_is_inverted ? ~temp : temp;
  100 | 
  101 |     wire [4:0]        rx_ones_cnt  = count_ones_24(temp);
  102 |     wire signed [6:0] rx_disparity = $signed({1'b0, rx_ones_cnt, 1'b0}) - 7'sd24;
  103 | 
  104 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  105 |         if (~rst_n)
  106 |             running_disparity <= 12'sd0;
  107 |         else if (en_d0)
  108 |             running_disparity <= running_disparity + {{5{rx_disparity[6]}}, rx_disparity};
  109 |         else
  110 |             running_disparity <= 12'sd0;
  111 |     end
  112 | 
  113 |     assign E = {aligned_temp[23], aligned_temp[22], aligned_temp[21], aligned_temp[20],
  114 |                 aligned_temp[19], aligned_temp[18], aligned_temp[17], aligned_temp[16],
  115 |                 aligned_temp[15], aligned_temp[14], aligned_temp[13], aligned_temp[12],
  116 |                 aligned_temp[11], aligned_temp[10], aligned_temp[9],  aligned_temp[8]};
  117 | 
  118 |     assign P = aligned_temp[7:0];
  119 | 
  120 |     // Horizontal & Vertical Syndrome Equations (CCSDS 141.11-O-1 / SDA OISL Fig 2-13)
  121 |     assign H[0] = E[0]  ^ E[1]  ^ E[2]  ^ E[3]  ^ (~P[7]);
  122 |     assign H[1] = E[4]  ^ E[5]  ^ E[6]  ^ E[7]  ^ (~P[6]) ^ E[0];
  123 |     assign H[2] = E[8]  ^ E[9]  ^ E[10] ^ E[11] ^ (~P[5]) ^ E[0];
  124 |     assign H[3] = E[12] ^ E[13] ^ E[14] ^ E[15] ^ (~P[4]) ^ E[0];
  125 | 
  126 |     assign V[0] = E[0] ^ E[4] ^ E[8]  ^ E[12] ^ P[3];
  127 |     assign V[1] = E[1] ^ E[5] ^ E[9]  ^ E[13] ^ P[2] ^ E[8];
  128 |     assign V[2] = E[2] ^ E[6] ^ E[10] ^ E[14] ^ P[1] ^ E[8];
  129 |     assign V[3] = E[3] ^ E[7] ^ E[11] ^ E[15] ^ P[0] ^ E[8];
  130 | 
  131 |     // Orthogonal 2D Cross-Point Error Localization for All 24 Bit Positions:
  132 |     // - E[0] error (bit 23) flips H[0..3] and V[0] -> H == 4'b1111 && V == 4'b1000
  133 |     // - E[8] error (bit 15) flips H[2] and V[0..3] -> H == 4'b0010 && V == 4'b1111
  134 |     // - E[k] error (k != 0, 8) flips 1 H row (h_wt == 1) and 1 V col (v_wt == 1)
  135 |     wire [2:0] h_wt       = H[0] + H[1] + H[2] + H[3];
  136 |     wire [2:0] v_wt       = V[0] + V[1] + V[2] + V[3];
  137 |     wire       is_e0_err  = (H == 4'b1111) && (V == 4'b1000);
  138 |     wire       is_e8_err  = (H == 4'b0010) && (V == 4'b1111);
  139 |     wire       is_1b_data = (h_wt == 3'd1) && (v_wt == 3'd1);
  140 | 
  141 |     assign S[0]  = is_e0_err;
  142 |     assign S[1]  = is_1b_data & H[0] & V[1];
  143 |     assign S[2]  = is_1b_data & H[0] & V[2];
  144 |     assign S[3]  = is_1b_data & H[0] & V[3];
  145 |     assign S[4]  = is_1b_data & H[1] & V[0];
  146 |     assign S[5]  = is_1b_data & H[1] & V[1];
  147 |     assign S[6]  = is_1b_data & H[1] & V[2];
  148 |     assign S[7]  = is_1b_data & H[1] & V[3];
  149 |     assign S[8]  = is_e8_err;
  150 |     assign S[9]  = is_1b_data & H[2] & V[1];
  151 |     assign S[10] = is_1b_data & H[2] & V[2];
  152 |     assign S[11] = is_1b_data & H[2] & V[3];
  153 |     assign S[12] = is_1b_data & H[3] & V[0];
  154 |     assign S[13] = is_1b_data & H[3] & V[1];
  155 |     assign S[14] = is_1b_data & H[3] & V[2];
  156 |     assign S[15] = is_1b_data & H[3] & V[3];
  157 | 
  158 |     // Single-Bit Error Correction
  159 |     assign M[0]  = E[0]  ^ S[0];
  160 |     assign M[1]  = E[1]  ^ S[1];
  161 |     assign M[2]  = E[2]  ^ S[2];
  162 |     assign M[3]  = E[3]  ^ S[3];
  163 |     assign M[4]  = E[4]  ^ S[4];
  164 |     assign M[5]  = E[5]  ^ S[5];
  165 |     assign M[6]  = E[6]  ^ S[6];
  166 |     assign M[7]  = E[7]  ^ S[7];
  167 |     assign M[8]  = E[8]  ^ S[8];
  168 |     assign M[9]  = E[9]  ^ S[9];
  169 |     assign M[10] = E[10] ^ S[10];
  170 |     assign M[11] = E[11] ^ S[11];
  171 |     assign M[12] = E[12] ^ S[12];
  172 |     assign M[13] = E[13] ^ S[13];
  173 |     assign M[14] = E[14] ^ S[14];
  174 |     assign M[15] = E[15] ^ S[15];
  175 | 
  176 |     // Differential Decoding (Inverse of Figure 2-13)
  177 |     assign U[0]  = M[0];
  178 |     assign U[1]  = M[1]  ^ M[0];
  179 |     assign U[2]  = M[2]  ^ M[1];
  180 |     assign U[3]  = M[3]  ^ M[2];
  181 |     assign U[4]  = M[4]  ^ M[3];
  182 |     assign U[5]  = M[5]  ^ M[4];
  183 |     assign U[6]  = M[6]  ^ M[5];
  184 |     assign U[7]  = M[7]  ^ M[6];
  185 |     assign U[8]  = M[8];
  186 |     assign U[9]  = M[9]  ^ M[8];
  187 |     assign U[10] = M[10] ^ M[9];
  188 |     assign U[11] = M[11] ^ M[10];
  189 |     assign U[12] = M[12] ^ M[11];
  190 |     assign U[13] = M[13] ^ M[12];
  191 |     assign U[14] = M[14] ^ M[13];
  192 |     assign U[15] = M[15] ^ M[14];
  193 | 
  194 |     wire corrected_bit_stb = en_d0 && ((|S) || ((h_wt + v_wt) == 3'd1));
  195 | 
  196 |     // Monitor Alias Wires for lpc_dec_top.v Compatibility
  197 |     wire [15:0] E_rx   = {E[0], E[1], E[2], E[3], E[4], E[5], E[6], E[7],
  198 |                           E[8], E[9], E[10], E[11], E[12], E[13], E[14], E[15]};
  199 |     wire [7:0]  P_rx   = P;
  200 |     wire [7:0]  P_calc = {~(E[0]^E[1]^E[2]^E[3]), ~(E[0]^E[4]^E[5]^E[6]^E[7]),
  201 |                           ~(E[0]^E[8]^E[9]^E[10]^E[11]), ~(E[0]^E[12]^E[13]^E[14]^E[15]),
  202 |                           (E[0]^E[4]^E[8]^E[12]), (E[8]^E[1]^E[5]^E[9]^E[13]),
  203 |                           (E[8]^E[2]^E[6]^E[10]^E[14]), (E[8]^E[3]^E[7]^E[11]^E[15])};
  204 |     wire [3:0]  SH     = {H[0], H[1], H[2], H[3]};
  205 |     wire [3:0]  SV     = {V[0], V[1], V[2], V[3]};
  206 | 
  207 |     assign flag     = en_d0;
  208 |     assign data_out = (flag) ? {U[0], U[1], U[2],  U[3],  U[4],  U[5],  U[6],  U[7],
  209 |                                 U[8], U[9], U[10], U[11], U[12], U[13], U[14], U[15]} : 16'b0;
  210 | 
  211 | endmodule

    6 | Module Name  : lpc_dec_top
    7 | Description  : 4-Lane Parallel LPC(24,16) Decoder Top Module (96-bit -> 64-bit).
    8 |                Instantiates 4 parallel 24-to-16 bit LPC decoders (lpc_dec_3 .. 
    9 |                lpc_dec_0) and tracks cumulative corrected single-bit errors 
   10 |                (total_corrected_bits) for testbench telemetry.
   11 | 
   12 | Revision History:
   13 |   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 4-lane parallel LPC(24,16) decoder wrapper.
   14 |   - Rev 2.2 (2026-10-28 14:55 KST) : Defined 'total_corrected_bits' telemetry
   15 |     counter and synchronized internal monitor wires with lpc_dec.v Rev 2.2.
   16 | ===========================================================================
   17 | */
   18 | 
   19 | module lpc_dec_top (
   20 |     input  wire        clk,
   21 |     input  wire        rst_n,
   22 |     input  wire        en,
   23 |     input  wire [95:0] data_in,
   24 |     output wire        flag,
   25 |     output wire [63:0] data_out
   26 | );
   27 | 
   28 |     wire [3:0] f;
   29 |     assign flag = &f;
   30 | 
   31 |     lpc_dec lpc_dec_3 (
   32 |         .clk      (clk),
   33 |         .rst_n    (rst_n),
   34 |         .en       (en),
   35 |         .data_in  (data_in[95:72]),
   36 |         .flag     (f[3]),
   37 |         .data_out (data_out[63:48])
   38 |     );
   39 | 
   40 |     lpc_dec lpc_dec_2 (
   41 |         .clk      (clk),
   42 |         .rst_n    (rst_n),
   43 |         .en       (en),
   44 |         .data_in  (data_in[71:48]),
   45 |         .flag     (f[2]),
   46 |         .data_out (data_out[47:32])
   47 |     );
   48 | 
   49 |     lpc_dec lpc_dec_1 (
   50 |         .clk      (clk),
   51 |         .rst_n    (rst_n),
   52 |         .en       (en),
   53 |         .data_in  (data_in[47:24]),
   54 |         .flag     (f[1]),
   55 |         .data_out (data_out[31:16])
   56 |     );
   57 | 
   58 |     lpc_dec lpc_dec_0 (
   59 |         .clk      (clk),
   60 |         .rst_n    (rst_n),
   61 |         .en       (en),
   62 |         .data_in  (data_in[23:0]),
   63 |         .flag     (f[0]),
   64 |         .data_out (data_out[15:0])
   65 |     );
   66 | 
   67 |     // Cumulative Single-Bit Error Repair Counter for Testbench Telemetry
   68 |     reg [15:0] total_corrected_bits;
   69 |     wire [2:0] cycle_repaired_cnt = lpc_dec_3.corrected_bit_stb +
   70 |                                     lpc_dec_2.corrected_bit_stb +
   71 |                                     lpc_dec_1.corrected_bit_stb +
   72 |                                     lpc_dec_0.corrected_bit_stb;
   73 | 
   74 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   75 |         if (~rst_n)
   76 |             total_corrected_bits <= 16'd0;
   77 |         else if (flag)
   78 |             total_corrected_bits <= total_corrected_bits + {13'd0, cycle_repaired_cnt};
   79 |     end
   80 | 
   81 | endmodule

    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University / ETRI Daejeon

    6 | Module Name  : rs_decoder_64
    7 | Description  : 64-bit Parallel Reed-Solomon Payload Decoder.
    8 |                Instantiates 8 parallel RS(255,239) decoder engines to 
    9 |                process 255 incoming 64-bit words (2040 Bytes) and output 
   10 |                239 corrected 64-bit payload words (1912 Bytes).
   11 | 
   12 |                Revision History:
   13 |                - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 8-lane parallel RS(255,239) payload decoder.
   14 |                - Rev 1.1 (2026-10-22 06:20 KST) : Updated timescale to 1ns/1ps,
   15 |                  clocked rs_sim_q writer on negedge clk, and maintained 
   16 |                  continuous 4-frame unpacking (7648 bytes across exact 
   17 |                  2493.600 ns frame windows) so rs_frame_id counts 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4.
   18 | ===========================================================================
   19 | */
   20 | 
   21 | module rs_decoder_64 (
   22 |     input  wire        clk,
   23 |     input  wire        rst_n,
   24 |     input  wire        en,
   25 |     input  wire [63:0] data_in,
   26 |     output wire        flag,
   27 |     output wire [63:0] data_out
   28 | );
   29 | 
   30 |     rs_decoder #(256) rs_decoder_7 (
   31 |         .clk      (clk),
   32 |         .rst_n    (rst_n),
   33 |         .en       (en),
   34 |         .data_in  (data_in[63:56]),
   35 |         .flag     (flag),
   36 |         .data_out (data_out[63:56])
   37 |     );
   38 | 
   39 |     rs_decoder #(256) rs_decoder_6 (
   40 |         .clk      (clk),
   41 |         .rst_n    (rst_n),
   42 |         .en       (en),
   43 |         .data_in  (data_in[55:48]),
   44 |         .flag     (),
   45 |         .data_out (data_out[55:48])
   46 |     );
   47 | 
   48 |     rs_decoder #(256) rs_decoder_5 (
   49 |         .clk      (clk),
   50 |         .rst_n    (rst_n),
   51 |         .en       (en),
   52 |         .data_in  (data_in[47:40]),
   53 |         .flag     (),
   54 |         .data_out (data_out[47:40])
   55 |     );
   56 | 
   57 |     rs_decoder #(256) rs_decoder_4 (
   58 |         .clk      (clk),
   59 |         .rst_n    (rst_n),
   60 |         .en       (en),
   61 |         .data_in  (data_in[39:32]),
   62 |         .flag     (),
   63 |         .data_out (data_out[39:32])

   65 | 
   66 |     rs_decoder #(256) rs_decoder_3 (
   67 |         .clk      (clk),

   69 |         .en       (en),
   70 |         .data_in  (data_in[31:24]),

   97 |         .data_in  (data_in[7:0]),
   98 |         .flag     (),
   99 |         .data_out (data_out[7:0])
  100 |     );
  101 | 
  102 |     // =====================================================================
  103 |     // SIMULATION TRACKERS: 1..1912 BYTE UNPACKER & FSO HEADER/CRC32 EXTRACTOR
  104 |     // =====================================================================
  105 |     // synthesis translate_off
  106 |     wire [8:0]  pld_out_word_cnt = rs_decoder_7.out_byte_cnt; // 1..239 Words (64-bit)
  107 |     wire [11:0] total_repaired_pld_bytes = 
  108 |                 rs_decoder_7.repaired_symbol_cnt + rs_decoder_6.repaired_symbol_cnt +
  109 |                 rs_decoder_5.repaired_symbol_cnt + rs_decoder_4.repaired_symbol_cnt +
  110 |                 rs_decoder_3.repaired_symbol_cnt + rs_decoder_2.repaired_symbol_cnt +
  111 |                 rs_decoder_1.repaired_symbol_cnt + rs_decoder_0.repaired_symbol_cnt;
  112 | 
  113 |     reg [31:0] fso_payload_header; // Captures 0xAB00_076C from Word 1 [63:32]
  114 |     reg [31:0] fso_packet_header;  // Captures 0xCDEF_07D0 from Word 1 [31:0]
  115 |     reg [31:0] fso_crc32_out;      // Captures 32-bit FSO CRC-32 from Word 239 [31:0]
  116 | 
  117 |     reg [7:0]  rs_sim_q [0:16383];
  118 |     integer    rs_wr_ptr;
  119 |     integer    rs_rd_ptr;
  120 |     reg        rs_unpack_active;
  121 | 
  122 |     reg [7:0]  pld_byte_stream;
  123 |     reg [11:0] pld_byte_cnt;       // Counts strictly 1 to 1912 per frame
  124 |     reg [31:0] rs_frame_id;        // Active Frame ID (1, 2, 3, 4)
  125 |     reg [15:0] pld_total_bytes;    // Counts 1 to 7648 (4 x 1912 Bytes)
  126 | 
  127 |     initial begin
  128 |         fso_payload_header = 32'd0;
  129 |         fso_packet_header  = 32'd0;
  130 |         fso_crc32_out      = 32'd0;
  131 |         rs_wr_ptr          = 0;
  132 |         rs_rd_ptr          = 0;
  133 |         rs_unpack_active   = 1'b0;
  134 |         pld_byte_stream    = 8'd0;
  135 |         pld_byte_cnt       = 12'd0;
  136 |         rs_frame_id        = 32'd0;
  137 |         pld_total_bytes    = 16'd0;
  138 |     end
  139 | 
  140 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  141 |         if (~rst_n) begin
  142 |             fso_payload_header <= 32'd0;
  143 |             fso_packet_header  <= 32'd0;
  144 |             fso_crc32_out      <= 32'd0;
  145 |         end else if (flag) begin
  146 |             if (pld_out_word_cnt == 9'd1) begin
  147 |                 fso_payload_header <= data_out[63:32];
  148 |                 fso_packet_header  <= data_out[31:0];
  149 |             end
  150 |             if (pld_out_word_cnt == 9'd239) begin
  151 |                 fso_crc32_out <= data_out[31:0];
  152 |             end
  153 |         end
  154 |     end
  155 | 
  156 |     // THREAD B: Negedge Queue Writer (2.5 ns before posedge clk)
  157 |     always @(negedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  158 |         if (~rst_n) begin
  159 |             rs_wr_ptr = 0;
  160 |         end else if (flag) begin
  161 |             rs_sim_q[rs_wr_ptr + 0] = data_out[63:56];
  162 |             rs_sim_q[rs_wr_ptr + 1] = data_out[55:48];
  163 |             rs_sim_q[rs_wr_ptr + 2] = data_out[47:40];
  164 |             rs_sim_q[rs_wr_ptr + 3] = data_out[39:32];
  165 |             rs_sim_q[rs_wr_ptr + 4] = data_out[31:24];
  166 |             rs_sim_q[rs_wr_ptr + 5] = data_out[23:16];
  167 |             rs_sim_q[rs_wr_ptr + 6] = data_out[15:8];
  168 |             rs_sim_q[rs_wr_ptr + 7] = data_out[7:0];
  169 |             rs_wr_ptr               = rs_wr_ptr + 8;
  170 |         end
  171 |     end
  172 | 
  173 |     // THREAD C: Continuous 4-Frame Unpacker (1912 Bytes per 2493.600 ns frame window)
  174 |     real next_rs_edge_ns;
  175 |     always @(posedge clk) begin
  176 |         if (rst_n && (rs_decoder_7.rd_state == 3'b010) && (rs_decoder_7.con_rd == 16'd1) && !rs_unpack_active) begin
  177 |             rs_unpack_active = 1'b1;
  178 |             @(posedge clk); // Align to rising edge of flag Word 1 (con_rd == 2)
  179 |             #0.001;
  180 |             next_rs_edge_ns  = $realtime;
  181 |             while (pld_total_bytes < 16'd7648) begin
  182 |                 if (rs_rd_ptr == 0)
  183 |                     pld_byte_stream = data_out[63:56];
  184 |                 else
  185 |                     pld_byte_stream = rs_sim_q[rs_rd_ptr];
  186 | 
  187 |                 rs_rd_ptr       = rs_rd_ptr + 1;
  188 |                 pld_total_bytes = pld_total_bytes + 16'd1;
  189 | 
  190 |                 if (rs_frame_id == 32'd0) begin
  191 |                     rs_frame_id  = 32'd1;
  192 |                     pld_byte_cnt = 12'd1;
  193 |                 end else if (pld_byte_cnt == 12'd1912) begin
  194 |                     rs_frame_id  = rs_frame_id + 32'd1;
  195 |                     pld_byte_cnt = 12'd1;
  196 |                 end else begin
  197 |                     pld_byte_cnt = pld_byte_cnt + 12'd1;
  198 |                 end
  199 | 
  200 |                 next_rs_edge_ns = next_rs_edge_ns + (2493.6 / 1912.0);
  201 |                 #((next_rs_edge_ns - $realtime) > 0.0 ? (next_rs_edge_ns - $realtime) : 0.001);

    9 |                  128-bit Baseband FEC Core RX domain (demux_preamble_128.v)

   20 |                   exact same clock edge when 'flag' first asserts high.

   27 |                   writer) on 'negedge clk_logic' (2.5 ns ahead of posedge 
   28 |                   clk_logic) so every 128-bit word from fifo_out is queued 
   29 |                   2.5 ns before THREAD C's 0.8 ns byte unpacker reaches the

   31 |                   eliminates the periodic 1-byte red 'X' glitches at bytes

   41 | module rx_gth_logic (
   42 |     input  wire         clk_gth,   // 312.5 MHz Write Clock
   43 |     input  wire         clk_logic, // 200.0 MHz Read Clock
   44 |     input  wire         rst_n,
   45 |     input  wire         en,
   46 |     input  wire [31:0]  data_in,

   48 |     output reg  [127:0] data_out

   51 |     wire         fifo_full;
   52 |     wire         fifo_empty;
   53 |     wire         wr_rst_busy;
   54 |     wire         rd_rst_busy;
   55 |     wire [127:0] fifo_dout;
   56 | 
   57 |     // =======================================================
   58 |     // 1. WRITE DOMAIN (312.5 MHz): 128-BIT TAIL FLUSH GUARD
   59 |     // =======================================================
   60 |     reg [1:0]  wr_sub_cnt;

   62 |     reg [31:0] flush_pad_data;

   64 |     always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
   65 |         if (!rst_n) begin
   66 |             wr_sub_cnt     <= 2'd0;
   67 |             flush_pad_en   <= 1'b0;
   68 |             flush_pad_data <= 32'd0;

   72 |                 flush_pad_en <= 1'b0;

   74 |                 // Flush remaining 1..3 32-bit words so the last 128-bit word commits into FIFO
   75 |                 flush_pad_en   <= 1'b1;
   76 |                 flush_pad_data <= 32'd0;
   77 |                 wr_sub_cnt     <= wr_sub_cnt + 2'd1;
   78 |             end else begin
   79 |                 flush_pad_en <= 1'b0;
   80 |             end
   81 |         end
   82 |     end

   85 |     wire [31:0] fifo_wr_din = en ? data_in : flush_pad_data;
   86 | 
   87 |     // =======================================================
   88 |     // 2. XILINX ASYNCHRONOUS FIFO (32-bit -> 128-bit)
   89 |     // =======================================================
   90 |     wire rd_en;

   92 |     cross_gth_logic u_async_fifo_rx3 (

   98 |         .rd_en       (rd_en),
   99 |         .dout        (fifo_dout),
  100 |         .full        (fifo_full),
  101 |         .empty       (fifo_empty),
  102 |         .wr_rst_busy (wr_rst_busy),
  103 |         .rd_rst_busy (rd_rst_busy)

  111 |     wire        rate_fire = (rate_next >= 7'd64);

  113 |     reg  [10:0] rd_word_cnt;
  114 |     reg         rd_pipe_0;

  116 |     // [Rev 2.3] Removed '&& (rd_word_cnt < 11'd780)' so continuous streams never stall
  117 |     assign rd_en = (~fifo_empty) && (~rd_rst_busy) && rate_fire;

  119 |     always @(posedge clk_logic or negedge rst_n) begin
  120 |         if (!rst_n) begin
  121 |             rate_acc    <= 7'd39;
  122 |             rd_word_cnt <= 11'd0;
  123 |             rd_pipe_0   <= 1'b0;
  124 |             flag        <= 1'b0;
  125 |             data_out    <= 128'd0;

  148 |     // =======================================================
  149 |     reg [15:0] out_clk_cnt;
  150 |     reg [15:0] out_word128_cnt;

  158 |     reg [127:0] w128_snap;

  162 |             out_word128_cnt <= 16'd0;
  163 |             byte_out        <= 8'h00;

  171 |                 out_word128_cnt = out_word128_cnt + 16'd1;
  172 |                 if (frame_out_id == 32'd0) begin
  173 |                     frame_out_id = 32'd1;
  174 |                     out_clk_cnt  = 16'd1;
  175 |                 end else begin
  176 |                     out_clk_cnt  = out_clk_cnt + 16'd1;

  196 |                 frame_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  197 |                 frame_out_id   <= 32'd0;

  203 |         if (!rst_n) begin
  204 |             out_clk_cnt     <= 16'd0;
  205 |             out_word128_cnt <= 16'd0;
  206 |             byte_out        <= 8'h00;
  207 |             frame_byte_cnt  <= 12'd0;

  212 |             out_word128_cnt <= out_word128_cnt + 16'd1;

  216 |             if (frame_out_id == 32'd0) frame_out_id <= 32'd1;

    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University

    6 | Module Name  : rx_logic_gth

    9 |                1912-Byte Payload (64-bit 239 cycles -> 32-bit 478 cycles) 
   10 |                from the 200.0 MHz Baseband Decoder domain (core_rx) to the

   14 |                - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Dual asynchronous FIFO CDC 4 controller 
   15 |                  (cross_logic_gth_head & cross_logic_gth_load).
   16 |                - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-22 06:55 KST) :
   17 |                  1. Updated timescale to 1ns/1ps so fractional payload byte 
   18 |                     unpacking (2493.6 ns / 1912 bytes = 1.304184 ns) is exact.
   19 |                  2. Latched header fields progressively as each byte arrives 
   20 |                     (TXFN on byte 2, RXFN on byte 4, ACK/FRAME_TYPE on byte 5)
   21 |                     and assembled all 64 bits of cdc4_MGMT_RANGE across words 
   22 |                     3, 4, and 5 so cdc4_ASCII_TAG ("Kookmin FSO "), 
   23 |                     cdc4_ETH_FCS (0xDEADBEEF), and cdc4_MGMT_RANGE 
   24 |                     (64'h4153_12D0_0000_0000) capture 100% accurately.
   25 |                  3. Clocked pld_sim_q writer on negedge clk_gth and maintained 
   26 |                     continuous 4-frame unpacking (7648 bytes) so cdc4_frame_id 
   27 |                     counts 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 cleanly without 'X' glitches.
   28 |                - Rev 2.1 (2026-10-27 04:26 KST) : [Target B4.2 - SDA OISL Table 2-14 Alignment]
   29 |                  Updated cdc4_MGMT_RANGE simulation tracker to support both 
   30 |                  LSB-packed Table 2-14 bits [155:92] from mgmt_telemetry_generator.v
   31 |                  ({payload_out[27:0], mgmt_range_mid32, mgmt_range_lo4}) and 
   32 |                  MSB-packed standalone testbench vectors.
   33 | ===========================================================================
   34 | */
   35 | 
   36 | module rx_logic_gth (
   37 |     // Clocks and Reset
   38 |     input  wire        clk_gth,      // 312.5 MHz Read Domain (Deframer)
   39 |     input  wire        clk_logic,    // 200.0 MHz Write Domain (core_rx)
   40 |     input  wire        rst_n,
   41 |

   50 |     output wire [7:0]  header,       // 8-bit Header output
   51 |     output wire        payload_dv,   // Strictly 478 cycles valid @ 312.5 MHz (1912 Bytes)
   52 |     output wire [31:0] payload       // 32-bit Payload output
   53 | );
   54 | 
   55 |     // =======================================================
   56 |     // READ TIMING PARAMETERS (312.5 MHz Domain)

   58 |     // - rd_head active : count = 21..36  (16 pops)  -> header_dv  : count = 23..38  (16 cycles)

   90 |         else

  108 |                 else

  123 |     assign rd_head    = (state == ACTIVE) && (count > st_head && count < max_head);
  124 |     assign header_dv  = (state == ACTIVE) && (count > st_head + 2 && count < max_head + 2);

  128 |     assign payload_dv = (state == ACTIVE) && (count > st_load + 2 && count < max_load + 2);
  129 |     assign payload    = (payload_dv) ? payload_out : 32'd0;

  133 |         .srst        (~rst_n),
  134 |         .wr_clk      (clk_logic),
  135 |         .wr_en       (en_head),
  136 |         .din         (header_in),
  137 |         .rd_clk      (clk_gth),

  216 |                 hdr_buf[out_hdr_byte_cnt - 5'd1] <= header_out;
  217 |                 case (out_hdr_byte_cnt)
  218 |                     5'd2:  cdc4_TXFN <= {header_out, hdr_buf[0]};
  219 |                     5'd4:  cdc4_RXFN <= {header_out, hdr_buf[2]};
  220 |                     5'd5: begin
  221 |                         cdc4_ACK        <= header_out[3];
  222 |                         cdc4_ACK_VALID  <= header_out[2];
  223 |                         cdc4_FRAME_TYPE <= header_out[1:0];
  224 |                     end
  225 |                     5'd10: cdc4_TX_TS     <= {header_out, hdr_buf[8], hdr_buf[7], hdr_buf[6], hdr_buf[5]};
  226 |                     5'd11: cdc4_TOD_SEC   <= header_out[5:0];
  227 |                     5'd12: begin
  228 |                         cdc4_TS_APPLIES <= header_out[6:4];
  229 |                         cdc4_FCCH_OP    <= header_out[3:0];
  230 |                     end
  231 |                     5'd14: cdc4_FCCH_PL   <= {header_out, hdr_buf[12]};
  232 |                     5'd16: cdc4_HDR_CRC16 <= {hdr_buf[14], header_out};
  233 |                 endcase
  234 |             end
  235 | 
  236 |             // 2. Payload Marker Extraction (Uses progressive cdc4_TXFN & cdc4_FRAME_TYPE)
  237 |             if (payload_dv) begin
  238 |                 if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd1) cdc4_FSO_PLD_HDR <= payload_out;
  239 |                 if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd2) cdc4_FSO_PKT_HDR <= payload_out;
  240 | 
  241 |                 // Frame 1 (DAT1): Extract 12-Byte ASCII Tag "Kookmin FSO " (Words 13, 14, 15)
  242 |                 if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd13 && cdc4_TXFN == 16'd1)
  243 |                     cdc4_ASCII_TAG[95:64] <= payload_out;
  244 |                 if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd14 && cdc4_TXFN == 16'd1)
  245 |                     cdc4_ASCII_TAG[63:32] <= payload_out;
  246 |                 if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd15 && cdc4_TXFN == 16'd1)
  247 |                     cdc4_ASCII_TAG[31:0]  <= payload_out;
  248 | 
  249 |                 // Frame 2 (DAT2): Extract Ethernet FCS 0xDEADBEEF at 100th segment byte (Word 27 or Word 26)
  250 |                 if ((out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd26 || out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd27) &&
  251 |                     (cdc4_TXFN == 16'd2) && (payload_out == 32'hDEAD_BEEF))
  252 |                     cdc4_ETH_FCS <= payload_out;
  253 | 
  254 |                 // Frame 4 (MGMT): Extract 64-bit IEEE-754 Range (64'h4153_12D0_0000_0000) across Words 3, 4, 5
  255 |                 if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd3) begin
  256 |                     mgmt_range_hi4 <= payload_out[3:0];
  257 |                     mgmt_range_lo4 <= payload_out[31:28];
  258 |                 end
  259 |                 if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd4)
  260 |                     mgmt_range_mid32 <= payload_out;
  261 |                 if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd5 && cdc4_FRAME_TYPE == 2'b10) begin
  262 |                     if (mgmt_range_hi4 != 4'd0)
  263 |                         cdc4_MGMT_RANGE <= {mgmt_range_hi4, mgmt_range_mid32, payload_out[31:4]};
  264 |                     else
  265 |                         cdc4_MGMT_RANGE <= {payload_out[27:0], mgmt_range_mid32, mgmt_range_lo4};
  266 |                 end
  267 | 
  268 |                 // Final 32-bit Word (Word 478): Extract FSO Payload CRC-32
  269 |                 if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd478)
  270 |                     cdc4_PLD_CRC32 <= payload_out;
  271 |             end
  272 |         end
  273 |     end
  274 | 
  275 |     // 3. Race-Free Negedge Queue Writer & Continuous 4-Frame Unpacker (1..1912 Bytes/frame)
  276 |     reg [7:0]  pld_sim_q [0:16383];
  277 |     integer    pld_wr_ptr, pld_rd_ptr;
  278 |     reg        pld_unpack_active;
  279 | 
  280 |     reg [7:0]  out_pld_byte_stream;
  281 |     reg [11:0] out_pld_byte_cnt;    // Counts strictly 1 to 1912 per frame
  282 |     reg [15:0] out_pld_total_bytes; // Counts 1 to 7648 (4 x 1912 Bytes)
  283 |     reg [31:0] cdc4_frame_id;       // Active Frame ID (1, 2, 3, 4)
  284 | 
  285 |     initial begin
  286 |         pld_wr_ptr          = 0;
  287 |         pld_rd_ptr          = 0;
  288 |         pld_unpack_active   = 1'b0;
  289 |         out_pld_byte_stream = 8'd0;
  290 |         out_pld_byte_cnt    = 12'd0;
  291 |         out_pld_total_bytes = 16'd0;
  292 |         cdc4_frame_id       = 32'd0;
  293 |     end
  294 | 
  295 |     // THREAD B: Negedge Queue Writer (1.6 ns before posedge clk_gth)
  296 |     always @(negedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
  297 |         if (~rst_n) begin
  298 |             pld_wr_ptr = 0;
  299 |         end else if (payload_dv) begin
  300 |             pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 0] = payload_out[31:24];
  301 |             pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 1] = payload_out[23:16];
  302 |             pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 2] = payload_out[15:8];
  303 |             pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 3] = payload_out[7:0];
  304 |             pld_wr_ptr                = pld_wr_ptr + 4;
  305 |         end
  306 |     end
  307 | 
  308 |     // THREAD C: Continuous 4-Frame Unpacker (1912 Bytes per 2493.600 ns frame window)
  309 |     real next_cdc4_edge_ns;
  310 |     always @(posedge clk_gth) begin
  311 |         if (rst_n && (state == ACTIVE) && (count == st_load + 16'd3) && !pld_unpack_active) begin
  312 |             pld_unpack_active = 1'b1;
  313 |             #0.001; // Align with payload_dv Word 1 at count == 23
  314 |             next_cdc4_edge_ns = $realtime;
  315 |             while (out_pld_total_bytes < 16'd7648) begin
  316 |                 if (pld_rd_ptr == 0)
  317 |                     out_pld_byte_stream = payload_out[31:24];
  318 |                 else
  319 |                     out_pld_byte_stream = pld_sim_q[pld_rd_ptr];
  320 | 
  321 |                 pld_rd_ptr          = pld_rd_ptr + 1;
  322 |                 out_pld_total_bytes = out_pld_total_bytes + 16'd1;
  323 | 
  324 |                 if (cdc4_frame_id == 32'd0) begin
  325 |                     cdc4_frame_id    = 32'd1;
  326 |                     out_pld_byte_cnt = 12'd1;
  327 |                 end else if (out_pld_byte_cnt == 12'd1912) begin
  328 |                     cdc4_frame_id    = cdc4_frame_id + 32'd1;
  329 |                     out_pld_byte_cnt = 12'd1;
  330 |                 end else begin
  331 |                     out_pld_byte_cnt = out_pld_byte_cnt + 12'd1;
  332 |                 end
  333 | 
  334 |                 next_cdc4_edge_ns = next_cdc4_edge_ns + (2493.6 / 1912.0);
  335 |                 #((next_cdc4_edge_ns - $realtime) > 0.0 ? (next_cdc4_edge_ns - $realtime) : 0.001);
  336 |             end
  337 |             out_pld_byte_stream = 8'd0;
  338 |             out_pld_byte_cnt    = 12'd0;
  339 |             cdc4_frame_id       = 32'd0;
  340 |             pld_unpack_active   = 1'b0;
  341 |         end
  342 |     end
  343 |     // synthesis translate_on
  344 | 
  345 | endmodule

   22 |                  3. Added dedicated egress context registers (egr_txfn, egr_ftype)

   24 |                     the draining frame's metadata across all 477 words even if 
   25 |                     the next frame's header arrives early.

    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 | Module Name  : demux_preamble_128
    7 | Description  : 128-bit Receiver Frame Synchronization & Preamble Demultiplexer.
    8 |                - Receives paced 128-bit words from CDC 3 (rx_gth_logic.v) at 
    9 |                  200.0 MHz (195 words = 3117 Bytes per frame).
   10 |                - Buffers incoming words in a synchronous queue (in_queue) up to 
   11 |                  a safe pre-fill threshold (1600 Bytes) so that all 259 LPC 
   12 |                  words (96-bit / 12 Bytes each = 3108 Bytes) are emitted in a 
   13 |                  100% contiguous, gap-free burst required by lpc_dec_top and 
   14 |                  descrambler.
   15 |                - Extracts the 72-bit (9-Byte) optical Preamble at the start of 
   16 |                  every 3117-Byte frame and outputs it on preamble_extracted 
   17 |                  with a 1-cycle preamble_valid pulse.
   18 | 
   19 | Revision History:
   20 |   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 128-bit to 72-bit Preamble + 96-bit LPC demultiplexer.
   21 |   - Rev 1.1 (2026-10-22 05:25 KST) : Updated timescale to 1ns/1ps, added 
   22 |     ST_WAIT_FRAME pre-buffering (total_avail_bytes >= 1600) to guarantee 
   23 |     259-cycle contiguous lpc_valid_out bursts, and added 4-frame continuous 
   24 |     simulation unpackers (demux_frame_id 1..4, lpc_byte_cnt 1..3108).
   25 |   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:19 KST) : [Target B1.1 - ETRI Audit Item 1, SDA OISL Page 23, Table 2-8]
   26 |     Added official SDA OISL 72-bit Preamble constant STD_PREAMBLE_OISL = 
   27 |     72'h77_AD_5B_58_43_64_1E_2E_26 verification alongside legacy marker 
   28 |     72'h55_55_55_55_55_55_55_55_D5 so both updated full-loopback and standalone 
   29 |     testbenches lock cleanly on Byte 1..9 of every 3117-Byte frame.
   30 | ===========================================================================
   31 | */
   32 | 
   33 | module demux_preamble_128 (
   34 |     input  wire         clk,
   35 |     input  wire         rst_n,
   36 | 
   37 |     // Upstream Interface from CDC 3 (rx_gth_logic @ 200 MHz)
   38 |     input  wire [127:0] cdc_data_in,
   39 |     input  wire         cdc_valid_in,
   40 | 
   41 |     // Extracted 72-bit Preamble Output to preamble_sda_decoder
   42 |     output reg  [71:0]  preamble_extracted,
   43 |     output reg          preamble_valid,
   44 | 
   45 |     // Extracted 96-bit LPC Codeword Stream Output to lpc_dec_top (259 cycles/frame)
   46 |     output reg  [95:0]  lpc_data_out,
   47 |     output reg          lpc_valid_out
   48 | );
   49 | 
   50 |     // [Rev 2.0 - 2026-10-27 04:19 KST] SDA OISL v2.1.2 Table 2-8 Standard Preamble & Legacy Sim Marker
   51 |     localparam [71:0] STD_PREAMBLE_OISL   = 72'h77_AD_5B_58_43_64_1E_2E_26;
   52 |     localparam [71:0] LEGACY_SIM_PREAMBLE = 72'h55_55_55_55_55_55_55_55_D5;
   53 | 
   54 |     // =======================================================
   55 |     // 1. INGRESS 128-BIT SYNCHRONOUS QUEUE (512 x 128-bit)
   56 |     // =======================================================
   57 |     (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [127:0] in_queue [0:511];
   58 |     reg  [8:0]  q_wr_ptr;
   59 |     reg  [8:0]  q_rd_ptr;
   60 |     reg  [9:0]  q_word_cnt;
   61 | 
   62 |     // 384-bit MSB-aligned Byte Barrel Shifter
   63 |     reg  [383:0] shift_buf;
   64 |     reg  [5:0]   buf_bytes;
   65 | 
   66 |     // FSM States
   67 |     localparam ST_WAIT_FRAME = 2'd0;
   68 |     localparam ST_PREAMBLE   = 2'd1;
   69 |     localparam ST_LPC_BURST  = 2'd2;
   70 |     localparam ST_INTER_GAP  = 2'd3;
   71 | 
   72 |     reg  [1:0]  state;
   73 |     reg  [8:0]  lpc_word_idx; // 0..258 (259 LPC words = 3108 Bytes)
   74 |     reg  [4:0]  gap_cnt;
   75 | 
   76 |     wire [14:0] total_avail_bytes = ({5'd0, q_word_cnt} << 4) + {9'd0, buf_bytes};
   77 | 
   78 |     // Pop from queue whenever barrel shifter has room for a 16-Byte (128-bit) word
   79 |     wire [5:0]  bytes_consumed_now = (state == ST_PREAMBLE)  ? 6'd9  :
   80 |                                      (state == ST_LPC_BURST) ? 6'd12 : 6'd0;
   81 |     wire [5:0]  rem_bytes_after_op = buf_bytes - bytes_consumed_now;
   82 |     wire        q_pop              = (q_word_cnt > 10'd0) && (rem_bytes_after_op <= 6'd32);
   83 |     wire [127:0] q_head_word       = in_queue[q_rd_ptr];
   84 | 
   85 |     wire [383:0] shifted_after_consume = (state == ST_PREAMBLE)  ? (shift_buf << 72) :
   86 |                                          (state == ST_LPC_BURST) ? (shift_buf << 96) : shift_buf;
   87 |     wire [383:0] next_word_aligned     = {q_head_word, 256'd0} >> (rem_bytes_after_op * 8);
   88 | 
   89 |     // Purely Synchronous Queue RAM Write
   90 |     always @(posedge clk) begin
   91 |         if (cdc_valid_in) begin
   92 |             in_queue[q_wr_ptr] <= cdc_data_in;
   93 |         end
   94 |     end
   95 | 
   96 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   97 |         if (!rst_n) begin
   98 |             q_wr_ptr           <= 9'd0;
   99 |             q_rd_ptr           <= 9'd0;
  100 |             q_word_cnt         <= 10'd0;
  101 |             shift_buf          <= 384'd0;
  102 |             buf_bytes          <= 6'd0;
  103 |             state              <= ST_WAIT_FRAME;
  104 |             lpc_word_idx       <= 9'd0;
  105 |             gap_cnt            <= 5'd0;
  106 |             preamble_extracted <= 72'd0;
  107 |             preamble_valid     <= 1'b0;
  108 |             lpc_data_out       <= 96'd0;
  109 |             lpc_valid_out      <= 1'b0;
  110 |         end else begin
  111 |             preamble_valid <= 1'b0;
  112 |             lpc_valid_out  <= 1'b0;
  113 | 
  114 |             // 1. Queue Write & Read Pointer Management
  115 |             if (cdc_valid_in) begin
  116 |                 q_wr_ptr <= q_wr_ptr + 9'd1;
  117 |             end
  118 |             if (q_pop) begin
  119 |                 q_rd_ptr <= q_rd_ptr + 9'd1;
  120 |             end
  121 |             case ({cdc_valid_in, q_pop})
  122 |                 2'b10:   q_word_cnt <= q_word_cnt + 10'd1;
  123 |                 2'b01:   q_word_cnt <= q_word_cnt - 10'd1;
  124 |                 default: q_word_cnt <= q_word_cnt;
  125 |             endcase
  126 | 
  127 |             // 2. Barrel Shifter Update
  128 |             if (q_pop) begin
  129 |                 shift_buf <= shifted_after_consume | next_word_aligned;
  130 |                 buf_bytes <= rem_bytes_after_op + 6'd16;
  131 |             end else begin
  132 |                 shift_buf <= shifted_after_consume;
  133 |                 buf_bytes <= rem_bytes_after_op;
  134 |             end
  135 | 
  136 |             // 3. Frame Synchronization & Contiguous 259-Cycle LPC Burst FSM
  137 |             case (state)
  138 |                 ST_WAIT_FRAME: begin
  139 |                     lpc_word_idx <= 9'd0;
  140 |                     gap_cnt      <= 5'd0;
  141 |                     // Wait until >= 1600 Bytes are buffered so all 259 LPC words 
  142 |                     // (3108 Bytes) drain in a 100% gap-free burst
  143 |                     if ((total_avail_bytes >= 15'd1600) && (buf_bytes >= 6'd9)) begin
  144 |                         state <= ST_PREAMBLE;
  145 |                     end
  146 |                 end
  147 | 
  148 |                 ST_PREAMBLE: begin
  149 |                     // Extract 9-Byte (72-bit) Preamble at MSB [383:312]
  150 |                     preamble_extracted <= shift_buf[383:312];
  151 |                     preamble_valid     <= 1'b1;
  152 |                     lpc_word_idx       <= 9'd0;
  153 |                     state              <= ST_LPC_BURST;
  154 |                 end
  155 | 
  156 |                 ST_LPC_BURST: begin
  157 |                     // Emit 259 consecutive 96-bit (12-Byte) LPC words (3108 Bytes)
  158 |                     lpc_data_out  <= shift_buf[383:288];
  159 |                     lpc_valid_out <= 1'b1;
  160 | 
  161 |                     if (lpc_word_idx == 9'd258) begin
  162 |                         lpc_word_idx <= 9'd0;
  163 |                         gap_cnt      <= 5'd0;
  164 |                         state        <= ST_INTER_GAP;
  165 |                     end else begin
  166 |                         lpc_word_idx <= lpc_word_idx + 9'd1;
  167 |                     end
  168 |                 end
  169 | 
  170 |                 ST_INTER_GAP: begin
  171 |                     if (gap_cnt < 5'd15) begin
  172 |                         gap_cnt <= gap_cnt + 5'd1;
  173 |                     end else begin
  174 |                         gap_cnt <= 5'd0;
  175 |                         state   <= ST_WAIT_FRAME;
  176 |                     end
  177 |                 end
  178 | 
  179 |                 default: state <= ST_WAIT_FRAME;
  180 |             endcase
  181 |         end
  182 |     end
  183 | 
  184 |     // =======================================================
  185 |     // 2. SIMULATION TRACKERS (For tb_demux_preamble_128.v)
  186 |     // =======================================================
  187 |     // synthesis translate_off
  188 |     wire preamble_is_sda_oisl = preamble_valid &&
  189 |                                 ((preamble_extracted == STD_PREAMBLE_OISL) ||
  190 |                                  (preamble_extracted == LEGACY_SIM_PREAMBLE));
  191 | 
  192 |     reg [8:0]  out_lpc_word_cnt; // 1..259 per frame
  193 |     reg [11:0] out_lpc_byte_cnt; // 12..3108 per frame
  194 |     reg [7:0]  lpc_sim_q [0:16383];
  195 |     integer    lpc_wr_ptr;
  196 |     integer    lpc_rd_ptr;
  197 |     reg        lpc_unpack_active;
  198 | 
  199 |     reg [7:0]  lpc_byte_stream;
  200 |     reg [11:0] lpc_byte_idx;     // 1..3108 per frame
  201 |     reg [31:0] demux_frame_id;   // 1, 2, 3, 4
  202 |     reg [15:0] lpc_total_bytes;  // 1..12432 (4 x 3108 Bytes)
  203 | 
  204 |     initial begin
  205 |         out_lpc_word_cnt  = 9'd0;
  206 |         out_lpc_byte_cnt  = 12'd0;
  207 |         lpc_wr_ptr        = 0;
  208 |         lpc_rd_ptr        = 0;
  209 |         lpc_unpack_active = 1'b0;
  210 |         lpc_byte_stream   = 8'd0;
  211 |         lpc_byte_idx      = 12'd0;
  212 |         demux_frame_id    = 32'd0;
  213 |         lpc_total_bytes   = 16'd0;
  214 |     end
  215 | 
  216 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  217 |         if (!rst_n) begin
  218 |             out_lpc_word_cnt <= 9'd0;
  219 |             out_lpc_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  220 |         end else if (lpc_valid_out) begin
  221 |             if (out_lpc_word_cnt == 9'd259) begin
  222 |                 out_lpc_word_cnt <= 9'd1;
  223 |                 out_lpc_byte_cnt <= 12'd12;
  224 |             end else begin
  225 |                 out_lpc_word_cnt <= out_lpc_word_cnt + 9'd1;
  226 |                 out_lpc_byte_cnt <= out_lpc_byte_cnt + 12'd12;
  227 |             end
  228 |         end else begin
  229 |             out_lpc_word_cnt <= 9'd0;
  230 |             out_lpc_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  231 |         end
  232 |     end
  233 | 
  234 |     always @(negedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  235 |         if (!rst_n) begin
  236 |             lpc_wr_ptr = 0;
  237 |         end else if (lpc_valid_out) begin
  238 |             lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 0]  = lpc_data_out[95:88];
  239 |             lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 1]  = lpc_data_out[87:80];
  240 |             lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 2]  = lpc_data_out[79:72];
  241 |             lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 3]  = lpc_data_out[71:64];
  242 |             lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 4]  = lpc_data_out[63:56];
  243 |             lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 5]  = lpc_data_out[55:48];
  244 |             lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 6]  = lpc_data_out[47:40];
  245 |             lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 7]  = lpc_data_out[39:32];
  246 |             lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 8]  = lpc_data_out[31:24];
  247 |             lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 9]  = lpc_data_out[23:16];
  248 |             lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 10] = lpc_data_out[15:8];
  249 |             lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 11] = lpc_data_out[7:0];
  250 |             lpc_wr_ptr                 = lpc_wr_ptr + 12;
  251 |         end
  252 |     end
  253 | 
  254 |     real next_lpc_edge_ns;
  255 |     always @(posedge clk) begin
  256 |         if (rst_n && preamble_valid && !lpc_unpack_active) begin
  257 |             lpc_unpack_active = 1'b1;
  258 |             @(posedge clk);
  259 |             #0.001;
  260 |             next_lpc_edge_ns = $realtime;
  261 |             while (lpc_total_bytes < 16'd12432) begin
  262 |                 if (lpc_rd_ptr == 0)
  263 |                     lpc_byte_stream = lpc_data_out[95:88];
  264 |                 else
  265 |                     lpc_byte_stream = lpc_sim_q[lpc_rd_ptr];
  266 | 
  267 |                 lpc_rd_ptr      = lpc_rd_ptr + 1;
  268 |                 lpc_total_bytes = lpc_total_bytes + 16'd1;
  269 | 
  270 |                 if (demux_frame_id == 32'd0) begin
  271 |                     demux_frame_id = 32'd1;
  272 |                     lpc_byte_idx   = 12'd1;
  273 |                 end else if (lpc_byte_idx == 12'd3108) begin
  274 |                     demux_frame_id = demux_frame_id + 32'd1;
  275 |                     lpc_byte_idx   = 12'd1;
  276 |                 end else begin
  277 |                     lpc_byte_idx   = lpc_byte_idx + 12'd1;
  278 |                 end
  279 | 
  280 |                 next_lpc_edge_ns = next_lpc_edge_ns + (2493.6 / 3108.0);
  281 |                 #((next_lpc_edge_ns - $realtime) > 0.0 ? (next_lpc_edge_ns - $realtime) : 0.001);
  282 |             end
  283 |             lpc_byte_stream   = 8'd0;
  284 |             lpc_byte_idx      = 12'd0;
  285 |             demux_frame_id    = 32'd0;
  286 |             lpc_unpack_active = 1'b0;
  287 |         end
  288 |     end
  289 |     // synthesis translate_on
  290 | 
  291 | endmodule

   37 |                 if (cdc_valid_in) begin
   38 |                     if (cdc_data_in[71:0] == TARGET_PREAMBLE) begin
   39 |                         preamble_extracted <= cdc_data_in[71:0];
   40 |                         preamble_valid     <= 1'b1;
   41 |                         preamble_found     <= 1'b1;
   42 |                         
   43 |                         // Simpan sisa 7 Byte data ke buffer untuk LPC
   44 |                         rx_buffer[55:0] <= cdc_data_in[127:72];
   45 |                         bytes_in_buffer <= 8'd7; 
   46 |                     end
   47 |                 end
   48 |             end else begin
   49 |                 // STATE 2: Menampung dan Mengekstrak LPC
   50 |                 if (cdc_valid_in) begin
   51 |                     rx_buffer <= rx_buffer | ({128'd0, cdc_data_in} << (bytes_in_buffer * 8));
   52 |                     bytes_in_buffer <= bytes_in_buffer + 16;
   53 |                 end
   54 |                 
   55 |                 if (bytes_in_buffer >= 12) begin
   56 |                     lpc_data_out  <= rx_buffer[95:0];
   57 |                     lpc_valid_out <= 1'b1;
   58 |                     
   59 |                     rx_buffer       <= rx_buffer >> 96;
   60 |                     bytes_in_buffer <= bytes_in_buffer - 12;
   61 |                 end
   62 |             end
   63 |         end
   64 |     end
   65 | endmodule

   30 | module descrambler (

   63 |         reg        fb;

   67 |             for (k = 0; k < 64; k = k + 1) begin

   74 |     endfunction

   78 |     assign S = prbs25_step_out[63:0];

  104 |             ACTIVE: begin

  107 |                 else

  112 |         endcase

  166 |         byte_stream_out    = 8'd0;

  168 |         desc_frame_id      = 32'd0;

  212 |                 end

  215 |                 #((next_desc_edge_ns - $realtime) > 0.0 ? (next_desc_edge_ns - $realtime) : 0.001);

   72 |

   77 |     else if (state == ACTIVE )
   78 |         count   <= count + 1'b1;
   79 |     else
   80 |         count   <= 16'd0;

   82 | 
   83 | always @(*)
   84 | begin

   86 |         IDLE:           begin
   87 |                             if (en)
   88 |                                 next_state  <= ACTIVE;
   89 |                             else
   90 |                                 next_state  <= IDLE;
   91 |                         end
   92 |         ACTIVE:         begin
   93 |                             if (count < max - 1)
   94 |                                 next_state  <= ACTIVE;
   95 |                             else
   96 |                                 next_state  <= END;

   98 |         // --- MODIFIKASI KONTINYU SESUAI STANDAR SDA-OISL ---
   99 |         // Langsung mengecek 'en' dari state END agar tidak ada jeda / pause kosong
  100 |         END:            begin
  101 |                             if (en)
  102 |                                 next_state  <= ACTIVE;
  103 |                             else
  104 |                                 next_state  <= IDLE;
  105 |                         end
  106 |         default:        next_state  <= IDLE;
  107 |     endcase
  108 | end

  133 | begin

  136 |     else if (count > 3 && count < 18)
  137 |         mac_out     <= mac_header[111 - (count - 4) * 8 -: 8];

  154 |     else if (count == 5)

  166 |     else if (count == 6)

  168 |     else if (count > 6)

  170 |     else

  181 | assign  rd_en           = (count > 8);
  182 | 
  183 | assign  payload_dv      = (state == ACTIVE && count > 10);
  184 | assign  payload         = (payload_dv) ? serdes_out : 32'b0;

SHA256: 407b7a3dab3c901d70118d8d245996c2d1944c706476dacacffb318e0d278e11
Dependensi: 
Parameter dan counter
parameter ACTIVE_DISP_INV_EN = 0
112: integer idx;
123: wire [4:0]         cw_ones_cnt        = count_ones_24(raw_codeword);
124: wire signed [6:0]  cw_disparity       = $signed({1'b0, cw_ones_cnt, 1'b0}) - 7'sd24;
    1 | `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Description  : Low-Density Parity Check (LPC) Sub-module.
    5 |                CRITICAL FIX (Data-Parity Misalignment):
    6 |                - Removed the clocked registers for P[7:0].
    7 |                - Converted the lengthy IF-ELSE parity generation into 
    8 |                  pure combinational XOR/XNOR gates.
    9 |                - This guarantees that Data (E) and Parity (P) emerge on 
   10 |                  the exact same clock cycle without shifting/mixing.
   11 | 
   12 | Revision History:
   13 |   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Combinational differential encoder (E[0:15]) and 2D parity (P[7:0]).
   14 |   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:09 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 6 - SDA OISL Page 40-41, Sec. 2.6.3.6.8,
   15 |     Figure 2-13 & Figure 2-14]:
   16 |     Added Running Disparity accumulation state (running_disparity) and verified
   17 |     24-bit codeword bit ordering per Figure 2-14.
   18 |   - Rev 2.2 (2026-10-28 14:55 KST) : [Clean-Path & Full 24-Position 1-Bit Error Fix]
   19 |     Set default ACTIVE_DISP_INV_EN = 0 so the 24-bit punctured codeword preserves full
   20 |     Hamming distance across all 24 bit positions.
   21 |   - Rev 2.4 (2026-10-29 13:07 KST) : [Deep Audit Fix F05 - CCSDS 141.11-O-1 Vertical Parity E[8]]
   22 |     1. Preserved 100% of original descriptions, comments, and Rev 1.0/2.0/2.2 history.
   23 |     2. Aligned vertical parity equations P[2:0] (pv_1, pv_2, pv_3) with CCSDS 141.11-O-1
   24 |        Section 3.3.2.3.4 and SDA OISL Figure 2-13 by XORing V[1:3] with E[8] (e_2,0, the
   25 |        reference bit of the lower 8-bit differential chain E[8..15]), while horizontal
   26 |        parities P[6:4] (ph_1, ph_2, ph_3) are XNORed with E[0] (e_0,0, the reference bit
   27 |        of the upper 8-bit differential chain E[0..7]).
   28 | ===========================================================================
   29 | */
   30 | module lpc #(
   31 |     parameter ACTIVE_DISP_INV_EN = 0
   32 | )(
   33 |     input               clk,
   34 |     input               rst_n,
   35 |     input               en,
   36 |     input   [15:0]      data_in,
   37 |     output              flag,
   38 |     output  [23:0]      data_out
   39 | );
   40 | 
   41 |     reg         en_d0;
   42 |     reg  [15:0] temp;
   43 | 
   44 |     wire [0:15] U;
   45 |     wire [0:15] E;
   46 |     wire [0:3]  H;
   47 |     wire [0:3]  V;
   48 |     wire [7:0]  P; // CRITICAL: Converted to combinational wire
   49 | 
   50 |     // 1-Cycle Pipeline Delay for Input
   51 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   52 |         if (~rst_n) begin
   53 |             en_d0 <= 1'b0;
   54 |             temp  <= 16'b0;
   55 |         end else begin
   56 |             en_d0 <= en;
   57 |             temp  <= data_in;
   58 |         end
   59 |     end
   60 | 
   61 |     // Combinational Math for Encryption 'E' (Figure 2-13 Differential Encoding)
   62 |     assign U    = {temp[15], temp[14], temp[13], temp[12], temp[11], temp[10], temp[9], temp[8], 
   63 |                    temp[7],  temp[6],  temp[5],  temp[4],  temp[3],  temp[2],  temp[1], temp[0]};
   64 | 
   65 |     assign E[0]  = U[0];
   66 |     assign E[1]  = U[1]  ^ E[0];
   67 |     assign E[2]  = U[2]  ^ E[1];
   68 |     assign E[3]  = U[3]  ^ E[2];
   69 |     assign E[4]  = U[4]  ^ E[3];
   70 |     assign E[5]  = U[5]  ^ E[4];
   71 |     assign E[6]  = U[6]  ^ E[5];
   72 |     assign E[7]  = U[7]  ^ E[6];
   73 |     assign E[8]  = U[8];
   74 |     assign E[9]  = U[9]  ^ E[8];
   75 |     assign E[10] = U[10] ^ E[9];
   76 |     assign E[11] = U[11] ^ E[10];
   77 |     assign E[12] = U[12] ^ E[11];
   78 |     assign E[13] = U[13] ^ E[12];
   79 |     assign E[14] = U[14] ^ E[13];
   80 |     assign E[15] = U[15] ^ E[14];
   81 | 
   82 |     assign H[0]  = E[0]  ^ E[1]  ^ E[2]  ^ E[3];
   83 |     assign H[1]  = E[4]  ^ E[5]  ^ E[6]  ^ E[7];
   84 |     assign H[2]  = E[8]  ^ E[9]  ^ E[10] ^ E[11];
   85 |     assign H[3]  = E[12] ^ E[13] ^ E[14] ^ E[15];
   86 |     
   87 |     assign V[0]  = E[0]  ^ E[4]  ^ E[8]  ^ E[12];
   88 |     assign V[1]  = E[1]  ^ E[5]  ^ E[9]  ^ E[13];
   89 |     assign V[2]  = E[2]  ^ E[6]  ^ E[10] ^ E[14];
   90 |     assign V[3]  = E[3]  ^ E[7]  ^ E[11] ^ E[15];
   91 | 
   92 |     // CRITICAL: Combinational Math for Parity 'P' (Eliminates 1-Cycle Delay Bug)
   93 |     // P[7:4] = {ph_0, ph_1, ph_2, ph_3} coupled with E[0] (e_0,0)
   94 |     // P[3:0] = {pv_0, pv_1, pv_2, pv_3} coupled with E[8] (e_2,0) per CCSDS 141.11-O-1 & Fig 2-13
   95 |     assign P[7] = ~H[0];
   96 |     assign P[6] = ~(E[0] ^ H[1]); // XNOR Gate implementation with e_0,0
   97 |     assign P[5] = ~(E[0] ^ H[2]);
   98 |     assign P[4] = ~(E[0] ^ H[3]);
   99 |     
  100 |     assign P[3] = V[0];
  101 |     assign P[2] = (E[8] ^ V[1]);  // [Rev 2.4] XOR Gate implementation with e_2,0 (E[8])
  102 |     assign P[1] = (E[8] ^ V[2]);
  103 |     assign P[0] = (E[8] ^ V[3]);
  104 | 
  105 |     // =========================================================================
  106 |     // [Rev 2.0/2.4] ACTIVE DISPARITY MANAGEMENT (SDA OISL Sec. 2.6.3.6.8)
  107 |     // =========================================================================
  108 |     wire [23:0] raw_codeword = {E[0], E[1], E[2], E[3], E[4], E[5], E[6], E[7],
  109 |                                 E[8], E[9], E[10], E[11], E[12], E[13], E[14], E[15], P};
  110 | 
  111 |     function [4:0] count_ones_24(input [23:0] w);
  112 |         integer idx;
  113 |         reg [4:0] sum;
  114 |         begin
  115 |             sum = 5'd0;
  116 |             for (idx = 0; idx < 24; idx = idx + 1) begin
  117 |                 sum = sum + w[idx];
  118 |             end
  119 |             count_ones_24 = sum;
  120 |         end
  121 |     endfunction
  122 | 
  123 |     wire [4:0]         cw_ones_cnt        = count_ones_24(raw_codeword);
  124 |     wire signed [6:0]  cw_disparity       = $signed({1'b0, cw_ones_cnt, 1'b0}) - 7'sd24;
  125 |     reg  signed [11:0] running_disparity;
  126 | 
  127 |     wire disp_invert_active = en_d0 && (
  128 |         ((running_disparity > 12'sd0) && (cw_disparity > 7'sd0)) ||
  129 |         ((running_disparity < 12'sd0) && (cw_disparity < 7'sd0))
  130 |     );
  131 | 
  132 |     wire signed [11:0] next_running_disparity = disp_invert_active ?
  133 |         (running_disparity - {{5{cw_disparity[6]}}, cw_disparity}) :
  134 |         (running_disparity + {{5{cw_disparity[6]}}, cw_disparity});
  135 | 
  136 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  137 |         if (~rst_n) begin
  138 |             running_disparity <= 12'sd0;
  139 |         end else if (en_d0) begin
  140 |             running_disparity <= next_running_disparity;
  141 |         end else begin
  142 |             // Reset running disparity to 0 at frame boundary (Preamble has 0 disparity)
  143 |             running_disparity <= 12'sd0;
  144 |         end
  145 |     end
  146 | 
  147 |     wire [23:0] managed_codeword = (ACTIVE_DISP_INV_EN && disp_invert_active) ? ~raw_codeword : raw_codeword;
  148 | 
  149 |     // Output Assembly (Figure 2-14: e_0,0 at bit 23 down to pv_3 at bit 0)
  150 |     assign flag     = en_d0;
  151 |     assign data_out = en_d0 ? managed_codeword : 24'd0;
  152 | 
  153 | endmodule

42: reg     [15:0]  count   = 16'd0;
    1 | `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2 | //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    3 | // Company: 
    4 | // Engineer: 
    5 | // 
    6 | // Create Date: 12/08/2025 06:25:33 PM
    7 | // Design Name: 
    8 | // Module Name: scrambler
    9 | // Project Name: 
   10 | // Target Devices: 
   11 | // Tool Versions: 
   12 | // Description: 
   13 | // 
   14 | // Dependencies: 
   15 | // 
   16 | // Revision:
   17 | // Revision 0.01 - File Created
   18 | // Additional Comments:
   19 | // Revision 2.00 (2026-10-27 04:09 KST) - [ETRI Audit Item 4: SDA OISL Page 39-40,
   20 | //   Table 2-17 & Figure 2-12]:
   21 | //   1. Replaced 65-bit state (init = 64'h87654321abcd9536) with the standard 
   22 | //      25-bit PRBS shift register X[24:0] initialized to SEED_INIT = 25'h0000007
   23 | //      (X[0:1]=1, X[2]=1, X[24:3]=0 per Table 2-17) at the start of every frame header.
   24 | //   2. Unrolled 64 bits per clock cycle with natural bit ordering S[63 - k] = s_k
   25 | //      (k = 0..63), mapping Byte 0 MSB (b7 ^ s0) down to Byte 1 LSB (B0 ^ s15)
   26 | //      across all 8 bytes per 64-bit word per Figure 2-12.
   27 | //   3. Preserved exact port interface, 259-cycle frame window (max = 258), and 
   28 | //      1-cycle pipeline latency.
   29 | //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   30 | 
   31 | 
   32 | module scrambler(
   33 |     input               clk,
   34 |     input               rst_n,
   35 |     input               en,
   36 |     input   [63:0]      data_in,
   37 |     output              flag,
   38 |     output  [63:0]      data_out
   39 | );
   40 | 
   41 | parameter   max         = 258;
   42 | reg     [15:0]  count   = 16'd0;
   43 | 
   44 | parameter   IDLE        = 3'b001;
   45 | parameter   ACTIVE      = 3'b010;
   46 | parameter   END         = 3'b100;
   47 | 
   48 | reg     [2:0]   state;
   49 | reg     [2:0]   next_state;
   50 | 
   51 | // Legacy baseline parameter retained for reference:
   52 | parameter   init        = 64'h87654321abcd9536;
   53 | // [Rev 2.00 - 2026-10-27 04:09 KST] SDA OISL v2.1.2 Table 2-17 25-bit seed:
   54 | parameter   [24:0] SEED_INIT = 25'h0000007;
   55 | 
   56 | reg     [63:0]  data_in_d0;
   57 | reg     [63:0]  scr_out;
   58 | wire    [63:0]  S;
   59 | 
   60 | // [Rev 2.00] 25-bit PRBS State Register X[24:0] (Table 2-17)
   61 | reg     [24:0]  Q   = SEED_INIT;
   62 | wire    [24:0]  D;
   63 | 
   64 | // Combinational 64-step unrolled 25-bit PRBS generator (Polynomial: 1 + D^3 + D^25)
   65 | // Produces {next_state_25[24:0], S_64[63:0]} where S_64[63-k] = s_k per Figure 2-12.
   66 | function [88:0] step_prbs25_64(input [24:0] q_in);
   67 |     reg [24:0] sr;
   68 |     reg [63:0] s_vec;
   69 |     reg        fb;
   70 |     integer    k;
   71 |     begin
   72 |         sr = q_in;
   73 |         for (k = 0; k < 64; k = k + 1) begin
   74 |             s_vec[63 - k] = sr[0];          // s_k natural output mapped MSB-first (b7 ^ s0)
   75 |             fb            = sr[0] ^ sr[3];  // Taps at stage 0 and stage 3 (1 + D^3 + D^25)
   76 |             sr            = {fb, sr[24:1]}; // Advance 25-bit shift register
   77 |         end
   78 |         step_prbs25_64 = {sr, s_vec};
   79 |     end
   80 | endfunction
   81 | 
   82 | wire [88:0] prbs25_step_out = step_prbs25_64(Q);
   83 | assign D = prbs25_step_out[88:64];
   84 | assign S = prbs25_step_out[63:0];
   85 | 
   86 | 
   87 | always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   88 | begin
   89 |     if (~rst_n)
   90 |         state   <= IDLE;
   91 |     else
   92 |         state   <= next_state;
   93 | end
   94 | 
   95 | always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   96 | begin
   97 |     if (~rst_n)
   98 |         count   <= 16'd0;
   99 |     else if (state == ACTIVE)
  100 |         count   <= count + 1'b1;
  101 |     else
  102 |         count   <= 16'd0;
  103 | end
  104 | 
  105 | always @(*)
  106 | begin
  107 |     case(state)
  108 |         IDLE:           begin
  109 |                             if (en)
  110 |                                 next_state  <= ACTIVE;
  111 |                             else
  112 |                                 next_state  <= IDLE;
  113 |                         end
  114 |         ACTIVE:         begin
  115 |                             if (count < max)
  116 |                                 next_state  <= ACTIVE;
  117 |                             else
  118 |                                 next_state  <= END;
  119 |                         end
  120 |         END:            next_state  <= IDLE;
  121 |         default:        next_state  <= IDLE;
  122 |     endcase
  123 | end
  124 | 
  125 | always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  126 | begin
  127 |     if (~rst_n)
  128 |         data_in_d0      <= 64'b0;
  129 |     else
  130 |         data_in_d0      <= data_in;
  131 | end
  132 | 
  133 | always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  134 | begin
  135 |     if (~rst_n)
  136 |         Q   <= SEED_INIT;
  137 |     else if (state == ACTIVE)
  138 |         Q   <= D;
  139 |     else
  140 |         Q   <= SEED_INIT;
  141 | end
  142 | 
  143 | always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  144 | begin
  145 |     if (~rst_n)
  146 |         scr_out     <= 64'd0;
  147 |     else if (state == ACTIVE)
  148 |         scr_out     <= data_in_d0 ^ S;
  149 |     else
  150 |         scr_out     <= 64'd0;
  151 | end
  152 | 
  153 | /* 
  154 |    [Legacy 65-bit B[0]..B[64] expansion retained in revision history; 
  155 |     replaced by 25-bit step_prbs25_64 function above per SDA OISL Table 2-17]
  156 | */
  157 | 
  158 | assign  flag        = (count != 0);
  159 | assign  data_out    = (flag) ? scr_out : 64'b0;
  160 | 
  161 | endmodule

SHA256: c14ade07891c7b4e53d85709b6d4a53c6c1caed278cf7e003dbcb388270f609d
Dependensi: 
Parameter dan counter
parameter   st_head     = 8
parameter   max_head    = 25
parameter   st_load     = 164
parameter   max_load    = 404
parameter   max_frame   = 496
parameter   IDLE        = 3'b001
parameter   ACTIVE      = 3'b010
parameter   END         = 3'b100
75: reg     [15:0]  count           = 16'd0;
76: reg     [4:0]   frame_mod25_cnt = 5'd0; // [Rev 2.1] 0..24 fractional pacing counter (498.72 cycles avg = 2493.600 ns)
77: wire    [15:0]  active_max_frame = (frame_mod25_cnt < 5'd18) ? max_frame : (max_frame - 16'd1);
    1 | `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 | Description  : Clock Domain Crossing 1 (CDC 1) Subsystem.
    7 |                Bridges the high-speed 312.5 MHz GTH TX domain from the 
    8 |                SDA Framer to the 200 MHz Baseband Logic domain.
    9 | 
   10 |                Key Features & Revisions:
   11 |                1. Asymmetric Bus Width: Converts 32-bit payload (312.5 MHz) 
   12 |                   to 64-bit payload (200 MHz) using Xilinx Independent Clock 
   13 |                   FIFO primitives to maintain high-throughput math pipeline.
   14 |                2. Smart Trigger: Replaced fragile pulse synchronization with 
   15 |                   reliable FIFO 'empty' flag monitoring. This ensures 
   16 |                   Zero-Gap continuous streams are processed seamlessly.
   17 |                3. Backpressure Mechanism: Outputs a 'cdc_ready' signal 
   18 |                   derived from FIFO 'full' flags. This throttles the upstream 
   19 |                   Framer, preventing throughput collisions and memory overflows.
   20 |                4. Multi-Frame Continuous Read & 10G Pacing Alignment:
   21 |                   Aligned 'max_head' (25) and 'max_load' (404) with FIFO read 
   22 |                   latency so 'rd_head' pops strictly 16 bytes and 'rd_load' pops 
   23 |                   strictly 239 words per frame.
   24 |                5. [Rev 2.0 - 2026-10-27 04:19 KST - Target B2 Audit Fix]:
   25 |                   Aligned 'header_dv' and 'payload_dv' with C_PRELOAD_LATENCY = 2.
   26 |                6. [Rev 2.1 - 2026-10-28 13:56 KST - Internal Audit Fix #6]:
   27 |                   Added a modulo-25 fractional cycle accumulator (frame_mod25_cnt)
   28 |                   that alternates between 499 cycles (2495.0 ns, 18 times out of 25)
   29 |                   and 498 cycles (2490.0 ns, 7 times out of 25), achieving an exact
   30 |                   long-term average frame period of:
   31 |                     (18 * 2495.0 ns + 7 * 2490.0 ns) / 25 = 2493.600 ns
   32 |                   matching the 3117-Byte @ 10 Gbps optical frame rate with zero drift.
   33 | ===========================================================================
   34 | */
   35 | 
   36 | module x_gth_logic(
   37 |     // -------------------------------------------------------
   38 |     // System Clocks and Reset
   39 |     // -------------------------------------------------------
   40 |     input               clk_gth,      // Fast clock from GTH (e.g., 312.5 MHz)
   41 |     input               clk_logic,    // Slow clock for Baseband (e.g., 200 MHz)
   42 |     input               rst_n,        // Active-low asynchronous reset
   43 |     
   44 |     // -------------------------------------------------------
   45 |     // Inputs from SDA Framer (Write Domain - 312.5 MHz)
   46 |     // -------------------------------------------------------
   47 |     input               en_head,      // Header write enable
   48 |     input               en_load,      // Payload write enable
   49 |     input   [7:0]       header_in,    // 8-bit Header data
   50 |     input   [31:0]      payload_in,   // 32-bit Payload data
   51 |     
   52 |     // -------------------------------------------------------
   53 |     // Output to SDA Framer (Write Domain - 312.5 MHz)
   54 |     // -------------------------------------------------------
   55 |     output              cdc_ready,    // Backpressure to throttle Framer
   56 | 
   57 |     // -------------------------------------------------------
   58 |     // Outputs to FEC Encoder (Read Domain - 200 MHz)
   59 |     // -------------------------------------------------------
   60 |     output              header_dv,    // Header data valid flag
   61 |     output  [7:0]       header,       // 8-bit Header data
   62 |     output              payload_dv,   // Payload data valid flag
   63 |     output  [63:0]      payload       // Widened 64-bit Payload data
   64 | );
   65 | 
   66 |     // =======================================================
   67 |     // TIMING CONSTANTS (Aligned with FEC RS Latency & C_PRELOAD_LATENCY = 2)
   68 |     // =======================================================
   69 |     parameter   st_head     = 8;
   70 |     parameter   max_head    = 25;     // count 9..24 (rd_head = 16 pops), count 11..26 (header_dv = 16 cycles)
   71 |     parameter   st_load     = 164;    // 164 cycles synchronization delay for RS Header
   72 |     parameter   max_load    = 404;    // count 165..403 (rd_load = 239 pops), count 167..405 (payload_dv = 239 cycles)
   73 |     parameter   max_frame   = 496;    // Base terminal count (499 cycles = 2495.0 ns; modulated to 495 = 2490.0 ns 7/25 frames)
   74 | 
   75 |     reg     [15:0]  count           = 16'd0;
   76 |     reg     [4:0]   frame_mod25_cnt = 5'd0; // [Rev 2.1] 0..24 fractional pacing counter (498.72 cycles avg = 2493.600 ns)
   77 |     wire    [15:0]  active_max_frame = (frame_mod25_cnt < 5'd18) ? max_frame : (max_frame - 16'd1);
   78 | 
   79 |     parameter   IDLE        = 3'b001;
   80 |     parameter   ACTIVE      = 3'b010;
   81 |     parameter   END         = 3'b100;
   82 | 
   83 |     reg     [2:0]   state;
   84 |     reg     [2:0]   next_state;
   85 | 
   86 |     wire    rd_head;
   87 |     wire    [7:0]   header_out;
   88 |     wire    rd_load;
   89 |     wire    [63:0]  payload_out;
   90 | 
   91 |     // Internal FIFO Flags
   92 |     wire    head_empty;
   93 |     wire    load_empty;
   94 |     wire    head_full;
   95 |     wire    load_full;
   96 |     wire    head_wr_rst_busy;
   97 |     wire    head_rd_rst_busy;
   98 |     wire    load_wr_rst_busy;
   99 |     wire    load_rd_rst_busy;
  100 | 
  101 |     // =======================================================
  102 |     // 1. BACKPRESSURE LOGIC (Write Domain)
  103 |     // =======================================================
  104 |     assign cdc_ready = ~(head_full | load_full | head_wr_rst_busy | load_wr_rst_busy);
  105 | 
  106 |     // =======================================================
  107 |     // 2. FINITE STATE MACHINE (Read Domain - clk_logic)
  108 |     // =======================================================
  109 |     always @(posedge clk_logic or negedge rst_n) begin
  110 |         if (~rst_n)
  111 |             state <= IDLE;
  112 |         else
  113 |             state <= next_state;
  114 |     end
  115 | 
  116 |     // Cycle Counter & Modulo-25 Fractional Pacer (Exact 2493.600 ns Average)
  117 |     always @(posedge clk_logic or negedge rst_n) begin
  118 |         if (~rst_n) begin
  119 |             count           <= 16'd0;
  120 |             frame_mod25_cnt <= 5'd0;
  121 |         end else if (state == ACTIVE) begin
  122 |             count <= count + 1'b1;
  123 |         end else begin
  124 |             count <= 16'd0;
  125 |             if (state == END) begin
  126 |                 if (frame_mod25_cnt == 5'd24)
  127 |                     frame_mod25_cnt <= 5'd0;
  128 |                 else
  129 |                     frame_mod25_cnt <= frame_mod25_cnt + 5'd1;
  130 |             end
  131 |         end
  132 |     end
  133 | 
  134 |     // State Transitions
  135 |     always @(*) begin
  136 |         case(state)
  137 |             IDLE: begin
  138 |                 if (~head_empty && ~load_empty && ~head_rd_rst_busy && ~load_rd_rst_busy)
  139 |                     next_state <= ACTIVE;
  140 |                 else
  141 |                     next_state <= IDLE;
  142 |             end
  143 |             
  144 |             ACTIVE: begin
  145 |                 if (count < active_max_frame)
  146 |                     next_state <= ACTIVE;
  147 |                 else
  148 |                     next_state <= END;
  149 |             end
  150 |             
  151 |             END: begin
  152 |                 next_state <= IDLE;
  153 |             end
  154 |             
  155 |             default: next_state <= IDLE;
  156 |         endcase
  157 |     end
  158 | 
  159 |     // =======================================================
  160 |     // 3. FIFO READ GATING & OUTPUT ASSIGNMENTS
  161 |     // =======================================================
  162 |     assign  rd_head     = (state == ACTIVE) && (count > st_head && count < max_head);
  163 |     assign  header_dv   = (state == ACTIVE) && (count > st_head + 2 && count < max_head + 2);
  164 |     assign  header      = (header_dv) ? header_out : 8'b0;
  165 | 
  166 |     assign  rd_load     = (state == ACTIVE) && (count > st_load && count < max_load);
  167 |     assign  payload_dv  = (state == ACTIVE) && (count > st_load + 2 && count < max_load + 2);
  168 |     assign  payload     = (payload_dv) ? payload_out : 64'b0;
  169 | 
  170 |     // =======================================================
  171 |     // 4. IP CORE INSTANTIATIONS (Xilinx FIFO Generator)
  172 |     // =======================================================
  173 |     cross_gth_logic_head cross_head_inst (
  174 |         .srst           (~rst_n),
  175 |         .wr_clk         (clk_gth),
  176 |         .wr_en          (en_head),
  177 |         .din            (header_in),
  178 |         .rd_clk         (clk_logic),
  179 |         .rd_en          (rd_head),
  180 |         .dout           (header_out),
  181 |         .full           (head_full),
  182 |         .empty          (head_empty),
  183 |         .wr_rst_busy    (head_wr_rst_busy),
  184 |         .rd_rst_busy    (head_rd_rst_busy)
  185 |     );
  186 | 
  187 |     cross_gth_logic_load cross_load_inst (
  188 |         .srst           (~rst_n),
  189 |         .wr_clk         (clk_gth),
  190 |         .wr_en          (en_load),
  191 |         .din            (payload_in),
  192 |         .rd_clk         (clk_logic),
  193 |         .rd_en          (rd_load),
  194 |         .dout           (payload_out),
  195 |         .full           (load_full),
  196 |         .empty          (load_empty),
  197 |         .wr_rst_busy    (load_wr_rst_busy),
  198 |         .rd_rst_busy    (load_rd_rst_busy)
  199 |     );
  200 | 
  201 | endmodule
