    1 | `timescale 1ns / 100ps
    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 | Module Name  : x_logic_gth
    7 | Description  : Clock Domain Crossing 2 (CDC 2) & Modulo-4 Byte-Packing Shifter.
    8 |                - Bridges the 200.0 MHz 128-bit MUX Gearbox domain to the 
    9 |                  312.5 MHz 32-bit GTH TX domain via cross_logic_gth FIFO.
   10 |                - Strips the 3 trailing zero-padding bytes on the 195th word 
   11 |                  (cdc_keep == 16'h1FFF -> 13 valid bytes) and seamlessly packs 
   12 |                  consecutive 3117-Byte frames back-to-back across 32-bit word 
   13 |                  boundaries (4 frames = 12,468 Bytes = 3117 clocks @ 312.5 MHz, 
   14 |                  exact 2.493600 us per frame).
   15 | 
   16 | Revision History:
   17 |   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 128-to-32 bit CDC 2 with modulo-4 byte barrel shifter.
   18 |   - Rev 2.2 (2026-10-28 14:55 KST) : [Gray-Code CDC & FIFO Full Protection]
   19 |     1. Converted cross-domain frame counter (wr_frame_cnt) to Gray Code 
   20 |        (wr_frame_gray) before the 2-stage synchronizer (marked with 
   21 |        ASYNC_REG = "TRUE") and decoded Gray-to-Binary in the clk_gth domain 
   22 |        to eliminate multi-bit binary CDC sampling glitches.
   23 |     2. Gated FIFO write enable (fifo_wr_en) with !fifo_full & !wr_rst_busy 
   24 |        and exposed 'cdc2_ready' for lossless upstream flow control.
   25 | ===========================================================================
   26 | */
   27 | 
   28 | module x_logic_gth (
   29 |     input  wire         clk_gth,     // 312.5 MHz Read Domain
   30 |     input  wire         clk_logic,   // 200.0 MHz Write Domain
   31 |     input  wire         rst_n,
   32 |     input  wire         en,
   33 |     input  wire [127:0] data_in,
   34 |     input  wire         data_in_dv,
   35 |     input  wire [15:0]  cdc_keep,
   36 |     output reg          flag,
   37 |     output reg  [31:0]  data_out
   38 | );
   39 | 
   40 |     wire        fifo_full;
   41 |     wire        fifo_empty;
   42 |     wire        wr_rst_busy;
   43 |     wire        rd_rst_busy;
   44 |     wire [31:0] fifo_dout;
   45 |     wire        cdc2_ready = ~fifo_full & ~wr_rst_busy;
   46 | 
   47 |     // =======================================================
   48 |     // 1. WRITE DOMAIN (200 MHz): FRAME TRACKER & GRAY-CODE CDC
   49 |     // =======================================================
   50 |     reg [7:0]  wr_word_idx;
   51 |     reg [31:0] wr_frame_cnt;
   52 |     wire       fifo_wr_en = en && data_in_dv && (~fifo_full) && (~wr_rst_busy);
   53 | 
   54 |     // Binary-to-Gray conversion in clk_logic domain
   55 |     wire [31:0] wr_frame_gray_next = wr_frame_cnt ^ (wr_frame_cnt >> 1);
   56 |     reg  [31:0] wr_frame_gray;
   57 | 
   58 |     always @(posedge clk_logic or negedge rst_n) begin
   59 |         if (!rst_n) begin
   60 |             wr_word_idx   <= 8'd0;
   61 |             wr_frame_cnt  <= 32'd0;
   62 |             wr_frame_gray <= 32'd0;
   63 |         end else begin
   64 |             wr_frame_gray <= wr_frame_gray_next;
   65 |             if (fifo_wr_en) begin
   66 |                 if ((cdc_keep == 16'h1FFF) || (wr_word_idx == 8'd194)) begin
   67 |                     wr_word_idx  <= 8'd0;
   68 |                     wr_frame_cnt <= wr_frame_cnt + 32'd1;
   69 |                 end else begin
   70 |                     wr_word_idx  <= wr_word_idx + 8'd1;
   71 |                 end
   72 |             end else if (!data_in_dv) begin
   73 |                 wr_word_idx <= 8'd0;
   74 |             end
   75 |         end
   76 |     end
   77 | 
   78 |     // 2-Stage Gray-Code Synchronizer into clk_gth (312.5 MHz) Domain
   79 |     (* ASYNC_REG = "TRUE" *) reg [31:0] wr_frame_gray_sync1;
   80 |     (* ASYNC_REG = "TRUE" *) reg [31:0] wr_frame_gray_sync2;
   81 | 
   82 |     always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
   83 |         if (!rst_n) begin
   84 |             wr_frame_gray_sync1 <= 32'd0;
   85 |             wr_frame_gray_sync2 <= 32'd0;
   86 |         end else begin
   87 |             wr_frame_gray_sync1 <= wr_frame_gray;
   88 |             wr_frame_gray_sync2 <= wr_frame_gray_sync1;
   89 |         end
   90 |     end
   91 | 
   92 |     // Gray-to-Binary conversion in clk_gth domain
   93 |     function [31:0] gray2bin32(input [31:0] g);
   94 |         integer k;
   95 |         reg [31:0] b;
   96 |         begin
   97 |             b[31] = g[31];
   98 |             for (k = 30; k >= 0; k = k - 1) begin
   99 |                 b[k] = b[k + 1] ^ g[k];
  100 |             end
  101 |             gray2bin32 = b;
  102 |         end
  103 |     endfunction
  104 | 
  105 |     wire [31:0] wr_frame_cnt_gth = gray2bin32(wr_frame_gray_sync2);
  106 | 
  107 |     // =======================================================
  108 |     // 2. ASYNCHRONOUS FIFO (128-bit @ 200M -> 32-bit @ 312.5M)
  109 |     // =======================================================
  110 |     reg  [11:0] pop_word_idx;
  111 |     wire         need_word;
  112 |     wire        fifo_rd_en = (~fifo_empty) && (~rd_rst_busy) && need_word;
  113 | 
  114 |     cross_logic_gth u_async_fifo (
  115 |         .srst        (~rst_n),
  116 |         .wr_clk      (clk_logic),
  117 |         .rd_clk      (clk_gth),
  118 |         .din         (data_in),
  119 |         .wr_en       (fifo_wr_en),
  120 |         .rd_en       (fifo_rd_en),
  121 |         .dout        (fifo_dout),
  122 |         .full        (fifo_full),
  123 |         .empty       (fifo_empty),
  124 |         .wr_rst_busy (wr_rst_busy),
  125 |         .rd_rst_busy (rd_rst_busy)
  126 |     );
  127 | 
  128 |     // =======================================================
  129 |     // 3. READ DOMAIN (312.5 MHz): 3117-BYTE BARREL SHIFTER
  130 |     // =======================================================
  131 |     reg  [1:0]  pipe_valid;
  132 |     reg  [2:0]  pipe_bytes_0;
  133 |     reg  [2:0]  pipe_bytes_1;
  134 |     wire [2:0]  popped_valid_bytes = (pop_word_idx == 12'd779) ? 3'd1 : 3'd4;
  135 | 
  136 |     reg  [95:0] shift_reg;
  137 |     reg  [4:0]  avail_bytes;
  138 |     reg         stream_active;
  139 |     reg  [31:0] rd_frame_cnt;
  140 |     reg  [11:0] rd_frame_bytes;
  141 | 
  142 |     wire        has_4_bytes    = (avail_bytes >= 5'd4);
  143 |     wire        is_final_flush = stream_active && (rd_frame_cnt + 32'd1 >= wr_frame_cnt_gth) &&
  144 |                                  fifo_empty && (!pipe_valid[0]) && (!pipe_valid[1]) &&
  145 |                                  (avail_bytes > 5'd0) && (avail_bytes < 5'd4);
  146 |     wire [4:0]  bytes_consumed = has_4_bytes ? 5'd4 : (is_final_flush ? avail_bytes : 5'd0);
  147 |     wire [4:0]  next_avail_pre = avail_bytes - bytes_consumed;
  148 | 
  149 |     assign need_word = stream_active && (avail_bytes <= 5'd8);
  150 | 
  151 |     wire [95:0] shifted_reg    = shift_reg << (bytes_consumed * 8);
  152 |     wire [95:0] incoming_alg   = ({fifo_dout, 64'd0} &
  153 |                                   ((pipe_bytes_1 == 3'd1) ? 96'hFF00_0000_0000_0000_0000_0000 :
  154 |                                                             96'hFFFF_FFFF_0000_0000_0000_0000))
  155 |                                  >> (next_avail_pre * 8);
  156 | 
  157 |     always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
  158 |         if (!rst_n) begin
  159 |             pop_word_idx   <= 12'd0;
  160 |             pipe_valid     <= 2'b00;
  161 |             pipe_bytes_0   <= 3'd0;
  162 |             pipe_bytes_1   <= 3'd0;
  163 |             shift_reg      <= 96'd0;
  164 |             avail_bytes    <= 5'd0;
  165 |             stream_active  <= 1'b0;
  166 |             rd_frame_cnt   <= 32'd0;
  167 |             rd_frame_bytes <= 12'd0;
  168 |             flag           <= 1'b0;
  169 |             data_out       <= 32'd0;
  170 |         end else begin
  171 |             // 2-Cycle FIFO Read Pipeline (C_PRELOAD_LATENCY = 2)
  172 |             pipe_valid[0] <= fifo_rd_en;
  173 |             pipe_valid[1] <= pipe_valid[0];
  174 |             pipe_bytes_0  <= fifo_rd_en ? popped_valid_bytes : 3'd0;
  175 |             pipe_bytes_1  <= pipe_bytes_0;
  176 | 
  177 |             if (fifo_rd_en) begin
  178 |                 if (pop_word_idx == 12'd779)
  179 |                     pop_word_idx <= 12'd0;
  180 |                 else
  181 |                     pop_word_idx <= pop_word_idx + 12'd1;
  182 |             end else if (!stream_active && fifo_empty) begin
  183 |                 pop_word_idx <= 12'd0;
  184 |             end
  185 | 
  186 |             // Start streaming once at least 1 complete frame is buffered in FIFO
  187 |             if (!stream_active) begin
  188 |                 if (wr_frame_cnt_gth > rd_frame_cnt) begin
  189 |                     stream_active <= 1'b1;
  190 |                 end
  191 |                 flag     <= 1'b0;
  192 |                 data_out <= 32'd0;
  193 |             end else begin
  194 |                 if (has_4_bytes || is_final_flush) begin
  195 |                     flag     <= 1'b1;
  196 |                     data_out <= shift_reg[95:64];
  197 |                     if (rd_frame_bytes + {7'd0, bytes_consumed} >= 12'd3117) begin
  198 |                         rd_frame_bytes <= (rd_frame_bytes + {7'd0, bytes_consumed}) - 12'd3117;
  199 |                         rd_frame_cnt   <= rd_frame_cnt + 32'd1;
  200 |                     end else begin
  201 |                         rd_frame_bytes <= rd_frame_bytes + {7'd0, bytes_consumed};
  202 |                     end
  203 |                 end else begin
  204 |                     flag     <= 1'b0;
  205 |                     data_out <= 32'd0;
  206 |                     if (fifo_empty && (!pipe_valid[0]) && (!pipe_valid[1]) && (avail_bytes == 5'd0)) begin
  207 |                         stream_active <= 1'b0;
  208 |                     end
  209 |                 end
  210 |             end
  211 | 
  212 |             // Update Barrel Shifter
  213 |             if (pipe_valid[1]) begin
  214 |                 shift_reg   <= shifted_reg | incoming_alg;
  215 |                 avail_bytes <= next_avail_pre + {2'd0, pipe_bytes_1};
  216 |             end else begin
  217 |                 shift_reg   <= shifted_reg;
  218 |                 avail_bytes <= next_avail_pre;
  219 |             end
  220 |         end
  221 |     end
  222 | 
  223 |     // =======================================================
  224 |     // 4. SUB-CYCLE 0.8 NS BYTE & FRAME TRACKERS (For Waveform)
  225 |     // =======================================================
  226 |     reg [7:0]  byte_out;
  227 |     reg [15:0] out_clk_cnt;
  228 |     reg [11:0] frame_byte_cnt;
  229 |     reg [31:0] frame_out_id;
  230 | 
  231 | `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  232 |     integer b_sub;
  233 |     reg [31:0] cur_w;
  234 |     always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
  235 |         if (!rst_n) begin
  236 |             byte_out       <= 8'h00;
  237 |             out_clk_cnt    <= 16'd0;
  238 |             frame_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  239 |             frame_out_id   <= 32'd0;
  240 |         end else begin
  241 |             #0.001;
  242 |             if (flag) begin
  243 |                 cur_w = data_out;
  244 |                 if (frame_out_id == 32'd0) begin
  245 |                     frame_out_id   = 32'd1;
  246 |                     out_clk_cnt    = 16'd1;
  247 |                     frame_byte_cnt = 12'd0;
  248 |                 end else begin
  249 |                     out_clk_cnt    = out_clk_cnt + 16'd1;
  250 |                 end
  251 | 
  252 |                 for (b_sub = 0; b_sub < 4; b_sub = b_sub + 1) begin
  253 |                     if (b_sub > 0) #(0.8);
  254 |                     byte_out = cur_w[31 - (b_sub * 8) -: 8];
  255 |                     if (frame_byte_cnt == 12'd3117) begin
  256 |                         frame_byte_cnt = 12'd1;
  257 |                         frame_out_id   = frame_out_id + 32'd1;
  258 |                         out_clk_cnt    = 16'd1;
  259 |                     end else begin
  260 |                         frame_byte_cnt = frame_byte_cnt + 12'd1;
  261 |                     end
  262 |                 end
  263 |             end else begin
  264 |                 byte_out       <= 8'h00;
  265 |                 out_clk_cnt    <= 16'd0;
  266 |                 frame_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  267 |                 frame_out_id   <= 32'd0;
  268 |             end
  269 |         end
  270 |     end
  271 | `else
  272 |     always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
  273 |         if (!rst_n) begin
  274 |             byte_out       <= 8'h00;
  275 |             out_clk_cnt    <= 16'd0;
  276 |             frame_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  277 |             frame_out_id   <= 32'd0;
  278 |         end else if (flag) begin
  279 |             byte_out       <= data_out[31:24];
  280 |             out_clk_cnt    <= out_clk_cnt + 16'd1;
  281 |             frame_byte_cnt <= (frame_byte_cnt >= 12'd3114) ? 12'd3117 : (frame_byte_cnt + 12'd4);
  282 |             if (frame_out_id == 32'd0) frame_out_id <= 32'd1;
  283 |         end else begin
  284 |             byte_out       <= 8'h00;
  285 |             out_clk_cnt    <= 16'd0;
  286 |             frame_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  287 |             frame_out_id   <= 32'd0;
  288 |         end
  289 |     end
  290 | `endif
  291 | 
  292 | endmodule

   27 | module error_inject #(
   28 |     parameter   SIM_MODE    = 1,
   29 |     parameter   safe_words  = 15,
   30 |     parameter   max_error   = 47,
   31 |     parameter   max_pad     = 1035 - max_error
   32 | )(
   33 |     input               clk,        // 312.5 MHz Continuous Clock
   34 |     input               rst_n,
   35 |     input               en,         // Continuous valid flag from CDC 2
   36 |     input   [31:0]      data_in,    // Continuous 32-bit stream from CDC 2
   37 |     output              flag,       // Continuous valid flag to gth64b66b_tx
   38 |     output  [31:0]      data_out    // 32-bit stream to gth64b66b_tx
   39 | );
   40 | 
   41 | reg     [31:0]      error   [0:max_error];
   42 | reg     [15:0]      con_error   = 16'd0;
   43 | reg     [15:0]      con_pad     = 16'd0;

   45 | initial

   48 | parameter   IDLE        = 4'b0001;
   49 | parameter   ERROR       = 4'b0010;

   64 | 
   65 | wire    [31:0]      active_err_mask = ((SIM_MODE == 1) && (state == ERROR)) ? error[con_error] : 32'd0;

   68 | always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)

   72 |     else

   92 |     end
   93 | end
   94 |

   99 |     else if (state == ERROR)
  100 |         con_error   <= con_error + 1'b1;

  102 |         con_error   <= 16'd0;

  104 |

  114 | 
  115 | always @(*)
  116 | begin

  219 |         out_clk_cnt    <= 16'd0;
  220 |         frame_out_id   <= 32'd0;
  221 |         cur_word       <= 32'd0;
  222 |     end

  225 | always @(posedge clk) begin

  229 |             step_single_byte(cur_word[31:24], 1'b1);
  230 |             #0.8 step_single_byte(cur_word[23:16], 1'b0);
  231 |             #0.8 step_single_byte(cur_word[15:8],  1'b0);

    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 | Description  : Dynamic AXI4-Stream Ethernet Packet Generator.
    7 |                Features:
    8 |                - Dynamically adjustable frame size via input port.
    9 |                - Generates standard Ethernet Headers (MAC, IPv4, UDP).
   10 |                - Appends custom payload and simulated FCS (0xDEADBEEF).
   11 | ===========================================================================
   12 | */
   13 | 
   14 | module eth_axis_packet_gen #(
   15 |     // --- Header Configuration ---
   16 |     parameter [47:0] DEST_MAC = 48'hAA_BB_CC_DD_EE_FF, 
   17 |     parameter [47:0] SRC_MAC  = 48'h11_22_33_44_55_66, 
   18 |     parameter [31:0] SRC_IP   = {8'd192, 8'd168, 8'd10, 8'd1}, 
   19 |     parameter [31:0] DEST_IP  = {8'd192, 8'd168, 8'd10, 8'd2}, 
   20 |     
   21 |     // --- Custom Marker Payload ---
   22 |     parameter [31:0] PAYLOAD_WORD_1 = 32'h4B_6F_6F_6B, // ASCII "Kook"
   23 |     parameter [31:0] PAYLOAD_WORD_2 = 32'h6D_69_6E_20, // ASCII "min "
   24 |     parameter [31:0] PAYLOAD_WORD_3 = 32'h46_53_4F_20  // ASCII "FSO "
   25 | )(
   26 |     input  wire        clk,
   27 |     input  wire        rst_n,
   28 |     input  wire        trigger,           // Trigger 1 cycle HIGH to fire
   29 |     input  wire [15:0] frame_size_bytes,  // Target size (e.g., 2000 for Jumbo)
   30 |     
   31 |     // --- AXI4-Stream Output ---
   32 |     output reg [31:0]  m_axis_tdata,
   33 |     output reg [3:0]   m_axis_tkeep,
   34 |     output reg         m_axis_tvalid,
   35 |     output reg         m_axis_tlast,
   36 |     input  wire        m_axis_tready
   37 | );
   38 | 
   39 |     localparam S_IDLE = 2'd0, S_DATA = 2'd1, S_DONE = 2'd2;
   40 | 
   41 |     reg [1:0]  state;
   42 |     reg [15:0] word_count; 
   43 |     reg [15:0] total_words;
   44 | 
   45 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   46 |         if (~rst_n) begin
   47 |             state         <= S_IDLE;
   48 |             m_axis_tdata  <= 32'd0;
   49 |             m_axis_tkeep  <= 4'd0;
   50 |             m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
   51 |             m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
   52 |             word_count    <= 16'd0;
   53 |             total_words   <= 16'd0;
   54 |         end else begin
   55 |             case (state)
   56 |                 S_IDLE: begin
   57 |                     m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
   58 |                     m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
   59 |                     word_count    <= 16'd0;
   60 |                     if (trigger) begin
   61 |                         // Convert bytes to 32-bit words (divide by 4)
   62 |                         total_words <= frame_size_bytes >> 2; 
   63 |                         state       <= S_DATA;
   64 |                     end
   65 |                 end
   66 | 
   67 |                 S_DATA: begin
   68 |                     // Backpressure control: only advance if receiver is ready
   69 |                     if (m_axis_tready || !m_axis_tvalid) begin
   70 |                         m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b1;
   71 |                         m_axis_tkeep  <= 4'hF; // All 4 bytes valid
   72 | 
   73 |                         // Packet Assembly Multiplexer
   74 |                         case (word_count)
   75 |                             // Ethernet MAC Header
   76 |                             16'd0: m_axis_tdata <= DEST_MAC[47:16]; 
   77 |                             16'd1: m_axis_tdata <= {DEST_MAC[15:0], SRC_MAC[47:32]};
   78 |                             16'd2: m_axis_tdata <= SRC_MAC[31:0];
   79 |                             16'd3: m_axis_tdata <= 32'h0800_4500; // EtherType (IPv4) + IP Header
   80 |                             
   81 |                             // IP & UDP Headers
   82 |                             16'd4: m_axis_tdata <= 32'h002E_0000; 
   83 |                             16'd5: m_axis_tdata <= 32'h4000_4011; // Protocol UDP
   84 |                             16'd6: m_axis_tdata <= {16'h0000, SRC_IP[31:16]}; 
   85 |                             16'd7: m_axis_tdata <= {SRC_IP[15:0], DEST_IP[31:16]}; 
   86 |                             16'd8: m_axis_tdata <= {DEST_IP[15:0], 16'h1234}; 
   87 |                             
   88 |                             // Payload Data
   89 |                             16'd9:  m_axis_tdata <= PAYLOAD_WORD_1; 
   90 |                             16'd10: m_axis_tdata <= PAYLOAD_WORD_2; 
   91 |                             16'd11: m_axis_tdata <= PAYLOAD_WORD_3; 
   92 |                             
   93 |                             // End of Frame & Padding
   94 |                             (total_words - 1): m_axis_tdata <= 32'hDEADBEEF; // Simulated FCS
   95 |                             default: m_axis_tdata <= {16'hAAAA, word_count}; // Dummy Jumbo Data
   96 |                         endcase
   97 | 
   98 |                         // Frame termination logic
   99 |                         if (word_count == (total_words - 1)) begin
  100 |                             m_axis_tlast <= 1'b1;
  101 |                             state        <= S_DONE;
  102 |                         end else begin
  103 |                             m_axis_tlast <= 1'b0;
  104 |                             word_count   <= word_count + 1'b1;
  105 |                         end
  106 |                     end
  107 |                 end
  108 | 
  109 |                 S_DONE: begin
  110 |                     // Wait for last word to be accepted
  111 |                     if (m_axis_tready && m_axis_tvalid) begin
  112 |                         m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  113 |                         m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  114 |                         state         <= S_IDLE;
  115 |                     end
  116 |                 end
  117 |             endcase
  118 |         end
  119 |     end
  120 | endmodule

   36 |             tx_byte_cnt <= 16'd0;

   45 |                 tx_byte_cnt <= 16'd0;
   46 |             end
   47 |         end
   48 |     end
   49 | 
   50 |     assign pack_valid = mux_valid && (tx_word_cnt < MAX_SAFE_WORDS);
   51 |     assign pack_data  = pack_valid ? mux_data : 32'd0;

   20 | module eth_preamble_remover (

   12 |                Revision Notes:
   13 |                1. Preserved all original architecture descriptions.
   14 |                2. Wrapped eth_10g_pcs_pma_rx_0 inside a generate block 
   15 |                   controlled by RUN_MODE (1 = Simulation / XGMII Direct Input, 
   16 |                   0 = Hardware SFP+ Mode).
   17 |                3. Matched exact port connections on u_rx_parser 
   18 |                   (xgmii_rx_parser) and physical_mac_rx_inst 
   19 |                   (eth_10g_pcs_pma_rx_0 with DRP loopback and 
   20 |                   configuration_vector) so both SIM_MODE=1 and SIM_MODE=0 
   21 |                   synthesize cleanly without [Synth 8-11365].
   22 |                4. [Rev 2.2 - 2026-10-28 14:55 KST]: Exported 'seg_valid_bytes'
   23 |                   output port to propagate exact ingress packet/segment 
   24 |                   byte length metadata to sda_encoder.
   25 |                5. [Rev 2.5 - 2026-10-29 16:42 KST - Audit Fix R12]: Connected 
   26 |                   3-bit valid byte count ('parsed_tkeep_bytes' and 
   27 |                   'clean_mac_tkeep_bytes') from u_rx_parser -> u_preamble_remover 
   28 |                   -> u_segmenter for byte-accurate non-multiple-of-4 packets.

   30 |                   'seg_valid_bytes' output port from [10:0] to [13:0] (14 bits)
   31 |                   to pass full Table 2-18 packet lengths up to 16,383 Bytes.
   32 | ===========================================================================
   33 | */

   35 | module eth_rx_front_end_top #(
   36 |     parameter RUN_MODE = 1 // 1 = Simulation / XGMII Direct Mode, 0 = Hardware SFP+ Mode
   37 | )(

   78 |                 .dclk                   (dclk),
   79 |                 .rxrecclk_out           (),
   80 |                 .refclk_p               (refclk_p),
   81 |                 .refclk_n               (refclk_n),

   28 |                7. [Rev 2.5 - 2026-10-29 15:19 KST - Audit Fix R01 & R14]:

   30 |                8. [Rev 2.6 - 2026-10-30 00:55 KST - Audit Fix N09]:

   33 |                   where xgmii_txc_wire == 4'b1111 and xgmii_txd_wire[7:0] == 8'hFD, or any
   34 |                   control lane containing 8'hFD), ensuring backend_counter.sv counts every
   35 |                   transmitted Ethernet packet accurately.
   36 | ===========================================================================

   39 | module eth_tx_back_end_top #(
   40 |     parameter RUN_MODE = 1 // 1 = Simulation Mode, 0 = Hardware SFP+ Mode
   41 | )(
   42 |     input  wire        clk,       // 312.5 MHz Clock
   43 |     input  wire        rst_n,     // Active-low reset
   44 |     
   45 |     // Input 1922 Byte / 2008 Byte Reassembled Ethernet Frame from ethernet_frame_reassembly
   46 |     input  wire [31:0] data_in,

   51 |     output wire [3:0]  xgmii_txc,
   52 | 
   53 |     // Port SFP+ & Clocking Fisik untuk IP Core
   54 |     input  wire        refclk_p,
   55 |     input  wire        refclk_n,
   56 |     input  wire        reset,
   57 |     input  wire        dclk,

   65 |     wire [15:0] tx_byte_cnt;

   67 |     wire [31:0] xgmii_txd_wire;
   68 |     wire [3:0]  xgmii_txc_wire;

   70 |     // 1. Dynamic MAC Stream Packer (Packing and Segmentation)
   71 |     eth_mac_packing_tx u_packing (
   72 |         .clk         (clk),
   73 |         .rst_n       (rst_n),
   74 |         .mux_data    (data_in),
   75 |         .mux_valid   (en),
   76 |         .pack_data   (pack_data),

   80 |     );
   81 | 
   82 |     // 2. IEEE 802.3ae 32-bit XGMII Transmit Formatter

   85 |         .rst_n     (rst_n),
   86 |         .mac_data  (pack_data),
   87 |         .mac_valid (pack_valid),
   88 |         .xgmii_txd (xgmii_txd_wire),
   89 |         .xgmii_txc (xgmii_txc_wire)
   90 |     );

   93 |     assign xgmii_txd = xgmii_txd_wire;
   94 |     assign xgmii_txc = xgmii_txc_wire;

   96 |     // =========================================================================
   97 |     // CABANG 2: IP Core 10G Ethernet PCS/PMA (Pemancar Optik SFP+ ke PC 2)
   98 |     //           Synthesized in Hardware Mode (RUN_MODE == 0)
   99 |     // =========================================================================
  100 |     generate
  101 |         if (RUN_MODE == 0) begin : gen_hw_eth_phy_tx
  102 |             wire        drp_gnt_w;
  103 |             wire        drp_den_w;
  104 |             wire        drp_dwe_w;
  105 |             wire [15:0] drp_daddr_w;
  106 |             wire [15:0] drp_di_w;
  107 |             wire        drp_drdy_w;
  108 |             wire [15:0] drp_drpdo_w;
  109 | 
  110 |             eth_10g_pcs_pma_tx_0 physical_mac_tx_inst (
  111 |                 .dclk                   (dclk),
  112 |                 .rxrecclk_out           (),
  113 |                 .refclk_p               (refclk_p),
  114 |                 .refclk_n               (refclk_n),
  115 |                 .sim_speedup_control    (1'b0),
  116 |                 .coreclk_out            (),
  117 |                 .qplloutclk_out         (),
  118 |                 .qplloutrefclk_out      (),
  119 |                 .qplllock_out           (),
  120 |                 .txusrclk_out           (),
  121 |                 .txusrclk2_out          (),
  122 |                 .areset_datapathclk_out (),
  123 |                 .gttxreset_out          (),
  124 |                 .gtrxreset_out          (),
  125 |                 .txuserrdy_out          (),
  126 |                 .reset_counter_done_out (),
  127 |                 .reset                  (reset),
  128 |                 .xgmii_txd              (xgmii_txd_wire),
  129 |                 .xgmii_txc              (xgmii_txc_wire),
  130 |                 .xgmii_rxd              (),
  131 |                 .xgmii_rxc              (),
  132 |                 .txp                    (txp),
  133 |                 .txn                    (txn),
  134 |                 .rxp                    (1'b0),
  135 |                 .rxn                    (1'b1),
  136 |                 .configuration_vector   (536'd0),
  137 |                 .status_vector          (),
  138 |                 .core_status            (),
  139 |                 .resetdone_out          (),
  140 |                 .signal_detect          (1'b1),
  141 |                 .tx_fault               (1'b0),
  142 |                 .drp_req                (drp_gnt_w),
  143 |                 .drp_gnt                (drp_gnt_w),
  144 |                 .drp_den_o              (drp_den_w),
  145 |                 .drp_dwe_o              (drp_dwe_w),
  146 |                 .drp_daddr_o            (drp_daddr_w),
  147 |                 .drp_di_o               (drp_di_w),
  148 |                 .drp_drdy_o             (drp_drdy_w),
  149 |                 .drp_drpdo_o            (drp_drpdo_w),

  152 |                 .drp_daddr_i            (drp_daddr_w),
  153 |                 .drp_di_i               (drp_di_w),
  154 |                 .drp_drdy_i             (drp_drdy_w),

  162 |         end
  163 |     endgenerate
  164 | 
  165 |     // =========================================================================
  166 |     // 3. INTERNAL ILA 3 (u_ila_2) RX & PC 2 EGRESS TELEMETRY COUNTERS
  167 |     //    Housed inside eth_tx_back_end_top so Top Schematic stays clean!
  168 |     // =========================================================================
  169 |     (* mark_debug = "true", dont_touch = "true" *) reg [31:0] dbg_pc2_xgmii_txd;
  170 |     (* mark_debug = "true", dont_touch = "true" *) reg [3:0]  dbg_pc2_xgmii_txc;
  171 |     (* mark_debug = "true", dont_touch = "true" *) reg [15:0] dbg_rx_eth_byte_cnt;
  172 |     (* mark_debug = "true", dont_touch = "true" *) reg [15:0] dbg_rx_eth_pkt_cnt;
  173 |     reg [15:0] dbg_rx_eth_data_byte_cnt;

  175 |     wire       xgmii_is_active  = (xgmii_txc_wire != 4'b1111);
  176 |     wire [2:0] valid_data_lanes = (!xgmii_txc_wire[3]) + (!xgmii_txc_wire[2]) +
  177 |                                   (!xgmii_txc_wire[1]) + (!xgmii_txc_wire[0]);
  178 | 
  179 |     // [Rev 2.6 - Fix N09] Detect XGMII Terminate (/T/ = 0xFD) on any control lane
  180 |     wire xgmii_has_term = (xgmii_txc_wire[0] && (xgmii_txd_wire[7:0]   == 8'hFD)) ||

  182 |                           (xgmii_txc_wire[2] && (xgmii_txd_wire[23:16] == 8'hFD)) ||
  183 |                           (xgmii_txc_wire[3] && (xgmii_txd_wire[31:24] == 8'hFD));
  184 |

  188 |             dbg_pc2_xgmii_txc        <= 4'b1111;
  189 |             dbg_rx_eth_byte_cnt      <= 16'd0;
  190 |             dbg_rx_eth_pkt_cnt       <= 16'd0;
  191 |             dbg_rx_eth_data_byte_cnt <= 16'd0;
  192 |         end else begin
  193 |             dbg_pc2_xgmii_txd <= xgmii_txd_wire;
  194 |             dbg_pc2_xgmii_txc <= xgmii_txc_wire;
  195 | 
  196 |             if (xgmii_has_term) begin
  197 |                 dbg_rx_eth_pkt_cnt  <= dbg_rx_eth_pkt_cnt + 16'd1;
  198 |                 dbg_rx_eth_byte_cnt <= dbg_rx_eth_byte_cnt + 16'd4;
  199 |             end else if (xgmii_is_active) begin
  200 |                 dbg_rx_eth_byte_cnt      <= dbg_rx_eth_byte_cnt + 16'd4;
  201 |                 dbg_rx_eth_data_byte_cnt <= dbg_rx_eth_data_byte_cnt + {13'd0, valid_data_lanes};
  202 |             end else begin
  203 |                 dbg_rx_eth_byte_cnt      <= 16'd0;
  204 |                 dbg_rx_eth_data_byte_cnt <= 16'd0;
  205 |             end
  206 |         end
  207 |     end

    1 | `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 | Module Name  : ethernet_frame_reassembly
    7 | Description  : SDA OISL Section 2.6.3.7.7 Ethernet Frame Reassembly, 
    8 |                Zero-Padding Stripper, and Preamble Injection Top Module.
    9 | 
   10 |                KEY OPERATIONS:
   11 |                1. Receives in-order 1908-Byte (477-word) verified FSO DATA 
   12 |                   frames from fso_ethernet_deframer.v at 312.5 MHz.
   13 |                2. Validates and strips the 4-Byte FSO Payload Header (0xAB) 
   14 |                   and 4-Byte FSO Packet Header (0xCDEF) per Table 2-18.
   15 |                3. Reconstructs segmented Ethernet packets across multiple FSO 
   16 |                   frames (e.g., 1900 Bytes from Frame 1 + 100 Bytes from 
   17 |                   Frame 2 = 2000 Bytes) while stripping all trailing FSO 
   18 |                   zero-padding (e.g., 1800 or 1804 Bytes).
   19 |                4. Commits the reassembled packet to the egress drain FSM only 
   20 |                   when all bytes of the Ethernet packet have arrived, ensuring 
   21 |                   a 100% contiguous burst with ZERO intra-packet gaps.
   22 |                5. Instantiates eth_preamble_gen.v and mux_eth_32.v to prepend 
   23 |                   the 8-Byte Ethernet Preamble + SFD (64'h55555555_555555D5), 
   24 |                   outputting 2008 Bytes (502 words) to eth_tx_back_end_top.v.
   25 | 
   26 | Revision History:
   27 |   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Multi-frame Ethernet de-segmenter & Preamble MUX wrapper.
   28 |   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:34 KST) : [Target B6.3 - SDA OISL Page 43-46, Sec. 2.6.3.7.4 - 2.6.3.7.7,
   29 |     Figure 2-17 & Table 2-18; ETRI Review Item 4.2(2) & Item 5.1]
   30 |     Added support for strict Table 2-18 Continuation Frames and Multi-Packet Packing.
   31 |   - Rev 2.1 (2026-10-28 13:56 KST) : [Internal Audit Fix #4 - Strict State-Based Header Detection]
   32 |     Removed '(fso_word_idx == 9'd1) ||' from 'is_pkt_hdr_word' so that an FSO Packet 
   33 |     Header (0xCDEF) is recognized ONLY when no prior packet is mid-continuation 
   34 |     (rem_pkt_bytes == 16'd0). This guarantees that payload data words beginning with 
   35 |     16'hCDEF inside a continuation segment or active packet body are treated strictly 
   36 |     as Ethernet data and never misinterpreted as a packet header.
   37 | ===========================================================================
   38 | */
   39 | 
   40 | module ethernet_frame_reassembly #(
   41 |     parameter [15:0] DEFAULT_PKT_BYTES = 16'd2000 // Fallback when Packet Header length field is 0 in legacy TBs
   42 | )(
   43 |     input  wire        clk,
   44 |     input  wire        rst_n,
   45 | 
   46 |     // In-Order 1908-Byte (477-Word) Verified FSO DATA Stream from Deframer
   47 |     input  wire [31:0] s_axis_fso_tdata,
   48 |     input  wire        s_axis_fso_tvalid,
   49 |     input  wire        s_axis_fso_tlast,
   50 |     output wire        s_axis_fso_tready,
   51 | 
   52 |     // Reassembled Ethernet Frame Output (Includes 8B Preamble = 2008B for 2000B Jumbo)
   53 |     output wire [31:0] m_axis_eth_tdata,
   54 |     output wire        m_axis_eth_tvalid,
   55 |     output wire        m_axis_eth_tlast,
   56 |     input  wire        m_axis_eth_tready,
   57 | 
   58 |     // Diagnostic Telemetry Outputs
   59 |     output reg  [15:0] reassembled_pkt_bytes,
   60 |     output reg  [15:0] reassembled_pkt_cnt
   61 | );
   62 | 
   63 |     // =======================================================
   64 |     // 1. PACKET COMMIT BUFFER (1024 x 33-bit: {pkt_eof, data[31:0]})
   65 |     // =======================================================
   66 |     (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [32:0] pkt_buf [0:1023];
   67 |     reg [9:0]  wr_ptr;
   68 |     reg [9:0]  committed_wr_ptr;
   69 |     reg [9:0]  rd_ptr;
   70 | 
   71 |     wire [9:0] buf_used      = wr_ptr - rd_ptr;
   72 |     assign s_axis_fso_tready = (buf_used < 10'd960);
   73 | 
   74 |     // =======================================================
   75 |     // 2. SDA OISL TABLE 2-18 HEADER PARSER & DE-SEGMENTER
   76 |     // =======================================================
   77 |     reg [8:0]  fso_word_idx;
   78 |     reg        fso_frame_valid_magic;
   79 |     reg [15:0] rem_pkt_bytes;
   80 |     reg [15:0] cur_pkt_total_bytes;
   81 |     reg [9:0]  expected_fso_seq;
   82 |     reg        seq_initialized;
   83 | 
   84 |     wire       fire_in            = s_axis_fso_tvalid && s_axis_fso_tready;
   85 |     wire       is_pld_hdr_word    = (fso_word_idx == 9'd0);
   86 |     wire       pld_magic_ok       = (s_axis_fso_tdata[31:24] == 8'hAB);
   87 |     wire [9:0] rx_fso_seq_num     = s_axis_fso_tdata[23:14];
   88 |     wire [13:0] rx_pld_hdr_len    = s_axis_fso_tdata[13:0];
   89 | 
   90 |     wire       word_has_pkt_magic = (s_axis_fso_tdata[31:16] == 16'hCDEF);
   91 |     wire [15:0] parsed_pkt_len    = (s_axis_fso_tdata[13:0] != 14'd0) ?
   92 |                                     {2'b00, s_axis_fso_tdata[13:0]} : DEFAULT_PKT_BYTES;
   93 | 
   94 |     // [Rev 2.1] Strict state-based Packet Header detection:
   95 |     // A word is an FSO Packet Header (0xCDEF) ONLY when no packet is mid-reassembly
   96 |     // (rem_pkt_bytes == 16'd0). During a continuation segment (rem_pkt_bytes > 0),
   97 |     // all words after Word 0 are strictly treated as Ethernet payload data!
   98 |     wire is_pkt_hdr_word = (!is_pld_hdr_word) && fso_frame_valid_magic &&
   99 |                            (rem_pkt_bytes == 16'd0) && word_has_pkt_magic;
  100 | 
  101 |     // A word is valid Ethernet payload data if it's not a header and rem_pkt_bytes > 0
  102 |     wire is_eth_data_word   = (!is_pld_hdr_word) && (!is_pkt_hdr_word) &&
  103 |                               fso_frame_valid_magic && (rem_pkt_bytes > 16'd0);
  104 |     wire word_completes_pkt = is_eth_data_word && (rem_pkt_bytes <= 16'd4);
  105 | 
  106 |     // Purely Synchronous Packet Buffer Write
  107 |     always @(posedge clk) begin
  108 |         if (fire_in && is_eth_data_word) begin
  109 |             pkt_buf[wr_ptr] <= {word_completes_pkt, s_axis_fso_tdata};
  110 |         end
  111 |     end
  112 | 
  113 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  114 |         if (!rst_n) begin
  115 |             fso_word_idx          <= 9'd0;
  116 |             fso_frame_valid_magic <= 1'b0;
  117 |             rem_pkt_bytes         <= 16'd0;
  118 |             cur_pkt_total_bytes   <= 16'd0;
  119 |             expected_fso_seq      <= 10'd0;
  120 |             seq_initialized       <= 1'b0;
  121 |             wr_ptr                <= 10'd0;
  122 |             committed_wr_ptr      <= 10'd0;
  123 |             reassembled_pkt_bytes <= 16'd0;
  124 |             reassembled_pkt_cnt   <= 16'd0;
  125 |         end else if (fire_in) begin
  126 |             // Advance FSO frame word index (0..476 = 477 words)
  127 |             if (s_axis_fso_tlast || (fso_word_idx == 9'd476)) begin
  128 |                 fso_word_idx <= 9'd0;
  129 |             end else begin
  130 |                 fso_word_idx <= fso_word_idx + 9'd1;
  131 |             end
  132 | 
  133 |             // 1. Word 0: Validate FSO Payload Header (0xAB) per Sec. 2.6.3.7.7
  134 |             if (is_pld_hdr_word) begin
  135 |                 if (pld_magic_ok) begin
  136 |                     fso_frame_valid_magic <= 1'b1;
  137 |                     expected_fso_seq      <= rx_fso_seq_num + 10'd1;
  138 |                     seq_initialized       <= 1'b1;
  139 | 
  140 |                     // Sec. 2.6.3.7.7 Sequence Skip Handling:
  141 |                     // If sequence number skipped while a partial packet was incomplete,
  142 |                     // discard the partial packet rolled back to committed_wr_ptr.
  143 |                     if (seq_initialized && (rx_fso_seq_num != expected_fso_seq) && (rem_pkt_bytes > 16'd0)) begin
  144 |                         wr_ptr        <= committed_wr_ptr;
  145 |                         rem_pkt_bytes <= 16'd0;
  146 |                     end else if ((rem_pkt_bytes > 16'd0) && (rx_pld_hdr_len != 14'd0)) begin
  147 |                         // Update remaining continuation length from Table 2-18 Payload Header
  148 |                         rem_pkt_bytes <= {2'b00, rx_pld_hdr_len};
  149 |                     end
  150 |                 end else begin
  151 |                     // Invalid 0xAB magic number: discard entire FSO frame per Sec. 2.6.3.7.7
  152 |                     fso_frame_valid_magic <= 1'b0;
  153 |                 end
  154 |             end
  155 | 
  156 |             // 2. FSO Packet Header (0xCDEF): Start of New Packet (only when rem_pkt_bytes == 0)
  157 |             else if (is_pkt_hdr_word) begin
  158 |                 rem_pkt_bytes       <= parsed_pkt_len;
  159 |                 cur_pkt_total_bytes <= parsed_pkt_len;
  160 |             end
  161 | 
  162 |             // 3. Active Ethernet Payload Words (Strips trailing zero-padding automatically)
  163 |             else if (is_eth_data_word) begin
  164 |                 wr_ptr <= wr_ptr + 10'd1;
  165 |                 if (word_completes_pkt) begin
  166 |                     rem_pkt_bytes         <= 16'd0;
  167 |                     committed_wr_ptr      <= wr_ptr + 10'd1;
  168 |                     reassembled_pkt_bytes <= cur_pkt_total_bytes;
  169 |                     reassembled_pkt_cnt   <= reassembled_pkt_cnt + 16'd1;
  170 |                 end else begin
  171 |                     rem_pkt_bytes <= rem_pkt_bytes - 16'd4;
  172 |                 end
  173 |             end
  174 |         end
  175 |     end
  176 | 
  177 |     // =======================================================
  178 |     // 3. CONTIGUOUS EGRESS DRAIN FSM (Zero Intra-Packet Gap)
  179 |     // =======================================================
  180 |     localparam ST_IDLE  = 2'd0;
  181 |     localparam ST_DRAIN = 2'd1;
  182 |     localparam ST_GAP   = 2'd2;
  183 | 
  184 |     reg [1:0]  drain_state;
  185 |     reg [2:0]  inter_pkt_gap;
  186 |     reg [31:0] asm_tdata;
  187 |     reg        asm_tvalid;
  188 |     reg        asm_tlast;
  189 | 
  190 |     wire        pkt_ready_to_drain = (rd_ptr != committed_wr_ptr);
  191 |     wire [32:0] head_pkt_word      = pkt_buf[rd_ptr];
  192 | 
  193 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  194 |         if (!rst_n) begin
  195 |             drain_state   <= ST_IDLE;
  196 |             rd_ptr        <= 10'd0;
  197 |             inter_pkt_gap <= 3'd0;
  198 |             asm_tdata     <= 32'd0;
  199 |             asm_tvalid    <= 1'b0;
  200 |             asm_tlast     <= 1'b0;
  201 |         end else begin
  202 |             case (drain_state)
  203 |                 ST_IDLE: begin
  204 |                     asm_tdata  <= 32'd0;
  205 |                     asm_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  206 |                     asm_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  207 |                     if (pkt_ready_to_drain && m_axis_eth_tready) begin
  208 |                         drain_state <= ST_DRAIN;
  209 |                     end
  210 |                 end
  211 | 
  212 |                 ST_DRAIN: begin
  213 |                     if (m_axis_eth_tready) begin
  214 |                         asm_tdata  <= head_pkt_word[31:0];
  215 |                         asm_tvalid <= 1'b1;
  216 |                         asm_tlast  <= head_pkt_word[32];
  217 |                         rd_ptr     <= rd_ptr + 10'd1;
  218 | 
  219 |                         if (head_pkt_word[32]) begin
  220 |                             inter_pkt_gap <= 3'd0;
  221 |                             drain_state   <= ST_GAP;
  222 |                         end
  223 |                     end
  224 |                 end
  225 | 
  226 |                 ST_GAP: begin
  227 |                     asm_tdata  <= 32'd0;
  228 |                     asm_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  229 |                     asm_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  230 |                     // Allow 6 cycles for mux_eth_32 (2-cycle Preamble) + XGMII IPG
  231 |                     if (inter_pkt_gap < 3'd5) begin
  232 |                         inter_pkt_gap <= inter_pkt_gap + 3'd1;
  233 |                     end else begin
  234 |                         inter_pkt_gap <= 3'd0;
  235 |                         drain_state   <= ST_IDLE;
  236 |                     end
  237 |                 end
  238 | 
  239 |                 default: drain_state <= ST_IDLE;
  240 |             endcase
  241 |         end
  242 |     end
  243 | 
  244 |     // =======================================================
  245 |     // 4. ETHERNET PREAMBLE GENERATOR & 2-CYCLE INJECTION MUX
  246 |     // =======================================================
  247 |     wire [63:0] eth_preamble_sfd;
  248 | 
  249 |     eth_preamble_gen u_eth_preamble_gen (
  250 |         .preamble_sfd (eth_preamble_sfd)
  251 |     );
  252 | 
  253 |     mux_eth_32 u_mux_eth_32 (
  254 |         .clk           (clk),
  255 |         .rst_n         (rst_n),
  256 |         .asm_data_in   (asm_tdata),
  257 |         .asm_valid_in  (asm_tvalid),
  258 |         .asm_last_in   (asm_tlast),
  259 |         .preamble_sfd  (eth_preamble_sfd),
  260 |         .eth_data_out  (m_axis_eth_tdata),
  261 |         .eth_valid_out (m_axis_eth_tvalid),
  262 |         .eth_last_out  (m_axis_eth_tlast)
  263 |     );
  264 | 
  265 | endmodule

SHA256: caf5a152d47271d681690dbe5bed2c9a660235cee65e5219f41576e359920667
Dependensi: fso_header_top, arq_tx_controller, fso_payload_top
Parameter dan counter
parameter [39:0] TX_PIPE_LATENCY_PS  = 40'd2_313_200,
parameter        LOOPBACK_ARQ_DIRECT = 1
localparam [39:0] ONE_SEC_PICOSEC = 40'd1_000_000_000_000
    1 | `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 | Description  : Ethernet to FSO Framer Grand Top Module.
    7 |                Implements the core "SDA Encoder" framing block from the architecture.
    8 |                
    9 |                Subsystem Integrations:
   10 |                1. Data Checker: Validates incoming Ethernet frames.
   11 |                2. arq_tx_controller.v: The Brain - SDA OCT State Machine.
   12 |                3. fso_header_top.v: 16-Byte Header Generator & FSO CRC-16.
   13 |                4. fso_payload_top.v: 1912-Byte Payload Assembler, IDLE/MGMT generators,
   14 |                   ARQ Retransmit RAM controller, and Final Multiplexer.
   15 |                
   16 |                Revision Note: 
   17 |                - Fixed Clock Domain Crossing (CDC) Interface. Header AXI-Stream 
   18 |                  output is now strictly 8-bit to match x_gth_logic.v requirements.
   19 |                  Port mappings have been rigidly aligned to prevent synthesis failures.
   20 |                - ETRI Timing Management Compliance: Connected 'tx_ts_in' and 
   21 |                  'ts_applies_in' to the Timestamp Manager with deterministic 
   22 |                  pipeline latency pre-compensation (TX_PIPE_LATENCY_PS = 2,313,200 ps)
   23 |                  so the Header TX_TS reflects the exact physical optical egress time.
   24 |                - [Rev 2.0 - 2026-10-27 04:26 KST - Target B5.3 Audit Fix]:
   25 |                  1. Fixed 'active_ts_applies' encoding per SDA OISL Table 2-9 & 
   26 |                     Section 2.6.3.3.4 (Page 24 & 26): value 3'b000 indicates that 
   27 |                     TX_TS applies to the CURRENT frame (when ts_valid == 1'b1).
   28 |                  2. Added pending ACK/NAK holding registers (pending_ack_valid, 
   29 |                     pending_ack, pending_rxfn) so that any 1-cycle 'rx_ack_valid_in' 
   30 |                     pulse arriving while a frame is mid-transmission (frame_busy == 1) 
   31 |                     is captured and held until the next 'tx_trigger_gen' fires.
   32 |                - [Rev 2.2 - 2026-10-28 14:55 KST]: Connected 'seg_valid_bytes' [10:0]
   33 |                  from XGMII Front-End Segmenter to u_fso_payload_top.
   34 |                - [Rev 2.5 - 2026-10-29 15:19 KST - Audit Fix R06]:
   35 |                  Added segment-boundary stall guard ('seg_in_progress') so that once a 
   36 |                  475-word Ethernet segment begins entering u_fso_payload_top, it is 
   37 |                  never truncated mid-segment when the 4th tracker slot fills up.
   38 |                - [Rev 2.6 - 2026-10-30 00:55 KST - Audit Fix N04]:
   39 |                  Qualified 'fso_data_valid' to u_arq_tx_controller with buffered 
   40 |                  DATA FIFO availability ('u_fso_payload_top.data_tvalid') or unstarted
   41 |                  ingress segment availability, preventing a completed 475-word segment 
   42 |                  from re-triggering an empty DATA frame after its final word.
   43 |                - [Rev 2.7 - 2026-10-30 01:55 KST - Audit Fix N05 & N13]:
   44 |                  1. [Fix N13]: Added exact modulo-10^12 picosecond rollover 
   45 |                     (ONE_SEC_PICOSEC = 40'd1_000_000_000_000) and modulo-60 second 
   46 |                     carry ('compensated_tod_sec') when adding TX_PIPE_LATENCY_PS, 
   47 |                     and fixed 'active_ts_applies' to 3'b000 (current frame association).
   48 |                  2. [Fix N05]: Added dedicated 'peer_rxfn_in', 'peer_ack_in', and 
   49 |                     'peer_ack_valid_in' ports alongside parameter 'LOOPBACK_ARQ_DIRECT'
   50 |                     so outbound Header ACK insertion (u_fso_header_top) is driven by 
   51 |                     local RX CRC results while TX tracker freeing/retransmission 
   52 |                     (u_arq_tx_controller) is driven by remote peer Header ACK in 
   53 |                     dual-terminal mode (LOOPBACK_ARQ_DIRECT = 0) or shared in 
   54 |                     single-FPGA loopback mode (LOOPBACK_ARQ_DIRECT = 1).
   55 | ===========================================================================
   56 | */
   57 | 
   58 | module ethernet_fso_framer #(
   59 |     // Deterministic delay from Header latch to first Preamble bit exiting GTH TX (in picoseconds)
   60 |     parameter [39:0] TX_PIPE_LATENCY_PS  = 40'd2_313_200,
   61 |     parameter        LOOPBACK_ARQ_DIRECT = 1
   62 | )(
   63 |     input  wire        clk,
   64 |     input  wire        rst_n,
   65 | 
   66 |     // -------------------------------------------------------
   67 |     // 1. INPUT: Ethernet Data & Length Metadata from XGMII Front-End Segmenter
   68 |     // -------------------------------------------------------
   69 |     input  wire [31:0] s_axis_eth_tdata,
   70 |     input  wire        s_axis_eth_tvalid,
   71 |     input  wire        s_axis_eth_tlast,
   72 |     output wire        s_axis_eth_tready,
   73 |     input  wire [10:0] seg_valid_bytes,
   74 | 
   75 |     // -------------------------------------------------------
   76 |     // 2. INPUT: Telemetry, PNT, and FCCH (From Satellite Subsystems)
   77 |     // -------------------------------------------------------
   78 |     input  wire        mgmt_trigger_1hz,
   79 |     input  wire [5:0]  rx_phy_ts_sec,
   80 |     input  wire [39:0] rx_phy_ts_picosec,
   81 |     input  wire [5:0]  tx_phy_ts_sec,
   82 |     input  wire [39:0] tx_phy_ts_picosec,
   83 |     input  wire [63:0] range_meters,
   84 |     input  wire [31:0] range_ts_sec,
   85 |     input  wire [39:0] range_ts_picosec,
   86 |     input  wire        ts_valid,
   87 |     input  wire [5:0]  tod_seconds_in, // Time of Day for Header Generation
   88 |     input  wire [3:0]  fcch_opcode,    // Fast Control Channel Opcode
   89 |     input  wire [15:0] fcch_pl,        // Fast Control Channel Payload
   90 | 
   91 |     // -------------------------------------------------------
   92 |     // 3. INPUT: ARQ Feedback (Local RX CRC Feedback & Remote Peer Header ACK)
   93 |     // -------------------------------------------------------
   94 |     input  wire [15:0] rx_rxfn_in,       // Local RX CRC-verified frame number (or loopback shared)
   95 |     input  wire        rx_ack_in,        // Local RX CRC ACK/NAK status
   96 |     input  wire        rx_ack_valid_in,  // Local RX CRC feedback valid
   97 |     input  wire [15:0] peer_rxfn_in,     // [Rev 2.7 - Fix N05] Remote peer ACK frame number from RX Header
   98 |     input  wire        peer_ack_in,      // [Rev 2.7 - Fix N05] Remote peer ACK/NAK bit from RX Header
   99 |     input  wire        peer_ack_valid_in,// [Rev 2.7 - Fix N05] Remote peer ACK valid bit from RX Header
  100 | 
  101 |     // -------------------------------------------------------
  102 |     // 4. OUTPUT: To CDC 1 (Clock Domain Crossing - x_gth_logic.v)
  103 |     // -------------------------------------------------------
  104 |     // Header Output Stream (16 Bytes Total - Sent 1 Byte per cycle)
  105 |     output wire [7:0]  m_axis_hdr_tdata,
  106 |     output wire        m_axis_hdr_tvalid,
  107 |     output wire        m_axis_hdr_tlast,
  108 |     input  wire        m_axis_hdr_tready,
  109 | 
  110 |     // Payload Output Stream (1912 Bytes Total - Sent 4 Bytes per cycle)
  111 |     output wire [31:0] m_axis_fso_tdata,
  112 |     output wire        m_axis_fso_tvalid,
  113 |     output wire        m_axis_fso_tlast,
  114 |     input  wire        m_axis_fso_tready,
  115 |     
  116 |     // Status Output
  117 |     output wire        eth_data_error_flag
  118 | );
  119 | 
  120 |     // =======================================================
  121 |     // INTERNAL INTERCONNECT WIRES
  122 |     // =======================================================
  123 |     wire [15:0] tx_txfn_out;
  124 |     wire [1:0]  payload_mux_sel;
  125 |     wire [1:0]  frame_type_out;
  126 |     wire        tx_trigger_gen;
  127 |     wire        tx_stall_mac;
  128 |     
  129 |     wire        ddr4_write_req;
  130 |     wire        ddr4_read_req;
  131 |     wire        ddr4_delete_req;
  132 |     wire [15:0] ddr4_addr;
  133 | 
  134 |     wire [31:0] chk_eth_tdata  = s_axis_eth_tdata;
  135 |     wire        chk_eth_tvalid = s_axis_eth_tvalid;
  136 |     wire        chk_eth_tlast  = s_axis_eth_tlast;
  137 |     wire        payload_eth_tready;
  138 | 
  139 |     // [Rev 2.5 - Fix R06] Track active 475-word ingress segment so tx_stall_mac only
  140 |     // gates NEW segments at segment boundaries and never truncates an active segment!
  141 |     reg seg_in_progress;
  142 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  143 |         if (!rst_n) begin
  144 |             seg_in_progress <= 1'b0;
  145 |         end else if (s_axis_eth_tvalid && s_axis_eth_tready) begin
  146 |             if (s_axis_eth_tlast)
  147 |                 seg_in_progress <= 1'b0;
  148 |             else
  149 |                 seg_in_progress <= 1'b1;
  150 |         end
  151 |     end
  152 | 
  153 |     wire eff_stall_ingress     = tx_stall_mac && !seg_in_progress;
  154 |     assign s_axis_eth_tready   = payload_eth_tready && !eff_stall_ingress;
  155 |     assign eth_data_error_flag = 1'b0;
  156 |     assign m_axis_hdr_tlast    = 1'b0;
  157 | 
  158 |     wire hdr_sys_busy;
  159 |     reg  payload_streaming;
  160 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  161 |         if (!rst_n) payload_streaming <= 1'b0;
  162 |         else if (tx_trigger_gen) payload_streaming <= 1'b1;
  163 |         else if (m_axis_fso_tvalid && m_axis_fso_tready && m_axis_fso_tlast) payload_streaming <= 1'b0;
  164 |     end
  165 | 
  166 |     wire frame_busy = hdr_sys_busy || payload_streaming;
  167 | 
  168 |     // [Rev 2.6 - Fix N04] Signal new DATA availability to scheduler only when either:
  169 |     // (a) fifo_data in u_fso_payload_top already holds buffered DATA words (data_tvalid), OR
  170 |     // (b) a new ingress segment is waiting at s_axis_eth_tvalid before streaming starts.
  171 |     wire fifo_data_has_frame = u_fso_payload_top.data_tvalid;
  172 |     wire new_data_seg_ready  = (chk_eth_tvalid && !seg_in_progress) || fifo_data_has_frame;
  173 | 
  174 |     // =======================================================
  175 |     // [Rev 2.0 & Rev 2.7 - Fix N05] SEPARATE LOCAL vs. PEER ARQ FEEDBACK ROUTING
  176 |     // 1. Outbound Header ACK insertion (u_fso_header_top) always reports our LOCAL
  177 |     //    RX CRC verification result (rx_rxfn_in, rx_ack_in, rx_ack_valid_in) to the peer.
  178 |     // 2. Local TX Tracker update (u_arq_tx_controller) uses:
  179 |     //    - peer_rxfn_in / peer_ack_in / peer_ack_valid_in when peer_ack_valid_in is driven
  180 |     //      or when LOOPBACK_ARQ_DIRECT == 0 (two-terminal mode).
  181 |     //    - rx_rxfn_in / rx_ack_in / rx_ack_valid_in when LOOPBACK_ARQ_DIRECT == 1.
  182 |     // =======================================================
  183 |     reg [15:0] pending_rxfn;
  184 |     reg        pending_ack;
  185 |     reg        pending_ack_valid;
  186 | 
  187 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  188 |         if (!rst_n) begin
  189 |             pending_rxfn      <= 16'd0;
  190 |             pending_ack       <= 1'b0;
  191 |             pending_ack_valid <= 1'b0;
  192 |         end else begin
  193 |             if (rx_ack_valid_in) begin
  194 |                 pending_rxfn      <= rx_rxfn_in;
  195 |                 pending_ack       <= rx_ack_in;
  196 |                 pending_ack_valid <= 1'b1;
  197 |             end else if (tx_trigger_gen) begin
  198 |                 pending_ack_valid <= 1'b0;
  199 |             end
  200 |         end
  201 |     end

  203 |     wire [15:0] hdr_rxfn_mux      = rx_ack_valid_in ? rx_rxfn_in : pending_rxfn;
  204 |     wire        hdr_ack_mux       = rx_ack_valid_in ? rx_ack_in  : pending_ack;
  205 |     wire        hdr_ack_valid_mux = rx_ack_valid_in | pending_ack_valid;
  206 | 
  207 |     wire        peer_port_active  = (peer_ack_valid_in === 1'b1);
  208 |     wire [15:0] tracker_rxfn_in   = peer_port_active    ? peer_rxfn_in      :
  209 |                                     LOOPBACK_ARQ_DIRECT ? rx_rxfn_in        : peer_rxfn_in;
  210 |     wire        tracker_ack_in    = peer_port_active    ? peer_ack_in       :
  211 |                                     LOOPBACK_ARQ_DIRECT ? rx_ack_in         : peer_ack_in;
  212 |     wire        tracker_valid_in  = peer_port_active    ? peer_ack_valid_in :
  213 |                                     LOOPBACK_ARQ_DIRECT ? rx_ack_valid_in   : (peer_ack_valid_in === 1'b1);
  214 | 
  215 |     // =======================================================
  216 |     // [Rev 2.7 - Fix N13] EGRESS TIMESTAMP PREDICTION WITH 10^12 PS ROLLOVER & MOD-60 CARRY
  217 |     // =======================================================

  222 |     wire [39:0] predicted_egress_tx_ts = tx_ts_sec_carry ?
  223 |                                          (raw_egress_tx_ts[39:0] - ONE_SEC_PICOSEC) :
  224 |                                          raw_egress_tx_ts[39:0];
  225 |     wire [5:0]  compensated_tod_sec    = tx_ts_sec_carry ?
  226 |                                          ((tod_seconds_in >= 6'd59) ? 6'd0 : (tod_seconds_in + 6'd1)) :
  227 |                                          tod_seconds_in;
  228 |     // SDA OISL Sec. 2.6.3.3.4: 3'b000 indicates TX_TS applies to the current frame
  229 |     wire [2:0]  active_ts_applies      = 3'b000;

  231 |     // =======================================================
  232 |     // B. ARQ TX CONTROLLER (The Orchestrator Brain)
  233 |     // =======================================================
  234 |     arq_tx_controller u_arq_tx_controller (
  235 |         .clk               (clk),

    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 | Description  : FSO AXI-Stream Synchronous FIFO.
    7 |                Configurable depth. Designed to be instantiated as:
    8 |                - fifo_data  (Buffers normal Payload traffic)
    9 |                - fifo_idle  (Buffers PRBS Idle traffic)
   10 |                - fifo_mgmt  (Buffers Telemetry/PNT traffic)
   11 | Revision Notes:
   12 |                - Separated the 'mem' array write operation into a dedicated 
   13 |                  'always @(posedge clk)' block without asynchronous reset so 
   14 |                  Vivado infers Distributed LUTRAM cleanly.
   15 | ===========================================================================
   16 | */
   17 | 
   18 | module fso_axis_fifo #(
   19 |     parameter DATA_WIDTH = 32,
   20 |     parameter FIFO_DEPTH = 1024,
   21 |     parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 10,
   22 |     parameter DEPTH      = FIFO_DEPTH,
   23 |     parameter PTR_WIDTH  = ADDR_WIDTH
   24 | )(
   25 |     input  wire                  clk,
   26 |     input  wire                  rst_n,
   27 | 
   28 |     // AXI-Stream Slave (Write Side)
   29 |     input  wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] s_axis_tdata,
   30 |     input  wire                  s_axis_tvalid,
   31 |     input  wire                  s_axis_tlast,
   32 |     output wire                  s_axis_tready,
   33 | 
   34 |     // AXI-Stream Master (Read Side)
   35 |     output wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] m_axis_tdata,
   36 |     output wire                  m_axis_tvalid,
   37 |     output wire                  m_axis_tlast,
   38 |     input  wire                  m_axis_tready
   39 | );
   40 | 
   41 |     (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [DATA_WIDTH:0] mem [0:FIFO_DEPTH-1];
   42 | 
   43 |     reg [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] wr_ptr;
   44 |     reg [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] rd_ptr;
   45 |     reg [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   count;
   46 | 
   47 |     wire full  = (count == FIFO_DEPTH);
   48 |     wire empty = (count == 0);
   49 | 
   50 |     assign s_axis_tready = !full;
   51 |     assign m_axis_tvalid = !empty;
   52 | 
   53 |     wire [DATA_WIDTH:0] head_word = mem[rd_ptr];
   54 |     assign m_axis_tdata = m_axis_tvalid ? head_word[DATA_WIDTH-1:0] : {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   55 |     assign m_axis_tlast = m_axis_tvalid ? head_word[DATA_WIDTH]     : 1'b0;
   56 | 
   57 |     wire wr_en = s_axis_tvalid && s_axis_tready;
   58 |     wire rd_en = m_axis_tvalid && m_axis_tready;
   59 | 
   60 |     // Purely Synchronous RAM Write
   61 |     always @(posedge clk) begin
   62 |         if (wr_en) begin
   63 |             mem[wr_ptr] <= {s_axis_tlast, s_axis_tdata};
   64 |         end
   65 |     end
   66 | 
   67 |     // Pointer and Occupancy Control Logic
   68 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   69 |         if (!rst_n) begin
   70 |             wr_ptr <= {ADDR_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   71 |             rd_ptr <= {ADDR_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   72 |             count  <= {(ADDR_WIDTH+1){1'b0}};
   73 |         end else begin
   74 |             if (wr_en) begin
   75 |                 wr_ptr <= wr_ptr + 1'b1;
   76 |             end
   77 |             if (rd_en) begin
   78 |                 rd_ptr <= rd_ptr + 1'b1;
   79 |             end
   80 |             case ({wr_en, rd_en})
   81 |                 2'b10:   count <= count + 1'b1;
   82 |                 2'b01:   count <= count - 1'b1;
   83 |                 default: count <= count;
   84 |             endcase
   85 |         end
   86 |     end
   87 | 
   88 | endmodule

Parameter dan counter

localparam IDLE   = 3'b001

23: reg [7:0] count = 8'd0;
    1 | `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Engineers    : Irzal Zaini (Original Core Math) 
    6 |                Williamsyah Baginda Miraj (Refactoring)
    7 | Description  : FSO Frame Header CRC-16 Generator.
    8 |                Uses polynomial: g(x) = x^16 + x^12 + x^5 + 1
    9 |                Compliant with SDA OISL Table 2-15.
   10 |                Processes 14 Bytes of Header data sequentially (8-bit/clock).
   11 | ===========================================================================
   12 | */
   13 | 
   14 | module fso_crc_16 #(parameter max = 15) (
   15 |     input  wire       clk,
   16 |     input  wire       rst_n,
   17 |     input  wire       en,
   18 |     input  wire [7:0] data_in,
   19 |     output wire       flag,
   20 |     output wire [7:0] data_out
   21 | );
   22 | 
   23 |     reg [7:0] count = 8'd0;
   24 | 
   25 |     localparam IDLE   = 3'b001;
   26 |     localparam ACTIVE = 3'b010;
   27 |     localparam END    = 3'b100;
   28 | 
   29 |     reg [2:0] state, next_state;
   30 |     reg [7:0] temp, crc_out;
   31 | 
   32 |     wire [15:0] D;
   33 |     reg  [15:0] Q = 16'b0;
   34 |     reg  [15:0] R = 16'b0;
   35 | 
   36 |     // FSM State Register
   37 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   38 |         if (~rst_n) state <= IDLE;
   39 |         else        state <= next_state;
   40 |     end
   41 | 
   42 |     // Byte Counter
   43 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   44 |         if (~rst_n) count <= 8'd0;
   45 |         else if (state == ACTIVE) count <= count + 1'b1;
   46 |         else count <= 8'd0;
   47 |     end
   48 | 
   49 |     // Next State Logic
   50 |     always @(*) begin
   51 |         case(state)
   52 |             IDLE:    next_state = en ? ACTIVE : IDLE;
   53 |             ACTIVE:  next_state = (count < max) ? ACTIVE : END;
   54 |             END:     next_state = IDLE;
   55 |             default: next_state = IDLE;
   56 |         endcase
   57 |     end
   58 | 
   59 |     // Input Register
   60 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   61 |         if (~rst_n) temp <= 8'd0;
   62 |         else        temp <= data_in;
   63 |     end
   64 | 
   65 |     // Shift Register Processing
   66 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   67 |         if(~rst_n) begin
   68 |             Q <= 16'b0;
   69 |             R <= 16'b0;
   70 |         end else if (state == ACTIVE) begin
   71 |             if (count < max) begin
   72 |                 Q <= D;
   73 |                 if (count == max - 2) R <= D; // Latch final CRC
   74 |             end else begin
   75 |                 Q <= 16'b0;
   76 |                 R <= 16'b0;
   77 |             end
   78 |         end
   79 |     end
   80 | 
   81 |     // Output Formatting (The Hardware MUX) -- following figure 2-9 sda oisl
   82 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   83 |         if(~rst_n) crc_out <= 8'b0;
   84 |         else if (state == ACTIVE) begin
   85 |             if (count < max - 1)      crc_out <= temp;      // Pass-through data
   86 |             else if (count == max - 1) crc_out <= R[15:8];  // Append CRC High Byte
   87 |             else if (count == max)     crc_out <= R[7:0];   // Append CRC Low Byte
   88 |         end
   89 |     end
   90 | 
   91 |     // CORE MATH: CCITT-16 XOR Logic (by Irzal Zaini)
   92 |     assign D[0]  = Q[8] ^ Q[12] ^ temp[0] ^ temp[4];
   93 |     assign D[1]  = Q[9] ^ Q[13] ^ temp[1] ^ temp[5];
   94 |     assign D[2]  = Q[10] ^ Q[14] ^ temp[2] ^ temp[6];
   95 |     assign D[3]  = Q[11] ^ Q[15] ^ temp[3] ^ temp[7];
   96 |     assign D[4]  = Q[12] ^ temp[4];
   97 |     assign D[5]  = Q[8] ^ Q[12] ^ Q[13] ^ temp[0] ^ temp[4] ^ temp[5];

    5 | Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 | Module Name  : fso_crc_16_checker
    7 | Description  : 16-bit Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC-16) Verifier for the 
    8 |                16-Byte SDA OISL Frame Header.
    9 |                Computes the CRC-16 polynomial x^16 + x^12 + x^5 + 1 over 
   10 |                the first 14 Header bytes (d0..d13) and compares the result 
   11 |                against bytes d14..d15.
   12 | 
   13 | Revision History:
   14 |   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 16-Byte Header CRC-16 verifier.
   15 |   - Rev 2.1 (2026-10-28 13:56 KST) : [Internal Audit Fix #3 - Strict CRC-16 Verification]
   16 |     Added parameter SIM_LEGACY_COMPAT = 0 (disabled by default) so operational 
   17 |     synthesis and compliance verification strictly require (rx_crc_word == Q) 
   18 |     without accepting the legacy simulation marker (16'hC160 + TXFN).
   19 | ===========================================================================
   20 | */
   21 | 
   22 | module fso_crc_16_checker #(
   23 |     parameter SIM_LEGACY_COMPAT = 0
   24 | )(
   25 |     input  wire       clk,
   26 |     input  wire       rst_n,
   27 |     input  wire       en,             // 16 cycles active from CDC 4 (header_dv)
   28 |     input  wire [7:0] data_in,        // 8-bit Header stream (d0..d15)
   29 |     output reg        hdr_check_done, // 1-cycle pulse after 16th byte
   30 |     output reg        hdr_crc_ok,     // 1 = CRC-16 PASS, 0 = CRC-16 FAIL
   31 |     output reg [15:0] calculated_crc,
   32 |     output reg [15:0] received_crc
   33 | );
   34 | 
   35 |     reg [4:0]  byte_cnt;
   36 |     reg [15:0] Q;
   37 |     reg [7:0]  txfn_lsb;
   38 |     reg [7:0]  txfn_msb;
   39 |     reg [7:0]  crc_msb_rx;
   40 | 
   41 |     // Parallel LFSR feedback equations for x^16 + x^12 + x^5 + 1
   42 |     wire [15:0] D;
   43 |     assign D[0]  = data_in[0] ^ data_in[4] ^ Q[8]  ^ Q[12];
   44 |     assign D[1]  = data_in[1] ^ data_in[5] ^ Q[9]  ^ Q[13];
   45 |     assign D[2]  = data_in[2] ^ data_in[6] ^ Q[10] ^ Q[14];
   46 |     assign D[3]  = data_in[3] ^ data_in[7] ^ Q[11] ^ Q[15];
   47 |     assign D[4]  = data_in[4] ^ Q[12];
   48 |     assign D[5]  = data_in[0] ^ data_in[4] ^ data_in[5] ^ Q[8]  ^ Q[12] ^ Q[13];
   49 |     assign D[6]  = data_in[1] ^ data_in[5] ^ data_in[6] ^ Q[9]  ^ Q[13] ^ Q[14];
   50 |     assign D[7]  = data_in[2] ^ data_in[6] ^ data_in[7] ^ Q[10] ^ Q[14] ^ Q[15];
   51 |     assign D[8]  = data_in[3] ^ data_in[7] ^ Q[0]  ^ Q[11] ^ Q[15];
   52 |     assign D[9]  = data_in[4] ^ Q[1]  ^ Q[12];
   53 |     assign D[10] = data_in[5] ^ Q[2]  ^ Q[13];
   54 |     assign D[11] = data_in[6] ^ Q[3]  ^ Q[14];
   55 |     assign D[12] = data_in[0] ^ data_in[4] ^ data_in[7] ^ Q[4]  ^ Q[8]  ^ Q[12] ^ Q[15];
   56 |     assign D[13] = data_in[1] ^ data_in[5] ^ Q[5]  ^ Q[9]  ^ Q[13];
   57 |     assign D[14] = data_in[2] ^ data_in[6] ^ Q[6]  ^ Q[10] ^ Q[14];
   58 |     assign D[15] = data_in[3] ^ data_in[7] ^ Q[7]  ^ Q[11] ^ Q[15];
   59 | 
   60 |     wire [15:0] rx_crc_word    = {crc_msb_rx, data_in};
   61 |     wire [15:0] sim_marker_crc = 16'hC160 + {txfn_msb, txfn_lsb};
   62 | 
   63 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   64 |         if (!rst_n) begin
   65 |             byte_cnt       <= 5'd0;
   66 |             Q              <= 16'd0;
   67 |             txfn_lsb       <= 8'd0;
   68 |             txfn_msb       <= 8'd0;
   69 |             crc_msb_rx     <= 8'd0;
   70 |             hdr_check_done <= 1'b0;
   71 |             hdr_crc_ok     <= 1'b0;
   72 |             calculated_crc <= 16'd0;
   73 |             received_crc   <= 16'd0;
   74 |         end else begin
   75 |             hdr_check_done <= 1'b0;
   76 | 
   77 |             if (en) begin
   78 |                 if (byte_cnt == 5'd0)  txfn_lsb <= data_in;
   79 |                 if (byte_cnt == 5'd1)  txfn_msb <= data_in;
   80 | 
   81 |                 if (byte_cnt < 5'd14) begin
   82 |                     // Bytes 0..13: Accumulate CRC-16 over 14-Byte Header
   83 |                     Q        <= D;
   84 |                     byte_cnt <= byte_cnt + 5'd1;
   85 |                 end else if (byte_cnt == 5'd14) begin
   86 |                     // Byte 14: Capture received CRC-16 MSB
   87 |                     crc_msb_rx <= data_in;
   88 |                     byte_cnt   <= byte_cnt + 5'd1;
   89 |                 end else begin
   90 |                     // Byte 15 (16th Byte): Capture CRC-16 LSB and verify
   91 |                     calculated_crc <= Q;
   92 |                     received_crc   <= rx_crc_word;
   93 |                     hdr_check_done <= 1'b1;
   94 |                     hdr_crc_ok     <= (rx_crc_word == Q) ||
   95 |                                       (SIM_LEGACY_COMPAT && (rx_crc_word == sim_marker_crc));
   96 |                     byte_cnt       <= 5'd0;
   97 |                     Q              <= 16'd0;
   98 |                 end
   99 |             end else begin
  100 |                 byte_cnt <= 5'd0;
  101 |                 Q        <= 16'd0;
  102 |             end
  103 |         end
  104 |     end
  105 | 
  106 | endmodule

    6 | Description  : SDA OISL FSO CRC-32 Generator (AXI4-Stream Compliant).

    8 |                Dynamic FSM intercepts the `tlast` signal from the 1908-Byte 
    9 |                payload, suppresses it, appends the 4-Byte calculated CRC, 
   10 |                and re-asserts the true `tlast` at the 1912th Byte.

   12 | */
   13 | 
   14 | module fso_crc_32 (
   15 |     input  wire        clk,
   16 |     input  wire        rst_n,
   17 | 
   18 |     // Input from fso_payload.v (1908 Bytes / 477 Words)

   20 |     input  wire        s_axis_tvalid,
   21 |     input  wire        s_axis_tlast,
   22 |     output wire        s_axis_tready,
   23 | 
   24 |     // Output to fifo_data (1912 Bytes / 478 Words)
   25 |     output reg  [31:0] m_axis_tdata,
   26 |     output reg         m_axis_tvalid,
   27 |     output reg         m_axis_tlast,
   28 |     input  wire        m_axis_tready
   29 | );

   33 |

   41 |     // register is either empty (!m_axis_tvalid) or being read this cycle.
   42 |     assign s_axis_tready = (state == S_DATA) && (!m_axis_tvalid || m_axis_tready);
   43 |     
   44 |     wire fire_in  = s_axis_tvalid && s_axis_tready;
   45 |     wire fire_out = m_axis_tvalid && m_axis_tready;
   46 | 
   47 |     // =======================================================
   48 |     // Dynamic FSM & Data Pipeline
   49 |     // =======================================================
   50 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   51 |         if (!rst_n) begin
   52 |             state         <= S_DATA;
   53 |             crc_reg       <= 32'd0;
   54 |             m_axis_tdata  <= 32'd0;
   55 |             m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
   56 |             m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;

   58 |             // Clear valid flag if downstream accepted the data
   59 |             if (fire_out) begin
   60 |                 m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
   61 |             end
   62 | 
   63 |             case (state)
   64 |                 S_DATA: begin
   65 |                     if (fire_in) begin
   66 |                         m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b1;
   67 |                         m_axis_tdata  <= s_axis_tdata; // Passthrough payload
   68 |                         m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;         // Suppress incoming tlast
   69 |                         crc_reg       <= next_crc;     // Update running CRC
   70 |

   73 |                             state <= S_CRC;
   74 |                         end
   75 |                     end

   83 |                         m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b1;         // Assert true end of frame
   84 |                         crc_reg       <= 32'd0;        // Reset CRC for next frame
   85 |                         state         <= S_DATA;       // Loop back
