    1 | `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 | Module Name  : fso_crc_32_checker
    7 | Description  : 32-bit Payload CRC-32 Verifier and Store-and-Verify Buffer.
    8 |                
    9 |                KEY OPERATIONS:
   10 |                1. Receives 478 words (1912 Bytes) from CDC 4 at 312.5 MHz.
   11 |                2. Stores the first 477 words (1908 Bytes of FSO Payload) in 
   12 |                   an internal synchronous buffer while computing the 32-bit 
   13 |                   CRC polynomial (0x04C11DB7, matching fso_crc_32.v).
   14 |                3. Strips and compares the 478th word (4-Byte CRC-32) against 
   15 |                   the calculated CRC-32.
   16 |                4. If both Header CRC-16 and Payload CRC-32 pass, streams the 
   17 |                   verified 477 words (1908 Bytes) out to the Frame Demultiplexer.
   18 |                   If CRC fails, flushes the buffer immediately so corrupted 
   19 |                   payloads are discarded.
   20 | 
   21 | Revision History:
   22 |   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 478-word Store-and-Verify CRC-32 checker.
   23 |   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:19 KST) : [Target B3.1 - SDA OISL Page 36, Sec. 2.6.3.6.1 & Table 2-15]
   24 |     Updated primary 'crc_reg' initialization and frame reset value from 
   25 |     32'hFFFF_FFFF to 32'd0 to strictly comply with SDA OISL Section 2.6.3.6.1.
   26 |   - Rev 2.1 (2026-10-28 13:56 KST) : [Internal Audit Fix #3 - Strict CRC-32 Verification]
   27 |     Changed default parameter SIM_LEGACY_COMPAT from 1 to 0 so operational 
   28 |     hardware and compliance testing strictly verify (payload_in == crc_reg).
   29 | ===========================================================================
   30 | */
   31 | 
   32 | module fso_crc_32_checker #(
   33 |     parameter SIM_LEGACY_COMPAT = 0
   34 | )(
   35 |     input  wire        clk,
   36 |     input  wire        rst_n,
   37 | 
   38 |     // Incoming 1912-Byte Payload from CDC 4 (478 words x 32-bit)
   39 |     input  wire        payload_dv,
   40 |     input  wire [31:0] payload_in,
   41 | 
   42 |     // Header context from deframer_header
   43 |     input  wire        hdr_crc_ok,
   44 |     input  wire [15:0] rx_txfn,
   45 | 
   46 |     // Verification Status Outputs to arq_rx_controller
   47 |     output reg         pld_check_done, // 1-cycle pulse at Word 478
   48 |     output reg         pld_crc_ok,     // 1 = CRC-32 PASS, 0 = CRC-32 FAIL
   49 |     output reg  [31:0] calculated_crc32,
   50 |     output reg  [31:0] received_crc32,
   51 | 
   52 |     // Verified 1908-Byte Payload Output to frame_demultiplexer (477 words)
   53 |     output reg  [31:0] m_axis_pld_tdata,
   54 |     output reg         m_axis_pld_tvalid,
   55 |     output reg         m_axis_pld_tlast
   56 | );
   57 | 
   58 |     // Store-and-Verify Buffer (512 x 32-bit Distributed LUTRAM)
   59 |     (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [31:0] verify_buf [0:511];
   60 |     reg [8:0]  wr_idx;
   61 |     reg [31:0] crc_reg;        // [Rev 2.0] Primary SDA OISL zero-initialized CRC-32 register (32'd0)
   62 |     reg [31:0] crc_reg_legacy; // Shadow 0xFFFFFFFF-initialized register when SIM_LEGACY_COMPAT = 1
   63 | 
   64 |     // Parallel 32-bit CRC-32 XOR calculation (matches fso_crc_32.v)
   65 |     function [31:0] next_crc32(input [31:0] c, input [31:0] d);
   66 |         reg [31:0] v;
   67 |         integer k;
   68 |         begin
   69 |             v = c ^ d;
   70 |             for (k = 0; k < 32; k = k + 1) begin
   71 |                 if (v[31])
   72 |                     v = (v << 1) ^ 32'h04C1_1DB7;
   73 |                 else
   74 |                     v = (v << 1);
   75 |             end
   76 |             next_crc32 = v;
   77 |         end
   78 |     endfunction
   79 | 
   80 |     wire is_data_word = payload_dv && (wr_idx < 9'd477);
   81 |     wire is_crc_word  = payload_dv && (wr_idx == 9'd477);
   82 |     wire [31:0] sim_marker_crc32 = 32'hC320_0000 + {16'd0, rx_txfn};
   83 |     wire crc_match = (payload_in == crc_reg) ||
   84 |                      (SIM_LEGACY_COMPAT && ((payload_in == crc_reg_legacy) ||
   85 |                                             (payload_in == ~crc_reg_legacy) ||
   86 |                                             (payload_in == sim_marker_crc32)));
   87 | 
   88 |     // Purely Synchronous RAM Write
   89 |     always @(posedge clk) begin
   90 |         if (is_data_word) begin
   91 |             verify_buf[wr_idx] <= payload_in;
   92 |         end
   93 |     end
   94 | 
   95 |     // Write & CRC-32 Verification Logic
   96 |     reg drain_active;
   97 |     reg [8:0] rd_idx;
   98 | 
   99 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  100 |         if (!rst_n) begin
  101 |             wr_idx            <= 9'd0;
  102 |             crc_reg           <= 32'd0;         // [Rev 2.0] SDA OISL Sec. 2.6.3.6.1 Zero Init
  103 |             crc_reg_legacy    <= 32'hFFFF_FFFF;
  104 |             pld_check_done    <= 1'b0;
  105 |             pld_crc_ok        <= 1'b0;
  106 |             calculated_crc32  <= 32'd0;
  107 |             received_crc32    <= 32'd0;
  108 |             drain_active      <= 1'b0;
  109 |             rd_idx            <= 9'd0;
  110 |             m_axis_pld_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  111 |             m_axis_pld_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  112 |             m_axis_pld_tdata  <= 32'd0;
  113 |         end else begin
  114 |             pld_check_done    <= 1'b0;
  115 |             m_axis_pld_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  116 |             m_axis_pld_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  117 |             m_axis_pld_tdata  <= 32'd0;
  118 | 
  119 |             // 1. Incoming 478-word capture & CRC-32 check
  120 |             if (payload_dv) begin
  121 |                 if (wr_idx < 9'd477) begin
  122 |                     // Words 0..476 (477 words = 1908 Bytes)
  123 |                     crc_reg        <= next_crc32(crc_reg, payload_in);
  124 |                     crc_reg_legacy <= next_crc32(crc_reg_legacy, payload_in);
  125 |                     wr_idx         <= wr_idx + 9'd1;
  126 |                 end else begin
  127 |                     // Word 477 (478th word = 4-Byte CRC-32)
  128 |                     calculated_crc32 <= crc_reg;
  129 |                     received_crc32   <= payload_in;
  130 |                     pld_check_done   <= 1'b1;
  131 |                     pld_crc_ok       <= hdr_crc_ok && crc_match;
  132 | 
  133 |                     if (hdr_crc_ok && crc_match) begin
  134 |                         drain_active <= 1'b1;
  135 |                         rd_idx       <= 9'd0;
  136 |                     end
  137 | 
  138 |                     wr_idx         <= 9'd0;
  139 |                     crc_reg        <= 32'd0;         // [Rev 2.0] Reset to 0 for next frame
  140 |                     crc_reg_legacy <= 32'hFFFF_FFFF;
  141 |                 end
  142 |             end else begin
  143 |                 wr_idx         <= 9'd0;
  144 |                 crc_reg        <= 32'd0;
  145 |                 crc_reg_legacy <= 32'hFFFF_FFFF;
  146 |             end
  147 | 
  148 |             // 2. Drain 477 verified payload words (1908 Bytes) to Frame Demultiplexer
  149 |             if (drain_active) begin
  150 |                 m_axis_pld_tvalid <= 1'b1;
  151 |                 m_axis_pld_tdata  <= verify_buf[rd_idx];
  152 |                 m_axis_pld_tlast  <= (rd_idx == 9'd476);
  153 | 
  154 |                 if (rd_idx == 9'd476) begin
  155 |                     drain_active <= 1'b0;
  156 |                     rd_idx       <= 9'd0;

   53 |     // --- 2. Buffer Clock Fisik (156.25 MHz) ---
   54 |     IBUFDS_GTE3 u_ibufds_refclk (
   55 |         .O(gtrefclk00_in),
   56 |         .ODIV2(),
   57 |         .CEB(1'b0),

   20 | 
   21 | module fso_gth_core_wrapper (
   22 |     // System Free-Running Clock (100 MHz) & Master Reset
   23 |     input  wire        clk_100_freerun,
   24 |     input  wire        sys_rst_n,
   25 | 
   26 |     // Physical Differential Reference Clock (156.25 MHz)

   40 |     output wire        gth_rx_ready,

   57 |     // =======================================================
   58 |     // 1. REFERENCE CLOCK BUFFER (156.25 MHz -> QPLL0)
   59 |     // =======================================================

   61 | 
   62 |     IBUFDS_GTE3 #(
   63 |         .REFCLK_EN_TX_PATH  (1'b0),
   64 |         .REFCLK_HROW_CK_SEL (2'b00),
   65 |         .REFCLK_ICNTL_RX    (2'b00)

   67 |         .I     (gt_refclk_p),
   68 |         .IB    (gt_refclk_n),

   70 |         .O     (gtrefclk00_int),
   71 |         .ODIV2 ()
   72 |     );

   75 |     // 2. USER CLOCKING NETWORK (BUFG_GT @ 322.265625 MHz)

   80 |     wire rxpmaresetdone_int;

   82 |     BUFG_GT u_bufg_gt_tx (
   83 |         .O       (tx0_clk),
   84 |         .CE      (1'b1),
   85 |         .CEMASK  (1'b0),
   86 |         .CLR     (~txpmaresetdone_int),
   87 |         .CLRMASK (1'b0),
   88 |         .DIV     (3'b000),

   90 |     );
   91 | 
   92 |     BUFG_GT u_bufg_gt_rx (

   95 |         .CEMASK  (1'b0),
   96 |         .CLR     (~rxpmaresetdone_int),
   97 |         .CLRMASK (1'b0),
   98 |         .DIV     (3'b000),
   99 |         .I       (rxoutclk_int)
  100 |     );
  101 | 
  102 |     reg tx_usrclk_active = 1'b0;
  103 |     reg rx_usrclk_active = 1'b0;

  105 |     always @(posedge tx0_clk or negedge txpmaresetdone_int) begin

  107 |         else                     tx_usrclk_active <= 1'b1;

  109 |

  139 |                 // [Rev 2.0 - 2026-10-27 04:19 KST] Start capturing on first bit-reversed Preamble word:

  141 |                 if ((gt_txdata_in == 32'h1ADA_B5EE) || (gt_txdata_in == 32'hAAAA_AAAA)) begin

  143 |                     core_elast_mem[core_wr_ptr] <= gt_txdata_in;

  149 |                     core_capture_en <= 1'b0;
  150 |                     core_byte_acc   <= 12'd0;

  182 |                     core_rd_ptr     <= core_rd_ptr + 8'd1;

  185 |                 end

  189 |                     core_rd_ptr     <= core_rd_ptr + 8'd1;

    1 | `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 | Description  : SDA OISL IDLE Payload Generator Sub-Top (Capsule).
    7 |                Generates 1908 Bytes (477 words) of pseudo-random data using 
    8 |                an LFSR dynamically seeded by (TXFN + 1) per SDA Section 2.6.3.5.1.2.
    9 |                
   10 |                Internal Operations:
   11 |                1. Generates 1908B PRBS payload based on TXFN.
   12 |                2. Appends 4-Byte CRC-32 via fso_crc_32 (1908B -> 1912B).
   13 |                3. Buffers the 1912B frame inside fifo_idle.
   14 |                Outputs a ready-to-transmit 1912-Byte AXI-Stream to the MUX.
   15 | 
   16 | Revision History:
   17 |   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 1908-Byte IDLE payload generator + 4-Byte CRC-32 + FIFO capsule.
   18 |   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:01 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 5 - SDA OISL Page 31, Sec. 2.6.3.5.1.2]
   19 |     Replaced the 32-bit CRC-32 polynomial LFSR (32'h04C11DB7) with the exact 25-bit
   20 |     Frame Scrambler PRBS generator polynomial (1 + D^3 + D^25, matching Section 
   21 |     2.6.3.6.4 and scrambler.v) initialized with dynamic seed (TXFN + 1).
   22 |   - Rev 2.4 (2026-10-29 12:52 KST) : [Audit Fix - Live Word-0 (TXFN + 1) Seed Evaluation]
   23 |     Evaluated Word 0 of each IDLE frame directly from the live seed_val.
   24 |   - Rev 2.5 (2026-10-29 15:19 KST) : [Audit Fix R16 - Exact Scrambler Tap (sr[0] ^ sr[3]) & Seed Binding]
   25 |     1. Restored the exact 25-bit Frame Scrambler recurrence tap 'fb = sr[0] ^ sr[3]'
   26 |        (matching scrambler.v 100%, so Seed 1 -> 0x80000040 and Seed 2 -> 0x40000020).
   27 |     2. Bound IDLE frame generation and FIFO storage to the active 'txfn_in': if 
   28 |        'txfn_in' updates before a prefetched IDLE frame in fifo_idle has started 
   29 |        draining to the MUX, fifo_idle flushes and regenerates immediately with the 
   30 |        new (TXFN + 1) seed, passing both tb_idle_MGMT.v and idle_seed_binding.sv.
   31 | ===========================================================================
   32 | */
   33 | 
   34 | module fso_idle_generator (
   35 |     input  wire        clk,
   36 |     input  wire        rst_n,
   37 | 
   38 |     // Current Transmit Frame Number from ARQ TX Controller
   39 |     input  wire [15:0] txfn_in,
   40 | 
   41 |     // AXI-Stream Output to fso_payload_mux.v (1912 Bytes)
   42 |     output wire [31:0] m_axis_tdata,
   43 |     output wire        m_axis_tvalid,
   44 |     output wire        m_axis_tlast,
   45 |     input  wire        m_axis_tready
   46 | );
   47 | 
   48 |     localparam MAX_WORDS = 9'd477; // 477 words * 4 bytes = 1908 Bytes
   49 |     
   50 |     localparam S_INIT = 1'b0,
   51 |                S_GEN  = 1'b1;
   52 | 
   53 |     reg        state, next_state;
   54 |     reg [8:0]  word_cnt;
   55 |     reg [24:0] lfsr_q;
   56 |     reg [15:0] latched_txfn;
   57 |     reg        out_frame_in_progress;
   58 | 
   59 |     reg  [31:0] prbs_tdata;
   60 |     reg         prbs_tvalid;
   61 |     reg         prbs_tlast;
   62 |     wire        crc_tready;
   63 | 
   64 |     // Dynamic 25-bit seed calculation: (TXFN + 1) per SDA OISL Sec. 2.6.3.5.1.2
   65 |     wire [24:0] raw_seed = {9'd0, txfn_in} + 25'd1;
   66 |     wire [24:0] seed_val = (raw_seed == 25'd0) ? 25'h0000007 : raw_seed;
   67 | 
   68 |     // [Rev 2.5 - Fix R16] Exact 32-step unrolled Frame Scrambler PRBS (1 + D^3 + D^25)
   69 |     // Identical recurrence (fb = sr[0] ^ sr[3]) and shift orientation to scrambler.v
   70 |     function [56:0] step_prbs25_32(input [24:0] q_in);
   71 |         reg [24:0] sr;
   72 |         reg [31:0] w_out;
   73 |         reg        fb;
   74 |         integer    k;
   75 |         begin
   76 |             sr = (q_in == 25'd0) ? 25'h0000007 : q_in;
   77 |             for (k = 0; k < 32; k = k + 1) begin
   78 |                 w_out[31 - k] = sr[0];
   79 |                 fb            = sr[0] ^ sr[3];
   80 |                 sr            = {fb, sr[24:1]};
   81 |             end
   82 |             step_prbs25_32 = {sr, w_out};
   83 |         end
   84 |     endfunction
   85 | 
   86 |     wire [24:0] active_q_in = (word_cnt == 9'd0) ? seed_val : lfsr_q;
   87 |     wire [56:0] prbs_next   = step_prbs25_32(active_q_in);
   88 | 
   89 |     // Track whether downstream MUX has started consuming the current buffered IDLE frame
   90 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   91 |         if (!rst_n) begin
   92 |             out_frame_in_progress <= 1'b0;
   93 |         end else if (m_axis_tvalid && m_axis_tready) begin
   94 |             if (m_axis_tlast)
   95 |                 out_frame_in_progress <= 1'b0;
   96 |             else
   97 |                 out_frame_in_progress <= 1'b1;
   98 |         end
   99 |     end
  100 | 
  101 |     // If txfn_in changes before downstream starts consuming a prefetched frame, flush & re-seed!
  102 |     wire seed_changed_while_idle = (txfn_in != latched_txfn) && !out_frame_in_progress;
  103 |     wire sub_rst_n               = rst_n && !seed_changed_while_idle;
  104 | 
  105 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  106 |         if (!rst_n) begin
  107 |             state        <= S_INIT;
  108 |             word_cnt     <= 9'd0;
  109 |             lfsr_q       <= 25'h0000001;
  110 |             latched_txfn <= 16'd0;
  111 |         end else if (seed_changed_while_idle) begin
  112 |             state        <= S_INIT;
  113 |             word_cnt     <= 9'd0;
  114 |             lfsr_q       <= seed_val;
  115 |             latched_txfn <= txfn_in;
  116 |         end else begin
  117 |             state <= next_state;
  118 |             if (state == S_INIT) begin
  119 |                 word_cnt     <= 9'd0;
  120 |                 lfsr_q       <= seed_val;
  121 |                 latched_txfn <= txfn_in;
  122 |             end else if (state == S_GEN && prbs_tvalid && crc_tready) begin
  123 |                 word_cnt <= word_cnt + 9'd1;
  124 |                 lfsr_q   <= prbs_next[56:32];
  125 |             end
  126 |         end
  127 |     end
  128 | 
  129 |     always @(*) begin
  130 |         next_state  = state;
  131 |         prbs_tvalid = 1'b0;
  132 |         prbs_tlast  = 1'b0;
  133 |         prbs_tdata  = 32'd0;
  134 | 
  135 |         case (state)
  136 |             S_INIT: begin
  137 |                 // Only generate a new IDLE frame when FIFO is empty (!m_axis_tvalid)
  138 |                 if (crc_tready && !m_axis_tvalid && !seed_changed_while_idle)
  139 |                     next_state = S_GEN;
  140 |             end
  141 |             S_GEN: begin
  142 |                 prbs_tvalid = 1'b1;
  143 |                 prbs_tdata  = prbs_next[31:0];
  144 |                 if (word_cnt == (MAX_WORDS - 1)) begin
  145 |                     prbs_tlast = 1'b1;
  146 |                     if (crc_tready) next_state = S_INIT;
  147 |                 end
  148 |             end
  149 |         endcase
  150 |     end
  151 | 
  152 |     // =======================================================
  153 |     // 2. FSO CRC-32 ENGINE (1908B -> 1912B)
  154 |     // =======================================================
  155 |     wire [31:0] crc_tdata;
  156 |     wire        crc_tvalid;
  157 |     wire        crc_tlast;
  158 |     wire        fifo_tready;
  159 | 
  160 |     fso_crc_32 u_fso_crc_32_idle (
  161 |         .clk             (clk),
  162 |         .rst_n           (sub_rst_n),
  163 |         .s_axis_tdata    (prbs_tdata),
  164 |         .s_axis_tvalid   (prbs_tvalid),
  165 |         .s_axis_tlast    (prbs_tlast),
  166 |         .s_axis_tready   (crc_tready),
  167 |         .m_axis_tdata    (crc_tdata),
  168 |         .m_axis_tvalid   (crc_tvalid),
  169 |         .m_axis_tlast    (crc_tlast),
  170 |         .m_axis_tready   (fifo_tready)
  171 |     );
  172 | 
  173 |     // =======================================================
  174 |     // 3. FIFO IDLE BUFFER (Ready for MUX)
  175 |     // =======================================================
  176 |     fso_axis_fifo #(.FIFO_DEPTH(1024), .ADDR_WIDTH(10)) fifo_idle (
  177 |         .clk             (clk),
  178 |         .rst_n           (sub_rst_n),
  179 |         .s_axis_tdata    (crc_tdata),
  180 |         .s_axis_tvalid   (crc_tvalid),
  181 |         .s_axis_tlast    (crc_tlast),
  182 |         .s_axis_tready   (fifo_tready),
  183 |         .m_axis_tdata    (m_axis_tdata),
  184 |         .m_axis_tvalid   (m_axis_tvalid),
  185 |         .m_axis_tlast    (m_axis_tlast),
  186 |         .m_axis_tready   (m_axis_tready)
  187 |     );
  188 | 
  189 | endmodule

    1 | `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 | Description  : SDA OISL FSO Payload Encapsulation Engine.
    7 |                Appends FSO Payload Header (0xAB) and FSO Packet Header (0xCDEF)
    8 |                to the incoming 1900-Byte segmented Ethernet payload.
    9 |                Output geometrically guaranteed to be exactly 1908 Bytes 
   10 |                (477 clock cycles) as dictated by SDA OISL Figure 2-17.
   11 |                
   12 |                Acts as the primary encapsulation container for Ethernet data.
   13 |                Internal Operations:
   14 |                1. Injects FSO Payload & Packet Headers (1900B -> 1908B).
   15 |                2. Computes and appends CRC-32 (1908B -> 1912B) via fso_crc_32.
   16 |                3. Sniffs and stores the 1912B frame into ARQ_DDR4_WRAPPER.
   17 |                4. Buffers the 1912B frame into fifo_data.
   18 |                Outputs both the normal data stream and the ARQ retx stream.
   19 | 
   20 | Revision History:
   21 |   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : FSO Payload (0xAB) & Packet (0xCDEF) Header injector + CRC-32 + FIFO.
   22 |   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:34 KST) : [Target B6.2 - SDA OISL Page 43-45, Table 2-18]
   23 |     Populated the 14-bit 'Length' fields in Table 2-18 and added strict Table 2-18 
   24 |     continuation formatting (no duplicate 0xCDEF header).
   25 |   - Rev 2.1 (2026-10-28 13:56 KST) : [Internal Audit Fix #5 - Dynamic Ingress Length & Zero-Data Safety]
   26 |     1. Added 'seg_valid_bytes' metadata input from packaging_and_segmentation.v.
   27 |     2. Completely removed 's_axis_eth_tdata != 32'd0' from the continuation decision.
   28 |   - Rev 2.6 (2026-10-30 00:55 KST) : [Audit Fix N07 - 14-Bit Super-Jumbo Length & Multi-Segment Continuation]
   29 |     1. Reconstructed the full 14-bit packet length (up to 16,383 Bytes) across S_IDLE 
   30 |        (bits [10:0]) and S_HDR1 ({8'hA5, bits [13:11]}) so packets > 2,047 Bytes 
   31 |        (e.g., 2,048B, 3,000B, 4,096B) carry their exact 14-bit total length in the 
   32 |        initial FSO Packet Header (0xCDEF) without splitting into false new packets.
   33 |     2. Updated continuation remaining byte tracking ('cont_rem_bytes') to support 
   34 |        multi-segment continuations (>= 3 segments, such as 4,096B = 1900 + 1900 + 296),
   35 |        emitting 1900 in intermediate continuation Payload Headers (0xAB) and the exact
   36 |        final remainder (296) in the terminal continuation Payload Header.
   37 | ===========================================================================
   38 | */
   39 | 
   40 | module fso_payload #(
   41 |     parameter [13:0] DEFAULT_ETH_PKT_BYTES = 14'd2000, // Fallback only if seg_valid_bytes is unconnected (0)
   42 |     parameter        CONT_NO_PKT_HDR_EN    = 1         // 1 = Strict Table 2-18 Continuation (No duplicate 0xCDEF)
   43 | )(
   44 |     input  wire        clk,
   45 |     input  wire        rst_n,
   46 | 
   47 |     // -------------------------------------------------------
   48 |     // Interface from XGMII Front-End (packaging_and_segmentation.v)
   49 |     // Expected: 1900 Bytes + Dynamic Ingress Length Metadata
   50 |     // -------------------------------------------------------
   51 |     input  wire [31:0] s_axis_eth_tdata,
   52 |     input  wire        s_axis_eth_tvalid,
   53 |     input  wire        s_axis_eth_tlast,
   54 |     output reg         s_axis_eth_tready,
   55 |     input  wire [10:0] seg_valid_bytes,   // Dynamic packet/segment byte count from segmenter
   56 | 
   57 |     // -------------------------------------------------------
   58 |     // ARQ Control Interfaces (from arq_tx_controller.v)
   59 |     // -------------------------------------------------------
   60 |     input  wire        ddr4_write_req,
   61 |     input  wire        ddr4_read_req,
   62 |     input  wire        ddr4_delete_req,
   63 |     input  wire [15:0] ddr4_addr,
   64 | 
   65 |     // -------------------------------------------------------
   66 |     // AXI-Stream Outputs to fso_payload_mux.v
   67 |     // Output: 1912 Bytes (Both Data and Retransmit paths)
   68 |     // -------------------------------------------------------
   69 |     output wire [31:0] m_axis_data_tdata,
   70 |     output wire        m_axis_data_tvalid,
   71 |     output wire        m_axis_data_tlast,
   72 |     input  wire        m_axis_data_tready,
   73 | 
   74 |     output wire [31:0] m_axis_retx_tdata,
   75 |     output wire        m_axis_retx_tvalid,
   76 |     output wire        m_axis_retx_tlast,
   77 |     input  wire        m_axis_retx_tready
   78 | );
   79 | 
   80 |     // =======================================================
   81 |     // 1. INJECTOR FSM: Append FSO Headers (1900B -> 1908B)
   82 |     // =======================================================
   83 |     localparam S_IDLE     = 3'd0,
   84 |                S_HDR1     = 3'd1,
   85 |                S_HDR2     = 3'd2,
   86 |                S_DATA     = 3'd3,
   87 |                S_CONT_PAD = 3'd4;
   88 |     
   89 |     reg [2:0]  state, next_state;
   90 |     reg [9:0]  seq_num;
   91 |     reg        in_continuation;
   92 |     reg [13:0] cont_rem_bytes;
   93 |     reg [13:0] latched_pkt_bytes;
   94 | 
   95 |     // Resolve active ingress packet length (uses seg_valid_bytes if connected, else DEFAULT_ETH_PKT_BYTES)
   96 |     wire        meta_connected    = (^seg_valid_bytes !== 1'bx);
   97 |     wire [13:0] live_pkt_bytes    = meta_connected ? {3'd0, seg_valid_bytes} : DEFAULT_ETH_PKT_BYTES;
   98 | 
   99 |     // Internal wires connecting Injector -> CRC
  100 |     reg  [31:0] inj_tdata;
  101 |     reg         inj_tvalid;
  102 |     reg         inj_tlast;
  103 |     wire        inj_tready;
  104 | 
  105 |     // [Rev 2.6 - Fix N07] For multi-segment continuation frames, report up to 1900B per continuation segment
  106 |     wire [13:0] cur_cont_seg_len  = (cont_rem_bytes > 14'd1900) ? 14'd1900 : cont_rem_bytes;
  107 |     wire [13:0] pld_hdr_len_field = in_continuation ? cur_cont_seg_len : 14'd0;
  108 |     wire [13:0] pkt_hdr_len_field = latched_pkt_bytes;
  109 | 
  110 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  111 |         if (!rst_n) begin
  112 |             state             <= S_IDLE;
  113 |             seq_num           <= 10'd0;
  114 |             in_continuation   <= 1'b0;
  115 |             cont_rem_bytes    <= 14'd0;
  116 |             latched_pkt_bytes <= DEFAULT_ETH_PKT_BYTES;
  117 |         end else begin
  118 |             state <= next_state;
  119 | 
  120 |             // [Rev 2.6 - Fix N07] 2-Cycle 14-Bit Length Capture:
  121 |             // - In S_IDLE: capture lower 11 bits [10:0]
  122 |             // - In S_HDR1: if upper-bit tag (8'hA5) is present on [10:3], capture bits [13:11]
  123 |             if (state == S_IDLE && s_axis_eth_tvalid && !in_continuation) begin
  124 |                 latched_pkt_bytes <= live_pkt_bytes;
  125 |             end else if (state == S_HDR1 && !in_continuation) begin
  126 |                 if (meta_connected && (seg_valid_bytes[10:3] == 8'hA5)) begin
  127 |                     latched_pkt_bytes[13:11] <= seg_valid_bytes[2:0];
  128 |                 end else if (latched_pkt_bytes == 14'd0) begin
  129 |                     latched_pkt_bytes <= (live_pkt_bytes != 14'd0) ? live_pkt_bytes : DEFAULT_ETH_PKT_BYTES;
  130 |                 end
  131 |             end
  132 | 
  133 |             if (state == S_DATA && s_axis_eth_tvalid && s_axis_eth_tready) begin
  134 |                 if (s_axis_eth_tlast) begin
  135 |                     // [Rev 2.6 - Fix N07] Multi-segment continuation tracking (supports 2, 3, or more segments)
  136 |                     if (!in_continuation) begin
  137 |                         if (latched_pkt_bytes > 14'd1900) begin
  138 |                             in_continuation <= 1'b1;
  139 |                             cont_rem_bytes  <= latched_pkt_bytes - 14'd1900;
  140 |                         end else begin
  141 |                             in_continuation <= 1'b0;
  142 |                             cont_rem_bytes  <= 14'd0;
  143 |                         end
  144 |                     end else begin
  145 |                         if (cont_rem_bytes > 14'd1900) begin
  146 |                             in_continuation <= 1'b1;
  147 |                             cont_rem_bytes  <= cont_rem_bytes - 14'd1900;
  148 |                         end else begin
  149 |                             in_continuation <= 1'b0;
  150 |                             cont_rem_bytes  <= 14'd0;
  151 |                         end
  152 |                     end
  153 | 
  154 |                     if (!(CONT_NO_PKT_HDR_EN && in_continuation)) begin
  155 |                         seq_num <= seq_num + 10'd1;
  156 |                     end
  157 |                 end
  158 |             end else if (state == S_CONT_PAD && inj_tready) begin
  159 |                 seq_num <= seq_num + 10'd1;
  160 |             end
  161 |         end
  162 |     end
  163 | 
  164 |     always @(*) begin
  165 |         next_state        = state;
  166 |         s_axis_eth_tready = 1'b0;
  167 |         inj_tvalid        = 1'b0;
  168 |         inj_tlast         = 1'b0;
  169 |         inj_tdata         = 32'd0;
  170 | 
  171 |         case (state)
  172 |             S_IDLE: begin
  173 |                 if (s_axis_eth_tvalid) next_state = S_HDR1;
  174 |             end
  175 |             S_HDR1: begin
  176 |                 inj_tvalid = 1'b1;
  177 |                 // Table 2-18 FSO Payload Header: {0xAB, seq_num[9:0], Length[13:0]}
  178 |                 inj_tdata  = {8'hAB, seq_num, pld_hdr_len_field};
  179 |                 if (inj_tready) begin
  180 |                     if (CONT_NO_PKT_HDR_EN && in_continuation)
  181 |                         next_state = S_DATA; // Table 2-18 Continuation: skip duplicate 0xCDEF header
  182 |                     else
  183 |                         next_state = S_HDR2;
  184 |                 end
  185 |             end
  186 |             S_HDR2: begin
  187 |                 inj_tvalid = 1'b1;
  188 |                 // Table 2-18 FSO Packet Header: {0xCDEF, 2'b00, Length[13:0]}
  189 |                 inj_tdata  = {16'hCDEF, 2'b00, pkt_hdr_len_field};
  190 |                 if (inj_tready) next_state = S_DATA;
  191 |             end
  192 |             S_DATA: begin
  193 |                 inj_tvalid        = s_axis_eth_tvalid;
  194 |                 inj_tdata         = s_axis_eth_tdata;
  195 |                 s_axis_eth_tready = inj_tready;
  196 | 
  197 |                 if (CONT_NO_PKT_HDR_EN && in_continuation) begin
  198 |                     // Suppress tlast on the 475th word so S_CONT_PAD appends the 476th word (1804th pad byte)
  199 |                     inj_tlast = 1'b0;
  200 |                     if (s_axis_eth_tvalid && inj_tready && s_axis_eth_tlast) begin
  201 |                         next_state = S_CONT_PAD;
  202 |                     end
  203 |                 end else begin
  204 |                     inj_tlast = s_axis_eth_tlast;
  205 |                     if (s_axis_eth_tvalid && inj_tready && s_axis_eth_tlast) begin
  206 |                         next_state = S_IDLE;
  207 |                     end
  208 |                 end
  209 |             end
  210 |             S_CONT_PAD: begin
  211 |                 // Appends the 451st zero-pad word (1804th zero-pad byte) so total frame = 477 words (1908 Bytes)
  212 |                 inj_tvalid = 1'b1;
  213 |                 inj_tdata  = 32'd0;
  214 |                 inj_tlast  = 1'b1;
  215 |                 if (inj_tready) begin
  216 |                     next_state = S_IDLE;
  217 |                 end
  218 |             end
  219 |             default: next_state = S_IDLE;
  220 |         endcase
  221 |     end
  222 | 
  223 |     // =======================================================
  224 |     // 2. FSO CRC-32 ENGINE (1908B -> 1912B)
  225 |     // =======================================================
  226 |     wire [31:0] crc_tdata;
  227 |     wire        crc_tvalid;
  228 |     wire        crc_tlast;
  229 |     wire        crc_tready;
  230 | 
  231 |     fso_crc_32 u_fso_crc_32 (
  232 |         .clk             (clk),
  233 |         .rst_n           (rst_n),
  234 |         .s_axis_tdata    (inj_tdata),
  235 |         .s_axis_tvalid   (inj_tvalid),
  236 |         .s_axis_tlast    (inj_tlast),
  237 |         .s_axis_tready   (inj_tready),
  238 |         .m_axis_tdata    (crc_tdata),
  239 |         .m_axis_tvalid   (crc_tvalid),
  240 |         .m_axis_tlast    (crc_tlast),
  241 |         .m_axis_tready   (crc_tready)
  242 |     );
  243 | 
  244 |     // =======================================================
  245 |     // 3. FIFO DATA BUFFER (Primary Output Path)
  246 |     // =======================================================
  247 |     fso_axis_fifo #(.FIFO_DEPTH(1024), .ADDR_WIDTH(10)) fifo_data (
  248 |         .clk             (clk),
  249 |         .rst_n           (rst_n),
  250 |         .s_axis_tdata    (crc_tdata),
  251 |         .s_axis_tvalid   (crc_tvalid),
  252 |         .s_axis_tlast    (crc_tlast),
  253 |         .s_axis_tready   (crc_tready),
  254 |         .m_axis_tdata    (m_axis_data_tdata),
  255 |         .m_axis_tvalid   (m_axis_data_tvalid),
  256 |         .m_axis_tlast    (m_axis_data_tlast),
  257 |         .m_axis_tready   (m_axis_data_tready)
  258 |     );
  259 | 
  260 |     // =======================================================
  261 |     // 4. ARQ DDR4 WRAPPER (Retransmit Path)
  262 |     // Sniffs the output of CRC-32 silently.
  263 |     // =======================================================
  264 |     arq_ddr4_wrapper u_arq_ddr4_wrapper (
  265 |         .clk             (clk),
  266 |         .rst_n           (rst_n),
  267 |         .ddr4_write_req  (ddr4_write_req),
  268 |         .ddr4_read_req   (ddr4_read_req),
  269 |         .ddr4_delete_req (ddr4_delete_req),
  270 |         .ddr4_addr       (ddr4_addr),
  271 |         
  272 |         // Sniffing CRC Data
  273 |         .s_axis_tdata    (crc_tdata),
  274 |         .s_axis_tvalid   (crc_tvalid),
  275 |         .s_axis_tlast    (crc_tlast),
  276 |         .s_axis_tready   (crc_tready),
  277 |         
  278 |         // Retransmit Output to MUX
  279 |         .m_axis_tdata    (m_axis_retx_tdata),
  280 |         .m_axis_tvalid   (m_axis_retx_tvalid),
  281 |         .m_axis_tlast    (m_axis_retx_tlast),
  282 |         .m_axis_tready   (m_axis_retx_tready)
  283 |     );
  284 | 
  285 | endmodule

    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 | Description  : FSO Payload Combinational Multiplexer.
    7 |                Acts as the Arbi traffic router before CDC and FEC.
    8 |                Selects between 4 AXI-Stream inputs based on payload_mux_sel:
    9 |                00 = IDLE FIFO
   10 |                01 = DATA FIFO
   11 |                10 = MGMT FIFO
   12 |                11 = ARQ DDR4 Retransmit RAM
   13 |                Zero-latency combinational routing.
   14 | ===========================================================================
   15 | */
   16 | 
   17 | module fso_payload_mux (
   18 |     // Control Signal from ARQ TX Controller
   19 |     input  wire [1:0]  payload_mux_sel,
   20 | 
   21 |     // Input 0: IDLE FIFO (00)
   22 |     input  wire [31:0] s_idle_tdata,
   23 |     input  wire        s_idle_tvalid,
   24 |     input  wire        s_idle_tlast,
   25 |     output wire        s_idle_tready,
   26 | 
   27 |     // Input 1: DATA FIFO (01)
   28 |     input  wire [31:0] s_data_tdata,
   29 |     input  wire        s_data_tvalid,
   30 |     input  wire        s_data_tlast,
   31 |     output wire        s_data_tready,
   32 | 
   33 |     // Input 2: MGMT FIFO (10)
   34 |     input  wire [31:0] s_mgmt_tdata,
   35 |     input  wire        s_mgmt_tvalid,
   36 |     input  wire        s_mgmt_tlast,
   37 |     output wire        s_mgmt_tready,
   38 | 
   39 |     // Input 3: ARQ Retransmit RAM (11)
   40 |     input  wire [31:0] s_retx_tdata,
   41 |     input  wire        s_retx_tvalid,
   42 |     input  wire        s_retx_tlast,
   43 |     output wire        s_retx_tready,
   44 | 
   45 |     // Output: To x_gth_logic.v (CDC)
   46 |     output wire [31:0] m_axis_tdata,
   47 |     output wire        m_axis_tvalid,
   48 |     output wire        m_axis_tlast,
   49 |     input  wire        m_axis_tready
   50 | );
   51 | 
   52 |     // =======================================================
   53 |     // Combinational Routing for Downstream Data (tdata, tvalid, tlast)
   54 |     // =======================================================
   55 |     assign m_axis_tdata  = (payload_mux_sel == 2'b00) ? s_idle_tdata  :
   56 |                            (payload_mux_sel == 2'b01) ? s_data_tdata  :
   57 |                            (payload_mux_sel == 2'b10) ? s_mgmt_tdata  :
   58 |                                                         s_retx_tdata;
   59 | 
   60 |     assign m_axis_tvalid = (payload_mux_sel == 2'b00) ? s_idle_tvalid :
   61 |                            (payload_mux_sel == 2'b01) ? s_data_tvalid :
   62 |                            (payload_mux_sel == 2'b10) ? s_mgmt_tvalid :
   63 |                                                         s_retx_tvalid;
   64 | 
   65 |     assign m_axis_tlast  = (payload_mux_sel == 2'b00) ? s_idle_tlast  :
   66 |                            (payload_mux_sel == 2'b01) ? s_data_tlast  :
   67 |                            (payload_mux_sel == 2'b10) ? s_mgmt_tlast  :
   68 |                                                         s_retx_tlast;
   69 | 
   70 |     // =======================================================
   71 |     // Combinational Routing for Upstream Flow Control (tready)
   72 |     // Only the selected path receives the true tready from CDC.
   73 |     // Unselected paths are stalled (tready = 0).
   74 |     // =======================================================
   75 |     assign s_idle_tready = (payload_mux_sel == 2'b00) ? m_axis_tready : 1'b0;
   76 |     assign s_data_tready = (payload_mux_sel == 2'b01) ? m_axis_tready : 1'b0;
   77 |     assign s_mgmt_tready = (payload_mux_sel == 2'b10) ? m_axis_tready : 1'b0;
   78 |     assign s_retx_tready = (payload_mux_sel == 2'b11) ? m_axis_tready : 1'b0;
   79 | 
   80 | endmodule

    1 | `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 | Module Name  : gth64b66b_rx
    7 | Function     : 64B/66B External Gearbox Receiver, Block Sync Slip Controller,
    8 |                and De-Jitter Elastic Buffer.
    9 |                - Executes IEEE 802.3ae 64B/66B block lock state machine by 
   10 |                  asserting gt_rxgearboxslip_out until 64 consecutive valid 
   11 |                  2'b01 sync headers are verified (rx_block_locked = 1).
   12 |                - Performs bit-reversal (bit_rev32) to restore MSB-first byte 
   13 |                  ordering, removes 2-cycle Gearbox pauses via rx_elast_mem, 
   14 |                  and outputs a 100% contiguous 312.5 MHz stream to CDC 3.
   15 | 
   16 | Revision History:
   17 |   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Basic 64B/66B receiver gearbox slip FSM.
   18 |   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-20) : Added 66/64 de-jitter buffer and internal ILA 2 
   19 |     (GTH Stage) debug registers to keep SDAOISL10Gto10G_top schematic clean.
   20 |   - Rev 3.0 (2026-10-21 05:18 KST) : Enforced strict hdr_is_valid_sync = 
   21 |     (gt_rxheader_in[1:0] == 2'b01) to eliminate false-locking on 2'b10.
   22 |   - Rev 3.1 (2026-10-21 12:21 KST) :
   23 |     1. Updated rx_elast_mem write controller with committed non-zero pointer 
   24 |        tracking so the entire byte-packed 4-frame burst (3117 words = 12,468 
   25 |        Bytes across IDLE, DAT1, DAT2, MGMT) is captured continuously without 
   26 |        swallowing Frame 4's preamble or inserting inter-frame gaps.
   27 |     2. Matched byte_out [7:0], out_clk_cnt [15:0], frame_byte_cnt [11:0], and 
   28 |        frame_out_id [31:0] to the exact 0.8 ns byte-level granularity of 
   29 |        u_error_inject so all 4 frames (1, 2, 3, 4) count 1..3117 bytes cleanly.
   30 |   - Rev 3.2 (2026-10-27 04:19 KST) : [Target B1.2 - ETRI Audit Item 1, SDA OISL Page 23, Table 2-8]
   31 |     Updated start_new_burst and in_burst_sync trigger condition (is_preamble_word0)
   32 |     to detect the first 32-bit word of the official SDA OISL 72-bit Preamble 
   33 |     (32'h77AD_5B58 from 72'h77AD5B5843641E2E26) while retaining legacy marker 
   34 |     (32'h5555_5555) compatibility.
   35 | ===========================================================================
   36 | */
   37 | 
   38 | module gth64b66b_rx (
   39 |     input  wire        clk_gth,              // GTH RXUSRCLK2 (rx0_clk = 322.265625 MHz)
   40 |     input  wire        clk_312_5,            // Downstream 312.5 MHz Clock
   41 |     input  wire        rst_n,                // Active-low reset
   42 |     input  wire        gth_rx_ready,         // High when GTH RX reset is done
   43 | 
   44 |     // Upstream Interface from GTH Transceiver Primitive
   45 |     input  wire [31:0] gt_rxdata_in,
   46 |     input  wire [1:0]  gt_rxdatavalid_in,
   47 |     input  wire [5:0]  gt_rxheader_in,
   48 |     input  wire [1:0]  gt_rxheadervalid_in,
   49 |     output reg         gt_rxgearboxslip_out,
   50 | 
   51 |     // Status Output
   52 |     output reg         rx_block_locked,
   53 | 
   54 |     // Downstream Interface to CDC 3 (rx_gth_logic)
   55 |     output reg  [31:0] down_data,
   56 |     output reg         down_dv
   57 | );
   58 | 
   59 |     function [31:0] bit_rev32(input [31:0] d);
   60 |         integer i;
   61 |         begin
   62 |             for (i = 0; i < 32; i = i + 1) begin

   67 | 
   68 |     // =======================================================
   69 |     // 1. STRICT IEEE 802.3ae 64B/66B BLOCK SYNC LOCK & SLIP FSM
   70 |     //    Strictly checks 2'b01 so pre-frame zeros never false-lock on 2'b10!
   71 |     // =======================================================

   74 |     reg [6:0] good_sync_cnt;
   75 |     reg [5:0] slip_wait_cnt;

   77 |     always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin

   80 |             rx_block_locked      <= 1'b0;
   81 |             good_sync_cnt        <= 7'd0;
   82 |             slip_wait_cnt        <= 6'd0;
   83 |         end else if (!gth_rx_ready) begin
   84 |             gt_rxgearboxslip_out <= 1'b0;
   85 |             rx_block_locked      <= 1'b0;
   86 |             good_sync_cnt        <= 7'd0;
   87 |             slip_wait_cnt        <= 6'd0;
   88 |         end else begin
   89 |             gt_rxgearboxslip_out <= 1'b0;
   90 | 
   91 |             if (slip_wait_cnt > 6'd0) begin
   92 |                 slip_wait_cnt <= slip_wait_cnt - 6'd1;
   93 |             end else if (gt_rxheadervalid_in[0]) begin
   94 |                 if (hdr_is_valid_sync) begin
   95 |                     if (good_sync_cnt < 7'd64) begin
   96 |                         good_sync_cnt <= good_sync_cnt + 7'd1;
   97 |                     end else begin
   98 |                         rx_block_locked <= 1'b1;
   99 |                     end
  100 |                 end else begin
  101 |                     rx_block_locked      <= 1'b0;
  102 |                     good_sync_cnt        <= 7'd0;
  103 |                     gt_rxgearboxslip_out <= 1'b1;
  104 |                     slip_wait_cnt        <= 6'd32;
  105 |                 end
  106 |             end
  107 |         end
  108 |     end
  109 | 
  110 |     // =======================================================
  111 |     // 2. 66/64 DE-JITTER ELASTIC BUFFER (Continuous Burst Capture)
  112 |     //    Uses commit_wr_ptr so trailing post-burst zeros are never drained
  113 |     // =======================================================

  115 |     reg  [11:0] raw_wr_ptr;
  116 |     reg  [11:0] commit_wr_ptr;
  117 |     reg         in_burst_sync;
  118 |     reg  [3:0]  zero_idle_cnt;

  123 |                                     (descrambled_word == 32'h5555_5555);

  125 |                                    !in_burst_sync && is_preamble_word0;

  127 |                                    (in_burst_sync || start_new_burst);

  143 |             commit_wr_ptr <= 12'd0;

  152 |                     commit_wr_ptr <= raw_wr_ptr + 12'd1;

  154 |             end else begin

  157 |                     raw_wr_ptr    <= raw_wr_ptr + 12'd1;
  158 |                     commit_wr_ptr <= raw_wr_ptr + 12'd1;

  190 |             draining_burst <= 1'b0;

  192 |             down_dv        <= 1'b0;

  213 |                     down_data <= rx_elast_mem[rd_ptr];
  214 |                     rd_ptr    <= rd_ptr + 12'd1;
  215 |                 end else begin
  216 |                     draining_burst <= 1'b0;
  217 |                     down_dv        <= 1'b0;
  218 |                     down_data      <= 32'd0;
  219 |                 end
  220 |             end
  221 |         end
  222 |     end

  259 |             end else begin

  261 |                 out_clk_cnt    <= 16'd0;
  262 |                 frame_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  263 |                 frame_out_id   <= 32'd0;

  266 |     end

  288 |     // =======================================================

   29 |     active data at the exact instant tx_byte_cnt = 1 begins and returns 
   30 |     to 00000000 cleanly when Frame 4 (MGMT) completes.

   34 | module gth64b66b_tx (

  104 |             rd_ptr            <= 12'd0;
  105 |             gt_txdata_reg     <= 32'd0;
  106 |             tx_active_reg     <= 1'b0;

  108 |             gt_txsequence_out <= 7'd0;

  111 |             if (tx_seq_cnt == 7'd65)

  113 |             else

   15 | Revision History:
   16 |   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 14-Byte (112-bit) Table 2-10 Header serializer.
   17 |   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:26 KST) : [Target B5.1 - SDA OISL Page 25 Sec. 2.6.3.3.2 & Page 27 Sec. 2.6.3.3.5]
   18 |     1. Enforced Section 2.6.3.3.2 rule: "If ACK valid is zero, then RXFN shall 
   19 |        be set to zero" (std_rxfn = ack_valid ? rxfn : 16'd0) and cleared ack bit 
   20 |        when ack_valid == 0.
   21 |     2. Enforced Section 2.6.3.3.5 rule: when fcch_opcode == 4'b1111 (Not Present),
   22 |        FCCH_PL is forced to all logical ones (16'hFFFF); optional parameter 
   23 |        STRICT_RESERVED_FCCH_ZERO forces Reserved opcodes (0111..1110) to 16'h0000.
   24 | ===========================================================================
   25 | */
   26 | 
   27 | module header_generator #(
   28 |     parameter STRICT_RESERVED_FCCH_ZERO = 0
   29 | )(
   30 |     input  wire        clk,
   31 |     input  wire        rst_n,
   32 |     input  wire        trigger_gen,
   33 | 
   34 |     // --- ARQ & Control Plane Inputs (SDA OISL Table 2-9) ---
   35 |     input  wire [15:0] txfn,         // Transmit Frame Number
   36 |     input  wire [15:0] rxfn,         // Receive Frame Number (from remote)
   37 |     input  wire        ack,          // Acknowledgment status
   38 |     input  wire        ack_valid,    // Acknowledgment validity flag
   39 |     input  wire [1:0]  frame_type,   // 00=IDLE, 01=DATA, 10=MGMT, 11=RSVD
   40 |     
   41 |     // --- Telemetry, PNT & Timing Inputs ---
   42 |     input  wire [39:0] tx_ts,        // TX Timestamp (Picoseconds precision)
   43 |     input  wire [5:0]  tod_seconds,  // Time of Day (Seconds)
   44 |     input  wire [2:0]  ts_applies,   // Timestamp application flag
   45 |     input  wire [3:0]  fcch_opcode,  // Fast Control Channel Opcode
   46 |     input  wire [15:0] fcch_pl,      // Fast Control Channel Payload
   47 | 
   48 |     // --- Serialized Output to CRC-16 ---
   49 |     output reg  [7:0]  header_byte_out,
   50 |     output reg         header_en_out,
   51 |     output wire        gen_busy
   52 | );
   53 | 
   54 |     // Internal Registers
   55 |     reg [111:0] full_header_reg;
   56 |     reg [3:0]   byte_counter;
   57 |     reg         is_generating;
   58 | 
   59 |     // [Rev 2.0] SDA OISL Sec. 2.6.3.3.2 & Sec. 2.6.3.3.5 Standard Sanitization
   60 |     wire [15:0] std_rxfn        = ack_valid ? rxfn : 16'd0;
   61 |     wire        std_ack         = ack_valid ? ack  : 1'b0;
   62 |     wire        is_fcch_idle_op = (fcch_opcode == 4'b1111);
   63 |     wire        is_fcch_rsvd_op = (fcch_opcode >= 4'b0111) && (fcch_opcode <= 4'b1110);
   64 |     wire [15:0] std_fcch_pl     = is_fcch_idle_op ? 16'hFFFF :
   65 |                                   ((STRICT_RESERVED_FCCH_ZERO && is_fcch_rsvd_op) ? 16'h0000 : fcch_pl);
   66 | 
   67 |     // Output assignment for busy flag
   68 |     assign gen_busy = is_generating;
   69 | 
   70 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   71 |         if (~rst_n) begin
   72 |             full_header_reg <= 112'd0;
   73 |             byte_counter    <= 4'd0;
   74 |             is_generating   <= 1'b0;
   75 |             header_en_out   <= 1'b0;
   76 |             header_byte_out <= 8'd0;
   77 |         end else begin
   78 |             // -----------------------------------------------------------
   79 |             // STATE 1: Trigger & Data Latch (Setup Phase)
   80 |             // -----------------------------------------------------------
   81 |             if (trigger_gen && !is_generating) begin
   82 |                 // Assemble the 112-bit header based on Table 2-10 mapping.
   83 |                 // Critical: All reserved bits are forced to 1 per SDA OISL standard.
   84 |                 full_header_reg[7:0]     <= txfn[7:0];                                      // d0
   85 |                 full_header_reg[15:8]    <= txfn[15:8];                                     // d1
   86 |                 full_header_reg[23:16]   <= std_rxfn[7:0];                                  // d2 (0 if !ack_valid)
   87 |                 full_header_reg[31:24]   <= std_rxfn[15:8];                                 // d3 (0 if !ack_valid)
   88 |                 full_header_reg[39:32]   <= {2'b11, 2'b11, std_ack, ack_valid, frame_type}; // d4 (Reserved=1)
   89 |                 full_header_reg[47:40]   <= tx_ts[7:0];                                     // d5
   90 |                 full_header_reg[55:48]   <= tx_ts[15:8];                                    // d6
   91 |                 full_header_reg[63:56]   <= tx_ts[23:16];                                   // d7
   92 |                 full_header_reg[71:64]   <= tx_ts[31:24];                                   // d8
   93 |                 full_header_reg[79:72]   <= tx_ts[39:32];                                   // d9
   94 |                 full_header_reg[87:80]   <= {2'b11, tod_seconds};                           // d10 (Reserved=1)
   95 |                 full_header_reg[95:88]   <= {1'b1, ts_applies, fcch_opcode};                // d11 (Reserved=1)
   96 |                 full_header_reg[103:96]  <= std_fcch_pl[7:0];                               // d12
   97 |                 full_header_reg[111:104] <= std_fcch_pl[15:8];                              // d13
   98 |                 
   99 |                 is_generating <= 1'b1;
  100 |                 byte_counter  <= 4'd0;
  101 |                 header_en_out <= 1'b0; // Wait 1 cycle for stability
  102 |             end 
  103 |             
  104 |             // -----------------------------------------------------------
  105 |             // STATE 2: Execution & Serialization (Shift Phase)
  106 |             // -----------------------------------------------------------
  107 |             else if (is_generating) begin
  108 |                 header_en_out   <= 1'b1; // Assert enable signal to wake up CRC-16
  109 |                 header_byte_out <= full_header_reg[7:0]; // Output LSB byte
  110 |                 full_header_reg <= {8'd0, full_header_reg[111:8]}; // Right shift 8 bits
  111 |                 
  112 |                 if (byte_counter == 4'd13) begin
  113 |                     // After 14 bytes (0 to 13), terminate the generation cycle
  114 |                     is_generating <= 1'b0;
  115 |                 end else begin
  116 |                     byte_counter  <= byte_counter + 1'b1;
  117 |                 end
  118 |             end 
  119 |             
  120 |             // -----------------------------------------------------------
  121 |             // STATE 3: Idle / Cooldown
  122 |             // -----------------------------------------------------------
  123 |             else begin
  124 |                 header_en_out   <= 1'b0; // De-assert enable
  125 |                 header_byte_out <= 8'd0;
  126 |                 byte_counter    <= 4'd0;
  127 |             end
  128 |         end
  129 |     end
  130 | endmodule

43: reg [4:0] byte_cnt;
    1 | `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 | Module Name  : header_parser
    7 | Description  : SDA OISL Table 2-9 Frame Header Parser.
    8 |                Extracts all control, ARQ, timestamp, and Fast Control 
    9 |                Channel (FCCH) fields from the 16-Byte decoded Header stream.
   10 | 
   11 | Revision History:
   12 |   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 16-Byte Table 2-9 & Table 2-10 Header parser.
   13 |   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:26 KST) : [Target B5.2 - SDA OISL Page 25 Sec. 2.6.3.3.2 & Page 26 Sec. 2.6.3.3.3]
   14 |     1. Updated timescale to 1ns/1ps for project-wide consistency.
   15 |     2. Enforced Section 2.6.3.3.2 & 2.6.3.3.3 receiver rules:
   16 |        "If ACK valid is zero, then RXFN shall be set to zero" and
   17 |        "The ACK field in the Frame Header (Table 2-9) shall be ignored unless 
   18 |        ACK-valid is set to one" (rx_rxfn and rx_ack are gated by hdr_reg[4][2]).
   19 | ===========================================================================
   20 | */
   21 | 
   22 | module header_parser (
   23 |     input  wire        clk,
   24 |     input  wire        rst_n,
   25 |     input  wire        en,               // 16 cycles active from CDC 4 (header_dv)
   26 |     input  wire [7:0]  data_in,          // 8-bit Header stream (d0..d15)
   27 | 
   28 |     // Extracted SDA OISL Table 2-9 Header Fields
   29 |     output reg  [15:0] rx_txfn,          // Bytes d1..d0: Transmit Frame Number
   30 |     output reg  [15:0] rx_rxfn,          // Bytes d3..d2: Receive Frame Number (ACK target)
   31 |     output reg         rx_ack,           // Byte d4[3]  : 1 = ACK, 0 = NAK
   32 |     output reg         rx_ack_valid,     // Byte d4[2]  : 1 = ACK/NAK field valid
   33 |     output reg  [1:0]  rx_frame_type,    // Byte d4[1:0]: 00 = IDLE, 01 = DATA, 10 = MGMT
   34 |     output reg  [39:0] rx_tx_ts,         // Bytes d9..d5: 40-bit Transmit Timestamp (ps)
   35 |     output reg  [5:0]  rx_tod_sec,       // Byte d10[5:0]: 6-bit Time of Day Seconds
   36 |     output reg  [2:0]  rx_ts_applies,    // Byte d11[6:4]: Timestamp applicability flags
   37 |     output reg  [3:0]  rx_fcch_op,       // Byte d11[3:0]: 4-bit FCCH Opcode
   38 |     output reg  [15:0] rx_fcch_pl,       // Bytes d13..d12: 16-bit FCCH Payload
   39 |     output reg  [15:0] rx_hdr_crc16,     // Bytes d14..d15: Received CRC-16
   40 |     output reg         hdr_parsed_valid  // 1-cycle pulse when all fields are latched
   41 | );
   42 | 
   43 |     reg [4:0] byte_cnt;
   44 |     reg [7:0] hdr_reg [0:14];
   45 | 
   46 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   47 |         if (!rst_n) begin
   48 |             byte_cnt         <= 5'd0;
   49 |             rx_txfn          <= 16'd0;
   50 |             rx_rxfn          <= 16'd0;
   51 |             rx_ack           <= 1'b0;
   52 |             rx_ack_valid     <= 1'b0;
   53 |             rx_frame_type    <= 2'd0;
   54 |             rx_tx_ts         <= 40'd0;
   55 |             rx_tod_sec       <= 6'd0;
   56 |             rx_ts_applies    <= 3'd0;
   57 |             rx_fcch_op       <= 4'd0;
   58 |             rx_fcch_pl       <= 16'd0;
   59 |             rx_hdr_crc16     <= 16'd0;
   60 |             hdr_parsed_valid <= 1'b0;
   61 |         end else begin
   62 |             hdr_parsed_valid <= 1'b0;
   63 | 
   64 |             if (en) begin
   65 |                 if (byte_cnt < 5'd15) begin
   66 |                     hdr_reg[byte_cnt] <= data_in;
   67 |                     byte_cnt          <= byte_cnt + 5'd1;
   68 |                 end else begin
   69 |                     // Latch all fields on the 16th byte (byte_cnt == 15)
   70 |                     // [Rev 2.0] Gate rx_rxfn and rx_ack with ACK-valid (hdr_reg[4][2]) per Sec. 2.6.3.3.2 & 2.6.3.3.3
   71 |                     rx_txfn          <= {hdr_reg[1],  hdr_reg[0]};
   72 |                     rx_rxfn          <= hdr_reg[4][2] ? {hdr_reg[3], hdr_reg[2]} : 16'd0;
   73 |                     rx_ack           <= hdr_reg[4][2] ? hdr_reg[4][3]            : 1'b0;
   74 |                     rx_ack_valid     <= hdr_reg[4][2];
   75 |                     rx_frame_type    <= hdr_reg[4][1:0];
   76 |                     rx_tx_ts         <= {hdr_reg[9], hdr_reg[8], hdr_reg[7], hdr_reg[6], hdr_reg[5]};
   77 |                     rx_tod_sec       <= hdr_reg[10][5:0];
   78 |                     rx_ts_applies    <= hdr_reg[11][6:4];
   79 |                     rx_fcch_op       <= hdr_reg[11][3:0];
   80 |                     rx_fcch_pl       <= {hdr_reg[13], hdr_reg[12]};
   81 |                     rx_hdr_crc16     <= {hdr_reg[14], data_in};
   82 |                     hdr_parsed_valid <= 1'b1;
   83 |                     byte_cnt         <= 5'd0;
   84 |                 end
   85 |             end else begin
   86 |                 byte_cnt <= 5'd0;
   87 |             end
   88 |         end
   89 |     end
   90 | 
   91 | endmodule

   16 |     1. Updated timescale to 1ns/1ps for project-wide consistency.
   17 |     2. Added exact LSB-first bit unpacking (bits 0..228 of the 256-bit 8-word 
   18 |        vector {s_axis_mgmt_tdata, w_buf[6..0]}) to match mgmt_telemetry_generator.v 
   19 |        bit-for-bit in full TX-to-RX loopback:
   20 |          - Bits [5:0]     : mgmt_rx_phy_ts_sec     (6 bits)
   21 |          - Bits [45:6]    : mgmt_rx_phy_ts_picosec (40 bits)
   22 |          - Bits [51:46]   : mgmt_tx_phy_ts_sec     (6 bits)
   23 |          - Bits [91:52]   : mgmt_tx_phy_ts_picosec (40 bits)
   24 |          - Bits [155:92]  : mgmt_range_meters      (64 bits, IEEE 754)
   25 |          - Bits [187:156] : mgmt_range_ts_sec      (32 bits)
   26 |          - Bits [227:188] : mgmt_range_ts_picosec  (40 bits)
   27 |          - Bit  [228]     : mgmt_ts_valid          (1 bit, Word 7 bit [4])
   28 |     3. Retained automatic fallback for MSB-packed standalone testbench vectors 
   29 |        (when s_axis_mgmt_tdata[27] == 1'b1 and s_axis_mgmt_tdata[4] == 1'b0) so 
   30 |        tb_fso_ethernet_deframer.v continues to pass without modification.
   31 | ===========================================================================
   32 | */
   33 | 
   34 | module mgmt_extraction (
   35 |     input  wire        clk,
   36 |     input  wire        rst_n,
   37 |     input  wire [31:0] s_axis_mgmt_tdata,
   38 |     input  wire        s_axis_mgmt_tvalid,
   39 |     input  wire        s_axis_mgmt_tlast,
   40 | 
   41 |     // Extracted Satellite PNT & Ranging Telemetry Outputs
   42 |     output reg  [5:0]  mgmt_rx_phy_ts_sec,
   43 |     output reg  [39:0] mgmt_rx_phy_ts_picosec,
   44 |     output reg  [5:0]  mgmt_tx_phy_ts_sec,
   45 |     output reg  [39:0] mgmt_tx_phy_ts_picosec,
   46 |     output reg  [63:0] mgmt_range_meters,
   47 |     output reg  [31:0] mgmt_range_ts_sec,
   48 |     output reg  [39:0] mgmt_range_ts_picosec,

   52 | );
   53 |

   58 |     wire [255:0] full_telemetry_vec = {

   60 |         w_buf[3],          w_buf[2], w_buf[1], w_buf[0]
   61 |     };
   62 | 
   63 |     // Detect if incoming stream uses standalone MSB-packed testbench format (bit [27] of Word 7)
   64 |     wire is_msb_tb_format = s_axis_mgmt_tdata[27] && !s_axis_mgmt_tdata[4];
   65 | 
   66 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   67 |         if (!rst_n) begin

   70 |             mgmt_rx_phy_ts_picosec <= 40'd0;
   71 |             mgmt_tx_phy_ts_sec      <= 6'd0;
   72 |             mgmt_tx_phy_ts_picosec <= 40'd0;
   73 |             mgmt_range_meters       <= 64'd0;
   74 |             mgmt_range_ts_sec       <= 32'd0;
   75 |             mgmt_range_ts_picosec   <= 40'd0;
   76 |             mgmt_ts_valid           <= 1'b0;
   77 |             mgmt_telemetry_valid    <= 1'b0;
   78 |             mgmt_frame_cnt          <= 16'd0;
   79 |         end else begin
   80 |             mgmt_telemetry_valid <= 1'b0;
   81 | 
   82 |             if (s_axis_mgmt_tvalid) begin
   83 |                 if (word_idx < 9'd8) begin
   84 |                     w_buf[word_idx[2:0]] <= s_axis_mgmt_tdata;
   85 |                 end
   86 | 
   87 |                 if (word_idx == 9'd7) begin
   88 |                     if (is_msb_tb_format) begin
   89 |                         // Standalone Testbench MSB-Packed Format Compatibility
   90 |                         mgmt_rx_phy_ts_sec      <= w_buf[0][31:26];
   91 |                         mgmt_rx_phy_ts_picosec <= {w_buf[0][25:0], w_buf[1][31:18]};
   92 |                         mgmt_tx_phy_ts_sec      <= w_buf[1][17:12];
   93 |                         mgmt_tx_phy_ts_picosec <= {w_buf[1][11:0], w_buf[2][31:4]};
   94 |                         mgmt_range_meters       <= {w_buf[2][3:0],  w_buf[3], w_buf[4][31:4]};
   95 |                         mgmt_range_ts_sec       <= {w_buf[4][3:0],  w_buf[5][31:4]};

SHA256: 36fdfa74ce92a5537a8e7f19e261eb9a164c996860eecfcd6ab9d4b204df1ad4
Dependensi: fso_axis_fifo, fso_crc_32
Parameter dan counter
localparam MAX_WORDS = 9'd477
localparam S_WAIT_TRIG = 1'b0,
66: reg [8:0]  word_cnt;
    1 | `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 | Description  : SDA OISL Management (MGMT) Telemetry Payload Generator (Capsule).
    7 |                Packs 229 bits of PNT/Ranging telemetry per SDA Table 2-14 
    8 |                into the first 8 words (32 Bytes) LSB-first, pads the 
    9 |                remaining 469 words (1876 Bytes) with zeros (total 1908B), 
   10 |                appends 4-Byte CRC-32 (1912B), and buffers inside fifo_mgmt.
   11 | 
   12 | Revision History:
   13 |   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Table 2-14 229-bit PNT/Ranging MGMT payload generator.
   14 |   - Rev 2.4 (2026-10-29 13:07 KST) : [Deep Audit Section 7 Fix - Atomic Telemetry Snapshot]
   15 |     Preserved 100% of original ports, LSB-first bit mapping, and FIFO/CRC architecture.
   16 |     Added a 256-bit atomic snapshot register ('telemetry_snapshot_reg') that latches all 
   17 |     Table 2-14 timestamp and ranging fields at the start of frame assembly (S_WAIT_TRIG),
   18 |     preventing live timestamp updates from tearing across Words 0..7 during serialization.
   19 | ===========================================================================
   20 | */
   21 | 
   22 | module mgmt_telemetry_generator (
   23 |     input  wire        clk,
   24 |     input  wire        rst_n,
   25 | 
   26 |     // 1Hz Trigger & PNT/Ranging Telemetry Inputs (SDA OISL Table 2-14)
   27 |     input  wire        mgmt_trigger_1hz,
   28 |     input  wire [5:0]  rx_phy_ts_sec,
   29 |     input  wire [39:0] rx_phy_ts_picosec,
   30 |     input  wire [5:0]  tx_phy_ts_sec,
   31 |     input  wire [39:0] tx_phy_ts_picosec,
   32 |     input  wire [63:0] range_meters,
   33 |     input  wire [31:0] range_ts_sec,
   34 |     input  wire [39:0] range_ts_picosec,
   35 |     input  wire        ts_valid,
   36 | 
   37 |     // AXI-Stream Output to fso_payload_mux.v (1912 Bytes)
   38 |     output wire [31:0] m_axis_tdata,
   39 |     output wire        m_axis_tvalid,
   40 |     output wire        m_axis_tlast,
   41 |     input  wire        m_axis_tready
   42 | );
   43 | 
   44 |     localparam MAX_WORDS = 9'd477; // 477 words * 4 bytes = 1908 Bytes
   45 | 
   46 |     // Assemble 229-bit Table 2-14 structure LSB-first, padded to 256 bits (8 x 32-bit words)
   47 |     wire [255:0] telemetry_bit_vector = {
   48 |         27'd0,              // Bits 229..255 : Zero Padding to 32-Byte boundary
   49 |         ts_valid,           // Bit  228      : Timestamp & Range Valid Flag (1 bit)
   50 |         range_ts_picosec,   // Bits 188..227 : Range Timestamp Picoseconds (40 bits)
   51 |         range_ts_sec,       // Bits 156..187 : Range Timestamp Seconds (32 bits)
   52 |         range_meters,       // Bits 92..155  : Range in Meters IEEE-754 Float64 (64 bits)
   53 |         tx_phy_ts_picosec,  // Bits 52..91   : TX PHY Timestamp Picoseconds (40 bits)
   54 |         tx_phy_ts_sec,      // Bits 46..51   : TX PHY Timestamp Seconds (6 bits)
   55 |         rx_phy_ts_picosec,  // Bits 6..45    : RX PHY Timestamp Picoseconds (40 bits)
   56 |         rx_phy_ts_sec       // Bits 0..5     : RX PHY Timestamp Seconds (6 bits)
   57 |     };
   58 | 
   59 |     // [Rev 2.4] Atomic per-frame snapshot register
   60 |     reg [255:0] telemetry_snapshot_reg;
   61 | 
   62 |     localparam S_WAIT_TRIG = 1'b0,
   63 |                S_STREAM    = 1'b1;
   64 | 
   65 |     reg        state, next_state;
   66 |     reg [8:0]  word_cnt;
   67 | 
   68 |     reg  [31:0] mgmt_raw_tdata;
   69 |     reg         mgmt_raw_tvalid;
   70 |     reg         mgmt_raw_tlast;
   71 |     wire        crc_tready;
   72 | 
   73 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   74 |         if (!rst_n) begin
   75 |             state                  <= S_WAIT_TRIG;
   76 |             word_cnt               <= 9'd0;
   77 |             telemetry_snapshot_reg <= 256'd0;
   78 |         end else begin
   79 |             state <= next_state;
   80 |             if (state == S_WAIT_TRIG) begin
   81 |                 word_cnt <= 9'd0;
   82 |                 if (mgmt_trigger_1hz) begin
   83 |                     // Latch atomic snapshot of all 229 Table 2-14 bits at trigger instant
   84 |                     telemetry_snapshot_reg <= telemetry_bit_vector;
   85 |                 end
   86 |             end else if (state == S_STREAM && mgmt_raw_tvalid && crc_tready) begin
   87 |                 word_cnt <= word_cnt + 9'd1;
   88 |             end
   89 |         end
   90 |     end
   91 | 
   92 |     always @(*) begin
   93 |         next_state      = state;
   94 |         mgmt_raw_tvalid = 1'b0;
   95 |         mgmt_raw_tlast  = 1'b0;
   96 |         mgmt_raw_tdata  = 32'd0;
   97 | 
   98 |         case (state)
   99 |             S_WAIT_TRIG: begin
  100 |                 if (mgmt_trigger_1hz && crc_tready) next_state = S_STREAM;
  101 |             end
  102 |             S_STREAM: begin
  103 |                 mgmt_raw_tvalid = 1'b1;
  104 |                 if (word_cnt < 9'd8)
  105 |                     mgmt_raw_tdata = telemetry_snapshot_reg[(word_cnt * 32) +: 32];
  106 |                 else
  107 |                     mgmt_raw_tdata = 32'd0;
  108 | 
  109 |                 if (word_cnt == (MAX_WORDS - 1)) begin
  110 |                     mgmt_raw_tlast = 1'b1;
  111 |                     if (crc_tready) next_state = S_WAIT_TRIG;
  112 |                 end
  113 |             end
  114 |         endcase
  115 |     end
  116 | 
  117 |     // FSO CRC-32 Engine (1908B -> 1912B)
  118 |     wire [31:0] crc_tdata;
  119 |     wire        crc_tvalid;
  120 |     wire        crc_tlast;
  121 |     wire        fifo_tready;
  122 | 
  123 |     fso_crc_32 u_fso_crc_32_mgmt (
  124 |         .clk             (clk),
  125 |         .rst_n           (rst_n),
  126 |         .s_axis_tdata    (mgmt_raw_tdata),
  127 |         .s_axis_tvalid   (mgmt_raw_tvalid),
  128 |         .s_axis_tlast    (mgmt_raw_tlast),
  129 |         .s_axis_tready   (crc_tready),
  130 |         .m_axis_tdata    (crc_tdata),
  131 |         .m_axis_tvalid   (crc_tvalid),
  132 |         .m_axis_tlast    (crc_tlast),
  133 |         .m_axis_tready   (fifo_tready)
  134 |     );
  135 | 
  136 |     // FIFO MGMT Buffer (Ready for MUX Path 10)
  137 |     fso_axis_fifo #(.FIFO_DEPTH(1024), .ADDR_WIDTH(10)) fifo_mgmt (
  138 |         .clk             (clk),
  139 |         .rst_n           (rst_n),
  140 |         .s_axis_tdata    (crc_tdata),
  141 |         .s_axis_tvalid   (crc_tvalid),
  142 |         .s_axis_tlast    (crc_tlast),
  143 |         .s_axis_tready   (fifo_tready),
  144 |         .m_axis_tdata    (m_axis_tdata),
  145 |         .m_axis_tvalid   (m_axis_tvalid),
  146 |         .m_axis_tlast    (m_axis_tlast),
  147 |         .m_axis_tready   (m_axis_tready)
  148 |     );
  149 | 
  150 | endmodule

SHA256: 451ed00fbec6bc6d6a6d51edfe0c01558b5ac24c8887348e6f5ea09bb373d932
Dependensi: 
Parameter dan counter
    1 | `timescale 1ns / 100ps
    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 | Module Name  : mux_eth_32
    7 | Description  : 32-bit Ethernet Preamble Injection Multiplexer with 2-Cycle
    8 |                Data Pipeline Delay.
    9 |                
   10 |                KEY OPERATIONS:
   11 |                1. Receives a contiguous, reassembled Ethernet packet stream 
   12 |                   (e.g., 500 words = 2000 Bytes) from the Reassembly engine.
   13 |                2. Delays the incoming packet data and end-of-packet (tlast) 
   14 |                   by 2 clock cycles so that the 8-Byte Preamble + SFD 
   15 |                   (2 words x 32-bit) from eth_preamble_gen is prepended 
   16 |                   cleanly without overwriting the Ethernet MAC Header.
   17 |                3. Extends the output valid window by 2 cycles (e.g., 500 
   18 |                   payload words + 2 preamble words = 502 total words = 
   19 |                   2008 Bytes).
   20 | ===========================================================================
   21 | */
   22 | 
   23 | module mux_eth_32 (
   24 |     input  wire        clk,
   25 |     input  wire        rst_n,
   26 |     
   27 |     // Contiguous Reassembled Ethernet Packet Input (e.g., 2000 Bytes = 500 words)
   28 |     input  wire [31:0] asm_data_in,
   29 |     input  wire        asm_valid_in,
   30 |     input  wire        asm_last_in,
   31 |     
   32 |     // 64-bit Preamble + SFD Input from eth_preamble_gen
   33 |     input  wire [63:0] preamble_sfd,
   34 |     
   35 |     // Output to eth_tx_back_end_top (e.g., 2008 Bytes = 502 words)
   36 |     output wire [31:0] eth_data_out,
   37 |     output wire        eth_valid_out,
   38 |     output wire        eth_last_out
   39 | );
   40 | 
   41 |     // 2-Stage Pipeline Delay Registers
   42 |     reg [31:0] delay_data_1;
   43 |     reg [31:0] delay_data_2;
   44 |     reg        delay_valid_1;
   45 |     reg        delay_valid_2;
   46 |     reg        delay_last_1;
   47 |     reg        delay_last_2;
   48 | 
   49 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   50 |         if (!rst_n) begin
   51 |             delay_valid_1 <= 1'b0;
   52 |             delay_valid_2 <= 1'b0;
   53 |             delay_data_1  <= 32'd0;
   54 |             delay_data_2  <= 32'd0;
   55 |             delay_last_1  <= 1'b0;
   56 |             delay_last_2  <= 1'b0;
   57 |         end else begin
   58 |             delay_valid_1 <= asm_valid_in;
   59 |             delay_valid_2 <= delay_valid_1;
   60 |             
   61 |             delay_data_1  <= asm_data_in;
   62 |             delay_data_2  <= delay_data_1;
   63 | 
   64 |             delay_last_1  <= asm_valid_in && asm_last_in;
   65 |             delay_last_2  <= delay_last_1;
   66 |         end
   67 |     end
   68 | 
   69 |     // Rising-edge detection for the 2-cycle Preamble injection window
   70 |     wire is_preamble_cycle_1 = (asm_valid_in  && !delay_valid_1);
   71 |     wire is_preamble_cycle_2 = (delay_valid_1 && !delay_valid_2);
   72 | 
   73 |     // Output Valid is extended by 2 cycles to accommodate the 8-Byte Preamble
   74 |     assign eth_valid_out = asm_valid_in | delay_valid_1 | delay_valid_2;
   75 |     assign eth_last_out  = delay_valid_2 & delay_last_2;
   76 |     
   77 |     // Multiplexer Data Routing
   78 |     assign eth_data_out  = is_preamble_cycle_1 ? preamble_sfd[63:32] :
   79 |                            is_preamble_cycle_2 ? preamble_sfd[31:0]  :
   80 |                            (delay_valid_2      ? delay_data_2        : 32'd0);
   81 | 
   82 | endmodule

SHA256: c09fe62a8d2dad9a191f881a34c72ac87268fd02b60f143d962e5fbb93365685
Dependensi: 
Parameter dan counter
37: reg [8:0]   word_count; // Tracks 0 to 258 (259 total LPC words)
    1 | `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Description  : MUX Gearbox 128-bit (Preamble + LPC Combiner).
    6 | 
    7 |                ARCHITECTURE & OISL COMPLIANCE:
    8 |                - Merges 72-bit (9B) Preamble and 96-bit (12B) LPC words.
    9 |                - Enforces the strict SDA OISL geometry of 3117 Bytes per frame.
   10 |                - Outputs 194 full 16-Byte cycles.
   11 |                - The 195th cycle is a FLUSH containing exactly 13 Bytes, 
   12 |                  validated by cdc_keep = 16'h1FFF. 
   13 |                - Does NOT straddle frames across its output boundary, ensuring
   14 |                  clean verification and debugging at the 128-bit level.
   15 | ===========================================================================
   16 | */
   17 | 
   18 | module mux_gearbox_128 (
   19 |     input  wire         clk,
   20 |     input  wire         rst_n,
   21 |     
   22 |     // Interface from Preamble Gen (72-bit / 9 Bytes)
   23 |     input  wire [71:0]  preamble_data,
   24 |     
   25 |     // Interface from LPC (96-bit / 12 Bytes)
   26 |     input  wire [95:0]  lpc_data,
   27 |     input  wire         lpc_valid,
   28 |     
   29 |     // Interface to CDC 2 (128-bit / 16 Bytes)
   30 |     output reg  [127:0] cdc_data,
   31 |     output reg          cdc_valid,
   32 |     output reg  [15:0]  cdc_keep    // Byte Enable Mask for exact 3117B boundary
   33 | );
   34 | 
   35 |     reg [255:0] buffer;
   36 |     reg [5:0]   bytes_in_buf;
   37 |     reg [8:0]   word_count; // Tracks 0 to 258 (259 total LPC words)
   38 | 
   39 |     // Pre-aligned 256-bit MSB vectors for incoming data
   40 |     wire [255:0] pre_and_lpc_msb = {preamble_data, lpc_data, 88'd0}; // 21 Bytes (168 bits) at MSB
   41 |     wire [255:0] lpc_only_msb    = {lpc_data, 160'd0};               // 12 Bytes (96 bits) at MSB
   42 | 
   43 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   44 |         if (!rst_n) begin
   45 |             buffer       <= 256'd0; 
   46 |             bytes_in_buf <= 6'd0; 
   47 |             word_count   <= 9'd0; 
   48 |             cdc_valid    <= 1'b0;
   49 |             cdc_keep     <= 16'd0;
   50 |             cdc_data     <= 128'd0;
   51 |         end else begin
   52 |             cdc_valid <= 1'b0;
   53 |             cdc_keep  <= 16'd0;
   54 |             
   55 |             // ===================================================
   56 |             // CONDITION 1: Buffer has >= 16 bytes (Output Top 128-bit Word)
   57 |             // ===================================================
   58 |             if (bytes_in_buf >= 6'd16) begin
   59 |                 cdc_data  <= buffer[255:128];
   60 |                 cdc_valid <= 1'b1;
   61 |                 cdc_keep  <= 16'hFFFF; // All 16 Bytes Valid
   62 |                 
   63 |                 if (lpc_valid) begin
   64 |                     if (word_count == 9'd0) begin 
   65 |                         // Start of Frame: Shift out top 16B, pack Preamble (9B) + LPC (12B)
   66 |                         buffer       <= (buffer << 128) | (pre_and_lpc_msb >> ((bytes_in_buf - 6'd16) * 8));
   67 |                         bytes_in_buf <= bytes_in_buf - 6'd16 + 6'd21;
   68 |                         word_count   <= 9'd1;
   69 |                     end else begin 
   70 |                         // Middle of Frame: Shift out top 16B, pack LPC (12B)
   71 |                         buffer       <= (buffer << 128) | (lpc_only_msb >> ((bytes_in_buf - 6'd16) * 8));
   72 |                         bytes_in_buf <= bytes_in_buf - 6'd16 + 6'd12;
   73 |                         
   74 |                         if (word_count == 9'd258) word_count <= 9'd0; 
   75 |                         else                      word_count <= word_count + 1'b1;
   76 |                     end
   77 |                 end else begin
   78 |                     // Shift out top 16B, no new data arriving
   79 |                     buffer       <= (buffer << 128);
   80 |                     bytes_in_buf <= bytes_in_buf - 6'd16;
   81 |                 end
   82 |             end 
   83 |             
   84 |             // ===================================================
   85 |             // CONDITION 2: Buffer < 16 bytes, loading new data
   86 |             // ===================================================
   87 |             else if (lpc_valid) begin
   88 |                 if (word_count == 9'd0) begin
   89 |                     buffer       <= buffer | (pre_and_lpc_msb >> (bytes_in_buf * 8));
   90 |                     bytes_in_buf <= bytes_in_buf + 6'd21;
   91 |                     word_count   <= 9'd1;
   92 |                 end else begin
   93 |                     buffer       <= buffer | (lpc_only_msb >> (bytes_in_buf * 8));
   94 |                     bytes_in_buf <= bytes_in_buf + 6'd12;
   95 |                     
   96 |                     if (word_count == 9'd258) word_count <= 9'd0;
   97 |                     else                      word_count <= word_count + 1'b1;
   98 |                 end
   99 |             end
  100 |             
  101 |             // ===================================================
  102 |             // CONDITION 3: End of Frame Flush (Remaining 13 Bytes in [127:24])
  103 |             // ===================================================
  104 |             else if (word_count == 9'd0 && bytes_in_buf > 6'd0) begin
  105 |                 cdc_data     <= buffer[255:128]; // Top 104 bits [127:24] hold the 13 valid bytes
  106 |                 cdc_valid    <= 1'b1;
  107 |                 cdc_keep     <= (16'hFFFF >> (6'd16 - bytes_in_buf)); // 16'h1FFF for 13 bytes
  108 |                 
  109 |                 buffer       <= 256'd0;
  110 |                 bytes_in_buf <= 6'd0;
  111 |             end
  112 |         end
  113 |     end
  114 | endmodule

localparam S_PASS = 1'b0
