parameter SIM_MODE            = 1,
parameter LOOPBACK_ARQ_DIRECT = 1
    1 | `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 | Description  : SDA Encoder Grand Top Module.
    7 | 
    8 | Revision History:
    9 |   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : SDA Encoder top-level integration.
   10 |   - Rev 2.2 (2026-10-28 14:55 KST) : Added 'seg_valid_bytes [10:0]' input port 
   11 |     and forwarded it to u_eth_fso_framer for dynamic packet length encapsulation.
   12 |   - Rev 2.5 (2026-10-29 16:42 KST) : [Audit Fix R19 - ARQ Feedback CDC Synchronizer]
   13 |     Added 2-stage (* ASYNC_REG = "TRUE" *) synchronizer registers (arq_rxfn_sync1/2,
   14 |     arq_ack_sync1/2, arq_valid_sync1/2) in the clk_gth domain to safely transfer the
   15 |     closed-loop ARQ feedback transaction from the receiver clock domain.
   16 |   - Rev 2.7 (2026-10-30 01:55 KST) : [Audit Fix N05 & N06 - Coherent Edge-Qualified CDC & Peer ACK Routing]
   17 |     1. [Fix N06]: Upgraded ARQ feedback CDC from independent bit sampling to a 
   18 |        3-stage edge-qualified coherent capture: when the synchronized valid signal 
   19 |        rises (arq_valid_sync2 && !arq_valid_sync3), the settled 16-bit frame number 
   20 |        and ACK bit are atomically latched into 'arq_rxfn_coherent' and 'arq_ack_coherent'
   21 |        alongside a 1-cycle 'arq_valid_pulse'.
   22 |     2. [Fix N05]: Added optional 'peer_rxfn_in', 'peer_ack_in', and 'peer_ack_valid_in'
   23 |        ports with matching coherent CDC synchronization to support independent local 
   24 |        and remote peer ARQ feedback paths in u_eth_fso_framer.
   25 | ===========================================================================
   26 | */
   27 | 
   28 | module sda_encoder #(
   29 |     parameter SIM_MODE            = 1,
   30 |     parameter LOOPBACK_ARQ_DIRECT = 1
   31 | )(
   32 |     input  wire        clk_logic, // 200.0 MHz
   33 |     input  wire        clk_gth,   // 312.5 MHz Continuous Clock
   34 |     input  wire        rst_n,
   35 | 
   36 |     input  wire [31:0] s_axis_eth_tdata,
   37 |     input  wire        s_axis_eth_tvalid,
   38 |     input  wire        s_axis_eth_tlast,
   39 |     output wire        s_axis_eth_tready,
   40 |     input  wire [10:0] seg_valid_bytes,
   41 | 
   42 |     input  wire        mgmt_trigger_1hz,
   43 |     input  wire [5:0]  rx_phy_ts_sec,
   44 |     input  wire [39:0] rx_phy_ts_picosec,
   45 |     input  wire [5:0]  tx_phy_ts_sec,
   46 |     input  wire [39:0] tx_phy_ts_picosec,
   47 |     input  wire [63:0] range_meters,
   48 |     input  wire [31:0] range_ts_sec,
   49 |     input  wire [39:0] range_ts_picosec,
   50 |     input  wire        ts_valid,
   51 |     input  wire [5:0]  tod_seconds_in, 
   52 |     input  wire [3:0]  fcch_opcode,    
   53 |     input  wire [15:0] fcch_pl,        
   54 | 
   55 |     // Local RX CRC Feedback (or shared loopback feedback)
   56 |     input  wire [15:0] rx_rxfn_in,      
   57 |     input  wire        rx_ack_in,       
   58 |     input  wire        rx_ack_valid_in,
   59 | 
   60 |     // [Rev 2.7 - Fix N05] Optional Remote Peer Header ACK Feedback
   61 |     input  wire [15:0] peer_rxfn_in,
   62 |     input  wire        peer_ack_in,
   63 |     input  wire        peer_ack_valid_in,
   64 | 
   65 |     output wire [31:0] tx_fso_data_out,
   66 |     output wire        tx_fso_valid_out,
   67 |     output wire        eth_data_error_flag
   68 | );
   69 | 
   70 |     // =======================================================
   71 |     // [Rev 2.7 - Fix N06] COHERENT EDGE-QUALIFIED CDC SYNCHRONIZER FOR ARQ FEEDBACK
   72 |     // =======================================================
   73 |     (* ASYNC_REG = "TRUE" *) reg [15:0] arq_rxfn_sync1,  arq_rxfn_sync2;
   74 |     (* ASYNC_REG = "TRUE" *) reg        arq_ack_sync1,   arq_ack_sync2;
   75 |     (* ASYNC_REG = "TRUE" *) reg        arq_valid_sync1, arq_valid_sync2, arq_valid_sync3;
   76 | 
   77 |     reg [15:0] arq_rxfn_coherent;
   78 |     reg        arq_ack_coherent;
   79 |     reg        arq_valid_pulse;
   80 | 
   81 |     (* ASYNC_REG = "TRUE" *) reg [15:0] peer_rxfn_sync1,  peer_rxfn_sync2;
   82 |     (* ASYNC_REG = "TRUE" *) reg        peer_ack_sync1,   peer_ack_sync2;
   83 |     (* ASYNC_REG = "TRUE" *) reg        peer_valid_sync1, peer_valid_sync2, peer_valid_sync3;
   84 | 
   85 |     reg [15:0] peer_rxfn_coherent;
   86 |     reg        peer_ack_coherent;
   87 |     reg        peer_valid_pulse;
   88 | 
   89 |     wire peer_valid_clean = (peer_ack_valid_in === 1'b1);
   90 |     wire [15:0] peer_rxfn_clean = (^peer_rxfn_in === 1'bx) ? 16'd0 : peer_rxfn_in;
   91 |     wire        peer_ack_clean  = (peer_ack_in === 1'b1);
   92 | 
   93 |     always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
   94 |         if (!rst_n) begin
   95 |             arq_rxfn_sync1     <= 16'd0;
   96 |             arq_rxfn_sync2     <= 16'd0;
   97 |             arq_ack_sync1      <= 1'b0;
   98 |             arq_ack_sync2      <= 1'b0;
   99 |             arq_valid_sync1    <= 1'b0;
  100 |             arq_valid_sync2    <= 1'b0;
  101 |             arq_valid_sync3    <= 1'b0;
  102 |             arq_rxfn_coherent  <= 16'd0;
  103 |             arq_ack_coherent   <= 1'b0;
  104 |             arq_valid_pulse    <= 1'b0;
  105 | 
  106 |             peer_rxfn_sync1    <= 16'd0;
  107 |             peer_rxfn_sync2    <= 16'd0;
  108 |             peer_ack_sync1     <= 1'b0;
  109 |             peer_ack_sync2     <= 1'b0;
  110 |             peer_valid_sync1   <= 1'b0;
  111 |             peer_valid_sync2   <= 1'b0;
  112 |             peer_valid_sync3   <= 1'b0;
  113 |             peer_rxfn_coherent <= 16'd0;
  114 |             peer_ack_coherent  <= 1'b0;
  115 |             peer_valid_pulse   <= 1'b0;
  116 |         end else begin
  117 |             // 1. Synchronize Local RX CRC Feedback
  118 |             arq_rxfn_sync1  <= rx_rxfn_in;
  119 |             arq_rxfn_sync2  <= arq_rxfn_sync1;
  120 |             arq_ack_sync1   <= rx_ack_in;
  121 |             arq_ack_sync2   <= arq_ack_sync1;
  122 |             arq_valid_sync1 <= rx_ack_valid_in;
  123 |             arq_valid_sync2 <= arq_valid_sync1;
  124 |             arq_valid_sync3 <= arq_valid_sync2;
  125 | 
  126 |             if (arq_valid_sync2 && !arq_valid_sync3) begin
  127 |                 arq_rxfn_coherent <= arq_rxfn_sync2;
  128 |                 arq_ack_coherent  <= arq_ack_sync2;
  129 |                 arq_valid_pulse   <= 1'b1;
  130 |             end else begin
  131 |                 arq_valid_pulse   <= 1'b0;
  132 |             end
  133 | 
  134 |             // 2. Synchronize Remote Peer Header ACK Feedback
  135 |             peer_rxfn_sync1  <= peer_rxfn_clean;
  136 |             peer_rxfn_sync2  <= peer_rxfn_sync1;
  137 |             peer_ack_sync1   <= peer_ack_clean;
  138 |             peer_ack_sync2   <= peer_ack_sync1;
  139 |             peer_valid_sync1 <= peer_valid_clean;
  140 |             peer_valid_sync2 <= peer_valid_sync1;
  141 |             peer_valid_sync3 <= peer_valid_sync2;
  142 | 
  143 |             if (peer_valid_sync2 && !peer_valid_sync3) begin
  144 |                 peer_rxfn_coherent <= peer_rxfn_sync2;
  145 |                 peer_ack_coherent  <= peer_ack_sync2;
  146 |                 peer_valid_pulse   <= 1'b1;
  147 |             end else begin
  148 |                 peer_valid_pulse   <= 1'b0;
  149 |             end
  150 |         end
  151 |     end

   23 | module stream_input(

   25 |     input               rst_n,
   26 |     input               en,
   27 |     output              flag,
   28 |     output  [31:0]      data_out
   29 | );
   30 |

   32 | reg     [31:0]      sample  [0:max];
   33 | reg     [7:0]       count   = 8'd0;
   34 | 
   35 | initial
   36 |     $readmemh("sample.mem", sample);
   37 | 
   38 | parameter   IDLE        = 3'b001;
   39 | parameter   ACTIVE      = 3'b010;
   40 | parameter   END         = 3'b100;
   41 | 
   42 | reg     [2:0]   state;
   43 | reg     [2:0]   next_state;
   44 | 
   45 | always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   46 | begin
   47 |     if (~rst_n)
   48 |         state   <= IDLE;
   49 |     else
   50 |         state   <= next_state;
   51 | end
   52 | 
   53 | always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   54 | begin
   55 |     if (~rst_n)
   56 |         count   <= 8'd0;
   57 |     else if (state == ACTIVE)
   58 |         count   <= count + 1'b1;
   59 |     else
   60 |         count   <= 8'd0;
   61 | end
   62 | 
   63 | always @(*)
   64 | begin
   65 |     case(state)
   66 |         IDLE:           begin
   67 |                             if (en)
   68 |                                 next_state  <= ACTIVE;
   69 |                             else
   70 |                                 next_state  <= IDLE;
   71 |                         end
   72 |         ACTIVE:         begin
   73 |                             if (count < max)
   74 |                                 next_state  <= ACTIVE;
   75 |                             else
   76 |                                 next_state  <= END;
   77 |                         end
   78 |         END:            next_state  <= IDLE;
   79 |         default:        next_state  <= IDLE;
   80 |     endcase
   81 | end
   82 | 
   83 | assign  flag        = (state == ACTIVE);
   84 | assign  data_out    = (flag) ? sample[count] : 32'b0;
   85 | 
   86 | 
   87 | 
   88 | endmodule

    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 | Module Name  : tb_FEC_Demux
    7 | Description  : Standalone Verification Testbench for Receiver FEC Demux 
    8 |                (FEC_Demux.v).
    9 |                - Feeds 4 continuous 259-word (2072-Byte) descrambled frames 
   10 |                  into FEC_Demux at 200.0 MHz.
   11 |                - Verifies that the first 4 words (32 Bytes) are serialized 
   12 |                  into 32 consecutive 8-bit Header bytes (header_dv = 1 for 
   13 |                  32 cycles) and the remaining 255 words (2040 Bytes) are 
   14 |                  routed to the 64-bit Payload bus (payload_dv = 1 for 255 cycles).
   15 | 
   16 | Revision History:
   17 |   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 4-frame FEC_Demux 32B Header + 2040B Payload splitter TB.
   18 |   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 15:55 KST) : [Table 2-10 & Table 2-18 Alignment]
   19 |     Aligned Header bytes d0..d15 with SDA OISL Table 2-10 LSB-first ordering 
   20 |     (d0 = TXFN[7:0], d1 = TXFN[15:8], d14..d15 = 16'h0F28 CRC-16) and Payload 
   21 |     Word 1 with Table 2-18 (64'hAB00_0000_CDEF_07D0 on DAT1, 64'hAB00_4064_AAAA_0001 
   22 |     on DAT2 Continuation Frame).
   23 |   - Rev 2.4 (2026-10-29 12:52 KST) : [Audit Fix - Elaboration & Self-Checking Scoreboard]
   24 |     Preserved 100% of original descriptions, comments, and Rev 1.0/2.0 history.
   25 |     Synchronized counter bindings with FEC_Demux.v Rev 2.4 and added strict $fatal 
   26 |     verification on total Header bytes (128B) and Payload words (1020W).
   27 | ===========================================================================
   28 | */
   29 | 
   30 | module tb_FEC_Demux();
   31 | 
   32 |     reg clk;   // 200.0 MHz Baseband Clock (5.0 ns)
   33 |     reg rst_n;
   34 | 
   35 |     reg         desc_dv;
   36 |     reg  [63:0] desc_data;
   37 | 
   38 |     wire        rs_head_dv;
   39 |     wire [7:0]  rs_head_out;
   40 |     wire        rs_load_dv;
   41 |     wire [63:0] rs_load_out;
   42 | 
   43 |     // Hierarchical Waveform Trackers inside FEC_Demux (Restored in FEC_Demux.v Rev 2.4)
   44 |     wire [5:0]  out_hdr_byte_cnt = u_fec_demux.out_hdr_byte_cnt; // 1..32 Bytes
   45 |     wire [8:0]  out_pld_word_cnt = u_fec_demux.out_pld_word_cnt; // 1..255 Words
   46 |     wire [11:0] out_pld_byte_cnt = u_fec_demux.out_pld_byte_cnt; // 8..2040 Bytes
   47 | 
   48 |     FEC_Demux u_fec_demux (
   49 |         .clk        (clk),
   50 |         .rst_n      (rst_n),
   51 |         .en         (desc_dv),
   52 |         .data_in    (desc_data),
   53 |         .header_dv  (rs_head_dv),
   54 |         .header     (rs_head_out),
   55 |         .payload_dv (rs_load_dv),
   56 |         .payload    (rs_load_out)
   57 |     );
   58 | 
   59 |     initial begin
   60 |         clk = 1'b0;
   61 |         forever #2.5 clk = ~clk;
   62 |     end
   63 | 
   64 |     localparam ST_STREAM = 2'd0;
   65 |     localparam ST_GAP    = 2'd1;
   66 |     localparam ST_DONE   = 2'd2;
   67 | 
   68 |     reg [1:0]  tb_state;
   69 |     reg [3:0]  frame_id;
   70 |     reg [15:0] cycle_cnt;
   71 | 
   72 |     integer total_hdr_bytes_out = 0;
   73 |     integer total_pld_words_out = 0;
   74 | 
   75 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   76 |         if (!rst_n) begin
   77 |             total_hdr_bytes_out <= 0;
   78 |             total_pld_words_out <= 0;
   79 |         end else begin
   80 |             if (rs_head_dv) total_hdr_bytes_out <= total_hdr_bytes_out + 1;
   81 |             if (rs_load_dv) total_pld_words_out <= total_pld_words_out + 1;
   82 |         end
   83 |     end
   84 | 
   85 |     initial begin
   86 |         rst_n     = 1'b0;
   87 |         tb_state  = ST_STREAM;
   88 |         frame_id  = 4'd1;
   89 |         cycle_cnt = 16'd1;
   90 |         #100;
   91 |         rst_n     = 1'b1;
   92 |     end
   93 | 
   94 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   95 |         if (rst_n) begin
   96 |             case (tb_state)
   97 |                 ST_STREAM: begin
   98 |                     if (cycle_cnt < 16'd259)
   99 |                         cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 16'd1;
  100 |                     else begin
  101 |                         tb_state  <= ST_GAP;
  102 |                         cycle_cnt <= 16'd1;
  103 |                     end
  104 |                 end
  105 |                 ST_GAP: begin
  106 |                     if (cycle_cnt < 16'd35)
  107 |                         cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 16'd1;
  108 |                     else if (frame_id < 4'd4) begin
  109 |                         frame_id  <= frame_id + 4'd1;
  110 |                         tb_state  <= ST_STREAM;
  111 |                         cycle_cnt <= 16'd1;
  112 |                     end else begin
  113 |                         tb_state  <= ST_DONE;
  114 |                     end
  115 |                 end
  116 |                 default: tb_state <= ST_DONE;
  117 |             endcase
  118 |         end
  119 |     end
  120 | 
  121 |     always @(*) begin
  122 |         desc_dv   = 1'b0;
  123 |         desc_data = 64'd0;
  124 | 
  125 |         if (rst_n && (tb_state == ST_STREAM)) begin
  126 |             desc_dv = 1'b1;
  127 |             // Words 1..4: 32-Byte RS(32,16) Encoded Header (Table 2-10 LSB-first)
  128 |             if      (cycle_cnt == 16'd1)   desc_data = {4'd0, frame_id, 8'h00, 16'h0000, 8'hFD, 24'h554433};
  129 |             else if (cycle_cnt == 16'd2)   desc_data = 64'h2211_F28A_8899_0F28;
  130 |             else if (cycle_cnt <= 16'd4)   desc_data = 64'hC1C2_C1C2_C1C2_C1C2;
  131 |             // Words 5..259: 2040-Byte 8xRS(255,239) Encoded Payload (Table 2-18)
  132 |             else if (cycle_cnt == 16'd5)   desc_data = (frame_id == 4'd2) ? 64'hAB00_4064_AAAA_0001 : 64'hAB00_0000_CDEF_07D0;
  133 |             else if (cycle_cnt == 16'd243) desc_data = 64'hDA7A_DA7A_C320_0000 + {60'd0, frame_id};
  134 |             else if (cycle_cnt >  16'd243) desc_data = 64'hB10C_B10C_B10C_B10C;
  135 |             else begin
  136 |                 if      (frame_id <= 4'd2) desc_data = 64'hDA7A_DA7A_DA7A_DA7A;
  137 |                 else if (frame_id == 4'd3) desc_data = 64'h1D1E_1D1E_1D1E_1D1E;
  138 |                 else                       desc_data = 64'hA1A1_A1A1_A1A1_A1A1;
  139 |             end
  140 |         end
  141 |     end
  142 | 
  143 |     initial begin
  144 |         wait(tb_state == ST_DONE);
  145 |         #500;
  146 |         $display("\n======================================================================");
  147 |         $display(" RECEIVER FEC_DEMUX GEOMETRY VERIFICATION REPORT");
  148 |         $display(" -> Total 8-bit RS Header Bytes Emitted (4 x 32B)    : %0d / 128 Bytes", total_hdr_bytes_out);
  149 |         $display(" -> Total 64-bit RS Payload Words Emitted (4 x 255W) : %0d / 1020 Words (%0d Bytes)",
  150 |                  total_pld_words_out, total_pld_words_out * 8);
  151 |         if (total_hdr_bytes_out == 128 && total_pld_words_out == 1020)
  152 |             $display(" -> RESULT: [PASS] 100%% EXACT HEADER & PAYLOAD DEMULTIPLEXING!");
  153 |         else
  154 |             $fatal(1, " -> RESULT: [FAIL] Header or Payload count mismatch!");
  155 |         $display("======================================================================\n");
  156 |         $finish;
  157 |     end
  158 | 
  159 | endmodule

   21 |                - RS Load Out    : 255 Cycles x 8 Byte = 2040 Bytes or 255 Words
   22 |                - MUX Final Out  : 259 Cycles x 8 Byte = 2072 Bytes or 259 Words (Continuous Out)
   23 |

   26 |   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 15:04 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 2 & Item 3 - SDA OISL Page 37, Sec. 2.6.3.6.3]
   27 |     1. Aligned Header byte injection order with SDA OISL Table 2-10 (Page 25):

   35 | ===========================================================================
   36 | */

  104 |         .en       (rs_head_dv),
  105 |         .data_in  (rs_head_out),
  106 |         .flag     (hdr_synd_done),
  107 |         .syndrome (hdr_syndrome_vec)
  108 |     );
  109 | 
  110 |     syndrome_unit #(.max(254)) u_pld_synd_chk_lane7 (
  111 |         .clk      (clk),
  112 |         .rst_n    (rst_n),
  113 |         .en       (rs_load_dv),
  114 |         .data_in  (rs_load_out[63:56]),
  115 |         .flag     (pld_synd_done),
  116 |         .syndrome (pld_syndrome_vec)
  117 |     );
  118 | 
  119 |     // =======================================================
  120 |     // 4. CLOCK & FSM GENERATION
  121 |     // =======================================================
  122 |     initial begin
  123 |         clk = 1'b0;
  124 |         forever #2.5 clk = ~clk; 
  125 |     end
  126 | 
  127 |     localparam ST_HEAD      = 3'd0;
  128 |     localparam ST_MATH_GAP  = 3'd1;
  129 |     localparam ST_LOAD      = 3'd2;
  130 |     localparam ST_FRAME_GAP = 3'd3;
  131 |     localparam ST_DONE      = 3'd4;
  132 | 
  133 |     reg [2:0]  tb_state;
  134 |     reg [3:0]  frame_id;
  135 |     reg [15:0] cycle_cnt;
  136 | 
  137 |     initial begin
  138 |         rst_n     = 1'b0;
  139 |         tb_state  = ST_HEAD;
  140 |         frame_id  = 4'd1;
  141 |         cycle_cnt = 16'd1;
  142 |         #100; rst_n = 1'b1;
  143 |     end
  144 | 
  145 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  146 |         if (rst_n) begin
  147 |             case (tb_state)
  148 |                 ST_HEAD: begin
  149 |                     if (cycle_cnt < 16) cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
  150 |                     else begin tb_state <= ST_MATH_GAP; cycle_cnt <= 16'd1; end
  151 |                 end
  152 |                 ST_MATH_GAP: begin
  153 |                     // 16 Cycles latency gap for RS Header Parity
  154 |                     if (cycle_cnt < 16) cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
  155 |                     else begin tb_state <= ST_LOAD; cycle_cnt <= 16'd1; end
  156 |                 end
  157 |                 ST_LOAD: begin
  158 |                     if (cycle_cnt < 239) cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
  159 |                     else begin tb_state <= ST_FRAME_GAP; cycle_cnt <= 16'd1; end
  160 |                 end
  161 |                 ST_FRAME_GAP: begin
  162 |                     // 35 Cycles gap between frames
  163 |                     if (cycle_cnt < 35) cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
  164 |                     else begin
  165 |                         if (frame_id < 4) begin
  166 |                             frame_id <= frame_id + 1'b1;
  167 |                             tb_state <= ST_HEAD;
  168 |                             cycle_cnt <= 16'd1;
  169 |                         end else begin
  170 |                             tb_state <= ST_DONE;
  171 |                         end
  172 |                     end
  173 |                 end
  174 |             endcase
  175 |         end
  176 |     end
  177 | 
  178 |     // =======================================================
  179 |     // 5. DATA INJECTION (Strict SDA OISL Formatting)
  180 |     // =======================================================
  181 |     always @(*) begin
  182 |         en_head   = 1'b0; header_in  = 8'd0;
  183 |         en_load   = 1'b0; payload_in = 64'd0;
  184 | 
  185 |         if (tb_state != ST_DONE) begin
  186 |             // --- HEADER MAPPING (16 Bytes per Table 2-10: d0=TXFN[7:0], d1=TXFN[15:8]) ---
  187 |             if (tb_state == ST_HEAD) begin
  188 |                 en_head = 1'b1;
  189 |                 if      (cycle_cnt == 1)  header_in = {4'd0, frame_id}; // d0: TXFN[7:0] (LSB)
  190 |                 else if (cycle_cnt == 2)  header_in = 8'h00;            // d1: TXFN[15:8] (MSB)
  191 |                 else if (cycle_cnt == 5)  header_in = (frame_id == 3) ? 8'hF0 : (frame_id == 4) ? 8'hF2 : 8'hFD; // d4: Reserved=1111 + Frame Type
  192 |                 else if (cycle_cnt == 15) header_in = 8'hC1; // CRC-16 MSB
  193 |                 else if (cycle_cnt == 16) header_in = 8'hC2; // CRC-16 LSB
  194 |                 else                      header_in = 8'hAA; // ARQ / FCCH Dummy
  195 |             end
  196 |             
  197 |             // --- PAYLOAD MAPPING (239 Words / 1912 Bytes) ---
  198 |             else if (tb_state == ST_LOAD) begin
  199 |                 en_load = 1'b1;
  200 |                 if      (cycle_cnt == 1)   payload_in = 64'hAB00_0000_CDEF_07D0; // Payload Hdr + Packet Hdr (Table 2-18)
  201 |                 else if (cycle_cnt == 2)   payload_in = 64'hAABB_CCDD_EEFF_1122; // Eth MAC Header
  202 |                 else if (cycle_cnt == 239) payload_in = 64'hDA7A_DA7A_C3C3_C3C3; // CRC-32 Tail at [31:0]
  203 |                 else begin
  204 |                     if (frame_id <= 2)      payload_in = 64'hDA7A_DA7A_DA7A_DA7A; // DATA Pattern
  205 |                     else if (frame_id == 3) payload_in = 64'h1D1E_1D1E_1D1E_1D1E; // IDLE Pattern
  206 |                     else                    payload_in = 64'hA1A1_A1A1_A1A1_A1A1; // MGMT Pattern
  207 |                 end
  208 |             end
  209 |         end
  210 |     end
  211 | 
  212 |     // =======================================================
  213 |     // 6. PERFECT WAVEFORM DUAL-TRACKERS (BYTES & WORDS)
  214 |     // =======================================================
  215 |     
  216 |     // String Indicator
  217 |     reg [31:0] mux_frame_type_str;
  218 |     always @(*) begin
  219 |         if      (frame_id == 1) mux_frame_type_str = "DAT1";
  220 |         else if (frame_id == 2) mux_frame_type_str = "DAT2";
  221 |         else if (frame_id == 3) mux_frame_type_str = "IDLE";
  222 |         else if (frame_id == 4) mux_frame_type_str = "MGMT";
  223 |         else                    mux_frame_type_str = "DONE";
  224 |     end
  225 | 
  226 |     // --- A. INPUT TRACKERS ---
  227 |     // 8-bit bus (1 cycle = 1 byte)
  228 |     wire [4:0]  in_header_byte_idx  = en_head ? cycle_cnt[4:0] : 5'd0;                        // 1 to 16 Bytes
  229 |     wire [2:0]  in_header_word_idx  = en_head ? ((cycle_cnt[4:0] - 1) / 8) + 1 : 3'd0;        // 1 to 2 Words
  230 | 
  231 |     // 64-bit bus (1 cycle = 8 bytes)
  232 |     wire [8:0]  in_payload_word_idx = en_load ? cycle_cnt[8:0] : 9'd0;                        // 1 to 239 Words
  233 |     wire [11:0] in_payload_byte_idx = en_load ? (cycle_cnt[8:0] * 8) : 12'd0;                 // 8 to 1912 Bytes
  234 | 
  235 |     // --- B. RS ENCODER OUTPUT TRACKERS ---
  236 |     reg [5:0] r_rs_head_cnt = 0;
  237 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  238 |         if (!rst_n) r_rs_head_cnt <= 0;
  239 |         else r_rs_head_cnt <= rs_head_dv ? (r_rs_head_cnt + 1'b1) : 6'd0;
  240 |     end
  241 |     wire [5:0] cur_rs_head_cnt = rs_head_dv ? (r_rs_head_cnt + 1'b1) : 6'd0;
  242 | 
  243 |     // 8-bit bus (+ 16 Parity = 32 cycles)
  244 |     wire [5:0]  rs_head_out_byte_idx = cur_rs_head_cnt;                                       // 1 to 32 Bytes
  245 |     wire [2:0]  rs_head_out_word_idx = rs_head_dv ? ((cur_rs_head_cnt - 1) / 8) + 1 : 3'd0;   // 1 to 4 Words
  246 | 
  247 |     reg [8:0] r_rs_load_cnt = 0;
  248 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  249 |         if (!rst_n) r_rs_load_cnt <= 0;
  250 |         else r_rs_load_cnt <= rs_load_dv ? (r_rs_load_cnt + 1'b1) : 9'd0;
  251 |     end
  252 |     wire [8:0] cur_rs_load_cnt = rs_load_dv ? (r_rs_load_cnt + 1'b1) : 9'd0;
  253 | 
  254 |     // 64-bit bus (+ 16 Parity = 255 cycles)
  255 |     wire [8:0]  rs_load_out_word_idx = cur_rs_load_cnt;                                       // 1 to 255 Words
  256 |     wire [11:0] rs_load_out_byte_idx = rs_load_dv ? (cur_rs_load_cnt * 8) : 12'd0;            // 8 to 2040 Bytes
  257 | 
  258 |     // --- C. FEC MUX OUTPUT TRACKERS ---
  259 |     reg [8:0] r_mux_cnt = 0;
  260 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  261 |         if (!rst_n) r_mux_cnt <= 0;
  262 |         else r_mux_cnt <= mux_dv ? (r_mux_cnt + 1'b1) : 9'd0;
  263 |     end
  264 |     wire [8:0] cur_mux_cnt = mux_dv ? (r_mux_cnt + 1'b1) : 9'd0;
  265 | 
  266 |     // 64-bit bus (4 Words Header + 255 Words Payload = 259 cycles)
  267 |     wire [8:0]  mux_out_word_idx = cur_mux_cnt;                                               // 1 to 259 Words
  268 |     wire [11:0] mux_out_byte_idx = mux_dv ? (cur_mux_cnt * 8) : 12'd0;                        // 8 to 2072 Bytes
  269 | 
  270 |     // [Rev 2.0] Syndrome Verification Counters (Proves GF(0x187) & roots j=120..135)
  271 |     integer hdr_synd_pass_cnt = 0;
  272 |     integer pld_synd_pass_cnt = 0;
  273 |     always @(posedge clk) begin
  274 |         if (hdr_synd_done) begin
  275 |             if (hdr_syndrome_vec == 128'd0) hdr_synd_pass_cnt = hdr_synd_pass_cnt + 1;
  276 |             $display(" [%0t] RS(32,16) Header Codeword Syndrome (GF 0x187, j=120..135)  = 0x%032X", $time, hdr_syndrome_vec);
  277 |         end
  278 |         if (pld_synd_done) begin
  279 |             if (pld_syndrome_vec == 128'd0) pld_synd_pass_cnt = pld_synd_pass_cnt + 1;
  280 |             $display(" [%0t] RS(255,239) Payload Codeword Syndrome (GF 0x187, j=120..135) = 0x%032X", $time, pld_syndrome_vec);
  281 |         end
  282 |     end
  283 | 
  284 |     // =======================================================
  285 |     // 7. SIMULATION TERMINATION & LOGGING
  286 |     // =======================================================
  287 |     initial begin
  288 |         wait(tb_state == ST_DONE);
  289 |         #5000;
  290 |         $display("\n=======================================================");
  291 |         $display(" FEC SUBSYSTEM GEOMETRY & GF(0x187) VERIFICATION COMPLETE");
  292 |         $display("=======================================================");
  293 |         $display(" MUX Out successfully packed Header and Payload seamlessly.");
  294 |         $display(" Output Profile: 259 Words (2072 Bytes) per Continuous Frame.");
  295 |         $display(" Header  RS(32,16)   Zero-Syndrome Passes : %0d / 4", hdr_synd_pass_cnt);
  296 |         $display(" Payload RS(255,239) Zero-Syndrome Passes : %0d / 4", pld_synd_pass_cnt);
  297 |         if (hdr_synd_pass_cnt == 4 && pld_synd_pass_cnt == 4)
  298 |             $display(" RESULT: [PASS] 100%% COMPLIANT WITH SDA OISL PAGE 37 (GF 0x187, j=120..135)!");
  299 |         $display("=======================================================\n");
  300 |         $finish;
  301 |     end
  302 | 
  303 | endmodule

    1 | `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 | Module Name  : tb_SDAOISL10Gto10G_top
    7 | Description  : Grand Top-Level End-to-End Verification Testbench for the 
    8 |                Complete SDA OISL 10G-to-10G Optical Communication System 
    9 |                (SDAOISL10Gto10G_top.v).
   10 | 
   11 |                END-TO-END SIGNAL FLOW & 8 WAVEFORM GROUPS (PC 1 -> PC 2):
   12 |                - GRP1 : PC 1 Ingress Packet Gen, XGMII RX & 1900B Segmentation
   13 |                - GRP2 : TX FSO Framer, Table 2-10 Header (16B) & Table 2-18 Payload (1912B)
   14 |                - GRP3 : TX CDC 1 & 200 MHz FEC Core (RS GF 0x187 + 25b Scrambler + LPC)
   15 |                - GRP4 : TX MUX Gearbox 128 (Preamble 72'h77AD5B5843641E2E26), CDC 2 & Error Inject
   16 |                - GRP5 : GTH 64B/66B Optical Transceiver Serial Loopback (TXP[1] -> RXP[1])
   17 |                - GRP6 : RX CDC 3 & 200 MHz FEC Core (Demux 128, LPC Dec, Descrambler, RS Dec)
   18 |                - GRP7 : RX CDC 4, Deframer (CRC-16/32 Check) & Closed-Loop Selective Repeat ARQ
   19 |                - GRP8 : RX Ethernet Reassembly (Table 2-18) & PC 2 10G XGMII Egress Back-End
   20 | 
   21 | Revision History:
   22 |   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : End-to-end top-level loopback testbench.
   23 |   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 16:14 KST) : [Full SDA OISL v2.1.2 & ETRI Audit Compliance]
   24 |     1. Organized all internal & external signals into 8 structured stage groups 
   25 |        (GRP1..GRP8) with dedicated byte counters (*_byte_cnt) and clock cycle 
   26 |        counters (*_clk_cnt) at every single pipeline stage.
   27 |     2. Added configurable CH_ERROR_MODE (0 = Clean Channel, 1 = Correctable 
   28 |        RS/LPC Errors <= 8 symbols, 2 = Full 48-word error.mem burst) to verify 
   29 |        both FEC symbol repair and closed-loop ARQ retransmission.
   30 |     3. Added automatic self-checking scoreboard verifying Preamble 
   31 |        72'h77AD5B5843641E2E26 lock, 2.493600 us frame timing, Table 2-18 
   32 |        continuation reassembly, ASCII payload tag ("Kookmin FSO "), and final 
   33 |        PC 2 Ethernet FCS (32'hDEADBEEF).
   34 |   - Rev 2.2 (2026-10-28 14:55 KST) : [Audit Compliance Updates]
   35 |     1. Matched GTH_REFCLK_HALF to exact 3.200 ns (156.25 MHz reference clock,
   36 |        6.400 ns period matching SDAOISL10Gto10G.xdc).
   37 |     2. Added a full word-by-word / byte-by-byte Scoreboard Queue (scb_fifo) that
   38 |        records every single ingress Ethernet word generated at PC 1 and verifies
   39 |        100% bit-exact equality against every reassembled Ethernet word at PC 2.
   40 |     3. Enforced strict failure assertions ($fatal) on any byte mismatch, CRC failure,
   41 |        or simulation watchdog timeout.
   42 |   - Rev 2.3 (2026-10-29 01:49 KST) : [Unified 2000B Jumbo (DAT1+DAT2) + IDLE + MGMT 5000km]
   43 |     1. Preserved all original descriptions, section headers, and Rev 1.0/2.0/2.2 logs.
   44 |     2. Added automatic 1-cycle 'mgmt_trigger_1hz' injection and ASCII frame type 
   45 |        indicators (grp2_tx_frame_str & grp7_rx_frame_str: "IDLE", "DAT1", "DAT2", 
   46 |        "MGMT") + extracted 64-bit IEEE-754 Range probe (grp7_mgmt_range_meters = 
   47 |        64'h4153_12D0_0000_0000) so the Grand Top simulation visibly verifies all 4 
   48 |        SDA OISL frame types in a single run.
   49 | ===========================================================================
   50 | */
   51 | 
   52 | module tb_SDAOISL10Gto10G_top();
   53 | 
   54 |     // =========================================================================
   55 |     // 1. TOP-LEVEL SIMULATION PARAMETERS
   56 |     // =========================================================================
   57 |     parameter SIM_MODE             = 1;     // 1 = Internal Packet Gen & XGMII Direct Mode
   58 |     parameter CH_ERROR_MODE        = 1;     // 0 = Clean, 1 = Correctable FEC Error (<=8 sym), 2 = Full Burst
   59 |     parameter TARGET_JUMBO_PKTS    = 2;     // Number of 2000-Byte Jumbo packets to verify at PC 2
   60 |     parameter real GTH_REFCLK_HALF = 3.200; // [Rev 2.2] Exact 3.200 ns half-period (156.25 MHz RefClk)
   61 | 
   62 |     // =========================================================================
   63 |     // 2. PHYSICAL BOARD CLOCKS, RESET & SERIAL LOOPBACK WIRES
   64 |     // =========================================================================
   65 |     reg        sys_clk_p;     // 200.0 MHz Differential System Clock (5.0 ns period)
   66 |     wire       sys_clk_n = ~sys_clk_p;
   67 | 
   68 |     reg        mgtrefclk_p;   // 156.25 MHz Ethernet PCS/PMA Reference Clock (6.4 ns period)
   69 |     wire       mgtrefclk_n = ~mgtrefclk_p;
   70 | 
   71 |     reg        fso_refclk_p;  // 156.25 MHz GTH Optical Reference Clock (6.4 ns period)
   72 |     wire       fso_refclk_n = ~fso_refclk_p;
   73 | 
   74 |     wire [1:0] tx_disable;
   75 |     wire       fan;
   76 |     wire [3:0] TXP_OUT;
   77 |     wire [3:0] TXN_OUT;
   78 |     wire [3:0] RXP_IN;
   79 |     wire [3:0] RXN_IN;
   80 | 
   81 |     // Optical SFP+ Channel 1 & Ethernet SFP+ Channel 0 Serial Loopback
   82 |     assign RXP_IN = TXP_OUT;
   83 |     assign RXN_IN = TXN_OUT;
   84 | 
   85 |     // Top-Level Probing & Status Outputs from SDAOISL10Gto10G_top
   86 |     wire [31:0] tx_fso_data_out;
   87 |     wire        tx_fso_valid_out;
   88 |     wire [31:0] rx_fso_data_out;
   89 |     wire        rx_fso_valid_out;
   90 |     wire [7:0]  rx_dec_hdr_tdata;
   91 |     wire        rx_dec_hdr_tvalid;
   92 |     wire [31:0] rx_dec_pld_tdata;
   93 |     wire        rx_dec_pld_tvalid;
   94 |     wire [31:0] pc2_xgmii_txd;
   95 |     wire [3:0]  pc2_xgmii_txc;
   96 |     wire        rx_preamble_locked;
   97 |     wire        rx_block_locked;
   98 |     wire        gth_link_up;
   99 |     wire        eth_data_error_flag;
  100 | 
  101 |     // =========================================================================
  102 |     // 3. GRAND TOP-LEVEL DUT INSTANTIATION
  103 |     // =========================================================================
  104 |     SDAOISL10Gto10G_top #(
  105 |         .SIM_MODE (SIM_MODE)
  106 |     ) u_dut (
  107 |         .sys_clk_p           (sys_clk_p),
  108 |         .sys_clk_n           (sys_clk_n),
  109 |         .tx_disable          (tx_disable),
  110 |         .mgtrefclk_n         (mgtrefclk_n),
  111 |         .mgtrefclk_p         (mgtrefclk_p),
  112 |         .fso_refclk_n        (fso_refclk_n),
  113 |         .fso_refclk_p        (fso_refclk_p),
  114 |         .RXN_IN              (RXN_IN),
  115 |         .RXP_IN              (RXP_IN),
  116 |         .TXN_OUT             (TXN_OUT),
  117 |         .TXP_OUT             (TXP_OUT),
  118 |         .fan                 (fan),
  119 |         .tx_fso_data_out     (tx_fso_data_out),
  120 |         .tx_fso_valid_out    (tx_fso_valid_out),
  121 |         .rx_fso_data_out     (rx_fso_data_out),
  122 |         .rx_fso_valid_out    (rx_fso_valid_out),
  123 |         .rx_dec_hdr_tdata    (rx_dec_hdr_tdata),
  124 |         .rx_dec_hdr_tvalid   (rx_dec_hdr_tvalid),
  125 |         .rx_dec_pld_tdata    (rx_dec_pld_tdata),
  126 |         .rx_dec_pld_tvalid   (rx_dec_pld_tvalid),
  127 |         .pc2_xgmii_txd       (pc2_xgmii_txd),
  128 |         .pc2_xgmii_txc       (pc2_xgmii_txc),

  134 | 
  135 |     // Configure Error Injector Channel Mode via hierarchy parameter override
  136 |     defparam u_dut.sda_encoder_inst.u_error_injector.SIM_MODE  = (CH_ERROR_MODE == 0) ? 0 : 1;
  137 |     defparam u_dut.sda_encoder_inst.u_error_injector.max_error = (CH_ERROR_MODE == 1) ? 18 : 47;
  138 | 
  139 |     // =========================================================================
  140 |     // 4. CLOCK GENERATORS
  141 |     // =========================================================================
  142 |     initial begin
  143 |         sys_clk_p = 1'b0;
  144 |         forever #2.5 sys_clk_p = ~sys_clk_p; // 200.0 MHz System Differential Clock
  145 |     end
  146 | 
  147 |     initial begin
  148 |         mgtrefclk_p = 1'b0;
  149 |         forever #3.2 mgtrefclk_p = ~mgtrefclk_p; // 156.25 MHz Ethernet RefClk
  150 |     end
  151 | 
  152 |     initial begin
  153 |         fso_refclk_p = 1'b0;
  154 |         forever #(GTH_REFCLK_HALF) fso_refclk_p = ~fso_refclk_p; // 156.25 MHz GTH Optical RefClk
  155 |     end
  156 | 
  157 |     // Internal Domain Clocks Probed for Stage-Accurate Counters
  158 |     wire clk_200m = u_dut.clk_logic;
  159 |     wire clk_tx   = u_dut.tx0_clk;
  160 |     wire clk_rx   = u_dut.rx0_clk;
  161 | 
  162 |     // =========================================================================
  163 |     // 5. STAGE-BY-STAGE WAVEFORM GROUPS WITH BYTE & CLOCK COUNTERS (GRP1..GRP8)
  164 |     // =========================================================================
  165 | 
  166 |     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  167 |     // GROUP 1: PC 1 INGRESS PACKET GEN, XGMII RX & 1900B SEGMENTATION (clk_tx)
  168 |     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  169 |     wire        grp1_pc1_gen_valid     = u_dut.gen_sim_mode.gen_axis_tvalid && u_dut.gen_sim_mode.gen_axis_tready;
  170 |     wire [31:0] grp1_pc1_gen_data      = u_dut.gen_sim_mode.gen_axis_tdata;
  171 |     wire        grp1_pc1_gen_last      = u_dut.gen_sim_mode.gen_axis_tlast;
  172 |     wire [31:0] grp1_pc1_xgmii_rxd     = u_dut.xgmii_txd_in;
  173 |     wire [3:0]  grp1_pc1_xgmii_rxc     = u_dut.xgmii_txc_in;
  174 |     wire        grp1_seg_valid         = u_dut.seg_axis_tvalid && u_dut.seg_axis_tready;
  175 |     wire [31:0] grp1_seg_data          = u_dut.seg_axis_tdata;
  176 |     wire        grp1_seg_last          = u_dut.seg_axis_tlast;
  177 |     wire [10:0] grp1_seg_active_bytes  = u_dut.seg_valid_bytes;
  178 | 
  179 |     reg  [15:0] grp1_pc1_clk_cnt       = 16'd0; // 1..500 Clocks
  180 |     reg  [15:0] grp1_pc1_byte_cnt      = 16'd0; // 4..2000 Bytes
  181 |     reg  [15:0] grp1_seg_clk_cnt       = 16'd0; // 1..475 Clocks
  182 |     reg  [15:0] grp1_seg_byte_cnt      = 16'd0; // 4..1900 Bytes
  183 |     reg  [15:0] grp1_seg_frame_id      = 16'd0;
  184 | 
  185 |     always @(posedge clk_tx) begin
  186 |         if (grp1_pc1_gen_valid) begin
  187 |             if (grp1_pc1_clk_cnt == 16'd500) begin
  188 |                 grp1_pc1_clk_cnt  <= 16'd1;
  189 |                 grp1_pc1_byte_cnt <= 16'd4;
  190 |             end else begin
  191 |                 grp1_pc1_clk_cnt  <= grp1_pc1_clk_cnt + 16'd1;
  192 |                 grp1_pc1_byte_cnt <= grp1_pc1_byte_cnt + 16'd4;
  193 |             end
  194 |         end else if (!u_dut.gen_sim_mode.gen_axis_tvalid) begin
  195 |             grp1_pc1_clk_cnt  <= 16'd0;
  196 |             grp1_pc1_byte_cnt <= 16'd0;
  197 |         end
  198 | 
  199 |         if (grp1_seg_valid) begin
  200 |             if (grp1_seg_clk_cnt == 16'd475 || grp1_seg_clk_cnt == 16'd0) begin
  201 |                 grp1_seg_clk_cnt  <= 16'd1;
  202 |                 grp1_seg_byte_cnt <= 16'd4;
  203 |                 grp1_seg_frame_id <= grp1_seg_frame_id + 16'd1;
  204 |             end else begin
  205 |                 grp1_seg_clk_cnt  <= grp1_seg_clk_cnt + 16'd1;
  206 |                 grp1_seg_byte_cnt <= grp1_seg_byte_cnt + 16'd4;
  207 |             end
  208 |         end else if (!u_dut.seg_axis_tvalid) begin
  209 |             grp1_seg_clk_cnt  <= 16'd0;
  210 |             grp1_seg_byte_cnt <= 16'd0;
  211 |         end
  212 |     end
  213 | 
  214 |     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  215 |     // GROUP 2: TX FSO FRAMER (16B HEADER + 1912B PAYLOAD) & ARQ TX (clk_tx)
  216 |     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  217 |     wire [15:0] grp2_tx_txfn           = u_dut.sda_encoder_inst.u_eth_fso_framer.tx_txfn_out;

  219 |     wire [1:0]  grp2_payload_mux_sel   = u_dut.sda_encoder_inst.u_eth_fso_framer.payload_mux_sel;

  223 |     wire [31:0] grp2_pld_data          = u_dut.sda_encoder_inst.framer_fso_tdata;

  226 | 
  227 |     reg  [31:0] grp2_tx_frame_str;
  228 |     always @(*) begin
  229 |         case (grp2_tx_frame_type)
  230 |             2'b00:   grp2_tx_frame_str = "IDLE";
  231 |             2'b01:   grp2_tx_frame_str = grp2_in_cont ? "DAT2" : "DAT1";
  232 |             2'b10:   grp2_tx_frame_str = "MGMT";
  233 |             default: grp2_tx_frame_str = "RSVD";
  234 |         endcase
  235 |     end

  237 |     reg  [7:0]  grp2_hdr_clk_cnt       = 8'd0;  // 1..16 Clocks

  242 |     always @(posedge clk_tx) begin
  243 |         if (grp2_hdr_valid) begin
  244 |             grp2_hdr_clk_cnt  <= grp2_hdr_clk_cnt + 8'd1;
  245 |             grp2_hdr_byte_cnt <= grp2_hdr_byte_cnt + 8'd1;
  246 |         end else begin
  247 |             grp2_hdr_clk_cnt  <= 8'd0;
  248 |             grp2_hdr_byte_cnt <= 8'd0;
  249 |         end
  250 | 
  251 |         if (grp2_pld_valid) begin
  252 |             if (grp2_pld_clk_cnt == 16'd478 || grp2_pld_clk_cnt == 16'd0) begin
  253 |                 grp2_pld_clk_cnt  <= 16'd1;
  254 |                 grp2_pld_byte_cnt <= 16'd4;
  255 |             end else begin
  256 |                 grp2_pld_clk_cnt  <= grp2_pld_clk_cnt + 16'd1;
  257 |                 grp2_pld_byte_cnt <= grp2_pld_byte_cnt + 16'd4;
  258 |             end
  259 |         end else begin
  260 |             grp2_pld_clk_cnt  <= 16'd0;
  261 |             grp2_pld_byte_cnt <= 16'd0;
  262 |         end
  263 |     end

  427 |     wire [15:0]  grp8_reasm_pkt_cnt    = u_dut.sda_decoder_inst.u_ethernet_frame_reassembly.reassembled_pkt_cnt;
  428 |     wire [31:0]  grp8_pc2_xgmii_txd    = pc2_xgmii_txd;
  429 |     wire [3:0]   grp8_pc2_xgmii_txc    = pc2_xgmii_txc;
  430 |     wire [15:0]  grp8_pc2_byte_cnt     = u_dut.back_end_inst.dbg_rx_eth_byte_cnt; // 4..2012 Bytes
  431 |     wire [15:0]  grp8_pc2_pkt_cnt      = u_dut.back_end_inst.dbg_rx_eth_pkt_cnt;  // 1..N Packets
  432 |     wire [15:0]  grp8_pc2_clk_cnt      = grp8_pc2_byte_cnt[15:2];                 // 1..503 Clocks
  433 | 
  434 |     reg  [15:0]  grp8_reasm_clk_cnt    = 16'd0; // 1..502 Clocks (2 Preamble + 500 Payload)
  435 |     reg  [15:0]  grp8_reasm_byte_cnt   = 16'd0; // 4..2008 Bytes
  436 |     reg  [95:0]  grp8_captured_ascii   = 96'd0; // Captures "Kookmin FSO "
  437 |     reg  [31:0]  grp8_captured_fcs     = 32'd0; // Captures 0xDEADBEEF
  438 | 
  439 |     // =========================================================================
  440 |     // [Rev 2.2] FULL WORD-BY-WORD / BYTE-BY-BYTE END-TO-END SCOREBOARD QUEUE
  441 |     // =========================================================================
  442 |     reg [31:0] scb_fifo [0:16383];
  443 |     integer    scb_wr_ptr        = 0;
  444 |     integer    scb_rd_ptr        = 0;
  445 |     integer    scb_matched_words = 0;
  446 |     integer    scb_error_words   = 0;
  447 | 
  448 |     always @(posedge clk_tx) begin
  449 |         if (grp1_pc1_gen_valid) begin
  450 |             scb_fifo[scb_wr_ptr] <= grp1_pc1_gen_data;
  451 |             scb_wr_ptr           <= scb_wr_ptr + 1;
  452 |         end
  453 |     end
  454 | 
  455 |     always @(posedge clk_rx) begin
  456 |         if (grp8_reasm_eth_valid) begin
  457 |             grp8_reasm_clk_cnt  <= grp8_reasm_clk_cnt + 16'd1;
  458 |             grp8_reasm_byte_cnt <= grp8_reasm_byte_cnt + 16'd4;
  459 | 
  460 |             // Words 0..1 are 8-Byte Ethernet Preamble (55555555_555555D5); Words 2..501 are Payload
  461 |             if (grp8_reasm_clk_cnt == 16'd0) begin
  462 |                 if (grp8_reasm_eth_data !== 32'h5555_5555) begin
  463 |                     scb_error_words <= scb_error_words + 1;
  464 |                     $fatal(1, "[SCOREBOARD FATAL] Ethernet Preamble Word 0 Mismatch: got 0x%08X", grp8_reasm_eth_data);
  465 |                 end
  466 |             end else if (grp8_reasm_clk_cnt == 16'd1) begin
  467 |                 if (grp8_reasm_eth_data !== 32'h5555_55D5) begin
  468 |                     scb_error_words <= scb_error_words + 1;
  469 |                     $fatal(1, "[SCOREBOARD FATAL] Ethernet Preamble Word 1 Mismatch: got 0x%08X", grp8_reasm_eth_data);
  470 |                 end
  471 |             end else begin
  472 |                 if (grp8_reasm_eth_data === scb_fifo[scb_rd_ptr]) begin
  473 |                     scb_matched_words <= scb_matched_words + 1;
  474 |                 end else begin
  475 |                     scb_error_words <= scb_error_words + 1;
  476 |                     $fatal(1, "[SCOREBOARD FATAL] Payload Word #%0d Mismatch! Expected=0x%08X, Got=0x%08X",
  477 |                            scb_rd_ptr, scb_fifo[scb_rd_ptr], grp8_reasm_eth_data);
  478 |                 end
  479 |                 scb_rd_ptr <= scb_rd_ptr + 1;
  480 |             end
  481 | 
  482 |             // Words 1..2 are Ethernet Preamble; Words 3..502 are Ethernet Packet (Words 12..14 = ASCII Tag)
  483 |             if (grp8_reasm_clk_cnt == 16'd11) grp8_captured_ascii[95:64] <= grp8_reasm_eth_data;
  484 |             if (grp8_reasm_clk_cnt == 16'd12) grp8_captured_ascii[63:32] <= grp8_reasm_eth_data;
  485 |             if (grp8_reasm_clk_cnt == 16'd13) grp8_captured_ascii[31:0]  <= grp8_reasm_eth_data;
  486 |             if (grp8_reasm_eth_last)          grp8_captured_fcs          <= grp8_reasm_eth_data;
  487 |         end else begin
  488 |             grp8_reasm_clk_cnt  <= 16'd0;
  489 |             grp8_reasm_byte_cnt <= 16'd0;
  490 |         end
  491 |     end
  492 | 
  493 |     // [Rev 2.3] Inject 1-cycle MGMT 1Hz trigger right after Jumbo Segment 2 (DAT2) starts
  494 |     // so the Grand Top simulation visibly transmits & receives IDLE, DAT1, DAT2, AND MGMT!
  495 |     initial begin
  496 |         wait(grp1_seg_frame_id == 16'd2);
  497 |         @(posedge clk_tx);
  498 |         force u_dut.sda_encoder_inst.mgmt_trigger_1hz = 1'b1;
  499 |         @(posedge clk_tx);
  500 |         release u_dut.sda_encoder_inst.mgmt_trigger_1hz;
  501 |     end
  502 | 
  503 |     // =========================================================================
  504 |     // 6. REAL-TIME SDA OISL TABLE 2-4 METRICS & EVENT TELEMETRY LOGGER
  505 |     // =========================================================================
  506 |     real tx_fso_frame_start_ns         = 0.0;
  507 |     real OISL_Frame_Duration_us        = 0.0;
  508 |     real OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps = 0.0;
  509 |     real OISL_Frame_Rate_kHz           = 0.0;
  510 | 
  511 |     always @(grp4_tx_frame_id) begin
  512 |         if (grp4_tx_frame_id >= 32'd1) begin
  513 |             if (tx_fso_frame_start_ns > 0.0) begin
  514 |                 OISL_Frame_Duration_us        = ($realtime - tx_fso_frame_start_ns) / 1000.0;
  515 |                 OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps = 15264.0 / OISL_Frame_Duration_us;
  516 |                 OISL_Frame_Rate_kHz           = 1000.0 / OISL_Frame_Duration_us;
  517 |                 $display(" [GRP4 TX OPTICAL] Frame %0d Completed -> Exact Duration = %0.6f us | Rate = %0.3f Mbps",
  518 |                          grp4_tx_frame_id - 1, OISL_Frame_Duration_us, OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps);
  519 |             end
  520 |             tx_fso_frame_start_ns = $realtime;
  521 |         end
  522 |     end
  523 | 
  524 |     always @(posedge clk_rx) begin
  525 |         if (u_dut.sda_decoder_inst.u_core_rx.preamble_valid) begin
  526 |             $display(" [%0.1f ns] [GRP6 RX PREAMBLE] Extracted = 0x%018X | Link Locked = %0b",
  527 |                      $realtime, grp6_rx_preamble_72b, grp6_rx_preamble_lock);
  528 |         end
  529 |         if (grp7_arq_fb_valid) begin
  530 |             $display(" [%0.1f ns] [GRP7 ARQ FEEDBACK] RXFN = %0d | Status = %s (hdr_crc_ok=%0b, pld_crc_ok=%0b)",
  531 |                      $realtime, grp7_arq_fb_rxfn, grp7_arq_fb_ack ? "ACK (1)" : "NAK (0)",
  532 |                      grp7_hdr_crc16_ok, grp7_pld_crc32_ok);
  533 |         end
  534 |         if (grp8_reasm_eth_valid && grp8_reasm_eth_last) begin
  535 |             $display(" [%0.1f ns] [GRP8 PC 2 EGRESS] Reassembled Jumbo Packet #%0d Completed (%0d Bytes + 8B Preamble = 2008B) | ASCII=\"%s\" | FCS=0x%08X",
  536 |                      $realtime, grp8_reasm_pkt_cnt, grp8_reasm_pkt_bytes, grp8_captured_ascii, grp8_reasm_eth_data);
  537 |         end
  538 |     end
  539 | 
  540 |     // Watchdog Timeout Guard (Enforces $fatal if link or packets stall)
  541 |     initial begin
  542 |         #500000; // 500 us maximum simulation watchdog
  543 |         $fatal(1, "[WATCHDOG FATAL] Simulation timed out before completing %0d Jumbo packets!", TARGET_JUMBO_PKTS);
  544 |     end
  545 | 
  546 |     // =========================================================================
  547 |     // 7. MAIN SIMULATION SEQUENCE & FINAL ETRI SCOREBOARD REPORT
  548 |     // =========================================================================
  549 |     initial begin
  550 |         $display("\n================================================================================");
  551 |         $display(" STARTING SDAOISL10Gto10G_top FULL END-TO-END SIMULATION (PC 1 -> FPGA -> PC 2)");
  552 |         $display(" -> SIM_MODE          : %0d (Internal 2000B Jumbo Traffic Generator)", SIM_MODE);
  553 |         $display(" -> CH_ERROR_MODE     : %0d (0=Clean, 1=Correctable FEC Error, 2=Full Burst)", CH_ERROR_MODE);
  554 |         $display(" -> TARGET_JUMBO_PKTS : %0d Packets (Full Byte-by-Byte Scoreboard Active)", TARGET_JUMBO_PKTS);
  555 |         $display("================================================================================\n");
  556 | 
  557 |         wait(gth_link_up == 1'b1);
  558 |         $display(" [%0.1f ns] [STAGE 1] GTH 10.3125 Gbps Serial Transceiver Link Up Achieved!", $realtime);
  559 | 
  560 |         wait(rx_block_locked == 1'b1);
  561 |         $display(" [%0.1f ns] [STAGE 2] 64B/66B RX Gearbox Sync Header (2'b01) Locked!", $realtime);
  562 | 
  563 |         wait(rx_preamble_locked == 1'b1);
  564 |         $display(" [%0.1f ns] [STAGE 3] SDA OISL 72-bit Preamble (72'h77AD5B5843641E2E26) Locked!\n", $realtime);
  565 | 
  566 |         // Wait until TARGET_JUMBO_PKTS full 2000-Byte Ethernet Jumbo frames exit to PC 2
  567 |         wait(grp8_pc2_pkt_cnt >= TARGET_JUMBO_PKTS);
  568 |         repeat (50) @(posedge clk_rx);
  569 | 
  570 |         $display("\n================================================================================");
  571 |         $display(" SDAOISL10Gto10G_top END-TO-END VERIFICATION REPORT (SDA OISL v2.1.2)");
  572 |         $display("================================================================================");
  573 |         $display(" 1. Optical Preamble (Table 2-8)   : 0x%018X (Locked = %0b)", grp6_rx_preamble_72b, rx_preamble_locked);
  574 |         $display(" 2. 64B/66B GTH Gearbox Status     : gth_link_up = %0b | rx_block_locked = %0b", gth_link_up, rx_block_locked);
  575 |         $display(" 3. FEC Error Repair Telemetry     : LPC Bits Repaired = %0d | RS Symbols Repaired = %0d",
  576 |                  grp6_lpc_repaired_bits, grp6_rs_repaired_syms);
  577 |         $display(" 4. MGMT 5000 km Ranging Recovered : 0x%016X (Expected: 0x415312D000000000)", grp7_mgmt_range_meters);
  578 |         $display(" 5. Full Byte Scoreboard Verified  : %0d Words (%0d Bytes) Matched | Errors = %0d",
  579 |                  scb_matched_words, scb_matched_words * 4, scb_error_words);
  580 |         $display(" 6. Recovered Payload Marker & FCS : ASCII = \"%s\" | FCS = 0x%08X",
  581 |                  grp8_captured_ascii, grp8_captured_fcs);
  582 |         if (rx_preamble_locked && rx_block_locked &&
  583 |             (scb_matched_words == TARGET_JUMBO_PKTS * 500) && (scb_error_words == 0) &&
  584 |             (grp8_captured_ascii == "Kookmin FSO ") &&
  585 |             (grp8_captured_fcs == 32'hDEAD_BEEF)) begin
  586 |             $display("--------------------------------------------------------------------------------");
  587 |             $display(" FINAL VERDICT: [PASS] ALL 4 FRAME TYPES (DAT1, DAT2, IDLE, MGMT) VERIFIED!");
  588 |         end else begin
  589 |             $fatal(1, "FINAL VERDICT: [FAIL] Scoreboard or status check failed!");
  590 |         end
  591 |         $display("================================================================================\n");
  592 |         $finish;
  593 |     end
  594 | 
  595 | endmodule

    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi

    8 |                SCENARIO:
    9 |                Simulates the exact 259-cycle continuous output from FEC_MUX.
   10 |                Sends 4 full frames: DAT1, DAT2, IDLE, MGMT.
   11 | 
   12 |                GEOMETRY PROOF:
   13 |                - MUX IN     : 259 Words (64-bit) / 2072 Bytes
   14 |                - SCRM OUT   : 259 Words (64-bit) / 2072 Bytes
   15 |                - LPC OUT    : 259 Words (96-bit) / 3108 Bytes
   16 |                 
   17 |                - Directly uses FEC_MUX output profile (259 cycles per frame).
   18 |                - Validates Scrambler (64-bit, 259 cycles -> 2072 Bytes).
   19 |                - Validates LPC Top (64-bit to 96-bit expansion -> 3108 Bytes).
   20 |                - Demonstrates 4 consecutive frames (DAT1, DAT2, IDLE, MGMT).
   21 |                 
   22 | Revision History:
   23 |   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 259-cycle Scrambler (2072B) & LPC (3108B) verification testbench.
   24 |   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 15:04 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 4 & Item 6 - SDA OISL Page 39-41]
   25 |     1. Exposed 25-bit PRBS Scrambler state 'scr_state_25b' (u_scrambler.Q[24:0]) 
   26 |        and 64-bit PRBS mask 'scr_prbs_mask_64b' (u_scrambler.S[63:0]) to prove 
   27 |        Table 2-17 reset seed 25'h0000007 and Figure 2-12 bit ordering.
   28 |     2. Exposed LPC Active Disparity Management accumulators ('lpc3_running_disp' 
   29 |        .. 'lpc0_running_disp') from u_lpc_top to prove Section 2.6.3.6.8 running 
   30 |        disparity tracking across all 259 cycles per frame.
   31 |     3. Added an automatic RX LPC Decoder (lpc_dec_top) + 25-bit Descrambler 
   32 |        (descrambler) loopback self-checker verifying 100% bit-accurate recovery 
   33 |        across all 4 frames (1,036 words = 8,288 Bytes, 0 errors).
   34 |   - Rev 2.4 (2026-10-29 12:52 KST) : [Audit Fix - Exact Reference Queue Scoreboard]
   35 |     1. Preserved 100% of original descriptions, comments, and Rev 1.0/2.0 history.
   36 |     2. Replaced fixed-index 'ref_pipe[3]' comparison with an exact First-In-First-Out
   37 |        Reference Queue (ref_queue[wr_ptr] pushed on mux_dv, ref_queue[rd_ptr] popped on
   38 |        rx_desc_dv) and widened frame_id concatenation to 64 bits ({4'd0, frame_id[3:0], ...}),
   39 |        achieving 1036 / 1036 matched words with 0 errors.
   40 | ===========================================================================

   43 | module tb_Scrambler_LPC();
   44 | 
   45 |     // =======================================================
   46 |     // 1. CLOCK AND RESET
   47 |     // =======================================================
   48 |     reg clk;   // 200 MHz Baseband Clock (5.0 ns period)
   49 |     reg rst_n;
   50 | 
   51 |     // =======================================================
   52 |     // 2. INPUT STIMULUS (Simulating FEC_MUX Output)
   53 |     // =======================================================
   54 |     reg         mux_dv;
   55 |     reg  [63:0] mux_data;
   56 | 
   57 |     // =======================================================
   58 |     // 3. OUTPUT WIRES (Connecting Scrambler -> LPC)
   59 |     // =======================================================
   60 |     wire        scr_dv;
   61 |     wire [63:0] scr_data;
   62 |     
   63 |     wire        lpc_dv;
   64 |     wire [95:0] lpc_data;
   65 | 
   66 |     // Loopback Self-Check Wires (lpc_dec_top -> descrambler)
   67 |     wire        rx_lpc_dec_dv;
   68 |     wire [63:0] rx_lpc_dec_data;
   69 |     wire        rx_desc_dv;
   70 |     wire [63:0] rx_desc_data;
   71 | 
   72 |     // =======================================================
   73 |     // 4. WAVEFORM TRACKERS (For Visual Proof to ETRI)
   74 |     // =======================================================
   75 |     reg  [31:0] frame_type_str; // Displays "DAT1", "DAT2", "IDLE", "MGMT"
   76 |     
   77 |     // Input Trackers (From FEC_MUX)
   78 |     reg  [8:0]  in_mux_word_idx; // 1 to 259 Words
   79 |     reg  [11:0] in_mux_byte_idx; // 8 to 2072 Bytes
   80 |     
   81 |     // Scrambler Output Trackers
   82 |     reg  [8:0]  out_scr_word_idx; // 1 to 259 Words
   83 |     reg  [11:0] out_scr_byte_idx; // 8 to 2072 Bytes
   84 |     
   85 |     // LPC Output Trackers (Final FEC Core Output)
   86 |     reg  [8:0]  out_lpc_word_idx; // 1 to 259 Words
   87 |     reg  [11:0] out_lpc_byte_idx; // 12 to 3108 Bytes (96-bit = 12 Bytes!)
   88 | 
   89 |     // [Rev 2.0] Hierarchical Probes for ETRI Audit Item 4 (25-bit PRBS) & Item 6 (Disparity)
   90 |     wire [24:0]        scr_state_25b     = u_scrambler.Q;
   91 |     wire [63:0]        scr_prbs_mask_64b = u_scrambler.S;
   92 |     wire signed [11:0] lpc3_running_disp = u_lpc_top.lpc_3.running_disparity;
   93 |     wire signed [11:0] lpc2_running_disp = u_lpc_top.lpc_2.running_disparity;
   94 |     wire signed [11:0] lpc1_running_disp = u_lpc_top.lpc_1.running_disparity;
   95 |     wire signed [11:0] lpc0_running_disp = u_lpc_top.lpc_0.running_disparity;
   96 | 
   97 |     // =======================================================
   98 |     // 5. DUT INSTANTIATIONS
   99 |     // =======================================================
  100 |     
  101 |     // A. Scrambler (64-bit, 259 cycles, 25-bit PRBS Seed 25'h0000007)
  102 |     scrambler u_scrambler (
  103 |         .clk      (clk),
  104 |         .rst_n    (rst_n),
  105 |         .en       (mux_dv),
  106 |         .data_in  (mux_data),
  107 |         .flag     (scr_dv),
  108 |         .data_out (scr_data)
  109 |     );
  110 | 
  111 |     // B. LPC Encoder Top (64-bit to 96-bit expansion, 259 cycles + Active Disparity)
  112 |     lpc_top u_lpc_top (
  113 |         .clk      (clk),
  114 |         .rst_n    (rst_n),
  115 |         .en       (scr_dv),
  116 |         .data_in  (scr_data),
  117 |         .flag     (lpc_dv),
  118 |         .data_out (lpc_data)
  119 |     );
  120 | 
  121 |     // C. [Rev 2.0] Loopback Self-Checker: LPC Decoder Top + 25-bit Descrambler
  122 |     lpc_dec_top u_rx_lpc_dec_top (
  123 |         .clk      (clk),
  124 |         .rst_n    (rst_n),
  125 |         .en       (lpc_dv),
  126 |         .data_in  (lpc_data),
  127 |         .flag     (rx_lpc_dec_dv),
  128 |         .data_out (rx_lpc_dec_data)
  129 |     );
  130 | 
  131 |     descrambler u_rx_descrambler (
  132 |         .clk      (clk),
  133 |         .rst_n    (rst_n),
  134 |         .en       (rx_lpc_dec_dv),
  135 |         .data_in  (rx_lpc_dec_data),
  136 |         .flag     (rx_desc_dv),
  137 |         .data_out (rx_desc_data)
  138 |     );
  139 | 
  140 |     // =======================================================
  141 |     // 6. CLOCK GENERATION (200 MHz -> 5.0 ns)
  142 |     // =======================================================
  143 |     initial begin
  144 |         clk = 1'b0;
  145 |         forever #2.5 clk = ~clk;
  146 |     end
  147 | 
  148 |     // =======================================================
  149 |     // 7. CONTINUOUS 4-FRAME GENERATOR FSM
  150 |     // =======================================================
  151 |     localparam ST_STREAM = 2'd0;
  152 |     localparam ST_GAP    = 2'd1;
  153 |     localparam ST_DONE   = 2'd2;
  154 | 
  155 |     reg [1:0]  tb_state;
  156 |     reg [3:0]  frame_id;
  157 |     reg [15:0] cycle_cnt;
  158 | 
  159 |     initial begin
  160 |         rst_n     = 1'b0;
  161 |         tb_state  = ST_STREAM;
  162 |         frame_id  = 4'd1;
  163 |         cycle_cnt = 16'd1;
  164 |         #100;
  165 |         rst_n     = 1'b1;
  166 |     end
  167 | 
  168 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  169 |         if (!rst_n) begin
  170 |             tb_state  <= ST_STREAM;
  171 |             frame_id  <= 4'd1;
  172 |             cycle_cnt <= 16'd1;
  173 |         end else begin
  174 |             case (tb_state)
  175 |                 ST_STREAM: begin
  176 |                     // FEC_MUX outputs exactly 259 words per frame
  177 |                     if (cycle_cnt < 16'd259) begin
  178 |                         cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
  179 |                     end else begin
  180 |                         tb_state  <= ST_GAP;
  181 |                         cycle_cnt <= 16'd1;
  182 |                     end
  183 |                 end
  184 |                 
  185 |                 ST_GAP: begin
  186 |                     // Short inter-frame gap to show Scrambler & LPC resetting cleanly
  187 |                     if (cycle_cnt < 16'd15) begin
  188 |                         cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
  189 |                     end else begin
  190 |                         if (frame_id < 4'd4) begin
  191 |                             frame_id  <= frame_id + 1'b1;
  192 |                             tb_state  <= ST_STREAM;
  193 |                             cycle_cnt <= 16'd1;
  194 |                         end else begin
  195 |                             tb_state  <= ST_DONE;
  196 |                         end
  197 |                     end
  198 |                 end
  199 |                 
  200 |                 ST_DONE: begin
  201 |                     tb_state <= ST_DONE;
  202 |                 end
  203 |             endcase
  204 |         end
  205 |     end
  206 | 
  207 |     // =======================================================
  208 |     // 8. DATA PATTERNS & TRACKER LOGIC
  209 |     // =======================================================
  210 |     always @(*) begin
  211 |         mux_dv   = 1'b0;
  212 |         mux_data = 64'd0;
  213 | 
  214 |         if (rst_n && (tb_state == ST_STREAM)) begin
  215 |             mux_dv = 1'b1;
  216 |             
  217 |             // Cycles 1 to 2: Original 16-Byte Header
  218 |             if (cycle_cnt == 16'd1)      mux_data = {4'd0, frame_id, 8'h00, 16'h0000, 8'hFD, 24'h554433};
  219 |             else if (cycle_cnt == 16'd2) mux_data = 64'h2211_F28A_8899_0F28;
  220 |             // Cycles 3 to 4: 16-Byte Header RS Parity
  221 |             else if (cycle_cnt <= 16'd4) mux_data = 64'hC1C2_C1C2_C1C2_C1C2;
  222 |             // Cycle 5: Payload Start (Table 2-18 FSO Payload & Packet Headers)
  223 |             else if (cycle_cnt == 16'd5) mux_data = (frame_id == 4'd2) ? 64'hAB00_4064_AAAA_0001 : 64'hAB00_0000_CDEF_07D0;
  224 |             // Cycle 243: Payload End (CRC-32)
  225 |             else if (cycle_cnt == 16'd243) mux_data = 64'hDA7A_DA7A_C320_0000 + {60'd0, frame_id};
  226 |             // Cycles 244 to 259: 16-Word (128-Byte) Payload RS Parity
  227 |             else if (cycle_cnt > 16'd243)  mux_data = 64'hB10C_B10C_B10C_B10C;
  228 |             // Cycles 6 to 242: Main Payload Body
  229 |             else begin
  230 |                 if (frame_id == 4'd1 || frame_id == 4'd2) mux_data = 64'hDA7A_DA7A_DA7A_DA7A;
  231 |                 else if (frame_id == 4'd3)                mux_data = 64'h1D1E_1D1E_1D1E_1D1E;
  232 |                 else                                      mux_data = 64'hA1A1_A1A1_A1A1_A1A1;
  233 |             end
  234 |         end
  235 |     end
  236 | 
  237 |     // String Indicator for Waveform
  238 |     always @(*) begin
  239 |         if (!rst_n || tb_state == ST_DONE) frame_type_str = "DONE";
  240 |         else if (tb_state == ST_GAP)       frame_type_str = "GAP ";
  241 |         else begin
  242 |             case (frame_id)
  243 |                 4'd1: frame_type_str = "DAT1";
  244 |                 4'd2: frame_type_str = "DAT2";
  245 |                 4'd3: frame_type_str = "IDLE";
  246 |                 4'd4: frame_type_str = "MGMT";
  247 |                 default: frame_type_str = "IDLE";
  248 |             endcase
  249 |         end
  250 |     end
  251 | 
  252 |     // [Rev 2.4] Exact FIFO Reference Queue for Loopback Self-Check (1036 Words)
  253 |     reg [63:0] ref_queue [0:2047];
  254 |     integer    ref_wr_ptr      = 0;
  255 |     integer    ref_rd_ptr      = 0;
  256 |     integer    loopback_ok_cnt = 0;
  257 |     integer    loopback_err_cnt = 0;
  258 | 
  259 |     // Byte & Word Counters for Waveform
  260 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  261 |         if (!rst_n) begin
  262 |             in_mux_word_idx  <= 9'd0;
  263 |             in_mux_byte_idx  <= 12'd0;
  264 |             out_scr_word_idx <= 9'd0;
  265 |             out_scr_byte_idx <= 12'd0;
  266 |             out_lpc_word_idx <= 9'd0;
  267 |             out_lpc_byte_idx <= 12'd0;
  268 |             ref_wr_ptr       <= 0;
  269 |             ref_rd_ptr       <= 0;
  270 |             loopback_ok_cnt  <= 0;
  271 |             loopback_err_cnt <= 0;
  272 |         end else begin
  273 |             // Record every accepted TX input word into Reference Queue
  274 |             if (mux_dv) begin
  275 |                 ref_queue[ref_wr_ptr] <= mux_data;
  276 |                 ref_wr_ptr            <= ref_wr_ptr + 1;
  277 |             end
  278 | 
  279 |             // Verify every recovered RX Descrambled word against Reference Queue
  280 |             if (rx_desc_dv) begin
  281 |                 if (rx_desc_data === ref_queue[ref_rd_ptr])
  282 |                     loopback_ok_cnt <= loopback_ok_cnt + 1;
  283 |                 else
  284 |                     loopback_err_cnt <= loopback_err_cnt + 1;
  285 |                 ref_rd_ptr <= ref_rd_ptr + 1;
  286 |             end
  287 | 
  288 |             // Track Input from MUX
  289 |             if (mux_dv) begin
  290 |                 in_mux_word_idx <= in_mux_word_idx + 1'b1;
  291 |                 in_mux_byte_idx <= in_mux_byte_idx + 12'd8;
  292 |             end else begin
  293 |                 in_mux_word_idx <= 9'd0;
  294 |                 in_mux_byte_idx <= 12'd0;
  295 |             end
  296 | 
  297 |             // Track Scrambler Output
  298 |             if (scr_dv) begin
  299 |                 if (out_scr_word_idx == 9'd0) begin
  300 |                     $display(" [%0t] Frame %0d Scrambler Word 1: State Q = 25'h%07X (Seed=0x0000007) | PRBS Mask S = 0x%016X",
  301 |                              $time, frame_id, scr_state_25b, scr_prbs_mask_64b);
  302 |                 end
  303 |                 out_scr_word_idx <= out_scr_word_idx + 1'b1;
  304 |                 out_scr_byte_idx <= out_scr_byte_idx + 12'd8;
  305 |             end else begin
  306 |                 out_scr_word_idx <= 9'd0;
  307 |                 out_scr_byte_idx <= 12'd0;
  308 |             end
  309 | 
  310 |             // Track LPC Output (96-bit = 12 Bytes per cycle!)
  311 |             if (lpc_dv) begin
  312 |                 out_lpc_word_idx <= out_lpc_word_idx + 1'b1;
  313 |                 out_lpc_byte_idx <= out_lpc_byte_idx + 12'd12;
  314 |             end else begin
  315 |                 out_lpc_word_idx <= 9'd0;
  316 |                 out_lpc_byte_idx <= 12'd0;
  317 |             end
  318 |         end
  319 |     end
  320 | 
  321 |     // Simulation Termination
  322 |     initial begin
  323 |         wait(tb_state == ST_DONE);
  324 |         wait(loopback_ok_cnt + loopback_err_cnt == 1036);
  325 |         #200;
  326 |         $display("\n=======================================================");
  327 |         $display(" SCRAMBLER (25-BIT SEED 0x0000007) & LPC(24,16) REPORT");
  328 |         $display("=======================================================");
  329 |         $display(" Scrambler aligned to 259-cycle processing (25-bit PRBS).");
  330 |         $display(" LPC expanded 64-bit words to 96-bit structures with Active Disparity.");
  331 |         $display(" Final output profile : 259 Words (3108 Bytes) per frame.");
  332 |         $display(" Loopback Verified    : %0d / 1036 Words Matched (Errors: %0d)", loopback_ok_cnt, loopback_err_cnt);
  333 |         if (loopback_ok_cnt == 1036 && loopback_err_cnt == 0)
  334 |             $display(" RESULT: [PASS] 100%% COMPLIANT WITH ETRI AUDIT ITEM 4 & ITEM 6!");
  335 |         else
  336 |             $fatal(1, " RESULT: [FAIL] Mismatches detected in Scrambler/LPC loopback!");
  337 |         $display("=======================================================\n");
  338 |         $finish;
  339 |     end
  340 | 
  341 | endmodule

    6 | Description  : Verification Testbench for Selective Repeat ARQ TX Controller

    8 |                Tests all 4 scenarios of the ARQ State Machine:
    9 |                - Scenario 1: The 'Happy Path' (Transmit -> ACK -> Delete from RAM)
   10 |                - Scenario 2: The 'Fast Error Path' (Transmit -> NAK -> Immediate Retx -> ACK)
   11 |                - Scenario 3: The 'Silent Path' (Holdoff Timer Expired -> 5x Max Retries -> Drop)
