   17 |   - Rev 2.5 (2026-10-29 16:42 KST) : [Audit Fix - Dynamic TXFN Capture & Handshake Sync]
   18 |     Captured the dynamically assigned 'last_data_txfn' upon 'ddr4_write_req' assertion
   19 |     so Scenario 1 (ACK) and Scenario 2 (NAK -> Retx -> ACK) target the exact active
   20 |     DATA frame sequence number even when intervening IDLE frames advance global_txfn.
   21 | ===========================================================================
   22 | */
   23 | 
   24 | module tb_arq_tx_controller();
   25 | 
   26 |     reg clk;
   27 |     reg rst_n;
   28 | 
   29 |     reg        fso_data_valid;
   30 |     reg        mgmt_tick_1hz;
   31 |     reg        header_gen_busy;
   32 | 
   33 |     reg [15:0] rx_rxfn_in;
   34 |     reg        rx_ack_in;
   35 |     reg        rx_ack_valid_in;
   36 | 
   37 |     wire [15:0] tx_txfn_out;
   38 |     wire [1:0]  tx_frame_type;
   39 |     wire        tx_trigger_gen;
   40 |     wire [1:0]  payload_mux_sel;
   41 |     wire        tx_stall_mac;
   42 | 
   43 |     wire        ddr4_write_req;
   44 |     wire        ddr4_read_req;
   45 |     wire        ddr4_delete_req;
   46 |     wire [15:0] ddr4_addr;
   47 | 
   48 |     // Instantiate DUT with fast simulation holdoff timer (50 ticks) and Table 2-11 x64 extension
   49 |     arq_tx_controller #(
   50 |         .ARQ_MAX_RETX      (3'd5),
   51 |         .ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG   (8'd255),
   52 |         .ARQ_HOLDOFF_MULT  (64),
   53 |         .SIM_SCALE_ENABLE  (1),
   54 |         .HOLDOFF_TICKS     (16'd50),
   55 |         .TRACKER_DEPTH     (4)
   56 |     ) u_dut (
   57 |         .clk             (clk),
   58 |         .rst_n           (rst_n),
   59 |         .fso_data_valid  (fso_data_valid),
   60 |         .mgmt_tick_1hz   (mgmt_tick_1hz),
   61 |         .header_gen_busy (header_gen_busy),
   62 |         .rx_rxfn_in      (rx_rxfn_in),
   63 |         .rx_ack_in       (rx_ack_in),
   64 |         .rx_ack_valid_in (rx_ack_valid_in),
   65 |         .tx_txfn_out     (tx_txfn_out),
   66 |         .tx_frame_type   (tx_frame_type),
   67 |         .tx_trigger_gen  (tx_trigger_gen),
   68 |         .payload_mux_sel (payload_mux_sel),
   69 |         .tx_stall_mac    (tx_stall_mac),
   70 |         .ddr4_write_req  (ddr4_write_req),
   71 |         .ddr4_read_req   (ddr4_read_req),
   72 |         .ddr4_delete_req (ddr4_delete_req),
   73 |         .ddr4_addr       (ddr4_addr)
   74 |     );
   75 | 
   76 |     initial begin
   77 |         clk = 1'b0;
   78 |         forever #2.5 clk = ~clk; // 200 MHz
   79 |     end
   80 | 
   81 |     // Simulate realistic downstream Frame Transmission Busy duration (10 clocks per trigger)
   82 |     always @(posedge clk) begin
   83 |         if (!rst_n) begin
   84 |             header_gen_busy <= 1'b0;
   85 |         end else if (tx_trigger_gen) begin
   86 |             header_gen_busy <= 1'b1;
   87 |             repeat (10) @(posedge clk);
   88 |             header_gen_busy <= 1'b0;
   89 |         end
   90 |     end
   91 | 
   92 |     // Verification Counters & Dynamic TXFN Tracker
   93 |     integer    write_req_cnt  = 0;
   94 |     integer    retx_req_cnt   = 0;
   95 |     integer    delete_req_cnt = 0;
   96 |     integer    mgmt_tx_cnt    = 0;
   97 |     reg [15:0] last_data_txfn = 16'd0;
   98 | 
   99 |     always @(posedge clk) begin
  100 |         if (rst_n) begin
  101 |             if (ddr4_write_req) begin
  102 |                 write_req_cnt  <= write_req_cnt + 1;
  103 |                 last_data_txfn <= ddr4_addr;
  104 |                 $display("[%0t ns] [FLOWCHART: Store frame copy in RAM] -> TXFN %0d Transmitted & Saved.", $time, tx_txfn_out);
  105 |             end
  106 |             if (ddr4_read_req) begin
  107 |                 retx_req_cnt <= retx_req_cnt + 1;
  108 |                 $display("[%0t ns] [FLOWCHART: Retrieve frame from RAM] -> TXFN %0d Retransmitted (Attempt #%0d).", $time, tx_txfn_out, retx_req_cnt + 1);
  109 |             end
  110 |             if (ddr4_delete_req) begin
  111 |                 delete_req_cnt <= delete_req_cnt + 1;
  112 |                 $display("[%0t ns] [FLOWCHART: Delete frame / Drop Frame] -> RAM Address %0d Freed.", $time, ddr4_addr);
  113 |             end
  114 |             if (tx_trigger_gen && (tx_frame_type == 2'b10)) begin
  115 |                 mgmt_tx_cnt <= mgmt_tx_cnt + 1;
  116 |                 $display("[%0t ns] [FLOWCHART: Priority 2 MGMT 1Hz]     -> TXFN %0d MGMT Frame Transmitted.", $time, tx_txfn_out);
  117 |             end
  118 |         end
  119 |     end
  120 | 
  121 |     initial begin
  122 |         rst_n           = 1'b0;
  123 |         fso_data_valid  = 1'b0;
  124 |         mgmt_tick_1hz   = 1'b0;
  125 |         header_gen_busy = 1'b0;
  126 |         rx_rxfn_in      = 16'd0;
  127 |         rx_ack_in       = 1'b0;
  128 |         rx_ack_valid_in = 1'b0;
  129 | 
  130 |         #20;
  131 |         rst_n = 1'b1;
  132 |         #15;
  133 | 
  134 |         $display("\n[CONFIG] Table 2-11 Extended Holdoff Window = %0d Frames (ARQ_MAX_RETX = %0d)",
  135 |                  u_dut.TABLE_2_11_HOLDOFF_FRAMES, u_dut.ARQ_MAX_RETX);
  136 | 
  137 |         // =======================================================
  138 |         // SCENARIO 1: The 'Happy Path' (Transmit -> ACK -> Delete)
  139 |         // =======================================================
  140 |         $display("\n=======================================================");
  141 |         $display("SCENARIO 1: The 'Happy Path' (Transmit -> ACK -> Delete)");
  142 |         $display("=======================================================");
  143 |         @(posedge clk); fso_data_valid = 1'b1;
  144 |         wait(ddr4_write_req == 1'b1);
  145 |         @(posedge clk); fso_data_valid = 1'b0;
  146 | 
  147 |         repeat (12) @(posedge clk);
  148 |         @(posedge clk);
  149 |         rx_rxfn_in      = last_data_txfn;
  150 |         rx_ack_in       = 1'b1; // Positive ACK
  151 |         rx_ack_valid_in = 1'b1;
  152 |         @(posedge clk);
  153 |         rx_ack_valid_in = 1'b0;
  154 |         repeat (5) @(posedge clk);
  155 | 
  156 |         // =======================================================
  157 |         // SCENARIO 2: The 'Fast Error Path' (Transmit -> NAK -> Retx -> ACK)
  158 |         // =======================================================
  159 |         $display("\n=======================================================");
  160 |         $display("SCENARIO 2: The 'Fast Error Path' (Transmit -> NAK -> Retx -> ACK)");
  161 |         $display("=======================================================");
  162 |         @(posedge clk); fso_data_valid = 1'b1;
  163 |         wait(ddr4_write_req == 1'b1);
  164 |         @(posedge clk); fso_data_valid = 1'b0;
  165 | 
  166 |         repeat (12) @(posedge clk);
  167 |         // Send NAK (rx_ack_in = 0) -> Forces immediate Retransmission!
  168 |         @(posedge clk);
  169 |         rx_rxfn_in      = last_data_txfn;
  170 |         rx_ack_in       = 1'b0; // NAK!
  171 |         rx_ack_valid_in = 1'b1;
  172 |         @(posedge clk);
  173 |         rx_ack_valid_in = 1'b0;
  174 | 
  175 |         // Wait for Priority 1 Retransmission to fire
  176 |         wait(ddr4_read_req == 1'b1);
  177 |         repeat (14) @(posedge clk);
  178 | 
  179 |         // Send Positive ACK to clear the retransmitted frame
  180 |         @(posedge clk);
  181 |         rx_rxfn_in      = last_data_txfn;
  182 |         rx_ack_in       = 1'b1; // ACK!
  183 |         rx_ack_valid_in = 1'b1;
  184 |         @(posedge clk);
  185 |         rx_ack_valid_in = 1'b0;
  186 |         repeat (5) @(posedge clk);
  187 | 
  188 |         // =======================================================
  189 |         // SCENARIO 3: The 'Silent Path' (Timer Expired -> 5x Max Retries -> Drop)
  190 |         // =======================================================
  191 |         $display("\n=======================================================");
  192 |         $display("SCENARIO 3: The 'Silent Path' (Timer Expired -> Max Retries -> Drop)");
  193 |         $display("=======================================================");
  194 |         @(posedge clk); fso_data_valid = 1'b1;
  195 |         wait(ddr4_write_req == 1'b1);
  196 |         @(posedge clk); fso_data_valid = 1'b0;
  197 | 
  198 |         // Wait for all 5 autonomous timeout retransmissions + final max-retry drop
  199 |         wait(delete_req_cnt == 3);
  200 |         repeat (5) @(posedge clk);
  201 | 
  202 |         // =======================================================
  203 |         // SCENARIO 4: Priority 2 MGMT 1Hz Frame Schedule Check
  204 |         // =======================================================
  205 |         $display("\n=======================================================");
  206 |         $display("SCENARIO 4: Priority 2 MGMT 1Hz Frame Schedule Check");
  207 |         $display("=======================================================");
  208 |         @(posedge clk); mgmt_tick_1hz = 1'b1;
  209 |         @(posedge clk); mgmt_tick_1hz = 1'b0;
  210 |         wait(mgmt_tx_cnt == 1);
  211 |         repeat (15) @(posedge clk);
  212 | 
  213 |         $display("\n=======================================================");
  214 |         $display(" ARQ TX CONTROLLER VERIFICATION SUMMARY");
  215 |         $display(" -> Total New DATA Writes  : %0d (Expected: >= 3)", write_req_cnt);
  216 |         $display(" -> Total Retransmissions  : %0d (Expected: 6 [1 NAK + 5 Timeout Retries])", retx_req_cnt);
  217 |         $display(" -> Total RAM Frees/Drops  : %0d (Expected: 3 [2 ACKed + 1 Max-Retry Drop])", delete_req_cnt);
  218 |         $display(" -> Total 1Hz MGMT Frames  : %0d (Expected: 1)", mgmt_tx_cnt);
  219 |         if ((write_req_cnt >= 3) && (retx_req_cnt == 6) && (delete_req_cnt == 3) && (mgmt_tx_cnt == 1))
  220 |             $display(" -> RESULT: [PASS] ALL 4 SELECTIVE REPEAT ARQ SCENARIOS VERIFIED 100%%!");
  221 |         else
  222 |             $fatal(1, " -> RESULT: [FAIL] ARQ TX Controller scenario count mismatch!");
  223 |         $display("=======================================================\n");
  224 |         $finish;
  225 |     end
  226 | 
  227 | endmodule

   32 | 
   33 | module tb_cdc3_rx_gth_logic();
   34 | 
   35 |     reg clk_gth;   // 312.5 MHz (Period = 3.2 ns)
   36 |     reg clk_logic; // 200.0 MHz (Period = 5.0 ns)
   37 |     reg rst_n;
   38 | 
   39 |     // Group 1: Data In from GTH RX (312.5 MHz, 32-bit)
   40 |     reg         gth_rx_dv;
   41 |     reg  [31:0] gth_rx_data;
   42 |     reg  [7:0]  in_byte_stream;
   43 |     reg  [11:0] in_byte_cnt;    // Counts 1 to 3117 per frame
   44 |     reg  [15:0] in_clk_cnt;     // Counts 1 to 780 per frame (312.5 MHz)
   45 |     reg  [31:0] in_frame_id;    // Active Input Frame ID (1, 2, 3, 4)
   46 | 
   47 |     // Group 2: Data Out from CDC 3 (200.0 MHz, 128-bit)
   48 |     wire         cdc3_flag_out;
   49 |     wire [127:0] cdc3_data_out;
   50 |     wire [15:0]  out_clk_cnt        = u_cdc3.out_clk_cnt;     // Counts 1 to 499 per frame (200 MHz)

   55 |     wire [31:0]  out_frame_id       = u_cdc3.frame_out_id;    // Active Output Frame ID (1, 2, 3, 4)
   56 | 
   57 |     // DUT Instantiation
   58 |     rx_gth_logic u_cdc3 (
   59 |         .clk_gth   (clk_gth),
   60 |         .clk_logic (clk_logic),
   61 |         .rst_n     (rst_n),
   62 |         .en        (gth_rx_dv),
   63 |         .data_in   (gth_rx_data),
   64 |         .flag      (cdc3_flag_out),
   65 |         .data_out  (cdc3_data_out)
   66 |     );
   67 | 
   68 |     // Clocks
   69 |     initial begin
   70 |         clk_gth = 1'b0;
   71 |         forever #1.6 clk_gth = ~clk_gth;   // 312.5 MHz
   72 |     end
   73 | 
   74 |     initial begin
   75 |         clk_logic = 1'b0;
   76 |         forever #2.5 clk_logic = ~clk_logic; // 200.0 MHz
   77 |     end
   78 | 
   79 |     // Frame Byte Pattern Function
   80 |     // [Rev 2.0 - 2026-10-27 15:20 KST] Bytes 1..9 updated to SDA OISL Table 2-8 Preamble:
   81 |     // 72'h77_AD_5B_58_43_64_1E_2E_26 (MSB 8'h77 transmitted first down to LSB 8'h26)
   82 |     function [7:0] get_frame_byte(input [31:0] f_idx, input [11:0] b_idx);
   83 |         begin
   84 |             case (b_idx)
   85 |                 12'd1:                      get_frame_byte = 8'h77;
   86 |                 12'd2:                      get_frame_byte = 8'hAD;
   87 |                 12'd3:                      get_frame_byte = 8'h5B;
   88 |                 12'd4:                      get_frame_byte = 8'h58;
   89 |                 12'd5:                      get_frame_byte = 8'h43;
   90 |                 12'd6:                      get_frame_byte = 8'h64;
   91 |                 12'd7:                      get_frame_byte = 8'h1E;
   92 |                 12'd8:                      get_frame_byte = 8'h2E;
   93 |                 12'd9:                      get_frame_byte = 8'h26;
   94 |                 12'd10:                     get_frame_byte = 8'hAA;
   95 |                 12'd11:                     get_frame_byte = 8'hBB;
   96 |                 12'd12:                     get_frame_byte = 8'hCC;
   97 |                 12'd13:                     get_frame_byte = f_idx[7:0];
   98 |                 12'd3105, 12'd3106:         get_frame_byte = 8'h99;
   99 |                 12'd3107, 12'd3108:         get_frame_byte = 8'h88;
  100 |                 12'd3109, 12'd3110:         get_frame_byte = 8'h77;
  101 |                 12'd3111, 12'd3112:         get_frame_byte = 8'h66;
  102 |                 12'd3113, 12'd3114:         get_frame_byte = 8'h55;
  103 |                 12'd3115, 12'd3116:         get_frame_byte = 8'h44;
  104 |                 12'd3117:                   get_frame_byte = 8'h33;
  105 |                 default:                    get_frame_byte = b_idx[7:0];
  106 |             endcase
  107 |         end
  108 |     endfunction
  109 | 
  110 |     integer total_word_idx;
  111 |     integer b0_abs, b1_abs, b2_abs, b3_abs;
  112 |     reg [7:0] byte0, byte1, byte2, byte3;
  113 | 
  114 |     task step_input_byte(input [7:0] b_val, input is_clk_edge);
  115 |         begin
  116 |             in_byte_stream <= b_val;
  117 |             if (in_frame_id == 32'd0) begin
  118 |                 in_frame_id <= 32'd1;
  119 |                 in_byte_cnt <= 12'd1;
  120 |                 in_clk_cnt  <= 16'd1;
  121 |             end else if (in_byte_cnt == 12'd3117) begin
  122 |                 in_frame_id <= in_frame_id + 32'd1;
  123 |                 in_byte_cnt <= 12'd1;
  124 |                 in_clk_cnt  <= 16'd1;
  125 |             end else begin
  126 |                 in_byte_cnt <= in_byte_cnt + 12'd1;
  127 |                 if (is_clk_edge)
  128 |                     in_clk_cnt <= in_clk_cnt + 16'd1;
  129 |             end
  130 |         end
  131 |     endtask
  132 | 
  133 |     initial begin
  134 |         rst_n          = 1'b0;
  135 |         gth_rx_dv      = 1'b0;
  136 |         gth_rx_data    = 32'd0;
  137 |         in_byte_stream = 8'd0;
  138 |         in_byte_cnt    = 12'd0;
  139 |         in_clk_cnt     = 16'd0;
  140 |         in_frame_id    = 32'd0;
  141 |         total_word_idx = 0;
  142 | 
  143 |         #100;
  144 |         rst_n = 1'b1;
  145 | 
  146 |         wait(u_cdc3.wr_rst_busy == 1'b0 && u_cdc3.rd_rst_busy == 1'b0);
  147 |         repeat (10) @(posedge clk_gth);
  148 | 
  149 |         for (total_word_idx = 0; total_word_idx < 3117; total_word_idx = total_word_idx + 1) begin
  150 |             b0_abs = total_word_idx * 4;
  151 |             b1_abs = total_word_idx * 4 + 1;
  152 |             b2_abs = total_word_idx * 4 + 2;
  153 |             b3_abs = total_word_idx * 4 + 3;
  154 | 
  155 |             byte0 = get_frame_byte((b0_abs / 3117) + 1, (b0_abs % 3117) + 1);
  156 |             byte1 = get_frame_byte((b1_abs / 3117) + 1, (b1_abs % 3117) + 1);
  157 |             byte2 = get_frame_byte((b2_abs / 3117) + 1, (b2_abs % 3117) + 1);
  158 |             byte3 = get_frame_byte((b3_abs / 3117) + 1, (b3_abs % 3117) + 1);
  159 | 
  160 |             @(posedge clk_gth);
  161 |             gth_rx_dv   <= 1'b1;
  162 |             gth_rx_data <= {byte0, byte1, byte2, byte3};
  163 | 
  164 |             step_input_byte(byte0, 1'b1);
  165 |             #0.8 step_input_byte(byte1, 1'b0);
  166 |             #0.8 step_input_byte(byte2, 1'b0);
  167 |             #0.8 step_input_byte(byte3, 1'b0);
  168 |         end
  169 | 
  170 |         @(posedge clk_gth);
  171 |         gth_rx_dv      <= 1'b0;
  172 |         gth_rx_data    <= 32'd0;
  173 |         in_byte_stream <= 8'd0;
  174 |         in_byte_cnt    <= 12'd0;
  175 |         in_clk_cnt     <= 16'd0;
  176 |         in_frame_id    <= 32'd0;
  177 |     end
  178 | 
  179 |     // SDA OISL Table 2-4 Metrics Analyzer
  180 |     real last_gth_edge_ns;
  181 |     real measured_gth_period_ns;
  182 |     real measured_byte_time_ns;
  183 | 
  184 |     real time_start;
  185 |     real time_end;
  186 |     real OISL_Frame_Duration_us;
  187 |     real OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps;
  188 |     real OISL_Frame_Rate_kHz;
  189 |     real OISL_FCCH_Mbps;
  190 | 
  191 |     initial begin
  192 |         last_gth_edge_ns              = 0.0;
  193 |         measured_gth_period_ns        = 0.0;
  194 |         measured_byte_time_ns         = 0.0;
  195 |         time_start                    = 0.0;
  196 |         time_end                      = 0.0;
  197 |         OISL_Frame_Duration_us        = 0.0;
  198 |         OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps = 0.0;
  199 |         OISL_Frame_Rate_kHz           = 0.0;
  200 |         OISL_FCCH_Mbps                = 0.0;
  201 |     end
  202 | 
  203 |     always @(posedge clk_gth) begin
  204 |         if (last_gth_edge_ns > 0.0) begin
  205 |             measured_gth_period_ns = $realtime - last_gth_edge_ns;
  206 |             measured_byte_time_ns  = measured_gth_period_ns / 4.0;
  207 |         end
  208 |         last_gth_edge_ns = $realtime;
  209 |     end
  210 | 
  211 |     always @(out_frame_id) begin
  212 |         if (out_frame_id >= 32'd1 && out_frame_id <= 32'd4) begin
  213 |             time_start = $realtime;
  214 |             time_end   = time_start + (3117.0 * measured_byte_time_ns);
  215 | 
  216 |             OISL_Frame_Duration_us        = (time_end - time_start) / 1000.0;
  217 |             OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps = 15264.0 / OISL_Frame_Duration_us;
  218 |             OISL_Frame_Rate_kHz           = 1000.0 / OISL_Frame_Duration_us;
  219 |             OISL_FCCH_Mbps                = 16.0 / OISL_Frame_Duration_us;
  220 | 
  221 |             $display("---------------------------------------------------------------");
  222 |             $display(" [CDC 3 OUTPUT] FRAME %0d ACTIVE (3117 Bytes, Synchronized Start)", out_frame_id);
  223 |             $display(" time_start     : %0.1f ns | time_end : %0.1f ns", time_start, time_end);
  224 |             $display(" Duration       : %0.6f us", OISL_Frame_Duration_us);
  225 |             $display(" Effective Rate : %0.6f Mbps", OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps);
  226 |             $display(" Frame Rate     : %0.6f kHz  | FCCH Rate: %0.6f Mbps", OISL_Frame_Rate_kHz, OISL_FCCH_Mbps);
  227 |             $display("---------------------------------------------------------------");
  228 |         end else if (out_frame_id == 32'd0) begin
  229 |             time_start                    = 0.0;
  230 |             time_end                      = 0.0;
  231 |             OISL_Frame_Duration_us        = 0.0;
  232 |             OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps = 0.0;
  233 |             OISL_Frame_Rate_kHz           = 0.0;
  234 |             OISL_FCCH_Mbps                = 0.0;
  235 |         end
  236 |     end
  237 | 
  238 |     initial begin
  239 |         wait(out_total_bytes == 16'd12468);
  240 |         wait(out_frame_id == 32'd0);
  241 |         #500;
  242 |         $display("\n[%0.1f ns] CDC 3 VERIFICATION COMPLETE: ALL 12,468 BYTES (4 x 3117B, Preamble 72'h77AD5B5843641E2E26) UNPACKED.\n", $realtime);
  243 |         $finish;
  244 |     end
  245 | 
  246 | endmodule

   18 |     1. Updated Frame 2 (DAT2) to Table 2-18 Continuation format (Word 1 =

   20 |        FCS 0xDEADBEEF lands at 32-bit Word 26).

   27 | module tb_cdc4_logic_gth();

   91 |         end
   92 |     end
   93 | 
   94 |     // Table 2-14 LSB-Packed Telemetry Vector (Matches mgmt_telemetry_generator.v)
   95 |     wire [255:0] mgmt_vec = {
   96 |         27'd0, 1'b1, 40'd0, 32'd1476000000,
   97 |         64'h4153_12D0_0000_0000, 40'd0, 6'd15,
   98 |         40'd16678204759, 6'd15
   99 |     };
  100 | 
  101 |     integer f, c;
  102 |     initial begin
  103 |         rst_n      = 1'b0;
  104 |         en_head    = 1'b0;
  105 |         en_load    = 1'b0;
  106 |         header_in  = 8'd0;
  107 |         payload_in = 64'd0;
  108 |         #100;
  109 |         rst_n      = 1'b1;

  112 |         repeat (10) @(posedge clk_logic);

  114 |         for (f = 1; f <= 4; f = f + 1) begin
  115 |             for (c = 1; c <= 239; c = c + 1) begin
  116 |                 @(posedge clk_logic);
  117 |                 if (c <= 16) begin
  118 |                     en_head   <= 1'b1;
  119 |                     case (c)
  120 |                         1:  header_in <= f[7:0];  // d0: TXFN[7:0]
  121 |                         2:  header_in <= 8'h00;   // d1: TXFN[15:8]
  122 |                         3:  header_in <= 8'h00;   // d2: RXFN[7:0]
  123 |                         4:  header_in <= 8'h00;   // d3: RXFN[15:8]
  124 |                         5:  header_in <= (f == 3) ? 8'hF0 : (f == 4) ? 8'hF2 : 8'hFD;
  125 |                         15: header_in <= 8'h0F;   // d14: CRC-16 MSB
  126 |                         16: header_in <= 8'h28;   // d15: CRC-16 LSB
  127 |                         default: header_in <= 8'h55;
  128 |                     endcase
  129 |                 end else begin
  130 |                     en_head   <= 1'b0;
  131 |                     header_in <= 8'd0;
  132 |                 end
  133 | 
  134 |                 en_load <= 1'b1;

  136 |                     if      (c == 1)   payload_in <= 64'hAB00_0000_CDEF_07D0;
  137 |                     else if (c == 7)   payload_in <= 64'h4B6F_6F6B_6D69_6E20; // "Kookmin "
  138 |                     else if (c == 8)   payload_in <= 64'h4653_4F20_AAAA_000E; // "FSO "
  139 |                     else if (c == 239) payload_in <= 64'hAAAA_01DC_C320_0001;
  140 |                     else               payload_in <= {32'hAAAA_0000 + c[31:0], 32'hBBBB_0000 + c[31:0]};
  141 |                 end else if (f == 2) begin
  142 |                     if      (c == 1)   payload_in <= 64'hAB00_4064_AAAA_0001; // Table 2-18 Continuation (Len=100B)
  143 |                     else if (c == 13)  payload_in <= 64'hAAAA_0018_DEAD_BEEF; // 100th Byte Eth FCS at Word 26
  144 |                     else if (c == 239) payload_in <= 64'h0000_0000_C320_0002;
  145 |                     else if (c > 13)   payload_in <= 64'd0;                   // 1804B Zero Padding
  146 |                     else               payload_in <= 64'hAAAA_0000_AAAA_0000;
  147 |                 end else if (f == 3) begin
  148 |                     if      (c == 239) payload_in <= 64'h1D1E_1D1E_C320_0003;
  149 |                     else               payload_in <= 64'h1D1E_1D1E_1D1E_1D1E;
  150 |                 end else begin

  153 |                     else if (c == 3)   payload_in <= {mgmt_vec[159:128],mgmt_vec[191:160]};
  154 |                     else if (c == 4)   payload_in <= {mgmt_vec[223:192],mgmt_vec[255:224]};
  155 |                     else if (c == 239) payload_in <= 64'h0000_0000_C320_0004;
  156 |                     else               payload_in <= 64'd0;
  157 |                 end
  158 |             end
  159 | 
  160 |             @(posedge clk_logic);
  161 |             en_head    <= 1'b0;
  162 |             en_load    <= 1'b0;
  163 |             header_in  <= 8'd0;
  164 |             payload_in <= 64'd0;

  166 |             repeat (260) @(posedge clk_logic);

  180 |         if (hdr_cnt == 64 && pld_cnt == 1912 && cdc4_ETH_FCS == 32'hDEAD_BEEF &&

   38 |     reg          data_in_dv;
   39 |     reg  [15:0]  cdc_keep;
   40 | 
   41 |     wire         flag;
   42 |     wire [31:0]  data_out;
   43 | 
   44 |     // =======================================================
   45 |     // 2. DUT INSTANTIATION
   46 |     // =======================================================
   47 |     x_logic_gth u_cdc2 (
   48 |         .clk_gth    (clk_gth),
   49 |         .clk_logic  (clk_logic),
   50 |         .rst_n      (rst_n),
   51 |         .en         (en),
   52 |         .data_in    (data_in),
   53 |         .data_in_dv (data_in_dv),
   54 |         .cdc_keep   (cdc_keep),
   55 |         .flag       (flag),
   56 |         .data_out   (data_out)
   57 |     );
   58 | 
   59 |     // =======================================================
   60 |     // 3. DUAL CLOCK GENERATION
   61 |     // =======================================================
   62 |     initial begin
   63 |         clk_logic = 1'b0;
   64 |         forever #2.5 clk_logic = ~clk_logic; // 200.0 MHz
   65 |     end
   66 | 
   67 |     initial begin
   68 |         clk_gth = 1'b0;
   69 |         forever #1.6 clk_gth = ~clk_gth;     // 312.5 MHz
   70 |     end
   71 | 
   72 |     // =======================================================
   73 |     // 4. WRITE DOMAIN FSM: MUX EMULATOR (200 MHz)
   74 |     // =======================================================
   75 |     localparam ST_WAIT_RST = 2'd0;
   76 |     localparam ST_STREAM   = 2'd1;
   77 |     localparam ST_GAP      = 2'd2;
   78 |     localparam ST_DONE     = 2'd3;
   79 | 
   80 |     reg [1:0]  tb_state;
   81 |     reg [3:0]  frame_id;
   82 |     reg [15:0] cycle_cnt;
   83 | 
   84 |     initial begin
   85 |         rst_n     = 1'b0;
   86 |         en        = 1'b0;
   87 |         tb_state  = ST_WAIT_RST;
   88 |         frame_id  = 4'd0;
   89 |         cycle_cnt = 16'd0;
   90 |         #100; 
   91 |         rst_n     = 1'b1; 
   92 |         en        = 1'b1;
   93 |     end
   94 | 
   95 |     always @(posedge clk_logic or negedge rst_n) begin
   96 |         if (!rst_n) begin
   97 |             tb_state  <= ST_WAIT_RST;
   98 |             frame_id  <= 4'd0;
   99 |             cycle_cnt <= 16'd0;
  100 |         end else begin
  101 |             case (tb_state)
  102 |                 ST_WAIT_RST: begin
  103 |                     if (!u_cdc2.wr_rst_busy) begin
  104 |                         if (cycle_cnt < 16'd5) begin
  105 |                             cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
  106 |                         end else begin
  107 |                             tb_state  <= ST_STREAM;
  108 |                             frame_id  <= 4'd1;
  109 |                             cycle_cnt <= 16'd1;
  110 |                         end
  111 |                     end
  112 |                 end
  113 |                 ST_STREAM: begin
  114 |                     if (cycle_cnt < 16'd195) begin
  115 |                         cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
  116 |                     end else begin
  117 |                         tb_state  <= ST_GAP;
  118 |                         cycle_cnt <= 16'd1;
  119 |                     end
  120 |                 end
  121 |                 ST_GAP: begin
  122 |                     if (cycle_cnt < 16'd304) begin
  123 |                         cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
  124 |                     end else begin
  125 |                         if (frame_id < 4'd4) begin
  126 |                             frame_id  <= frame_id + 1'b1;
  127 |                             tb_state  <= ST_STREAM;
  128 |                             cycle_cnt <= 16'd1;
  129 |                         end else begin
  130 |                             tb_state  <= ST_DONE;
  131 |                             cycle_cnt <= 16'd0;
  132 |                             en        <= 1'b0;
  133 |                         end
  134 |                     end
  135 |                 end
  136 |                 ST_DONE: begin
  137 |                     en <= 1'b0;
  138 |                 end
  139 |             endcase
  140 |         end
  141 |     end
  142 | 
  143 |     always @(*) begin
  144 |         data_in_dv = 1'b0;
  145 |         data_in    = 128'd0;
  146 |         cdc_keep   = 16'd0;
  147 | 
  148 |         if (rst_n && (tb_state == ST_STREAM)) begin
  149 |             data_in_dv = 1'b1;
  150 |             if (cycle_cnt == 16'd1) begin
  151 |                 // [Rev 2.0] Word 1 carries 72-bit SDA OISL Preamble (72'h77AD5B5843641E2E26) at MSB [127:56]
  152 |                 cdc_keep = 16'hFFFF;
  153 |                 data_in  = {72'h77_AD_5B_58_43_64_1E_2E_26, 24'hAA_BB_CC, {12'd0, frame_id}, cycle_cnt};
  154 |             end else if (cycle_cnt <= 16'd194) begin
  155 |                 cdc_keep = 16'hFFFF;
  156 |                 data_in  = {32'hAAAA_BBBB, 32'hCCCC_DDDD, {28'd0, frame_id}, {16'd0, cycle_cnt}};
  157 |             end else if (cycle_cnt == 16'd195) begin
  158 |                 cdc_keep = 16'h1FFF;
  159 |                 data_in  = {104'h9999_8888_7777_6666_5555_4444_33, 24'h000000};
  160 |             end
  161 |         end
  162 |     end
  163 | 
  164 |     // =======================================================
  165 |     // 5. WAVEFORM TRACKERS FOR DATA IN & DATA OUT
  166 |     // =======================================================
  167 |     // Group 1: Data In from MUX (200 MHz)
  168 |     wire [15:0] in_clk_cnt  = data_in_dv ? cycle_cnt : 16'd0;
  169 |     wire [11:0] in_byte_cnt = data_in_dv ? 
  170 |                               ((cdc_keep == 16'hFFFF) ? (cycle_cnt * 12'd16) : 12'd3117) 
  171 |                               : 12'd0;
  172 | 
  173 |     // Group 2: Data Out from CDC (312.5 MHz & Byte Stream)
  174 |     wire [7:0]  byte_out       = u_cdc2.byte_out;       
  175 |     wire [15:0] out_clk_cnt    = u_cdc2.out_clk_cnt;    
  176 |     wire [11:0] frame_byte_cnt = u_cdc2.frame_byte_cnt; 
  177 |     wire [31:0] frame_out_id   = u_cdc2.frame_out_id;   
  178 | 
  179 |     // =======================================================
  180 |     // 6. FRAME-ALIGNED SDA OISL TABLE 2-4 METRIC ANALYZER
  181 |     // =======================================================
  182 |     real last_gth_edge_ns;
  183 |     real measured_gth_period_ns;
  184 |     real measured_byte_time_ns;
  185 | 
  186 |     real time_start;
  187 |     real time_end;
  188 |     real OISL_Frame_Duration_us;
  189 |     real OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps;
  190 |     real OISL_Frame_Rate_kHz;
  191 |     real OISL_FCCH_Mbps;
  192 | 
  193 |     reg [31:0] prev_frame_id;
  194 | 
  195 |     initial begin
  196 |         last_gth_edge_ns              = 0.0;
  197 |         measured_gth_period_ns        = 0.0;
  198 |         measured_byte_time_ns         = 0.0;
  199 |         prev_frame_id                 = 32'd0;
  200 |         time_start                    = 0.0;
  201 |         time_end                      = 0.0;
  202 |         OISL_Frame_Duration_us        = 0.0;
  203 |         OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps = 0.0;
  204 |         OISL_Frame_Rate_kHz           = 0.0;
  205 |         OISL_FCCH_Mbps                = 0.0;
  206 |     end
  207 | 
  208 |     // Continuously measure the real GTH clock period from simulation events
  209 |     always @(posedge clk_gth) begin
  210 |         if (last_gth_edge_ns > 0.0) begin
  211 |             measured_gth_period_ns = $realtime - last_gth_edge_ns;
  212 |             measured_byte_time_ns  = measured_gth_period_ns / 4.0; // 4 Bytes per 32-bit word
  213 |         end
  214 |         last_gth_edge_ns = $realtime;
  215 |     end
  216 | 
  217 |     // Update metrics synchronously with frame_out_id so values sit directly 
  218 |     // underneath their respective frame (1, 2, 3, 4) in the waveform!
  219 |     always @(frame_out_id) begin
  220 |         if (frame_out_id >= 32'd1 && frame_out_id <= 32'd4) begin
  221 |             // Verify previous frame completion timestamp if transitioning between frames
  222 |             if (prev_frame_id >= 32'd1) begin
  223 |                 $display(" [VERIFIED] Frame %0d completed at exact $realtime = %0.1f ns (Shared Boundary data_out = 0x%08X)",
  224 |                          prev_frame_id, $realtime, data_out);
  225 |             end
  226 | 
  227 |             // Capture live start time of the current active frame
  228 |             time_start = $realtime;
  229 |             // Compute end time of the 3117-byte frame from live-measured byte duration
  230 |             time_end   = time_start + (3117.0 * measured_byte_time_ns);
  231 | 
  232 |             OISL_Frame_Duration_us        = (time_end - time_start) / 1000.0;
  233 |             OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps = 15264.0 / OISL_Frame_Duration_us;
  234 |             OISL_Frame_Rate_kHz           = 1000.0 / OISL_Frame_Duration_us;
  235 |             OISL_FCCH_Mbps                = 16.0 / OISL_Frame_Duration_us;
  236 | 
  237 |             $display("---------------------------------------------------");
  238 |             $display(" FRAME %0d ACTIVE (Metrics Aligned Under Frame %0d)", frame_out_id, frame_out_id);
  239 |             $display(" time_start     : %0.1f ns", time_start);
  240 |             $display(" time_end       : %0.1f ns", time_end);
  241 |             $display(" Duration       : %0.6f us", OISL_Frame_Duration_us);
  242 |             $display(" Effective Rate : %0.6f Mbps", OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps);
  243 |             $display(" Frame Rate     : %0.6f kHz", OISL_Frame_Rate_kHz);
  244 |             $display(" FCCH Rate      : %0.6f Mbps", OISL_FCCH_Mbps);
  245 |             $display("---------------------------------------------------");
  246 |         end
  247 |         else if (frame_out_id == 32'd0) begin
  248 |             if (prev_frame_id == 32'd4) begin
  249 |                 $display(" [VERIFIED] Frame 4 completed at exact $realtime = %0.1f ns", $realtime);
  250 |             end
  251 |             // Reset all metrics cleanly to 0.0 during IDLE (before Frame 1 & after Frame 4)
  252 |             time_start                    = 0.0;
  253 |             time_end                      = 0.0;
  254 |             OISL_Frame_Duration_us        = 0.0;
  255 |             OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps = 0.0;
  256 |             OISL_Frame_Rate_kHz           = 0.0;
  257 |             OISL_FCCH_Mbps                = 0.0;
  258 |         end
  259 |         prev_frame_id = frame_out_id;
  260 |     end
  261 | 
  262 |     // =======================================================
  263 |     // 7. SIMULATION TERMINATION
  264 |     // =======================================================
  265 |     initial begin
  266 |         wait(tb_state == ST_DONE);
  267 |         wait(flag == 1'b0);
  268 |         #500;
  269 |         $display("\n[%0t] ALL 4 FRAMES (4 x 3117B = 12,468B in 3117 GTH Clocks) TRANSMITTED CLEANLY.\n", $time);
  270 |         $finish;
  271 |     end
  272 | 
  273 | endmodule

    2 | //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    3 | // Company: WiComAI Lab
    4 | // Description: Testbench Isolasi Demultiplexer 128-bit & Preamble Checker
    5 | //
    6 | // Revision History:
    7 | //   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 128-bit Demultiplexer & Preamble Checker isolation TB.
    8 | //   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 15:20 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 1 & Target B1.1 Fix]

   13 | //     3. Streamed a complete 195-word (3,117-Byte) frame with 25/64 CDC 3 pacing 
   14 | //        so demux_preamble_128 crosses its 1600-Byte pre-buffer threshold, 
   15 | //        extracts preamble_extracted = 72'h77AD5B5843641E2E26, asserts 
   16 | //        link_locked = 1'b1, and outputs all 259 contiguous 96-bit LPC words (3,108 Bytes).
   17 | //   - Rev 2.3 (2026-10-29 01:49 KST) : [Unified 4-Frame Scenario & Counter Alignment]
   18 | //     1. Preserved all original comments and Rev 1.0/2.0 history logs 100% intact.
   19 | //     2. Upgraded stimulus to stream all 4 sequential FSO frames (DAT1, DAT2, IDLE, 
   20 | //        MGMT = 4 x 3117 Bytes = 12,468 Bytes) with standardized counters: 
   21 | //        demux_frame_id (1..4), frame_type_str, in_clk_cnt, in_byte_cnt (1..3117), 
   22 | //        out_clk_cnt (1..259), and out_byte_cnt (12..3108).
   23 | //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   24 | 
   25 | module tb_demux_decoder();
   26 | 
   27 |     reg clk;
   28 |     reg rst_n;
   29 |     
   30 |     // Stimulus dari CDC
   31 |     reg [127:0] cdc_data_in;
   32 |     reg         cdc_valid_in;
   33 |     
   34 |     // Observasi Output
   35 |     wire [71:0] preamble_extracted;
   36 |     wire        preamble_valid;
   37 |     wire [95:0] lpc_data_out;
   38 |     wire        lpc_valid_out;
   39 |     wire        link_locked;
   40 | 
   41 |     // Standardized Waveform Counters & Frame Labels
   42 |     wire [8:0]  out_clk_cnt      = u_demux.out_lpc_word_cnt; // 1..259 Clocks
   43 |     wire [11:0] out_byte_cnt     = u_demux.out_lpc_byte_cnt; // 12..3108 Bytes
   44 |     wire [31:0] demux_frame_id   = u_demux.demux_frame_id;   // 1..4
   45 |     wire [15:0] locked_frame_cnt = u_checker.locked_frame_cnt;
   46 |     reg  [31:0] frame_type_str;
   47 |     reg  [15:0] in_clk_cnt;
   48 |     reg  [11:0] in_byte_cnt;
   49 | 
   50 |     always @(*) begin
   51 |         case (demux_frame_id)
   52 |             32'd1:   frame_type_str = "DAT1";
   53 |             32'd2:   frame_type_str = "DAT2";
   54 |             32'd3:   frame_type_str = "IDLE";
   55 |             32'd4:   frame_type_str = "MGMT";
   56 |             default: frame_type_str = "WAIT";
   57 |         endcase
   58 |     end
   59 | 
   60 |     // 1. Initiation Demux
   61 |     demux_preamble_128 u_demux (
   62 |         .clk(clk),
   63 |         .rst_n(rst_n),
   64 |         .cdc_data_in(cdc_data_in),
   65 |         .cdc_valid_in(cdc_valid_in),
   66 |         .preamble_extracted(preamble_extracted),
   67 |         .preamble_valid(preamble_valid),
   68 |         .lpc_data_out(lpc_data_out),
   69 |         .lpc_valid_out(lpc_valid_out)
   70 |     );
   71 | 
   72 |     // 2. Initiation Preamble Checker ([Rev 2.0] Fixed module name to preamble_sda_decoder)
   73 |     preamble_sda_decoder u_checker (
   74 |         .clk(clk),
   75 |         .rst_n(rst_n),
   76 |         .preamble_in(preamble_extracted),
   77 |         .preamble_valid_in(preamble_valid),
   78 |         .link_locked_out(link_locked)
   79 |     );
   80 | 
   81 |     // Clock 200 MHz
   82 |     always #2.5 clk = ~clk;
   83 | 
   84 |     function [7:0] get_frame_byte(input [31:0] f_idx, input [11:0] b_idx);
   85 |         begin
   86 |             case (b_idx)
   87 |                 12'd1:   get_frame_byte = 8'h77;
   88 |                 12'd2:   get_frame_byte = 8'hAD;
   89 |                 12'd3:   get_frame_byte = 8'h5B;
   90 |                 12'd4:   get_frame_byte = 8'h58;
   91 |                 12'd5:   get_frame_byte = 8'h43;
   92 |                 12'd6:   get_frame_byte = 8'h64;
   93 |                 12'd7:   get_frame_byte = 8'h1E;
   94 |                 12'd8:   get_frame_byte = 8'h2E;
   95 |                 12'd9:   get_frame_byte = 8'h26;
   96 |                 12'd10:  get_frame_byte = 8'hAB;
   97 |                 12'd13:  get_frame_byte = f_idx[7:0];
   98 |                 12'd3117:get_frame_byte = 8'h33;
   99 |                 default: begin
  100 |                     if      (f_idx <= 32'd2) get_frame_byte = 8'hDA;
  101 |                     else if (f_idx == 32'd3) get_frame_byte = 8'h1D;
  102 |                     else                     get_frame_byte = 8'hA1;
  103 |                 end
  104 |             endcase
  105 |         end
  106 |     endfunction
  107 | 
  108 |     integer i, k, abs_b;
  109 |     reg [127:0] word128_tmp;
  110 |     integer lpc_out_cnt = 0;
  111 | 
  112 |     always @(posedge clk) begin
  113 |         if (preamble_valid) begin
  114 |             $display(" [%0t] Preamble Extracted = 0x%018X (Expected: 0x77AD5B5843641E2E26)",
  115 |                      $time, preamble_extracted);
  116 |         end
  117 |         if (lpc_valid_out) begin
  118 |             lpc_out_cnt <= lpc_out_cnt + 1;
  119 |         end
  120 |     end
  121 | 
  122 |     initial begin
  123 |         // Initiation
  124 |         clk          = 0;
  125 |         rst_n        = 0;
  126 |         cdc_data_in  = 0;
  127 |         cdc_valid_in = 0;
  128 |         in_clk_cnt   = 0;
  129 |         in_byte_cnt  = 0;
  130 | 
  131 |         #20;
  132 |         rst_n = 1;
  133 |         #20;
  134 | 
  135 |         // ------ SCENARIO 1 & 2: FLOW FLOW 4 FRAMES (DAT1, DAT2, IDLE, MGMT = 780 Word 128-bit / 12,468 Byte) ---
  136 |         // The first word contains {72'h77_AD_5B_58_84_64_1_1_2E_2E_26, 56-bit LPC Initial data} in MSB [127:56]
  137 |         for (i = 0; i < 780; i = i + 1) begin
  138 |             for (k = 0; k < 16; k = k + 1) begin
  139 |                 abs_b = i * 16 + k;
  140 |                 if (abs_b < 12468)
  141 |                     word128_tmp[127 - (k * 8) -: 8] = get_frame_byte((abs_b / 3117) + 1, (abs_b % 3117) + 1);
  142 |                 else
  143 |                     word128_tmp[127 - (k * 8) -: 8] = 8'd0;
  144 |             end
  145 |             @(posedge clk);
  146 |             cdc_valid_in <= 1'b1;
  147 |             cdc_data_in  <= word128_tmp;
  148 |             in_clk_cnt   <= (i % 195) + 1;
  149 |             in_byte_cnt  <= ((i * 16) % 3117) + 16;
  150 |         end
  151 | 
  152 |         // Finish transmission
  153 |         @(posedge clk);
  154 |         cdc_valid_in <= 1'b0;
  155 |         cdc_data_in  <= 128'd0;
  156 |         in_clk_cnt   <= 16'd0;
  157 |         in_byte_cnt  <= 12'd0;
  158 | 
  159 |        // Wait for all 1036 words LPC (4 x 259 words = 12,432 Bytes) finished issued continuously
  160 |         wait(lpc_out_cnt == 1036);
  161 |         #200;
  162 |         $display("\n=======================================================");
  163 |         $display(" DEMUX 128 & PREAMBLE DECODER 4-FRAME VERIFICATION REPORT");
  164 |         $display(" -> Extracted Preamble : 0x%018X", preamble_extracted);
  165 |         $display(" -> Link Locked Status : %0b (Locked Frames: %0d / 4)", link_locked, locked_frame_cnt);
  166 |         $display(" -> Contiguous LPC Out : %0d Words (%0d Bytes, Expected: 1036 Words / 12432B)",
  167 |                  lpc_out_cnt, lpc_out_cnt * 12);
  168 |         if ((preamble_extracted == 72'h77_AD_5B_58_43_64_1E_2E_26) &&
  169 |             (link_locked == 1'b1) && (lpc_out_cnt == 1036))
  170 |             $display(" -> RESULT: [PASS] 100%% COMPLIANT WITH SDA OISL TABLE 2-8!");
  171 |         $display("=======================================================\n");
  172 |         $finish;
  173 |     end
  174 | 
  175 | endmodule

    1 | `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 | Module Name  : tb_demux_preamble_128
    7 | Description  : Verification Testbench for 128-bit Receiver Preamble Demux 
    8 |                (demux_preamble_128.v) and Optical Sync Lock Verifier 
    9 |                (preamble_sda_decoder.v), driven directly by CDC 3 
   10 |                (rx_gth_logic.v).
   11 | 
   12 |                KEY OBJECTIVES:
   13 |                1. Feeds 4 continuous 3117-Byte FSO frames (12,468 Bytes in 
   14 |                   3117 clocks @ 312.5 MHz) into CDC 3 (rx_gth_logic).
   15 |                2. Verifies that demux_preamble_128 extracts the exact 72-bit 
   16 |                   (9-Byte) Preamble at the start of each frame and emits 
   17 |                   259 contiguous 96-bit LPC words (3108 Bytes) per frame.
   18 |                3. Verifies that preamble_sda_decoder asserts link_locked_out = 1 
   19 |                   and increments locked_frame_cnt from 1 to 4.
   20 | 
   21 | Revision History:
   22 |   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 4-frame CDC 3 -> demux_preamble_128 -> preamble_sda_decoder TB.
   23 |   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 15:55 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 1 & Target B1.1 Verification]
   24 |     Updated 'get_frame_byte' (Bytes 1..9 of every 3117-Byte frame) from the 
   25 |     legacy marker (72'h55_55_55_55_55_55_55_55_D5) to the official SDA OISL 
   26 |     v2.1.2 Table 2-8 72-bit Preamble (72'h77_AD_5B_58_43_64_1E_2E_26, MSB 8'h77 
   27 |     transmitted first down to LSB 8'h26) and added automatic self-checking 
   28 |     assertions for all 4 frames.
   29 | ===========================================================================
   30 | */
   31 | 
   32 | module tb_demux_preamble_128();
   33 | 
   34 |     reg clk_gth;   // 312.5 MHz Write Clock to CDC 3 (3.2 ns)
   35 |     reg clk_logic; // 200.0 MHz Read & Demux Clock (5.0 ns)
   36 |     reg rst_n;

   48 |     wire         preamble_valid;
   49 |     wire [95:0]  lpc_data_out;

   54 |     wire [15:0]  locked_frame_cnt = u_preamble_dec.locked_frame_cnt;
   55 |     wire [8:0]   out_lpc_word_cnt = u_demux_128.out_lpc_word_cnt;
   56 |     wire [11:0]  out_lpc_byte_cnt = u_demux_128.out_lpc_byte_cnt;

   64 |         .clk_gth   (clk_gth),
   65 |         .clk_logic (clk_logic),

   70 |         .data_out  (cdc3_data_out)
   71 |     );
   72 |

  103 |     end
  104 | 
  105 |     // [Rev 2.0] Official SDA OISL Table 2-8 72-bit Preamble (72'h77AD5B5843641E2E26)
  106 |     function [7:0] get_frame_byte(input [31:0] f_idx, input [11:0] b_idx);
  107 |         begin
  108 |             case (b_idx)
  109 |                 12'd1:               get_frame_byte = 8'h77;
  110 |                 12'd2:               get_frame_byte = 8'hAD;
  111 |                 12'd3:               get_frame_byte = 8'h5B;
  112 |                 12'd4:               get_frame_byte = 8'h58;
  113 |                 12'd5:               get_frame_byte = 8'h43;
  114 |                 12'd6:               get_frame_byte = 8'h64;
  115 |                 12'd7:               get_frame_byte = 8'h1E;
  116 |                 12'd8:               get_frame_byte = 8'h2E;
  117 |                 12'd9:               get_frame_byte = 8'h26;
  118 |                 12'd10:              get_frame_byte = 8'hAA;
  119 |                 12'd11:              get_frame_byte = 8'hBB;
  120 |                 12'd12:              get_frame_byte = 8'hCC;
  121 |                 12'd13:              get_frame_byte = f_idx[7:0];
  122 |                 12'd3105, 12'd3106:  get_frame_byte = 8'h99;
  123 |                 12'd3107, 12'd3108:  get_frame_byte = 8'h88;
  124 |                 12'd3109, 12'd3110:  get_frame_byte = 8'h77;
  125 |                 12'd3111, 12'd3112:  get_frame_byte = 8'h66;
  126 |                 12'd3113, 12'd3114:  get_frame_byte = 8'h55;
  127 |                 12'd3115, 12'd3116:  get_frame_byte = 8'h44;
  128 |                 12'd3117:            get_frame_byte = 8'h33;
  129 |                 default:             get_frame_byte = b_idx[7:0];
  130 |             endcase
  131 |         end
  132 |     endfunction
  133 | 
  134 |     integer total_word_idx;
  135 |     integer b0_abs, b1_abs, b2_abs, b3_abs;
  136 |     integer total_lpc_words_captured = 0;
  137 |     integer preamble_match_cnt       = 0;
  138 | 
  139 |     always @(posedge clk_logic) begin
  140 |         if (preamble_valid) begin
  141 |             $display(" [%0.1f ns] Frame %0d Preamble Extracted = 0x%018X (Expected: 0x77AD5B5843641E2E26)",
  142 |                      $realtime, preamble_match_cnt + 1, preamble_extracted);
  143 |             if (preamble_extracted == 72'h77_AD_5B_58_43_64_1E_2E_26)
  144 |                 preamble_match_cnt <= preamble_match_cnt + 1;
  145 |         end
  146 |         if (lpc_valid_out) begin
  147 |             total_lpc_words_captured <= total_lpc_words_captured + 1;
  148 |         end
  149 |     end
  150 | 
  151 |     initial begin
  152 |         rst_n          = 1'b0;
  153 |         gth_rx_dv      = 1'b0;
  154 |         gth_rx_data    = 32'd0;
  155 |         total_word_idx = 0;
  156 | 
  157 |         #100;
  158 |         rst_n = 1'b1;
  159 | 
  160 |         wait(u_cdc3.wr_rst_busy == 1'b0 && u_cdc3.rd_rst_busy == 1'b0);
  161 |         repeat (10) @(posedge clk_gth);
  162 | 
  163 |         // Stream 4 continuous 3117-Byte frames (12,468 Bytes = 3117 words x 32-bit)
  164 |         for (total_word_idx = 0; total_word_idx < 3117; total_word_idx = total_word_idx + 1) begin
  165 |             b0_abs = total_word_idx * 4;
  166 |             b1_abs = total_word_idx * 4 + 1;
  167 |             b2_abs = total_word_idx * 4 + 2;
  168 |             b3_abs = total_word_idx * 4 + 3;
  169 | 
  170 |             @(posedge clk_gth);
  171 |             gth_rx_dv   <= 1'b1;
  172 |             gth_rx_data <= {
  173 |                 get_frame_byte((b0_abs / 3117) + 1, (b0_abs % 3117) + 1),
  174 |                 get_frame_byte((b1_abs / 3117) + 1, (b1_abs % 3117) + 1),
  175 |                 get_frame_byte((b2_abs / 3117) + 1, (b2_abs % 3117) + 1),
  176 |                 get_frame_byte((b3_abs / 3117) + 1, (b3_abs % 3117) + 1)
  177 |             };
  178 |         end
  179 | 
  180 |         @(posedge clk_gth);
  181 |         gth_rx_dv   <= 1'b0;
  182 |         gth_rx_data <= 32'd0;
  183 | 
  184 |         wait(total_lpc_words_captured == 1036);
  185 |         wait(demux_frame_id == 32'd0);
  186 |         #200;
  187 | 
  188 |         $display("\n======================================================================");
  189 |         $display(" DEMUX PREAMBLE 128 & SDA OISL TABLE 2-8 LOCK REPORT");
  190 |         $display(" -> Official Preamble (72'h77AD5B5843641E2E26) Matches : %0d / 4", preamble_match_cnt);
  191 |         $display(" -> Optical Link Locked Status (link_locked_out)       : %0b", link_locked_out);
  192 |         $display(" -> Total Locked Frames (locked_frame_cnt)             : %0d / 4", locked_frame_cnt);
  193 |         $display(" -> Total 96-bit LPC Words Emitted (4 x 259)           : %0d / 1036 (%0d Bytes)",
  194 |                  total_lpc_words_captured, total_lpc_words_captured * 12);
  195 |         if (preamble_match_cnt == 4 && link_locked_out == 1'b1 && total_lpc_words_captured == 1036)
  196 |             $display(" -> RESULT: [PASS] 100%% COMPLIANT WITH ETRI AUDIT ITEM 1!");
  197 |         $display("======================================================================\n");
  198 |         $finish;
  199 |     end
  200 | 
  201 | endmodule

    2 | //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    3 | // Deskripsi: Testbench Isolasi untuk Demultiplexer Preamble (Sliding Window)
    4 | //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    5 | 
    6 | module tb_demux_preamble_hotswap();
    7 | 
    8 |     // Sinyal Input
    9 |     reg          clk;
   10 |     reg          rst_n;
   11 |     reg  [127:0] cdc_data_in;
   12 |     reg          cdc_valid_in;
   13 | 
   14 |     // Sinyal Output
   15 |     wire [71:0]  preamble_extracted;

   18 |     wire         lpc_valid_out;
   19 | 
   20 |     // Instansiasi Device Under Test (DUT)
   21 |     demux_preamble_hotswap uut (
   22 |         .clk(clk),
   23 |         .rst_n(rst_n),
   24 |         .cdc_data_in(cdc_data_in),
   25 |         .cdc_valid_in(cdc_valid_in),
   26 |         .preamble_extracted(preamble_extracted),
   27 |         .preamble_valid(preamble_valid),
   28 |         .lpc_data_out(lpc_data_out),
   29 |         .lpc_valid_out(lpc_valid_out)
   30 |     );
   31 | 
   32 |     // Generator Clock (Misal: 200 MHz sesuai clock CDC Decoder)
   33 |     always #2.5 clk = ~clk;
   34 | 
   35 |     // Parameter Data Uji
   36 |     // Ingat: Little Endian di bus. D5 ada di MSB.
   37 |     localparam [71:0] PREAMBLE_DATA = 72'hD55555555555555555;
   38 |     localparam [95:0] DUMMY_LPC_DATA = 96'hAABBCCDDEEFF_112233445566;

   40 |     initial begin
   41 |         // 1. Inisialisasi
   42 |         clk = 0;
   43 |         rst_n = 0;
   44 |         cdc_data_in = 128'd0;
   45 |         cdc_valid_in = 0;
   46 | 
   47 |         #20;
   48 |         rst_n = 1;
   49 |         #20;
   50 | 
   51 |         // --- SKENARIO 1: GTH MEMUNTAHKAN SAMPAH IDLE (Tidak Boleh Mengunci) ---
   52 |         $display("Skenario 1: Mengirim Data Sampah/Idle GTH...");
   53 |         @(posedge clk);
   54 |         cdc_valid_in <= 1'b1;
   55 |         cdc_data_in  <= 128'h00000000_00000000_00000000_00000000;
   56 |         
   57 |         @(posedge clk);
   58 |         cdc_data_in  <= 128'h00000000_00000000_02000000_00800000; // Sampah penyelarasan
   59 |         
   60 |         @(posedge clk);
   61 |         cdc_data_in  <= 128'h00000000_00000000_00000000_00000000;
   62 | 
   63 |         // --- SKENARIO 2: KEDATANGAN FSO FRAME ASLI ---
   64 |         $display("Skenario 2: Menyuntikkan Preamble dan LPC Payload...");
   65 |         @(posedge clk);
   66 |         // Kita masukan Preamble 72-bit (9 Byte) di bagian bawah (LSB),
   67 |         // dan sebagian LPC data di 56-bit (7 Byte) sisanya (128 - 72 = 56).
   68 |         cdc_data_in  <= {DUMMY_LPC_DATA[55:0], PREAMBLE_DATA}; 
   69 |         
   70 |         @(posedge clk);
   71 |         // Sisa LPC Data (40-bit / 5 Byte) diletakkan di LSB siklus berikutnya,
   72 |         // sisanya diisi nol.
   73 |         cdc_data_in  <= {88'd0, DUMMY_LPC_DATA[95:56]};
   74 |         
   75 |         @(posedge clk);
   76 |         cdc_valid_in <= 1'b0; // Akhiri transmisi
   77 | 
   78 |         #100;
   79 |         $display("Simulasi Selesai.");

    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 | Description  : Post-CDC 2 Standalone Testbench for Error Injector (312.5 MHz).
    7 | 
    8 |                ARCHITECTURE & WAVEFORM GROUPS:
    9 |                - Group 1: Data In from CDC 2 (312.5 MHz, 32-bit Continuous)
   10 |                  Feeds the exact continuous 3117-Byte/frame stream exiting 
   11 |                  CDC 2 (x_logic_gth) into error_inject.v. Includes 1-by-1 
   12 |                  input byte counter (in_byte_cnt: 1..3117) and input clock 
   13 |                  counter (in_clk_cnt: 1..780).
   14 |                - Group 2: Data Out from Error Inject to GTH TX (312.5 MHz, 32-bit)
   15 |                  Displays the corrupted output stream heading to gth64b66b_tx.v,
   16 |                  proving that the 9B Preamble (55..55D5) and 48B LPC Header 
   17 |                  remain uncorrupted while 48 payload words are XORed with 
   18 |                  'error.mem', maintaining exact SDA OISL Table 2-4 metrics.
   19 | 
   20 | Revision History:
   21 |   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Post-CDC 2 3-Zone Error Injector testbench.
   22 |   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 15:20 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 1 & Port Elaboration Fix]
   23 |     1. Removed non-existent '.stall_in(1'b0)' port connection on u_error_inject 
   24 |        so the instantiation matches error_inject.v 100% without [VRFC 10-3180].
   25 |     2. Updated Bytes 1..9 of every frame (cycle_cnt == 1) from the simulation 
   26 |        marker (55..55D5) to the official SDA OISL Table 2-8 72-bit Preamble 
   27 |        (72'h77_AD_5B_58_43_64_1E_2E_26) and verified that Zone 1 (first 60B) 
   28 |        passes the Preamble and LPC Header through completely uncorrupted.
   29 | ===========================================================================

   31 | 
   32 | module tb_error_inject();
   33 | 
   34 |     // =======================================================
   35 |     // 1. MASTER SWITCH & CLOCK/RESET SIGNALS (312.5 MHz)
   36 |     // =======================================================
   37 |     // SIM_MODE = 1: Digital 'error.mem' XOR active (Vivado Simulation)
   38 |     // SIM_MODE = 0: Digital bypass for Physical Manual VOA (/t49G/51 LC/PC)
   39 |     parameter SIM_MODE = 1;
   40 | 
   41 |     reg clk_logic; // 200.0 MHz ( Drives upstream CDC 2 write side )
   42 |     reg clk_gth;   // 312.5 MHz ( Primary clock for CDC 2 Out -> Error Inject -> GTH )
   43 |     reg rst_n;
   44 |     reg en_upstream;
   45 | 
   46 |     // Internal Upstream Stimulus to CDC 2 (Hidden background driver)
   47 |     reg  [127:0] mux_data_in;
   48 |     reg          mux_data_dv;
   49 |     reg  [15:0]  mux_cdc_keep;
   50 | 
   51 |     // =======================================================
   52 |     // 2. GROUP 1 SIGNALS: DATA IN FROM CDC 2 (312.5 MHz, 32-bit)
   53 |     // =======================================================
   54 |     wire         cdc2_flag_in;     // Continuous Valid from CDC 2 (312.5 MHz)
   55 |     wire [31:0]  cdc2_data_in;     // Continuous 32-bit Data from CDC 2 (312.5 MHz)
   56 |     wire [7:0]   in_byte_stream   = u_cdc2.byte_out;       // 1-by-1 Byte entering Error Inject
   57 |     wire [15:0]  in_clk_cnt       = u_cdc2.out_clk_cnt;    // 1..780 Clock Counter from CDC 2
   58 |     wire [11:0]  in_byte_cnt      = u_cdc2.frame_byte_cnt; // 1..3117 Byte Counter from CDC 2
   59 |     wire [31:0]  in_frame_id      = u_cdc2.frame_out_id;   // Active Frame ID (1, 2, 3, 4)
   60 | 
   61 |     // =======================================================
   62 |     // 3. GROUP 2 SIGNALS: DATA OUT FROM ERROR INJECT TO GTH (312.5 MHz)
   63 |     // =======================================================
   64 |     wire         gth_tx_valid_out; // Continuous Valid to gth64b66b_tx
   65 |     wire [31:0]  gth_tx_data_out;  // 32-bit Data to gth64b66b_tx
   66 |     wire [31:0]  err_mask_applied   = u_error_inject.applied_mask;
   67 |     wire [15:0]  corrupted_word_cnt = u_error_inject.corrupted_word_cnt;
   68 |     wire [7:0]   out_byte_stream    = u_error_inject.byte_out;       // 1-by-1 Byte exiting Error Inject
   69 |     wire [15:0]  out_clk_cnt        = u_error_inject.out_clk_cnt;    // 1..780 Clock Counter to GTH
   70 |     wire [11:0]  frame_byte_cnt     = u_error_inject.frame_byte_cnt; // 1..3117 Byte Counter to GTH
   71 |     wire [31:0]  frame_out_id       = u_error_inject.frame_out_id;   // Active Frame ID (1, 2, 3, 4)
   72 | 
   73 |     // =======================================================
   74 |     // 4. DUT INSTANTIATIONS (CDC 2 -> ERROR INJECTOR)
   75 |     // =======================================================
   76 |     x_logic_gth u_cdc2 (
   77 |         .clk_gth    (clk_gth),
   78 |         .clk_logic  (clk_logic),
   79 |         .rst_n      (rst_n),
   80 |         .en         (en_upstream),
   81 |         .data_in    (mux_data_in),
   82 |         .data_in_dv (mux_data_dv),
   83 |         .cdc_keep   (mux_cdc_keep),
   84 |         .flag       (cdc2_flag_in),
   85 |         .data_out   (cdc2_data_in)
   86 |     );
   87 | 
   88 |     error_inject #(
   89 |         .SIM_MODE   (SIM_MODE),
   90 |         .safe_words (15), // Protects first 60B (9B Preamble + 48B Header LPC + 3B)
   91 |         .max_error  (47)  // 48 words from error.mem
   92 |     ) u_error_inject (
   93 |         .clk        (clk_gth),
   94 |         .rst_n      (rst_n),
   95 |         .en         (cdc2_flag_in),
   96 |         .data_in    (cdc2_data_in),
   97 |         .flag       (gth_tx_valid_out),
   98 |         .data_out   (gth_tx_data_out)
   99 |     );
  100 | 
  101 |     // =======================================================
  102 |     // 5. CLOCK GENERATION
  103 |     // =======================================================
  104 |     initial begin
  105 |         clk_logic = 1'b0;
  106 |         forever #2.5 clk_logic = ~clk_logic; // 200.0 MHz
  107 |     end
  108 | 
  109 |     initial begin
  110 |         clk_gth = 1'b0;
  111 |         forever #1.6 clk_gth = ~clk_gth;     // 312.5 MHz (3.2 ns period)
  112 |     end
  113 | 
  114 |     // =======================================================
  115 |     // 6. UPSTREAM FEEDER (Generates 4 Continuous 3117B Frames)
  116 |     // =======================================================
  117 |     localparam ST_WAIT_RST = 2'd0;
  118 |     localparam ST_STREAM   = 2'd1;
  119 |     localparam ST_GAP      = 2'd2;
  120 |     localparam ST_DONE     = 2'd3;
  121 | 
  122 |     reg [1:0]  tb_state;
  123 |     reg [3:0]  frame_id;
  124 |     reg [15:0] cycle_cnt;
  125 | 
  126 |     initial begin
  127 |         rst_n       = 1'b0;
  128 |         en_upstream = 1'b0;
  129 |         tb_state    = ST_WAIT_RST;
  130 |         frame_id    = 4'd0;
  131 |         cycle_cnt   = 16'd0;
  132 |         #100; 
  133 |         rst_n       = 1'b1; 
  134 |         en_upstream = 1'b1;
  135 |     end
  136 | 
  137 |     always @(posedge clk_logic or negedge rst_n) begin
  138 |         if (!rst_n) begin
  139 |             tb_state  <= ST_WAIT_RST;
  140 |             frame_id  <= 4'd0;
  141 |             cycle_cnt <= 16'd0;
  142 |         end else begin
  143 |             case (tb_state)
  144 |                 ST_WAIT_RST: begin
  145 |                     if (!u_cdc2.wr_rst_busy) begin
  146 |                         if (cycle_cnt < 16'd5) cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
  147 |                         else begin
  148 |                             tb_state  <= ST_STREAM;
  149 |                             frame_id  <= 4'd1;
  150 |                             cycle_cnt <= 16'd1;
  151 |                         end
  152 |                     end
  153 |                 end
  154 |                 ST_STREAM: begin
  155 |                     if (cycle_cnt < 16'd195) cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
  156 |                     else begin
  157 |                         tb_state  <= ST_GAP;
  158 |                         cycle_cnt <= 16'd1;
  159 |                     end
  160 |                 end
  161 |                 ST_GAP: begin
  162 |                     if (cycle_cnt < 16'd304) cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
  163 |                     else begin
  164 |                         if (frame_id < 4'd4) begin
  165 |                             frame_id  <= frame_id + 1'b1;
  166 |                             tb_state  <= ST_STREAM;
  167 |                             cycle_cnt <= 16'd1;
  168 |                         end else begin
  169 |                             tb_state    <= ST_DONE;
  170 |                             cycle_cnt   <= 16'd0;
  171 |                             en_upstream <= 1'b0;
  172 |                         end
  173 |                     end
  174 |                 end
  175 |                 ST_DONE: en_upstream <= 1'b0;
  176 |             endcase
  177 |         end
  178 |     end
  179 | 
  180 |     always @(*) begin
  181 |         mux_data_dv  = 1'b0;
  182 |         mux_data_in  = 128'd0;
  183 |         mux_cdc_keep = 16'd0;
  184 | 
  185 |         if (rst_n && (tb_state == ST_STREAM)) begin
  186 |             mux_data_dv = 1'b1;
  187 |             if (cycle_cnt == 16'd1) begin
  188 |                 // [Rev 2.0] Bytes 1..9: Official SDA OISL Table 2-8 72-bit Preamble (72'h77AD5B5843641E2E26)
  189 |                 // Bytes 10..16: First 7 Bytes of LPC Header
  190 |                 mux_cdc_keep = 16'hFFFF;
  191 |                 mux_data_in  = {72'h77_AD_5B_58_43_64_1E_2E_26, 24'hAA_BB_CC, {12'd0, frame_id}, 16'd1};
  192 |             end else if (cycle_cnt <= 16'd194) begin
  193 |                 mux_cdc_keep = 16'hFFFF;
  194 |                 mux_data_in  = {32'hAAAA_BBBB, 32'hCCCC_DDDD, {28'd0, frame_id}, {16'd0, cycle_cnt}};
  195 |             end else if (cycle_cnt == 16'd195) begin
  196 |                 // Final 13 Bytes of the 3117-Byte Frame (ending in 0x33)
  197 |                 mux_cdc_keep = 16'h1FFF;
  198 |                 mux_data_in  = {104'h9999_8888_7777_6666_5555_4444_33, 24'h000000};
  199 |             end
  200 |         end
  201 |     end
  202 | 
  203 |     // =======================================================
  204 |     // 7. FRAME-ALIGNED SDA OISL TABLE 2-4 METRIC ANALYZER
  205 |     // =======================================================
  206 |     real last_gth_edge_ns;
  207 |     real measured_gth_period_ns;
  208 |     real measured_byte_time_ns;
  209 | 
  210 |     real time_start;
  211 |     real time_end;
  212 |     real OISL_Frame_Duration_us;
  213 |     real OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps;
  214 |     real OISL_Frame_Rate_kHz;
  215 |     real OISL_FCCH_Mbps;
  216 | 
  217 |     reg [31:0] prev_frame_id;
  218 | 
  219 |     initial begin
  220 |         last_gth_edge_ns              = 0.0;
  221 |         measured_gth_period_ns        = 0.0;
  222 |         measured_byte_time_ns         = 0.0;
  223 |         prev_frame_id                 = 32'd0;
  224 |         time_start                    = 0.0;
  225 |         time_end                      = 0.0;
  226 |         OISL_Frame_Duration_us        = 0.0;
  227 |         OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps = 0.0;
  228 |         OISL_Frame_Rate_kHz           = 0.0;
  229 |         OISL_FCCH_Mbps                = 0.0;
  230 |     end
  231 | 
  232 |     always @(posedge clk_gth) begin
  233 |         if (last_gth_edge_ns > 0.0) begin
  234 |             measured_gth_period_ns = $realtime - last_gth_edge_ns;
  235 |             measured_byte_time_ns  = measured_gth_period_ns / 4.0;
  236 |         end
  237 |         last_gth_edge_ns = $realtime;
  238 |     end
  239 | 
  240 |     always @(frame_out_id) begin
  241 |         if (frame_out_id >= 32'd1 && frame_out_id <= 32'd4) begin
  242 |             time_start = $realtime;
  243 |             time_end   = time_start + (3117.0 * measured_byte_time_ns);
  244 | 
  245 |             OISL_Frame_Duration_us        = (time_end - time_start) / 1000.0;
  246 |             OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps = 15264.0 / OISL_Frame_Duration_us;
  247 |             OISL_Frame_Rate_kHz           = 1000.0 / OISL_Frame_Duration_us;
  248 |             OISL_FCCH_Mbps                = 16.0 / OISL_Frame_Duration_us;
  249 | 
  250 |             $display("---------------------------------------------------------------");
  251 |             $display(" [ERROR INJECT -> GTH] FRAME %0d ACTIVE (SIM_MODE = %0d)", frame_out_id, SIM_MODE);
  252 |             $display(" time_start     : %0.1f ns | time_end : %0.1f ns", time_start, time_end);
  253 |             $display(" Duration       : %0.6f us (3117 Bytes Continuous)", OISL_Frame_Duration_us);
  254 |             $display(" Effective Rate : %0.6f Mbps", OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps);
  255 |             $display(" Frame Rate     : %0.6f kHz  | FCCH Rate: %0.6f Mbps", OISL_Frame_Rate_kHz, OISL_FCCH_Mbps);
  256 |             $display("---------------------------------------------------------------");
  257 |         end
  258 |         else if (frame_out_id == 32'd0) begin
  259 |             time_start                    = 0.0;
  260 |             time_end                      = 0.0;
  261 |             OISL_Frame_Duration_us        = 0.0;
  262 |             OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps = 0.0;
  263 |             OISL_Frame_Rate_kHz           = 0.0;
  264 |             OISL_FCCH_Mbps                = 0.0;
  265 |         end
  266 |         prev_frame_id = frame_out_id;
  267 |     end
  268 | 
  269 |     // =======================================================
  270 |     // 8. SIMULATION TERMINATION
  271 |     // =======================================================
  272 |     initial begin
  273 |         wait(tb_state == ST_DONE);
  274 |         wait(gth_tx_valid_out == 1'b0);
  275 |         #500;
  276 |         $display("\n[%0t] POST-CDC 2 ERROR INJECTOR VERIFICATION COMPLETE (Preamble 72'h77AD5B5843641E2E26 Protected).\n", $time);
  277 |         $finish;
  278 |     end
  279 | 
  280 | endmodule

   16 |        Segment 1 & 3 report exactly 1900 valid Ethernet bytes while Segment 2 & 4 
   17 |        hold 100 valid Ethernet bytes across the 450-cycle S_PAD zero-padding phase.
   18 |     2. Added automatic segment counter & FCS (0xDEADBEEF at cycle 25 of Segment 2 
   19 |        and Segment 4) verification across all 4 emitted 475-word segments.
   20 | ===========================================================================
   21 | */
   22 | 
   23 | module tb_eth_rx_front_end_top();
   24 | 
   25 |     reg clk;
   26 |     reg rst_n;
   27 |     reg trigger;
   28 |     reg [15:0] target_frame_size;
   29 | 
   30 |     // AXI-Stream from Virtual PC
   31 |     wire [31:0] gen_tdata;
   32 |     wire [3:0]  gen_tkeep;
   33 |     wire        gen_tvalid, gen_tlast, gen_tready;
   34 | 
   35 |     // Physical XGMII Link
   36 |     wire [31:0] xgmii_txd;
   37 |     wire [3:0]  xgmii_txc;
   38 | 
   39 |     // FSO Output
   40 |     wire [31:0] fso_data_out;
   41 |     wire        fso_valid, fso_last;
   42 |     reg         fso_ready;
   43 | 
   44 |     // Instantiations
   45 |     eth_axis_packet_gen u_packet_gen (
   46 |         .clk(clk), .rst_n(rst_n), .trigger(trigger), .frame_size_bytes(target_frame_size),
   47 |         .m_axis_tdata(gen_tdata), .m_axis_tkeep(gen_tkeep),
   48 |         .m_axis_tvalid(gen_tvalid), .m_axis_tlast(gen_tlast), .m_axis_tready(gen_tready)
   49 |     );
   50 | 
   51 |     xgmii_tx_encoder u_tx_encoder (
   52 |         .clk(clk), .rst_n(rst_n),
   53 |         .s_axis_tdata(gen_tdata), .s_axis_tkeep(gen_tkeep),
   54 |         .s_axis_tvalid(gen_tvalid), .s_axis_tlast(gen_tlast), .s_axis_tready(gen_tready),
   55 |         .xgmii_txd(xgmii_txd), .xgmii_txc(xgmii_txc)
   56 |     );
   57 | 
   58 |     eth_rx_front_end_top #(.RUN_MODE(1)) u_front_end_dut (
   59 |         .clk(clk), .rst_n(rst_n),
   60 |         .xgmii_rxd(xgmii_txd), .xgmii_rxc(xgmii_txc),
   61 |         .fso_data_out(fso_data_out), .fso_valid(fso_valid), .fso_last(fso_last), .fso_ready(fso_ready),
   62 |         .refclk_p(1'b0), .refclk_n(1'b0), .reset(1'b0), .dclk(1'b0), .rxp(1'b0), .rxn(1'b0)
   63 |     );
   64 | 
   65 |     // Clock Generation 312.5 MHz (3.2ns period)
   66 |     initial begin
   67 |         clk = 1'b0;
   68 |         forever #1.6 clk = ~clk; 
   69 |     end
   70 |     
   71 |     // Payload Cycle Counter & [Rev 2.0] Segment Valid Bytes Tracker (For ETRI Proof)
   72 |     wire [10:0] seg_valid_bytes = u_front_end_dut.u_segmenter.seg_valid_bytes;
   73 |     reg  [15:0] payload_cycle_cnt;
   74 |     integer     completed_seg_cnt = 0;
   75 |     integer     fcs_verified_cnt  = 0;
   76 | 
   77 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   78 |         if (!rst_n) begin
   79 |             payload_cycle_cnt <= 16'd0;
   80 |             completed_seg_cnt <= 0;
   81 |             fcs_verified_cnt  <= 0;
   82 |         end else if (fso_valid && fso_ready) begin
   83 |             if ((payload_cycle_cnt == 16'd24) && (fso_data_out == 32'hDEAD_BEEF)) begin
   84 |                 fcs_verified_cnt <= fcs_verified_cnt + 1;
   85 |             end
   86 |             if (fso_last || (payload_cycle_cnt == 16'd474)) begin
   87 |                 $display(" [%0t] Segment %0d Completed (475 Words = 1900B) | Active Ethernet Bytes (seg_valid_bytes) = %0d B",
   88 |                          $time, completed_seg_cnt + 1, seg_valid_bytes);
   89 |                 completed_seg_cnt <= completed_seg_cnt + 1;
   90 |                 payload_cycle_cnt <= 16'd0;
   91 |             end else begin
   92 |                 payload_cycle_cnt <= payload_cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
   93 |             end
   94 |         end else begin
   95 |             payload_cycle_cnt <= 16'd0;
   96 |         end
   97 |     end
   98 | 
   99 |     // Simulation Scenario
  100 |     initial begin
  101 |         rst_n     = 1'b0;
  102 |         trigger   = 1'b0;
  103 |         fso_ready = 1'b1; // Framer is always ready
  104 |         target_frame_size = 16'd2000; // Force Jumbo Frame
  105 |         
  106 |         #100;
  107 |         rst_n = 1'b1;
  108 |         #50;
  109 |         
  110 |         $display("\n[%0t] SCENARIO: Firing TWO 2000-Byte Jumbo Frames Back-to-Back...", $time);
  111 |         
  112 |         // Fire Jumbo 1
  113 |         @(posedge clk); trigger = 1'b1; 
  114 |         @(posedge clk); trigger = 1'b0; 
  115 |         
  116 |         // Tunggu hingga generator hampir selesai mentransfer Jumbo 1 ke XGMII Encoder
  117 |         // 500 clocks * 3.2ns = 1600ns. Kita fire Jumbo 2 persis saat Jumbo 1 selesai,
  118 |         // memaksa XGMII Encoder membentuk IPG secara perangkat keras.
  119 |         #1610; 
  120 |         
  121 |         // Fire Jumbo 2
  122 |         @(posedge clk); trigger = 1'b1; 
  123 |         @(posedge clk); trigger = 1'b0;
  124 |         
  125 |         // Biarkan simulasi berjalan cukup lama agar padding selesai
  126 |         #6500;
  127 |         $display("\n=======================================================");
  128 |         $display(" FRONT-END JUMBO SEGMENTATION & ELASTIC FIFO REPORT");
  129 |         $display(" -> Total 475-Word Segments Emitted : %0d / 4", completed_seg_cnt);
  130 |         $display(" -> 2000th-Byte FCS (0xDEADBEEF) OK : %0d / 2 Jumbo Packets", fcs_verified_cnt);
  131 |         if (completed_seg_cnt == 4 && fcs_verified_cnt == 2)
  132 |             $display(" -> RESULT: [PASS] ZERO DROPPED PACKETS & EXACT 1900B/100B SPLIT!");
  133 |         $display("=======================================================\n");
  134 |         $finish;
  135 |     end
  136 | endmodule

    1 | `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2 | /*
    3 | ===========================================================================
    4 | Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 | Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 | Module Name  : tb_eth_tx_back_end_top
    7 | Description  : Standalone Verification Testbench for eth_tx_back_end_top.v
    8 |                (eth_mac_packing_tx + xgmii_tx_formatter) at 312.5 MHz.
    9 | 
   10 |                Revision History:
   11 |                - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Basic stimulus testbench for eth_tx_back_end_top.
   12 |                - Rev 1.1 (2026-10-22 07:09 KST) :
   13 |                  1. Preserved original module/instance names and port structure.
   14 |                  2. Upgraded input stimulus to feed an authentic 502-word 
   15 |                     (2008-Byte) Ethernet frame (2 words [8B] Preamble 
   16 |                     0x55555555_555555D5 + 500 words [2000B] Jumbo Ethernet 
   17 |                     Packet ending in FCS 0xDEADBEEF).
   18 |                  3. Added zero-lag waveform counters for input (in_word_cnt 
   19 |                     1..502, in_byte_cnt 4..2008) and XGMII output 
   20 |                     (xgmii_word_cnt 1..503, xgmii_byte_cnt 4..2012).
   21 | ===========================================================================
   22 | */
   23 | 
   24 | module tb_eth_tx_back_end_top();
   25 |     reg clk;
   26 |     reg rst_n;
   27 |     reg [31:0] data_in;
   28 |     reg        en;
   29 |     
   30 |     wire [31:0] xgmii_txd;
   31 |     wire [3:0]  xgmii_txc;
   32 |     wire        txp_unused, txn_unused;
   33 | 
   34 |     // Zero-lag Input & Output Counters for Waveform Verification
   35 |     reg  [15:0] in_word_cnt;
   36 |     reg  [15:0] in_byte_cnt;
   37 |     reg  [15:0] raw_xgmii_idx;
   38 |     wire        xgmii_active   = (xgmii_txd != 32'h0707_0707);
   39 |     wire [15:0] xgmii_word_cnt = xgmii_active ? (raw_xgmii_idx + 16'd1) : 16'd0; // 1..503
   40 |     wire [15:0] xgmii_byte_cnt = xgmii_active ? ((raw_xgmii_idx + 16'd1) * 16'd4) : 16'd0; // 4..2012
   41 | 
   42 |     eth_tx_back_end_top #(
   43 |         .RUN_MODE (1)
   44 |     ) uut (
   45 |         .clk       (clk),
   46 |         .rst_n     (rst_n),
   47 |         .data_in   (data_in),
   48 |         .en        (en),
   49 |         .xgmii_txd (xgmii_txd),
   50 |         .xgmii_txc (xgmii_txc),
   51 |         .refclk_p  (1'b0),
   52 |         .refclk_n  (1'b1),
   53 |         .reset     (~rst_n),
   54 |         .dclk      (clk),
   55 |         .txp       (txp_unused),
   56 |         .txn       (txn_unused)
   57 |     );
   58 | 
   59 |     always #1.6 clk = ~clk; // 312.5 MHz (Period = 3.2 ns)
   60 | 
   61 |     integer i;
   62 | 
   63 |     initial begin
   64 |         clk         = 0;
   65 |         rst_n       = 0;
   66 |         data_in     = 32'd0;
   67 |         en          = 0;
   68 |         in_word_cnt = 16'd0;
   69 |         in_byte_cnt = 16'd0;
   70 |         
   71 |         #20;
   72 |         rst_n = 1;
   73 |         repeat (10) @(posedge clk);
   74 | 
   75 |         // Simulation of input from ethernet_frame_reassembly (Exact 2008 Byte = 502 cycles:
   76 |         // 8 Byte Preamble + 2000 Byte Ethernet Jumbo Package)
   77 |         for (i = 0; i < 502; i = i + 1) begin
   78 |             @(posedge clk);
   79 |             en          <= 1'b1;
   80 |             in_word_cnt <= i[15:0] + 16'd1;
   81 |             in_byte_cnt <= (i[15:0] + 16'd1) * 16'd4;
   82 | 
   83 |             case (i)
   84 |                 0:   data_in <= 32'h5555_5555; // Preamble Word 1 (Bytes 1..4)
   85 |                 1:   data_in <= 32'h5555_55D5; // Preamble + SFD Word 2 (Bytes 5..8)
   86 |                 2:   data_in <= 32'hDA01_0203; // Dest MAC [47:16]
   87 |                 3:   data_in <= 32'h0405_5A01; // Dest MAC [15:0] + Src MAC [47:32]
   88 |                 4:   data_in <= 32'h0203_0405; // Src MAC [31:0]
   89 |                 5:   data_in <= 32'h0800_4500; // EtherType IPv4 (0x0800)
   90 |                 11:  data_in <= 32'h4B6F_6F6B; // ASCII "Kook"
   91 |                 12:  data_in <= 32'h6D69_6E20; // ASCII "min "
   92 |                 13:  data_in <= 32'h4653_4F20; // ASCII "FSO "
   93 |                 501: data_in <= 32'hDEAD_BEEF; // 502nd Word (Byte 2008): Ethernet FCS
   94 |                 default: data_in <= 32'hA0A0_B0B0 + i;
   95 |             endcase
   96 |         end
   97 | 
   98 |         // stop send
   99 |         @(posedge clk);
  100 |         data_in     <= 32'd0;
  101 |         en          <= 1'b0;
  102 |         in_word_cnt <= 16'd0;
  103 |         in_byte_cnt <= 16'd0;
  104 | 
  105 |         #100;
  106 |         $finish;
  107 |     end
  108 | 
  109 |     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  110 |         if (!rst_n)
  111 |             raw_xgmii_idx <= 16'd0;
  112 |         else if (xgmii_active)
  113 |             raw_xgmii_idx <= raw_xgmii_idx + 16'd1;
  114 |         else
  115 |             raw_xgmii_idx <= 16'd0;
  116 |     end
  117 | 
  118 | endmodule

   38 | module tb_fso_deframer_payload();
